title: down syndrome awareness campaigns
texto:
down syndrome awareness campaigns the canadian down syndrome society  cdss  has launched a powerful national awareness campaign titled  it was never okay  forward not backward  ahead of world down syndrome day on march 21  2025  this initiative aims to draw attention to the systemic barriers that continue to hinder the rights and opportunities of individuals with down syndrome in canada 

through a compelling photo series created in collaboration with photographer hilary gauld  the  it was never okay  forward not backward  campaign highlights five key advocacy priorities   education  healthcare  employment  housing  and recreation  each image pairs a critical issue with a call to action  urging canadians to sign a petition that supports these advocacy efforts  the powerful national awareness campaign also seeks to influence political discourse ahead of the upcoming election 

image credit  canadian down syndrome society

title: chamoy inspired pickle snacks
texto:
chamoy inspired pickle snacks van holten s  the brand behind the popular pickle in a pouch  has teamed up with chamoy mega to introduce a bold new snack that certainly has the potential to go viral   the van holten s x chamoy mega pickle 

this collaboration combines van holten s expertise in creating convenient  flavorful pickles with chamoy mega s authentic mexican inspired chamoy  the result is a unique fusion of spicy  salty  and tangy flavors  the product s convenience and portability further enhance its appeal  packaged in van holten s signature single serve pouch  the chamoy mega pickle is ideal for on the go snacking 

the van holten s x chamoy mega pickle is designed to cater to the growing consumer demand for globally inspired snacks  particularly those influenced by mexican cuisine  it also consciously aims to capitalize on the viral popularity of chamoy pickles across social media platforms like tiktok and instagram 

image credit  van holten s x chamoy mega

title: earthy protein breads
texto:
earthy protein breads the  profusion organic protein bread  offers a plant based loaf that combines the robust flavours of rye and flax  delivering a nutty taste that becomes even more pronounced when toasted 

each 100g serving offers 20 1g of protein and 11 4g of fiber  making it an ideal choice for those seeking to boost their protein intake without compromising on taste  the bread s low carbohydrate content  at just 14 4g per 100g  caters to individuals following low carb or ketogenic diets 

crafted from organic ingredients  including whole grain rye flour  wheat protein  and flax seeds  this bread aligns with sustainable and health focused lifestyles  its dense  seedy texture provides a satisfying chew  and toasting enhances its flavor profile  offering a versatile base for various toppings  consumers have praised its taste and nutritional benefits  noting its ability to keep them feeling full longer 

image credit  profusion

title: festive french fry events
texto:
festive french fry events jameson irish whiskey and chain house collaborated to create  the french fry showdown   a unique st  patrick s day themed event in los angeles that combined gourmet food  innovative cocktails  and an immersive brand experience 

 the french fry showdown  featured an all you can eat french fry feast and emphasized variety   from shoestring  crinkle cut  and waffle to curly and wedge fries  the snackable food was served alongside creative sauces and seasonings like jameson irish whiskey bbq  hot cheeto dust  and black garlic ranch  attendees of the st  patrick s day themed event were invited to sample and rate the fries  with the winning fry revealed at the end  the experience was complemented by a selection of jameson based cocktails  including the minty mockrock slushie and the lucky root whiskey root beer  as well as non alcoholic options like the pi day mocktail  there was also a caviar station and a custom ice luge 

image credit  jameson irish whiskey and chain house

title: text recognition tools
texto:
text recognition tools word detection is a tool designed to quickly locate and highlight specific words in real time camera views or uploaded images  it allows users to scan printed text  digital documents  or images  making it useful for professionals handling large amounts of information 

the tool enhances efficiency by eliminating the need for manual searches  offering immediate results with high accuracy  it can be applied in various fields  including document review  language translation  and educational settings  users simply point their camera at text or upload an image  and the tool instantly highlights the searched words  by integrating advanced text recognition technology  word detection provides a practical solution for those needing to extract key information quickly  this makes it valuable for researchers  students  and professionals dealing with extensive text based data 

image credit  word detection

title: auto brand supported soccer tournaments
texto:
auto brand supported soccer tournaments volkswagen canada has announced a significant partnership with canada soccer  becoming the organization s exclusive automotive sponsor  this collaboration underscores volkswagen s commitment to fostering the growth of soccer across canada   from grassroots initiatives to the national stage  with a history of supporting canadian soccer  including its involvement with the canadian premier league since 2019  volkswagen aims to leverage its resources and brand influence to further elevate the sport s profile in the country 

the collaboration also offers tangible benefits for soccer enthusiasts and volkswagen customers alike  through initiatives like the volkswagen fc  game changers program  which has donated over  70 000 to community soccer projects  the brand has already made a meaningful impact on local soccer development  this partnership is likely to expand such efforts  providing more opportunities for young players  coaches  and fans to engage with the sport 

the partnership between the automaker and canada soccer comes at a pivotal time  as the country prepares to co host the fifa world cup in 2026  an event expected to significantly boost soccer s popularity and participation nationwide 

image credit  volkswagen canada

title: hot honey inspired burger menus
texto:
hot honey inspired burger menus red robin gourmet burgers embraces the growing trend of hot honey infusions in the food industry through a partnership with the original and leading brand of hot honey  mike s hot honey   together  the two businesses have introduced a mouthwatering hot and sweet menu collaboration that will be available to guests on march 24th 

the red robin gourmet burgers x mike s hot honey  collaboration features three main menu items  these include the hot honey crispy chicken sandwich  the hot honey pepperoni pizza  and the hot honey wings  the delectable dishes emphasize interesting flavor combinations  for example  the hot honey crispy chicken sandwich is enhanced with green chili aioli  fresh jalapeño  and shredded cabbage mix  the hot honey wings  on the other hand  are topped with red pepper flakes 

image credit  red robin gourmet burgers x mike s hot honey

title: branded happiness focused studies
texto:
branded happiness focused studies garmin  in partnership with researchers from harvard university  the university of oxford  and other institutions  has unveiled preliminary findings from a pioneering study exploring the connections between happiness  health  and lifestyle  this ambitious research initiative is known as the health and happiness study 

the study utilizes garmin smartwatches and smartphones to collect data on physical activity  sleep patterns  and emotional states  the goal is to identify key factors that influence wellbeing  the pilot phase of the health and happiness study has already yielded significant insights  revealing strong correlations between daily exercise  sufficient sleep  and higher levels of happiness  as well as reduced stress  these early results  while requiring further validation through a larger global study  highlight the potential of wearable technology to provide actionable insights into mental and physical health 

image credit  garmin

title: groundbreaking body hydrating products
texto:
groundbreaking body hydrating products hydrinity accelerated skin science has introduced encore body hydrator  a groundbreaking product designed to redefine body care by addressing hydration and skin health with innovative technology  this new offering marks the brand s strategic entry into the dermatological body care market 

the encore body hydrator is formulated with supercharged hyaluronic acid  this key ingredient is known for its ability to retain moisture  hydrinity accelerated skin science adds a proprietary blend of vegan collagen peptides  antioxidants  and high performance actives to the mix  as well  these components work synergistically to deliver deep nourishment  firming  and rejuvenation while targeting the unique challenges of body skin absorption for long lasting results 

in a clinical study involving 20 participants  encore body hydrator demonstrated significant improvements in skin hydration  texture  and firmness within just two weeks  notably  90  of participants reported long lasting hydration and improved skin texture  while 80  observed a reduction in dryness and enhanced radiance  additionally  70  noted visibly firmer skin 

image credit  hydrinity accelerated skin science

title: scent based breakfast experiences
texto:
scent based breakfast experiences the breakfast experience at lettnerhof donauhotel is designed to provide guests with a high quality and satisfying start to their day  the hotel offers a first class breakfast buffet that includes a variety of fresh fruits  refreshing fruit juices  aromatic coffee  fragrant bread  and fragrant keo tea  guests can also enjoy a selection of freshly baked bread  fine spreads  and wholesome cereals  the emphasis on using high quality ingredients ensures that the breakfast is both nutritious and enjoyable for all guests 

in addition to the diverse food and beverage options  the breakfast at lettnerhof donauhotel is served in an elegant and serene atmosphere  the bright panoramic café  adorned with mediterranean balustrades  offers a unique setting for guests to enjoy their meal while taking in the picturesque views of the danube river  the combination of a well curated breakfast menu and a tranquil dining environment creates a memorable and indulgent breakfast experience for guests at lettnerhof donauhotel 

image credit  lettnerhof donauhotel

title: fragrance focused resort meals
texto:
fragrance focused resort meals the breakfast at central resort flachau s glückskind restaurant offers a diverse and carefully curated selection of dishes designed to provide guests with a delightful start to their day  the breakfast buffet features a variety of options  including crispy bread rolls  cereals  and special egg dishes  fresh fruits and an assortment of beverages  such as aromatic coffee  fragrant tea  and refreshing juices  are also available  the buffet is designed to cater to different tastes and preferences  ensuring that all guests leave satisfied and ready for the day s adventures 

in addition to the wide range of food and drink options  the breakfast experience at glückskind restaurant is enhanced by the attention to detail and the inviting atmosphere  the use of colorful children s tableware makes breakfast an enjoyable experience for younger guests  while adults can savor their meals in a relaxed setting  the breakfast buffet can be booked in advance or added spontaneously during the stay  providing flexibility for guests  overall  the breakfast at central resort flachau aims to create a memorable and enjoyable start to the day for all visitors 

image credit  shutterstock

title: fragrant singaporean breakfast restaurants
texto:
fragrant singaporean breakfast restaurants pang pang kopi  located in singpost centre  offers a unique vegetarian breakfast experience that has garnered attention for its aromatic offerings  the menu features a variety of signature drinks and toast creations  including the pang pang waterfall kopi  a frosty mug of 100  robusta coffee with a creamy  frothy finish  toast enthusiasts can enjoy the signature kopi bun  which boasts a crispy exterior  fluffy interior  and a rich blend of dark roast coffee  homemade kaya  and butter  for a softer alternative  the steamed bun offers a pillowy texture and creamy kaya  providing a nostalgic touch  these breakfast items are often paired with soft boiled eggs to complete the traditional experience 

the ambiance of pang pang kopi is designed to evoke a sense of nostalgia  with retro inspired interiors featuring earthy tones  vintage style tiled floors  and wooden furniture  this setting  combined with the irresistible aroma of the coffee brews  creates an inviting atmosphere that encourages patrons to relax and linger  the restaurant s emphasis on fragrant and flavorful dishes has left many consumers saying  jin pang ah   which means  fragrant  in hokkien  overall  pang pang kopi provides a delightful breakfast experience that blends tradition with innovation  making it a popular destination for both locals and visitors 

image credit  pang pang kopi

title: mascot approved deodorant campaigns
texto:
mascot approved deodorant campaigns dove s men care full body deodorant  is changing the game in men s care  proving that odour protection goes beyond just the armpits  with only 1  of sweat originating from underarms  dove men care is tackling full body freshness with a dermatologist tested formula designed for pits  privates  feet  and beyond    keeping men fresh  comfortable  and confident for up to 72 hours 

to put its power to the test  dove men care enlisted the one toronto icon who sweats the most    none other than the toronto raptors  beloved mascot  the raptor  from high flying court stunts to a night out on the town  the raptor took the deodorant on a full body sweat challenge  proving its all day odor protection in real time  whether in action packed arenas or packed subway cars  the raptor stayed fresh  inviting fans to put it to the sniff test 

available in spray and stick formulas with soothing scents like shea butter   cedar and marine   blue cypress  dove men care full body deodorant is now at major retailers 

image credit  dove

title: green tile garden studios
texto:
green tile garden studios local design firm delve architects uses glazed green tiles when creating the kim oflage garden studio  the tiles come together to create a camouflage look that blends in perfectly with the surrounding trees and bushes  the name of the garden blends the clients  names together  kit and imogen  and camouflage  th garden studio reflects the previous extension and replaces black timber cladding with the glazed tiles and green window frames 

designer philip russel speaks more about the design to dezeen  noting  given the narrow  confined nature of the site at the end of the garden  with neighbors on both sides  we aimed to reduce the visual mass with a dual pitched roof and green tiled facade blending into the garden  our aim was to foster a seamless connection between the home and garden  blending in with its surrounding environment and providing an environment for work  relaxation  and leisure  

image credit  fred howarth

title: bra preserving 3d printed hangers
texto:
bra preserving 3d printed hangers joyce lai is an industrial designer based in chicago and she has created the bras up hanger  it is a 3d printed structure that is made with the goal of increasing the lifespan of a bra  bras up is made from recycled resin and stainless steel with components including side clips and a loop at the bottom 

lai speaks more on the design   while some existing products incorporate a similar bulging structure  they often require users to hang bras upright   a method that fails to provide proper support and can lead to misshaping  bras up eliminates this issue by allowing bras to be hung only in the correct  upside down position  ensuring they dry without strain on the fabric or cup structure

title: limited ceramic poker sets
texto:
limited ceramic poker sets american artist daniel arsham has created the wpt arsham poker set  this is a limited poker game set made for the world poker tour defined by its ceramic poker chips and signature artist colors with linen cards  arsham explains more on the  relic  aspect   the collaboration was an opportunity to push the boundaries of a traditional poker set  through materials  texture and form  i wanted each element to evoke a sense of refinement and permanence  a testament to the culture and energy of the poker world  

ceo asam pliska chose arsham for this project because it was important to merge the timelessness of the game while also bringing attention to how it evolves  pliska tells dezeen   every detail of the design  from the unique colour palette to the curved dealer button and classical statuary inspired face cards embodies the dual nature of poker  a game steeped in tradition and history  yet constantly evolving  it s this balance of beauty  function and heritage that makes the set truly special  

image credit  daniel arsham

title: retro singaporean coffee experiences
texto:
retro singaporean coffee experiences chin mee chin confectionery  established in 1925  offers a nostalgic breakfast experience that reflects its rich heritage  located in the katong area of singapore  this historic coffee shop is renowned for its traditional offerings  including kaya toast  soft boiled eggs  and kopi  the kaya toast  a signature dish  features a generous spread of house made kaya  coconut jam  on freshly toasted bread  often accompanied by a slab of butter  the soft boiled eggs are served with a dash of soy sauce and white pepper  providing a simple yet flavorful start to the day  the coffee  brewed using a traditional sock filter  is robust and aromatic  complementing the breakfast items perfectly 

the ambiance of chin mee chin confectionery adds to the overall experience  with its vintage decor and old school charm  the shop s interior features marble topped tables  wooden chairs  and tiled floors  reminiscent of a bygone era  the walls are adorned with photographs and memorabilia that tell the story of the coffee shop s long history  despite modern renovations  the establishment has retained its classic appeal  attracting both locals and tourists who seek an authentic taste of singapore s culinary past  the combination of traditional food and nostalgic atmosphere makes chin mee chin confectionery a cherished destination for breakfast enthusiasts 

image credit  shanti c k

title: modern interpreted english homes
texto:
modern interpreted english homes london design firm threefold architects has refreshed the eight gables home in a way that reimagines a modern angle  the team blends red brick and timber materials at the home located in whitstable  kent by replacing the former dwelling  it maintains the original tudor style which is notably prevalent in the areas as well  the influence informs the layout of the home as the living areas have a pinwheel organization around a central fireplace 

ryan hakimian  associate at threefold architects notes   reinterpreting the local historic tudor architecture of the area was both an exciting opportunity and a serious challenge  as we had to create a contemporary and sustainable home which respects the historical context while also avoiding pastiche  we identified from the outset some key features of historic tudor architecture that we wanted to incorporate  an expressed timber post and beam structure  a spatial arrangement around a central fireplace  and a strong connection to a mature garden setting  

image credit  charles hosea

title: abstract face artful rugs
texto:
abstract face artful rugs designer jaime hayon has created the base foundation of the talk talk rug series for nanimarquina defined by its abstract face artwork seen from a profile perspective  the design brings attention to the postmodern element of interiors  this is notably the fifth rug collection between hayon and the spanish brand 

there are two different designs of the talk talk    one which faces left and the other facing right  the studio notes   talk talk is a collection born from the work of the artist jaime hayon  where the relationship between art and design is explored through his iconic faces  as playful as they are expressive   the rugs are designed so that they can be used along or in multiples 

image credit  jaime hayon

title: collaborative earthy tonal shoes
texto:
collaborative earthy tonal shoes new balance works in collaboration with stone island to bring a new look to its made in usa 998 sneaker model with the launch of the raso gommato colorway palette  the classic silhouette was first launched in 1993 and was the first to feature the very iconic abzorb cushioning 

the new version is inspired by the iconic raso gommato fabric by stone island  this is a satin weave cotton that is military rooted and finished with a polyurethane coating  the material was first unveiled in 1984 by massimo osti  since then  the material has been a staple in stone island s aesthetics  this makes up the shoe s upper before it is complemented by nubuck overlays and reflective accents 

image credit  stone island  new balance

title: sleek slim collaborative footwear
texto:
sleek slim collaborative footwear new balance works in collaboration with junya watanabe man to launch the new minimus ux200 model  it is set to drop officially on march 21 and comes in two colorway palettes  the sneaker rests on a flat sole unit and boasts a slim silhouette 

the japanese designer has modernized the model and it was first presented to the public during the brand s spring summer 2025 runway show  the minimus ux200 is one of the most slim silhouettes by new balance  which often pushes chunkier models  the upper is made from mixed textiles with a blend of mesh  synthetic taping  and leather  this build also enhances the lightweight feel at the sole with a triangular cage at the toe box 

image credit  junya watanabe man  new balance

title: sneaker fused ceramic exhibitions
texto:
sneaker fused ceramic exhibitions roberto lugo is an activist and artist based in philadelphia and he is also behind the drip exhibition located at new york s r   company  the ceramic works by lugo explore the symbolic relationship that lies between design  art  and culture  he integrates elements of classic pottery with modern street styles  the drip exhibition brings attention to the nike air force 1s as it is a symbol in basketball and hip hop culture during the 80s and 90s it showcases the hand painted sneakers with his teapots 

this captures the blend of street fashion with the dropping visuals of the ceramic glaze  drip also goes beyond the cultural elements and explores notions of justice and glass by rethinking the very idea of  cultural value  and consumption through the eras  the gallery notes   by fusing black cultural history with centuries old ceramic traditions  lugo redefines these objects   the sneaker and the teapot   as meaningful symbols of identity and collective culture  

image credit  roberto lugo  r   company

title: bright color based spring fashion
texto:
bright color based spring fashion locally made japanese fashion brand vowels is launching its third instalment designed for the spring summer 2025 season  it is designed by its creative director yuki yagi and the core of the capsule builds on this year s color trends  the seasonal range is led by hues of olive green  deep blue  cherry red  and burnt orange 

the collection made its original debut last 06   during paris fashion week  the looks nod to its own archives as yugi wanted to recreate  products that go well with any outfit you own and allow you to keep running in your lane   the capsule fuses the core designs of the brand with relaxed silhouettes decorated with bold statement patterning  this is exemplified by classic polos  for example  which are detailed with a wavy stripe pattern 

image credit  vowels

title: rapper signature dynamic footwear
texto:
rapper signature dynamic footwear puma continues to grow its work alongside rapper a ap rocky as the two highlight the new mostro disccord model  this is his latest signature model and it boasts a triple black colorway palette with an archival tech making up its build  additionally  the mostro disccord also has a modern finish with the bio geotesk  it is designed in partnership with jon tang  who is the lead sportstyle footwear designer at puma 

the sneaker is essentially a modern refresh of the rapper s favorite archival style  the puma mostrol  it is then joined by the brand s adored signature disc system  now the mostro disccord joins his expanding range of designs at puma  rocky notes on the collaboration   i m learning how to feed my inner designer and to put out things that i believe are cool  i always think of doing things from a subversive point of view  

image credit  puma

title: origami inspired laptop stands
texto:
origami inspired laptop stands lenovo introduces the origami x9 sleeve  which addresses the common issue of pain points especially when working over long periods of time  this is a solution that transforms the structure from a protective case into an ergonomic stand  the sleeve is meant for the x9 accessory ecosystem and it fits perfectly with the lenovo x9 notebooks with its origami like fold 

this elevates the laptop so that it stands at a more comfortable viewing angle when it is necessary  when it is no longer in use  users can fold up the flats and pack them up within seconds  what stands out about the origami x9 sleeve is the intentional engineering as it also features smart features including non slip textures and hidden magnetic buttons 

image credit  lenovo

title: elderly catered journal concepts
texto:
elderly catered journal concepts arushi srivastava and soham chatterjee are the creative minds who conjured up the dual screen journal concept  it is a solution that addresses the challenges that come with traditional memory keeping  by keeping handwritten journals and photo albums through generations  there seems to be lacking some sense of connectivity whereas smartphones and digital experiences speak only to the newer generations and less of the older generation 

the journal bridges the gap by imitating the feeling of physically writing in a notebook and jotting down memories  it fuses with digital sharing by creating a platform to preserve memories in a way that feels deep and modern  when it is unfolded  the two screens appear like a writing surface 

image credit  arushi srivastava  soham chatterjee

title: elevated modern 4k projectors
texto:
elevated modern 4k projectors benq introduces a look at the new gp520 projector which is a premium home cinema projection that is made to deliver an effortless experience  the gp520 is full of entertainment features and adaptive imaging  the most notable feature is the adaptability of the projector with 2600 ansi lumens 

the device is meant for open plan living spaces with an integrated adaptive picture system to elevate the experience even further  this way  it can adjust the image based on the wall color  the room layout  and lighting conditions  the experience is very simple  users do not need any dedicated room for the experience or blackout curtains  simply turn on the device  and it will adjust the variables accordingly 

image credit  benq

title: space rocket inspired timepieces
texto:
space rocket inspired timepieces unimatic works in collaboration with massena lab on the special u1 spg  nasa artemis  limited edition  this is a captivating timepiece that celebrates humanity s return to working on more lunar exploration whilst also delivering elevated watch components  the design is led by a burnt orange hue which is also aligned with the space launch system rocket by nasa 

there are only 99 pieces available throughout the globe with the addition of official nasa endorsements  in terms of the specs  the watch has a 40mm stainless steel case which is finished with the aforementioned burnt orange  following this is the ceramic based coating which ensures that it remains durable with the hardness of 9 on the mohs scale 

image credit  unimatic  massena lab

title: artfully dynamic vessels
texto:
artfully dynamic vessels devin wilde is a ceramicist based in brooklyn and he explains his creative process   i find working with clay to be therapeutic  good for the soul  it s inherently imperfect  also kind and forgiving  it helps me work through perfectionist tendencies that are unkind to myself   more than other mediums i ve explored 

it s simply how i want to spend my day   his work ranges from dynamic art forms to simple silhouettes which speaks for itself  these are all hand built first by using a blend of clay and an aggregate that is known as  grog   this will help with supporting the overall structure  then it would create some texture  preserve the linework  and help with drying 

image credit  devin wilde

title: high rise tokyo apartments
texto:
high rise tokyo apartments the morandi i apartment located in akasaka is the result of the creative work between molteni designer nicola gallizia and apollo architects   associates  the duo transforms what would usually blend into the background  cabinets and other storage units into the defining element of the home 

the storage space is a big element of the molteni brand and the two ensure it becomes the root of this architectural experience  what makes this stand out in the morandi i apartment is how it would function with the rest of the home  it simultaneously works as the room divider  circulation guide  and exhibition space  when guests come into the family room  they are met by a visual representation as the cabinets are the gallery walls and spatial delineator as well 

image credit  masao nishikawa

title: floral detailed baseball caps
texto:
floral detailed baseball caps new era works in collaboration with mlb to present the sakura pack  it is a series of team hats detailed with sakura blossom motifs  this includes the teams  the new york yankees  los angeles dodgers  san diego padres  and pittsburgh pirates  additionally  the series also has a custom new era logo 

across all fo the fitted caps 59fifty  followed by the unstructured 9twenty styles  which are notably adjustable    the team s logos are decorated with custom embroidery in pink and white which honor the japanese sakura flower  the season in which these bloom the most is between late march to early may  the collection also uses earthy tones across the styles to root itself in the natural inspiration 

image credit  new era

title: sustainable solar powered homes
texto:
sustainable solar powered homes australian brand tiny solar homes has designed the wanda  which is a single level home that can host up to four people  the exterior is made with a durable build in order to withstand all of the natural elements  the power is backed by solar elements as the panel is installed on the roof 

the wanda is made on top of a triple axle trailer and measures about 27 feet in length  other notable details include its aluminum finish and there is also an outdoor shower  the interior welcomes guests with the large double glass doors  bringing them into the bright living room  the living area is comprised of a sofa bed that sleeps two and entertainment with the wall mounted tv with concealed speakers 

image credit  tiny solar homes

title: iridescent tonal chair collections
texto:
iridescent tonal chair collections fritz hansen introduces the series 7 chair by arne jacobsen in the limited edition 7 14 am color palette to mark its 70th anniversary  the chair made its original debut back in 1955 and there are now five new colors as a part of the overarching ever the sevener campaign 

it celebrates seven decades of the chair to present the model in a new light  the name was inspired by what users would call the chair in an affectionate term  the 7 14 am color palette is dubbed after the danish light which emerges at dawn  the slight touch of iridescence can be seen with its pearlescent glow  the light shades include violet  pink  green  beige  and blue 

image credit  fritz hansen

title: sleep poverty awareness campaigns
texto:
sleep poverty awareness campaigns ikea canada introduces its sleepless lamp campaign  which brings awareness to the issue of sleep poverty  it has launched just in time for national sleep awareness month  the initiative brings attention to the reality that about half a million children across the nation struggle with getting enough sleep often due to poor living conditions 

at the core of the campaign is the interactive installation which reflects the fragmented sleep patterns of kids affected by the issue  by looking at real sleep data  the lamp will erratically flicker  this reflects the restlessness and elements that are caused by the lack of proper sleep environments and bedding  this is on display at scarborough town center from march 27 30 

image credit  ikea canada

title: nature connecting warm apartments
texto:
nature connecting warm apartments found in the heart of tel aviv is the urban refuge apartment designed by the team at baranowitz   kronenberg  it is located in the calm lenontin neighborhood and the progressive interior design redefines the way that users perceive the notion of compact urban living 

the apartment is deeply connected with nature as it doubles as a residence and a workspace  there is consistent use of wood throughout the home  and using this organic material presents an effortless warm  and tranquil feeling  this is perfectly paired with the delicate grain and natural luminosity of wood  the warm base stimulates creativity and makes it a great space to work over long hours without feeling very confined 

image credit  baranowitz   kronenberg

title: subtle blue modern laptops
texto:
subtle blue modern laptops the new apple macbook air grabs attention with its new tone    arriving in a sky blue palette  the 2025 model replaces the previous space gray option  the subtle changes elevate the model to a delicate hue that brings it closer to a lighter palette  beyond just the tonal update  the new macbook air is mostly unchanged  which is great for loyal users 

the ultra slim model is retained  continuing with the lightweight design  it comes in either 13 inch of 15 inch variations  the premium aluminum chassis makes up the laptop as well and continues the perfectly balanced elegance of its stylish look and sturdiness  on the edges of the laptop are two thunderbolt 4 ports and a magsafe 3 charging port 

image credit  apple

title: breakfast brand digital platforms
texto:
breakfast brand digital platforms kellogg  is pushing boundaries in how it connects with its consumers with the launch of kellogg s town  it is made in collaboration with markle  carat uk  and dentu creative  kellogg s town is a digital platform that fuses entertainment and personalized approaches to engaging with the brand  this offers a new and interactive way for families to kick off their day 

kellogg s town is now available in 23 european countries and an be accessed in 16 different languages  the immersive digital playground brings the iconic breakfast foods to life  users can play games including shelf shuffle  which boosts cognitive thinking  crafting with coco is another game that encourages families to repurpose cereal boxes into sustainable craft projects 

image credit  kelloggs

title: dynamic sculptrual research hubs
texto:
dynamic sculptrual research hubs the ragon institute functions as a hub that conducts research on infectious diseases including covid 19  it is deigned by local architecture studio payette with mass general  mit  and harvard university  the structure boasts a sculptural look with a doughnut shape making up the terrace and topped off by green roofs 

another standout feature is the research facility made with a v shaped silhouette  the studio notes more on the design   the design approach embraced the unusual triangular site as a singular object by floating the mass above a continuous band of landscape on all sides   the team adds   the building has been elevated above the floodplain  with protective measures for the below grade garage to mitigate against extreme weather events  

image credit  robert benson

title: creator focused game launches
texto:
creator focused game launches game developer ubisoft has unveiled the full roster of official siege x co streamers  featuring some of twitch s biggest names  including michael  shroud  grzesiek  hasan  hasanabi  piker  ludwig ahgren  and more 

originally announced during this year s six invitational  siege x promises to bring significant evolution to the tactical fps genre  notably  the game launch event will be streamed by over 200 content creators  some of whom will be playing live from atlanta  georgia  additionally  viewers who tune into the twitch stream can unlock exclusive in game drops by linking their ubisoft account 

the siege x showcase is set to take place in atlanta with a youtube livestream scheduled for march 13th at 10 am pt   1 pm et 

image credit  ubisoft

title: one legged luxury fashion jeans

title: state of the art road safety devices
texto:
state of the art road safety devices ddpai s z60 pro dashcam is presented as a state of the art road safety device that provides drivers with comprehensive coverage through advanced imaging and connectivity features 

equipped with sony starvis 2 sensors  the z60 pro delivers exceptional 4k video quality in both daylight and low light conditions  this is possible thanks to the realcube 2 0 and nightvis 2 0 technologies  the road safety device supports three channel recording and can capture footage from the front  rear  and interior of the vehicle  additionally  the z60 pro offers 4g connectivity  a free sim card  and a 90 day 30gb data trial to enable live streaming  remote access to recordings  and continuous surveillance 

advanced safety features  such as forward vehicle start alert and fatigue driving alerts  along with built in gps and a supercapacitor  make the z60 pro a reliable and customizable tool for modern drivers 

image credit  ddpai

title: easter inspired family apparel line
texto:

to amplify the appeal of its full family easter collection  rufflebutts   ruggedbutts also offers embroidered personalization options  the garments are perfect for easter celebrations  family photos  weddings  and other springtime events

title: comfort focused mammography chair designs
texto:
comfort focused mammography chair designs enable me  a tampa based company under vela medical  has achieved significant progress in improving mammography experiences with its fda approved vela mammography chair  this innovation is now available in hospitals and clinics across 33 states 

the vela mammography chair is designed to enhance patient comfort  safety  and imaging accuracy  its innovative features include electric height and tilt adjustments  foldable armrests for wheelchair transfers  and a stable platform that accommodates patients of varying sizes  including those weighing up to 350 pounds  additionally  the vela mammography chair has the potential to improve workflow efficiency by reducing technologist strain and enhancing clinic hygiene 

enable me aims to expand access to the vela chair to all 50 states by the end of 2025 

image credit  enable me

title: cryptocurrency investor focused loyalty programs
texto:
cryptocurrency investor focused loyalty programs prometheus  a leading ultra luxury real estate developer based in portugal  has introduced an innovative luxury real estate program tailored exclusively for cryptocurrency investors  the initiative will allow such individuals to purchase high end smart homes in madeira using digital assets 

the first of its kind luxury real estate program enables buyers to acquire properties at a future valuation of their chosen cryptocurrency  which could potentially double the current market value of their tokens  for example  if ethereum is valued at  3 300 per token  investors can secure a villa at  6 600 per token  this will effectively lock in a discounted price while enjoying immediate use of the property 

in addition to this crypto investor focused loyalty program  prometheus offers a buy now  pay later option  allowing investors to defer payment until the end of a bull run or over two years at 0  interest 

image credit  prometheus

title: adaptive humanoid robot systems
texto:
adaptive humanoid robot systems the google gemini 2 0 humanoid robotics system has been announced by the tech brand as a system that harnesses the power of artificial intelligence  ai  in new ways to help push robotics even further into its next phase  the system covers the vision  language and action aspects in a unified framework that would enable robots to respond to new tasks and environments without requiring extensive training  this speaks to the way that we could see robots becoming a more prominent place in the everyday landscape to help with general purpose systems and setups alike 

the google gemini 2 0 humanoid robotics system also prioritizes human like speed and efficiency  which would enable the robot to operate autonomously to further reduce reliance on human operators or administrators

title: oat based cold foam creamers
texto:
oat based cold foam creamers silk oat cold foam creamer is a new launch that promises to elevate plant based beverages prepared at home  unlike non dairy spray whip  this formula provides a foamy finish and flavors like white chocolate macadamia or cinnamon caramel 

perfect for recreating coffeehouse favorites at home  like cold brew or hot and cold lattes  silk oat cold foam creamer is made with a base of oat milk  cane sugar for a hint of sweetness  plus traces of additional ingredients like pea protein and baking soda 

when it comes to recreating cafe quality beverages at home  consumers are spoiled for their choice of alternative milks  whipped toppings and flavored syrups  and the silk oat cold foam creamer fills the gap in creating indulgently textured drinks without dairy

title: celebratory cold foam events
texto:
celebratory cold foam events scooter s coffee has announced the establishment of national cold foam day as part of the brand s commitment to helping those who have a penchant for the coffee topping  the event will take place on march 7  2025 and will see the brand giving away cold foam fan club stickers to fans who can use them to showcase their pride for the drink topping  the event also puts a spotlight on several of the cafe brand s offerings that include cold foams perfect for elevating the flavor or nutritional profile of any drink 

chief strategy officer malorie maddox spoke on the national cold foam day event saying   with so many flavors to choose from  our pillowy soft cold foam has the power to transform any of your scooter s coffee favorites into an entirely new and uniquely tasty experience  by establishing national cold foam day  we re inviting our customers to make their drink their own and put a new spin on their favorites  celebrate with us because you ve earned it  

image credit  scooter s coffee

title: alt cold foaming creams
texto:
alt cold foaming creams award winning oat coffee creamer brand sown debuted oat cold foaming cream as a convenient way for consumers to indulge in barista quality vanilla flavored cold foam from the comfort of home  there s a unique beauty in cafe crafted drinks thanks to skillful baristas who can create velvety textures and rich flavors that are often elusive when attempting to replicate the experience at home  leaving a sense of disappointment when the homemade versions lack that same indulgent quality  sown oat cold foaming cream offers a simple  affordable way to create cafe quality drinks  as it s ready to sit atop cold brew after just 30 seconds of frothing 

other than cold brew  sown s non gmo  gluten free oat cold foaming cream dairy alternative pairs well with decadent desserts like affogato and classic coffee cocktails like the espresso martini

title: protein packed coffee toppers
texto:
protein packed coffee toppers scooter s coffee wants to help guests up their protein intake and meet their fitness goals in 2025 with the debut of its new protein cold foam 

in the past few years  cold foam has become a popular topper for cold brew and other iced beverages  now  you can enjoy the same creamy coffee topper while getting an added serving of protein  in fact  each serving of scooter s new velvety vanilla cold foam is packed with a whopping 13 grams of protein  this new beverage boosting option can be added to any of scooter s cold drinks 

to up your protein intake even further  you can try the brand s new strawberry protein shake  which features creamy strawberry flavors and 22 grams of protein per serving 

image credit  scooter s coffee

title: cafe style foam toppers
texto:
cafe style foam toppers cold foam has become a must have for coffee lovers who want to elevate their at home brews  and the new dunkin  cold foam creamers deliver a crave worthy frothy texture that transforms everyday coffee into a sensorial  cafe quality experience 

while the chocolate flavor appeals to anyone with a love of anytime indulgence  the extra extra cold foam creamer was inspired by dunkin  customers   extra cream  extra sweet  order  prepared with real cream and sugar  the cold foam creamers enhance the experience of cold or hot coffee by gradually blending into the beverage while sipped 

dunkin  launched its cold foam creamers in extra extra and chocolate flavors alongside a limited edition dunkin  s mores flavored creamer at grocery retailers nationwide

title: black currant infused whiskeys
texto:
black currant infused whiskeys von payne spirits has announced a strategic partnership with premium brands of northwest arkansas  alongside the introduction of its unique black currant infused whiskey  von payne black  to the arkansas market 

von payne black has garnered a loyal following among whiskey enthusiasts and bartenders due to its bold flavor profile and iconic gargoyle pour spout  the innovative infusion of black currant certainly sets the expression apart from traditional whiskeys and the spirit has been recognized at the san francisco world spirits competition with a gold medal 

the collaboration with premium brands ensures that von payne black will be widely accessible through retail and on premise locations in arkansas  shawn harlan  vice president of sales   marketing at von payne spirit  shared   whiskey drinkers today are looking for more than just a great spirit they want a story  an experience  something that stands out  with premium brands  expertise and strong market presence  we re excited to introduce von payne black to northwest arkansas and continue our mission of bringing this one of a kind whiskey to more consumers nationwide  

image credit  von payne spirits

title: french vanilla protein powders
texto:
french vanilla protein powders qualify protein has expanded its lineup of high quality protein supplements with the launch of the creamy french vanilla whey protein powder  designed to support active lifestyles  this latest offering is formulated to delight the taste buds with a smooth  creamy texture and a rich vanilla flavor 

each serving of qualify protein s creamy french vanilla whey protein powder provides 25 to 26 grams of protein  alongside essential amino acids and branched chain amino acids  the formulation strives to aid muscle recovery  growth  and weight management  the product is gluten free  mixes easily with water  and is crafted to meet the needs of athletes at all levels  additionally  qualify protein s product is versatile as it can be beneficial in all stages of a workout   pre  during  and post exercise 

image credit  qualify protein

title: inaugural single malt whiskeys
texto:
inaugural single malt whiskeys hirsch selected whiskeys  which is under the umbrella of hotaling   co   has unveiled its first american single malt whiskey   the departure 

distilled entirely at hotaling   co  s original potrero hill facility in san francisco  this limited edition release is crafted from 100  maris otter malted barley  aged for over six years in new charred and toasted american oak barrels  and bottled at 49  abv  maris otter malted barley  in particular  is known for its rich  malty character  to maintain the exclusivity of this milestone  hirsch selected whiskeys has produced only 1 350 bottles for circulation 

the departure represents a bold shift for the brand  which is traditionally known for its bourbons  the release coincides with the recent establishment of official regulations for american single malt whiskey  which is a rapidly growing category in the spirits industry 

image credit  hirsch selected whiskeys

title: expansive luxury cruise experiences
texto:
expansive luxury cruise experiences silversea cruises  2028 world cruise is titled  an ode to the moment   this 132 day luxury voyage aboard the silver shadow will take travelers to 58 destinations across 29 countries and five continents 

an ode to the moment will depart from miami on january 5 and conclude in nice on may 16  the meticulously curated journey promises an immersive exploration of diverse cultures  histories  and landscapes  including visits to over 30 unesco world heritage sites  the 2028 world cruise itinerary is divided into nine thematic chapters  each offering unique experiences such as cultural immersions  wildlife encounters  and exclusive events  alongside optional overland tours for deeper discovery 

with a focus on slower  more meaningful travel  the cruise aims to provide guests with unparalleled access to both iconic landmarks and lesser known destinations  all while enjoying silversea s signature luxury and personalized service 

image credit  silversea cruises

title: next generation display systems
texto:
next generation display systems sony has unveiled its next generation display system  which features advanced signal processing technology that enables individual control of high density rgb led backlights  this innovation allows each red  green  and blue led to operate independently  which results in exceptional color purity and a wide color gamut 

by leveraging proprietary backlight control technology  the next generation display system achieves precise gradation and nuanced shading across the entire brightness spectrum  this makes sony s offerings ideal for both professional film production and home entertainment  the system supports over 99  of the dci p3 color space and approximately 90  of the bt 2020 standard  ensuring vibrant and true to life colors  additionally  its peak brightness of over 4000 cd m²  combined with dynamic power allocation for rgb channels  allows for vivid detail in both bright and dark scenes without compromising color accuracy 

the display s ability to faithfully reproduce subtle hues and intricate light variations ensures that creators  artistic visions are accurately conveyed  while viewers can enjoy a more immersive and lifelike visual experience 

image credit  sony

title: dynamic basketball informed marketing campaigns
texto:
dynamic basketball informed marketing campaigns mondel z international is making a significant return to march madness with a dynamic marketing campaign featuring ncaa athletes and engaging fan experiences  the company has enlisted college basketball stars juju watkins and jackson shelstad to headline a 30 second tv spot  alongside a roster of current and former ncaa athletes that will represent the company s popular snack brands  including oreo  ritz  chips ahoy   triscuit  and wheat thins  these athletes will serve as brand ambassadors  creating buzz and excitement around the tournament through social media content and interactive fan activities 

additionally  mondel z is offering fans the chance to win exclusive prizes   from vip trips to the 2026 ncaa men s or women s final four to autographed merchandise and personalized messages from athletes  consumers can take advantage of these contests through the brand s win time outz microsite 

image credit  mondel z international

title: nano pulsing beauty devices
texto:
nano pulsing beauty devices based on technology developed at nasa to maintain the skeletal structure of astronauts in space  uplift 5 is a breakthrough at home anti aging beauty device  this non invasive solution taps into the power of advanced u5 nano pulse technology and applies high frequency low magnitude vibration  hflmv  to reverse visible signs of aging with just five minutes of daily use 

this device offers a non invasive approach for enhancing facial bone structure  toning and sculpting facial muscles  and contouring and lifting facial and neck skin from within  as well as targeting hard to reach areas around the lips and eyes 

this doctor approved  patent pending technology goes beyond the surface and specifically impacts osteoblasts  cells that form new bone  and fibroblasts  cells in connective tissue  facial skin  and muscle

title: age statement whisky expressions
texto:
age statement whisky expressions kavalan distillery has introduced its first age statement whisky   the kavalan 15 years old single malt whisky   as part of its  time exploration  series  this limited edition release will be available in only 30 000 bottles globally  the launch is intended to celebrate nearly two decades of whisky making excellence since the distillery produced taiwan s first new make spirit in 2006 

the kavalan 15 years old single malt whisky is matured in a combination of ex bourbon  oloroso sherry  ruby port  and puncheon casks  the 2025 age statement whisky is bottled at 43  abv and is designed to highlight the depth and complexity achieved through years of careful aging and cask selection 

the packaging and presentation further enhance its appeal  the design features natural wood grain textures and gold foiled accents  additionally  the story behind the whisky   celebrating kavalan s journey and taiwan s emergence as a respected whisky producing region   adds a layer of cultural and historical significance that resonates with consumers interested in the heritage and craftsmanship of spirits 

image credit  kavalan distillery

title: botanical inspired beverages
texto:
botanical inspired beverages this spring  a fresh lineup of colorful  botanical inspired beverages are coming to starbucks reserve roasteries and stores in chicago  new york city  and seattle  purple is a common color across the lineup  whether it s just a touch on the lavender matcha malt or experienced from first sip to last with the iced ube coconut latte the first starbucks reserve coffee beverage made with ube  a journey with color also awaits with the citrus butterfly pea flower tea tasting journey  which takes after a classic starbucks reserve roastery tokyo flavor and delights with layers of sakura allure tea and a scoop of vanilla gelato 

alongside these colorful menu additions  customers can look forward to enjoying floral inspired treats like the rose pistachio twice baked cornetto and fig walnut ricotta toast  plus cocktails like the sakura blossom negroni and butterfly tea spritz

title: high protein pastas
texto:
high protein pastas at expo west 2025  yo mama s foods debuted its new high protein pasta  introducing a delicious product to pair with its sauces  the nutritious  high protein  high fiber pastas made from alubia beans and provide 18 grams of protein and 10 5 grams of fiber per 3 5 ounce serving  and they can be found in classic shapes like penne  fusilli  and elbow 

these gluten free  low glycemic pastas are satiating  replenishing and supportive of healthy digestion  offering an alternative to many pasta products on the market that leave people will feelings of discomfort or regret after eating 

also at the event  the brand showcased a refreshed vodka sauce featuring a richer  creamier  more flavorful formula perfect for coating its new bean based pasta  alternatively  other pairings may include basil and roasted garlic or classic alfredo

title: functional postbiotic beverages
texto:
functional postbiotic beverages as a new wave of better for you beverages dominates the soda category  asahi beverages america debuted refrezz at expo west 2025  these canned postbiotic beverages contain compounds that help with everything from supporting overall well being to relaxation  and sleep  these wellness sodas made with non fat milk are coming to consumers in flavors like lemon   ginger  blueberry   mint  and apple   rosemary 

in place of high sugar sodas  a new generation of consumers is reaching for sodas with functional benefits and value added ingredients like l 92  and cp2305  which is associated with both refreshing and supporting restful sleep 

although prebiotic beverages are immensely popular at the moment  a consumer might choose a postbiotic beverage instead because it contains beneficial compounds that are already fermented  making them easier for the body to absorb and digest 

image credit  dustin humes  unsplash

title: ai driven pet ecosystems
texto:
ai driven pet ecosystems pet madness is changing the pet industry for pet owners  brands  veterinarians  and service providers with a first of its kind ai driven pet ecosystem  the sparty ai system  set to be unveiled at the humanx ai conference  provides training advice  real time recommendations  plus tools for owners to track vet visits and medications from a central location 

 the pet industry is long overdue for a tech revolution   said alexa elliot  ceo of pet madness inc   for 37 years  my family ran a pet retail store  but like many small businesses  we lacked the resources to implement ai and cutting edge technology  

pet madness is also pioneering ai driven pet tech products like the matrix smart collar with gps tracking  health monitoring  and a virtual name tag  the charging leash  which charges smart collars and pet devices while walking  and soon  luxury swarovski crystal collars and leashes

title: amorous cosmetic ingredients
texto:
amorous cosmetic ingredients being in love is known to give people a fresh faced  radiant looking glow associated with the release of oxytocin  the love molecule  and glowcytocin is a first of its kind cosmetic ingredient that recreates the benefits of being in love 

the vegan ingredient of 99 8  natural origin is a blend of glycerin  water  and an extract derived from the bulbs of white hyacinth  as part of a placebo controlled clinical study of 60 male and female mixed ethnicity volunteers ages 18 to 65  twice daily application of glowcytocin for 28 days visibly and significantly enhanced the look of participants  skin  beyond boosting luminosity  the ingredient also influenced happiness and positive moods 

at the upcoming in cosmetics global show in amsterdam  the swiss canadian company behind the innovative ingredient  lucas meyer cosmetics  will launch glowcytocin

title: urban toronto sanctuaries
texto:
urban toronto sanctuaries nobu hotel toronto is set to open its doors in summer 2025  introducing a refined urban sanctuary in the heart of toronto s dynamic entertainment district 

this highly anticipated property will feature  36 exclusive rooms and suites  designed to offer a private and serene retreat for those seeking an escape from the bustling city life   located on  the top floors 41 to 45 of a mixed use development  the nobu hotel toronto will be the first luxury hotel in the city to occupy such a prime position  rising 45 stories above the skyline  

situated just one block from the toronto international film festival and a short walk from premier shopping  entertainment  sports venues  and iconic landmarks like the cn tower and scotiabank arena  the hotel offers unparalleled access to the city s vibrant culture  guests will enjoy breathtaking panoramic views of lake ontario and the toronto skyline  with accommodations that blend japanese inspired aesthetics with canadian craftsmanship  creating a sophisticated and tranquil atmosphere 

image credit  nobu hotel toronto

title: rtd protein cold brew lattes
texto:
rtd protein cold brew lattes healthee s protein cold brew lattes are ready to sip straight from the can and share functional benefits pus decadent  dessert like flavors with no added sugar  these stevia sweetened drinks were shown at expo west 2025  with the brand offering a look at varieties like bone collagen  sea salt caramel   joint collagen  chocolate   and skin  hair   nails collagen  french vanilla  

these protein cold brew lattes are made with micellular casein isolate and bioactive collagen peptides  and an eight ounce can contains 70 calories and 15 grams of protein 

these collagen lattes offer convenient  flavor focused alternatives to powdery drink mixes and chalky protein bars  making it easy for health conscious consumers to support their wellness goals on the go

title: refreshing protein drinks
texto:
refreshing protein drinks at a time when the probiotic soda category is booming and health conscious consumers can t get enough better for you beverages  protein pop is entering the market  powered by 20 grams of clear whey protein  these all natural  gluten free  lactose free canned drinks are said to be highly satiating and supportive of building lean muscle 

protein pop satisfies the demand for not only healthful drinks but also protein packed beverages that are light and refreshing as opposed to heavy  creamy options  gym goers and active individuals craving unique protein sources will soon be introduced to deliciously different non carbonated choices like protein pop in flavors like watermelon  peach  blue raspberry  and piña colada 

shown at natural products expo west 2025  protein pop comes in at 90 calories per 12 ounce slim can

title: large scale drone lightshows
texto:
large scale drone lightshows abu dhabi is preparing to debut an extraordinary drone lightshow  a bold step towards reinforcing its position as a leading global destination for culture and innovation  in partnership with colorado based nova sky stories and emirati company analog  known for its expertise in physical intelligence and mixed reality  this project aims to redefine large scale storytelling through state of the art drone technology 

this multi year collaboration will feature synchronized drone displays at some of abu dhabi s most iconic landmarks  merging the emirate s rich heritage with its forward looking vision  the performance will  showcase the world s most advanced fleet of 10 000 drones  a pioneering first for the region   the light shows will craft dynamic visual narratives  highlighting abu dhabi s cultural legacy while celebrating its ambitious future 

this remarkable initiative is designed not only to captivate audiences but to enhance tourism  offering an immersive and unforgettable experience 

image credit  department of culture and tourism   abu dhabi

title: futurist profile  zahra karim
texto:
futurist profile  zahra karim zahra karim  senior research advisor at trend hunter  recently spoke at future festival miami on how ai is transforming marketing  creativity  and consumer engagement 

with ai marketing expected to reach  107 5 billion by 2028  karim explored how brands can leverage ai for efficiency while preserving human creativity and authenticity  ai tools are revolutionizing data analytics  content creation  and social media marketing  but karim emphasized that ai enhances marketing    it doesn t replace the human touch 

she also addressed the growing need for authenticity  while 90  of marketers believe their content is authentic  many consumers disagree  exposing a trust gap ai alone cannot fix  brands like starbucks and virgin cruises have successfully integrated ai while maintaining emotional connection  showing that ai should support  not replace  human ingenuity 

karim highlighted emerging trends like ethical resonance and casualization  which reflect consumers  increasing demand for transparency  inclusivity  and value driven marketing  as ai reshapes the industry  businesses must balance efficiency with ethical engagement 

couldn t make it to future festival miami  join us in new york from 06   3 4 to explore ai  marketing  and future trends with top innovators from brands like netflix  google  and starbucks

title: savory breakfast cups
texto:
savory breakfast cups at expo west 2025  the pizza cupcake introduced its evolved identity  incredifulls  which will help the brand better offer bite sized products for eating occasions throughout the day  first thing in the morning  incredifulls breakfast cups are ready to savor  and varieties like egg   cheese with everything seasoning share a taste of rbst free cheese  cage free eggs and no artificial flavors or preservatives 

these protein packed bites with 150 calories per serving boast  secret dough  that all ages will fall in love with  this simple  snackable format promises to lend itself well to a variety of mini meals from day to night  allowing more freedom beyond the original pizza inspired cups  the official website for the savory gourmet snacks with flaky outer layers and cheesy insides launches soon

title: celebrative ice cream promotions
texto:
celebrative ice cream promotions in honor of its 85th anniversary  dairy queen is offering exciting cone and blizzard promotions to celebrate the season 

on  free cone day   thursday  march 20th  dq rewards members can receive a complimentary small vanilla cone by redeeming the offer in the dq app  additionally  participating locations will feature the  dip it for kids  initiative  allowing customers to add any dip to their cone for  1  with all proceeds benefiting local children s hospitals across canada through the children s miracle network  dips available include the classic  chocolate dip  and the new  crunchin  cookie dip   which features a blue candy coating mixed with cookies and cream bits 

from march 24th to april 6th  dq is also celebrating with an  0 85 mini  blizzard treat  offer available in the dq app with a  1 or more purchase  applicable to any blizzard flavor  including the  mint oreo blizzard  of the month 

image credit  dairy queen

title: transparent mint liqueurs
texto:
transparent mint liqueurs minty is a fresh  smooth  transparent mint liqueur from premium organic spirits brand pegasus distillerie and it shares the crisp refreshment of all organic mint grown and  handpicked from the alps  in all  this mint liqueur features three types of mint orange mint  japanese mint  and moroccan mint and no artificial flavors of colors  taste wise  minty is said to open with bright citrus notes that lead into the beautiful depth of japanese mint and finish with the warming comfort of moroccan mint 

 i like to refer to minty as an  après ritivo   said maxime girardin  founder and master distiller at pegasus distillerie   meaning whether you re just off the slopes  ending a padel match with friends or wrapping up a presentation at the office  minty is made for savoring all the little shared moments that spark joy in life

title: roguelike beat em up games
texto:
roguelike beat em up games absolum is an upcoming beat  em up game developed by dotemu  guard crush games  and supamonks  the game is set in the fictional world of talamh  where a magical cataclysm has led to the mistrust of magic among the common folk  the sun king azra has taken advantage of this situation by enslaving wizards through his crimson order and placing loyal princes to rule over the conquered realms  players will take on the role of outcast heroes who rise from the shadows to challenge azra s oppressive regime and restore magic to the land  absolum combines classic beat  em up gameplay with modern roguelite elements  offering fast paced action and endless replayability 

the game features a hand drawn aesthetic and allows players to choose between four characters  each with unique abilities and fighting styles  absolum supports both solo and cooperative play  with local and online co op options available  the game is set to be released on multiple platforms  including pc  nintendo switch  playstation 4  and playstation 5  sometime in 2025  dotemu  known for its work on streets of rage 4  aims to deliver a fresh and engaging experience with absolum  blending the nostalgia of classic beat  em ups with the depth and replayability of modern roguelites 

image credit  dotemu

title: space themed dog treats
texto:
space themed dog treats givepet introduced its first freeze dried dog treats  each of which is made with just a single ingredient and colorfully branded using space themed imagery referencing freeze dried astronaut food 

these nutrient packed  lightweight  and small batch formulas are designed for adventure ready pups  and like all other givepet treats  they re free from artificial colors  flavors and preservatives  while astromutt is a wild caught salmon treat  mars rover is a chicken breast treat  and space cowboy is a beef liver treat 

 we wanted to introduce freeze dried treat options for the plethora of benefits they provide for both pets and their owners   said givepet founder chris dennis   they have high nutritional value  require minimal processing and are a high reward treat   beyond treating pets and their owners  these peoducts help to give back by supporting animal shelters and rescue organizations

title: playful spring forward statements
texto:
playful spring forward statements this spring  marc jacobs unveils the  charm collection   a bold and vibrant line celebrating the season s fresh trends  drawing inspiration from the lively spirit of new york city  the collection features  sticker inspired graphics  optical illusion prints  and striking statement jewelry  all reflecting marc jacobs  signature vision  

key pieces include ready to wear items such as the  runway charm shirt  and  runway charm straight jean   offering a way to create a streamlined and bold look  accessories play a significant role in the collection  with  the sticker clover shoulder bag    the sticker canvas medium tote bag   and  the sticker patch mini bag  all making a statement   the sticker snapshot  and  the sticker chain shoulder strap  on the other hand  provide versatile options for both style and practicality  complementing these are  the sticker charm statement necklace  and  sticker charm earrings   completing the collection s playful  spring forward aesthetic 

image credit  marc jacobs

title: culinary battle games
texto:
culinary battle games cooking competition viewers who ve wondered if they could handle the heat in the kitchen will soon be able to put their culinary skills to the test with show me your chef  the world s first live action cooking competition board game  this experience for four to 12 participants can be played one on one in four teams or up to three per team  teams bring grocery lists  compete for ingredients  and race against the clock  just as they would on the set of a high action game show kitchen 

while junior chef mode is kid friendly  qr code invitation templates simplify hosting  the experience calls for a peer judging panel and provides a trophy  offering a fun way for foodies to try something new together and bond over time in the kitchen

title: smart tv party games
texto:
smart tv party games jackbox games  known for its popular party games  is set to launch a new app for smart tvs in mid 2025  this app will allow users to play a selection of jackbox s interactive games directly on their smart tvs  making it more accessible for players to enjoy these games on a larger screen  the app will initially offer a small collection of ad supported games for free  with plans to introduce a subscription fee for full access to the entire catalog of games  the service will be powered by aws gamelift streams  enabling the quick launch and streaming of games to various devices  including smart tvs and web applications 

the move to smart tvs is part of jackbox games  broader strategy to make its games more accessible and easy to play  until now  jackbox games have primarily been available on pcs and game consoles  requiring additional steps to play on a big screen  the new app aims to simplify this process and reach a wider audience  while specific details about supported smart tv models and pricing are not yet available  the company plans to release a beta version of the app on one or two smart tv platforms in the spring of 2025 

image credit  jackbox games

title: styling focused hair collections
texto:
styling focused hair collections the nexxus styling collection is here to change the game  bringing salon quality styling with the health of your hair at the forefront  whether you re perfecting a sleek bun  embracing frizz free curls  or achieving voluminous 90s inspired blowouts  nexxus delivers the tools you need without sacrificing hair integrity 

at the heart of this collection is styleprotect technology  a breakthrough innovation designed to protect strands from heat  humidity  and damage while keeping styles locked in place  from the  slick stick  for taming flyaways to the  epic shine anti humidity spray  that adds weightless gloss  each product is formulated for long lasting results without stiffness or buildup 

the collection also features the  volumizing mousse    blow dry frizz control cream   and  prep   protect heat defense spray   all designed to create trending looks while ensuring your hair stays strong and vibrant  with color safe  frizz fighting  and humidity resistant benefits  this launch is a must for beauty lovers who demand both style and hair health 
available now at major retailers  the nexxus styling collection brings professional grade performance to your everyday routine 

image credit  nexxus

title: signature cocktail experiences
