title: dermatology backed skincare coaches
texto:
dermatology backed skincare coaches spotscan  coach is a skincare digital coach app and the latest milestone from ustwo  a leading digital product studio harnessing ai to design impactful products that foster positive behavioral change  the app is created in collaboration with l oréal for its dermatologist backed skincare brand  la roche posay  the recently launched spotscan  coach delivers a personalized experience by merging dermatology backed skincare advice with daily support to help users build effective routines and gain confidence in their skin  uniquely  it also integrates mental health considerations  framing skincare as part of holistic wellness 

leading ever aspect of the app s creation  ustwo designed the user experience  interface  and overall aesthetic in alignment with la roche posay s design language  defining the coaching program and content strategy to ensure tailored  actionable  and consistently refreshed content for users  following a six week beta testing phase  spotscan  coach demonstrated that 90  of beta users reported feeling more motivated to stick to their skincare routines  additionally  74  experienced visible improvements in their skin 

as technology continues to shape the future in 2025  digital coaching emerges as a transformative force with immense potential and this project by ustwo is at the forefront of this innovation shift  spotscan  coach exemplifies the digital product studio s expertise in creating world class digital products that drive positive habits and deliver real results

title: curated design initiatives
texto:
curated design initiatives the eames institute of infinite curiosity is excited to announces the launch of the curious 100  a groundbreaking initiative honoring one hundred courageous and innovative leaders spanning an array of creative disciplines  drawing inspiration from the insatiable curiosity of the institute s namesakes  ray and charles eames  the curious 100 is a testament to the boundless potential of curiosity to shape a brighter  more creative and equitable future at a time where we need that vision more than ever 

the curious 100 honors the eameses  curiosity and interdisciplinary approach to design  which continue to inspire innovation and creative problem solving globally  scott shigeoka  author  researcher  and a key partner on the curious 100  identifies curiosity as a powerful tool for personal growth  deeper connection  and meaningful change  he emphasizes that curiosity allows people to break free from their biases  challenge assumptions  approach others with empathy  and cultivate resilience  creativity  and a willingness to evolve 

selected from a broad spectrum of disciplines  spanning food  arts  design  technology  community building  and social impact  the selected honorees represent the transformative impact of curiosity across ten dynamic categories  including builders  makers  reformers  and storytellers  the curious 100 is a celebration of courageous leaders and creative minds across the united states who are harnessing the transformative power of curiosity to solve today s most pressing problems whether it s combating climate change  advancing racial justice  addressing the housing crisis  or tackling food insecurity  this list includes a wide range of advocates  from those championing regenerative agriculture and material use to those supporting some of the most vulnerable communities in our society 

honorees include theaster gates  the world renowned artist transforming chicago s south side through urban renewal and community building projects  dr  ayana elizabeth johnson  author and a leading climate advocate revolutionizing marine conservation and sean sherman  known as the sioux chef  a trailblazer in advancing indigenous cuisine and food sovereignty  other include adrienne maree brown  author and facilitator who nurtures ideas and practices for transformation and healing and hannah beachler  the academy award winning production designer for black panther  recognized for her groundbreaking contributions to cinematic storytelling and culture

title: music inspired enlivening parks
texto:
music inspired enlivening parks local design firm soba unveils the orchestra park design  which is a project that alters what was once a vacant urban lot in kunshan  china  the yellow accents enliven the viewing platforms with play spaces and performance areas  the team drew inspiration from the area and its heritage of sizhu music  which is a traditional collection of string and wind instruments  the design results in curved flowing structures with an interactive music installation 

the founding partner of soba  ruo wang tells dezeen   the design carefully respects and preserves the natural landscape  including the mature trees and wetlands  while also addressing the local community s need for recreational space  we took inspiration from the shapes of jiangnan sizhu or  silk and bamboo  orchestra instruments  using their graceful curves and rhythm to guide the layout of the park  

image credit  holi

title: thailand international modern museums
texto:
thailand international modern museums international studio why architecture has unveiled designs of the dib bangkok museum  this is claimed to be the first museum in thailand that is dedicated to international modern art  it is set to open at the end of this year  and it is hosted a 1980s warehouse that has been renovated by the firm and topped off with a sawtooth roof  the studio notes   dib bangkok is thailand s first major museum dedicated to international contemporary art   the founder of the institution 

purat osathnugrah  is honoring his late father  petch osathanugrah  whose artwork collection comprises dib bangkok s work  he adds   bangkok  with all its energy  creativity  and unstoppable spirit  has long been overdue for an anchor to its contemporary art scene that matches its vibrancy  we re building dib bangkok to be a true creative oasis  a bridge between thailand  southeast asia  and the global art scene  

image credit  why architecture

title: granite clad coastal schools
texto:
granite clad coastal schools french design firm amelia tavella architectes designed the edmond simeoni school and cultural space  it is defined by irregular block forms made from granite to clad the structure as a nod to the craggy environments in corsica  the space is located in the coastal village of lumio and has rough granite walls  stepped concrete pathways  and green roofs to top it off 

the founder of the studio  amelia tavella explains   the project s guiding idea was to adapt to the rhythms  strengths  and rough edges of the land  allowing the architecture to blend seamlessly with its surroundings  i aimed to create a school that becomes a part of the landscape  marrying the village and its view of the sea  echoing the curves of the land while enhancing the beauty of nature  it s about creating space for learning and culture without altering the land s integrity  

image credit  guillaume porsche

title: art gallery functioned residences
texto:
art gallery functioned residences architect prince harrison has designed the green hills residence  which is a stucco clad home he has created for himself and his wife  located in tennessee  it is made with an open air courtyard and the interior spaces are designed with a focus on the display of artwork  functioning as an art gallery as well 

the house is resting on a sloped site with one acre of space and is bordered by woodlands and animals  harrison notes   the project was conceived as an art gallery that functions as a primary residence  the residence was designed as a set of cubic volumes arranged around an outdoor courtyard  the dark anthracite coloured stucco was selected to mimic the organic quality and colour of tree bark  

image credit  keith isaacs

texto:
juxtaposing powerful sportscars the morgan supersport is a new  sleek car by morgan motor company inspired by various decades past for a juxtaposing look  the designers rearranged the eras into a modern interpretation  and the model comes in two interchangeable roof versions 

one is made with a mohair soft top that is great for warmer weather  and the other is a carbon fiber hard top for more harsh weather  the car is constructed on a cxv aluminum platform on top of the frame made from sh wooden material s which is better for torsional ridgity and suspension systems  users can also opt for the dynamic handling pack  which includes adjustable dampers and a limited slip differential that caters to a sublime driving control

title: oak wood clad residences
texto:
oak wood clad residences chilean design studio hebra arquitectos has completed a house dubbed palo quemado  it is located in southern chile and is defined by its native oak cladding topped by faceted roofs  it laps out along the v shaped site which overlooks captivating views of the lake

title: plant based contemporary lamps

plant based contemporary lamps the lily lamp is a captivating illumination decor which is designed by the team at maju  the lily lamp is 3d printed and made using plant based materials so that it is entirely biodegradable  the main focus of the lamp is the light itself as the shade is printed without any supporting material to save energy

all of the pieces transform how wood functions as the narrative and unveils how it can unveil new purposes with familiar materials  all of the designs by li are deeply personal and stem from her heritage and background  she speaks more on the weaving chair range for example   this idea of transforming flatness into volume became the core of the piece  i believe that design should be approachable yet profound  allowing people to feel a sense of connection with the piece

title: air purifier integrated monitors
texto:

title: handle only fashion handbags
texto:
handle only fashion handbags paris based fashion imprint zomer has taken the notion of minimalism to new heights with the no budget bag  it is a designer handbag that ironically comes without the actual bag  presented as a part of this year s fall winter 2025 lineup at paris fashion week  the accessory is walked down the aisle with a single handle 

there are no storage pockets or anything else  the bag is designed by danial aitouganoc  vaia tatopoulou  and marvin buelleck  the no budget bag falls into the brand s seasonal range and it is part of the capsule which explores unconventional designs  this includes pieces such as reverse worn apparel but the no budget bag stands out with its zero storage component

title: light therapy helmets
texto:
light therapy helmets the lightweight  battery powered  and affordably priced neuronic light is a transcranial photobiomodulation  tpbm  helmet designed to increase access to the benefits of near infrared light therapy  people naturally encounter near infrared light from the sun  especially during sunrise and sunset  but indoor lifestyles and increased screen time limit daily exposure to its potential benefits  neuronic light aims to deliver targeted infrared light to the brain and support cognitive function and overall well being 

with the neuronic light  users can opt into a large scale tpbm study   the neuronic light is the largest research initiative in transcranial photobiomodulation   said marvin schönauer  co founder of neuronic   when users connect the helmet to the app  we gain invaluable insights into real world usage patterns  helping us better understand how tpbm impacts daily life

title: seed oil free snacks
texto:

wild fox foods  lineup offers flavors for every kind of snacker  while those with a sweet tooth will gravitate toward products like the cinnamon churro protein bar or the dark chocolate raisin trail mix  snackers who crave a taste of something different will find satisfaction in the savory  salty  smoky options  beyond flavor  wild fox foods appeals to ingredient conscious consumers who want to avoid seed oils many actively avoid products formulated with seed oils due to concerns about their potential inflammatory effects  and potential links to chronic health issues

title: manuka honey sodas
texto:
manuka honey sodas at expo west 2025  1770 launched manuka honey soda with fresh  fruity flavors like pear  lemon  and pineapple  these naturally sweetened artisanal sodas not only tap into honey for flavor but a specific type of honey known for its numerous health benefits  finding that manuka honey was inaccessibly priced for the average consumer  1770 founder summer jun set out to offer an affordable  approachable product in a convenient format  uniquely  the brand s cans are engineered with a cup like top that opens fully  as opposed to a flip top  for resealing 

as consumers prioritize clean ingredients and balanced sweetness  naturally sweetened foods and beverages are on the rise  honey  with its rich flavor and simple  unprocessed appeal  is making a strong comeback as a favorite natural sweetener 

image credit  ben moreland  unsplash

title: canadian beauty company rebrands
texto:
canadian beauty company rebrands vasanti cosmetics unveils a fresh look and groundbreaking product launches  solidifying its position as an inclusive canadian beauty leader  with a modernized aesthetic inspired by sisterhood and empowerment  vasanti continues its mission to serve diverse skin tones with high performance  clean formulations 

at the heart of the rebrand is  sun s up    a game changing mineral sunscreen that delivers spf protection without the dreaded white cast    just a radiant  healthy glow  vasanti is also expanding its  color correcting concealer  range with two new shades  ensuring more people can find their perfect match for neutralizing dark circles effortlessly 

founded 27 years ago by sisters pinki gosal and monal patel  vasanti was born out of a need for beauty products that truly cater to medium skin tones  now  with a refined blush toned aesthetic and its ever growing fan base    including millennials and gen z    the brand continues to innovate  this next chapter is all about inclusivity  confidence  and beauty without compromise  discover the new vasanti at vasanticosmetics com 

image credit  vasanti

title: modern brick retro residences
texto:
modern brick retro residences architecture firm mclaren excell has taken on the role of transforming a home in wimbledon that was first built in the 70s  the result is captivating with a striking design which embraces modern themes without disrupting the timelessness of the original build  it is set on a site that was previously occupied by a dated home and the new space is confident 

the design is led by a modern grey hue made from brick at the exterior with clean lines and cubic structures  the house draws attention on the quiet street  the vision of the transformation was to bring attention to the client s passion for brick houses and materiality and this is honored by a palette of timber  concrete  and brick 

image credit  mclaren excell

title: dairy free dubai style chocolates
texto:
dairy free dubai style chocolates the notco dubai style notsquare is a new product from the plant based chocolate brand that will provide consumers with a dairy free way to try out the popular dubai chocolate experience  the product consists of the recognizable pistachios and knafeh inside of a plant based chocolate coating that combine to create a rich  satisfying taste and texture experience  the chocolate bar also features a nutrition minded recipe with seven grams of protein and no added sugar to give it a competitive edge over other treat varieties on the market 

the notco dubai style notsquare is a limited edition product that the brand hasn t yet confirmed where consumers will be able to purchase it from  the product is expected to be a must try amongst consumers intrigued by the viral dubai chocolate trend  but seeking out a plant based alternative option 

image credit  notco

title: traditional dessert inspired chocolates
texto:
traditional dessert inspired chocolates magno chocolates introduced its  pistachio knafeh chocolate bar   an elevated version of the popular  dubai chocolate bar   crafted with  53  cacao from tumaco  renowned for its award winning and ethically sourced quality  this bar stands out for its extra thick design and premium ingredients  

the pistachio knafeh chocolate bar features  a rich pistachio filling made from finely ground pistachios  combined with the distinctive crunch of traditional arabic knafeh pastry   this unique blend offers a sophisticated flavor profile and a delightful texture  making it an exceptional choice for those seeking a gourmet chocolate experience 

as a high quality product that integrates traditional flavors with a modern twist  this unique multi textural chocolate bar presents an appealing option for consumers seeking to explore innovative and luxurious chocolate offerings 

image credit  magno chocolates

title: limited time chocolate sundaes
texto:
limited time chocolate sundaes ghirardelli chocolate company has introduced a limited time dubai chocolate sundae experience to offer chocolate enthusiasts a unique and luxurious dessert  available for one day only on march 8  2025  at ghirardelli square in san francisco  and later on march 22  2025  at its new york city location  the delectable sundae combines ghirardelli s iconic hot fudge with the viral dubai chocolate trend 

the dubai chocolate sundae experience features layers of vanilla ice cream  handmade hot fudge  pistachio butter  white chocolate  and kataifi  shredded phyllo   topped with a gold leafed ghirardelli milk chocolate caramel square  whipped cream  and caramel sauce  this innovative creation reflects ghirardelli s commitment to blending tradition with modern flavor trends to offer customers a memorable and indulgent experience  coincidentally  the limited edition desert also marks the brand s 173 year legacy of crafting premium chocolate

title: recreated pistachio filled bars
texto:
recreated pistachio filled bars morrisons has released its own version of the social media popularized dubai chocolate bar  aiming to bring the treat to new audiences based in the uk  filled with a pistachio creme mixture  crunchy kadayif pastry  and wrapped in a milk chocolate layer  these cake bars are priced at  4 each and are created by the brand flair 

 experience the rich  authentic pistachio paste harmoniously mixed with delicately baked kunafa  nestled on a sumptuous bed of soft chocolate cake  all enrobed in luscious chocolate  each bite offers a decadent  unforgettable taste adventure that s as unique as it is addictive   morrisons said in a statement 

the flair pistachio kunafa dubai chocolate cake bars can be found at morrisons locations across the uk 

image credit  morrisons

title: naturally flavored protein bars
texto:
naturally flavored protein bars smul makes protein bars that are rich in fiber  gluten free  low in sugar and perfect for on the go snacking  these naturally flavored protein bars are abundant in plant based protein  and varieties like the strawberry almond protein bar with roasted almonds and freeze dried strawberries are especially treat like thanks to a sugar free  plant based white chocolate coating  fans of dark chocolate will find satisfaction in varieties like the cherry almond protein bar  which boasts 13 grams of plant protein per bar and no artificial sweeteners or added refined sugar 

these plant powered bars feature a base of chicory root fiber and a blend of fava beans  chicory extract  pea protein isolate  and other ingredients for their nutritious qualities  flavor  and texture 

at expo west 2025  smul offered a look at its expanded protein bar range  which includes flavors like coconut  pecan caramel  and hazelnut cocoa

title: plumping lip treatments
texto:
plumping lip treatments l oréal paris recently introduced its plump ambition hyaluron lip oil  combining instant volume enhancement with long lasting hydration in a non sticky formula  the innovative lip treatment features a potent blend of hyaluronic acid and tripeptides that work to plump and nourish lips while delivering a high shine finish and gentle tingling sensation  available in ten shades including the popular berry jolie  the product promises a comfortable wear experience with 24 hour moisture retention 

the luxury inspired lip oil offers a multi benefit approach to lip care with its smooth application and volumizing properties  additionally  the formula incorporates peppermint oil for a refreshing sensation and vanilla extract for a subtle fragrance note  positioned as an affordable alternative to high end plumping treatments at an srp of  19 99  the plump ambition collection is now available across major canadian retailers including shoppers drug mart  london drugs  and walmart  consumer reviews highlight the product s non sticky texture  long lasting wear  and effective moisturizing capabilities

title: dubai chocolate ice creams
texto:
dubai chocolate ice creams the baskin robbins dubai chocolate menu is the brand s latest lineup of offerings arriving in the middle east market that will provide patrons with a new range of treats to enjoy that are themed with the viral chocolate in mind 

the menu includes the dubai chocolate ice cream bar with chocolate and vanilla ice cream along with pistachio sauce and knafeh  all covered in a chocolate shell  the menu also features the dubai chocolate single kids sundae  dubai chocolate thick shake and the happiness pack 

the baskin robbins dubai chocolate menu responds to consumer demand for social media inspired treats as they seek out ways to enjoy some of the most viral and trend worthy items they see from creators online

title: transformative gel balm cleansers
texto:
transformative gel balm cleansers glossier s milky jelly cleansing balm meets the demand for transformative cleansers that not only remove product and grime effectively but also leave the skin feeling deeply hydrated and comfortably refreshed  this nourishing gel balm makeup remover can be emulsified with water to create a sensorial cleansing experience powered by sugar based surfactants  glycerin  and a botanical oil blend that includes squalene  grape seed oil  and sunflower seed oil 

this new formula introduces another gentle cleansing experience that fans of glossier s milky jelly cleanser will appreciate  while the brand s milky jelly cleanser is useful for light makeup removal  the new milky jelly cleansing balm tackles waterproof and long wearing makeup  as well as spf and it can also be applied as a leave on moisture mask

title: volumizing lip oils
texto:
volumizing lip oils l oréal paris introduces the  plump ambition hyaluron lip oil   a groundbreaking product designed to elevate any lip care routine  this innovative formula provides immediate volume and offers 24 hour hydration  all while delivering a glossy  non sticky finish with just one swipe  enriched with nourishing hyaluronic acid and tripeptides  the lip oil gently plumps and hydrates the lips  leaving them with a smooth  soft texture that lasts throughout the day 

furthermore  the plump ambition hyaluron lip oil is available in a wide range of captivating shades  allowing individuals to find the perfect option for any occasion  the shades include  berry jolie    cherry cherie    crystal clear    la nuit sparkle    latte glace    milky nu    nude macaron    rogue in love    wine o clock   and  worth it  

this exceptional lip oil is available for purchase on amazon ca  as well as at major mass and drugstore retailers throughout canada  including shoppers drug mart  london drugs  walmart  and jean coutu

title: curated trend content
texto:
curated trend content dynamics in retail are constantly evolving  and ady floyd is at the forefront of helping brands navigate these changes  as the vp of client success at trend hunter  she works with over 40 brands every day to uncover new opportunities and tailor trend content to meet their needs  ady s passion lies in collaborating with clients to identify emerging trends and ensure they re positioned for success  her expertise in retail  omnichannel strategies  and entertainment has led to successful partnerships with brands like beam suntory and roots 

beyond trend curation  ady is a top client success strategist at trend hunter  where she advises leading brands on innovation strategies  her dynamic approach and hands on experience allow her to lead custom workshops that address a wide variety of business objectives  ady is also behind two of trend hunter s most requested keynotes  omnichannel retail and rewriting the rules of retail 

whether speaking at major conferences like chfa  the category management association  or future festival  ady is dedicated to helping brands stay ahead in a rapidly changing retail and entertainment landscape  if you missed out on future festival miami  don t worry you still have the chance to secure your tickets for future festival new york

title: sound focused ice cream ads
texto:
sound focused ice cream ads the new magnum ice cream ads are turning up the volume on what makes the indulgent treat so irresistible  the brand s latest campaign   crack   takes inspiration from its fans  who have long praised the unmistakable sound of biting into a magnum bar s thick chocolate shell 

directed by martin werner and created by lola mullenlowe  the series of wordless spots exaggerates just how impactful that first bite can be  from sending pool balls flying across a table to disrupting a peaceful library  the ads playfully highlight the sensory pleasure of magnum s signature crack  the tagline   thick  cracking chocolate   drives home the message that indulgence should be both seen and heard 

 for 35 years  magnum has been a symbol of true pleasure   said tugce aksoy  the brand s global director  the campaign takes that experience beyond taste  reinforcing magnum s status as the go to ice cream for luxurious  multi sensory delight    now rolling out across europe  including in the u k  and turkey 

image credit  magnum

title: mystery flavor hot cross buns
texto:
mystery flavor hot cross buns people know and love the classic taste of hot cross buns and in 2025  aldi is shaking up the treat all ages eagerly anticipate with three limited edition village bakery mystery hot cross buns  ahead of easter  aldi launched a first of its kind guess the hot cross bun flavor competition  giving three lucky shoppers the chance to win  1 000 each if they guess the mystery hot cross bun flavor correctly 

each of the village bakery mystery hot cross buns comes in colorful packaging and drops a different week leading up to easter celebrations to keep taste buds guessing 

consumers love the thrill of mystery flavors  and brands are taking it a step further by reinventing seasonal favorites with unexpected twists  keeping every taste experience fresh  fun  and full of surprises

title: lemony mushroom based bites
texto:
lemony mushroom based bites fully cooked  seasoned mushrooms are the star ingredient in windy city mushrooms  fungitarian lineup  and at expo west 2025  the company debuted plant based fungitarian crab cakes formulated with lion s mane mushrooms  these bites are made to be heated and served as appetizers or entrees on their own  and they re full of fresh  lemony flavors that offer an alternative to seafood that rivals the look and taste of real crab cakes 

the plant powered  mushroom based crab cakes expand the globally inspired fungitarian lineup  which includes savory fungitarian marinara seasoned with authentic italian herbs and spices  fungitarian taco  and fungitarian asian zing for stir fries and rice bowls  for those who prefer to do their own seasoning  windy city mushrooms offers a selection of fresh  gourmet mushrooms  including lion s mane

title: mesquite based bars
texto:
mesquite based bars with the cocoa crisis driving up prices and threatening supply  the need for inventive  great tasting cocoa alternatives has never been greater  pushing brands like mez to develop mesquite based  un chocolate  bars 

these superfood chocolate alternatives are rich in protein and fiber  and low in sugar  and they are ready to savor in varieties like mellow milk  warm spices  and peanut better  these plant based  cacao free bars also avoid other common ingredients in chocolate products like dairy  palm oil and sugar alcohols  as well as caffeine and theobromine 

while all the varieties build on a base of illipe butter  mesquite bean flour  pea and rice protein fermented by shiitake mycelium  mellow milk incorporates notes of cinnamon  coconut and date  and warm spices is infused with cardamom

title: salmon protein sticks
texto:
salmon protein sticks most meat snacks are made with chicken  turkey  or beef  but surfsnax debuted salmon snack sticks at expo west 2025  introducing consumers to an alternative that s just as convenient and nutritious  the individually wrapped salmon sticks made for on the go snacking boast 70 calories  protein  and 1 000 milligrams of omega 3 fatty acids per serving 

meat stick snacks are rising in popularity as consumers seek convenient  high protein options that fit their busy lifestyles  with bold  smoky flavors and a satisfying texture  these portable meat stick snacks offer a quick and flavorful way to refuel at home  at work  or during outdoor adventures 

the all new salmon snack sticks join surfsnax s portfolio of fish based jerky snacks  diversifying a category dominated by other animal proteins

title: take home qsr dipping sauces
texto:
take home qsr dipping sauces fried chicken fans love an ultra crispy crunch but also a bold  flavorful sauce for dipping and drizzling  and three bottled popeyes sauces launched for those who can t get enough of the chain s famous sauces  available in mild blackened ranch and two medium heat options  sweet heat  and mardi gras mustard  popeyes  dipping sauces are coming to select grocery stores and online retailers 

while one savory blackened seasoning blend builds on a base of creamy buttermilk ranch  another taps into the growing demand for  swicy  flavors  the last in the lineup takes the form of a creamy creole mustard mixed with a bite from horseradish and fans will have to wait the longest to experience this flavor since it won t be available until later this spring

title: better for your tortilla chips
texto:
better for your tortilla chips the garden veggie flavor burst tortilla chips have been announced by hain celestial as the brand s latest innovation that responds to consumer demand for better for you takes on classic food products 

the snack features a tortilla chip format that comes in two flavor options including smoky bbq and sweet tangy chili  which are both crafted with five kinds of vegetables including spinach  beet  red bell pepper  carrot and tomato  the snack is also made with wholesome additional ingredients like non gmo corn and is crafted with no artificial flavors or preservatives in the mix 

senior director of marketing ed kaiser commented on the garden veggie flavor burst tortilla chips saying   we know snackers are increasingly looking for better for you options that don t compromise on taste  and we re thrilled to meet that demand with craveable new varieties of flavor burst  whether you crave that classic smoky barbecue taste or a trend forward experience with the sweet spicy kick of chili  we ve got the perfect better for you snack in our flavor burst line up  

image credit  garden veggie snacks

title: featherlight rugged adventurer timepieces
texto:
featherlight rugged adventurer timepieces the casio pro trek prjb001b 2 timepiece is a rugged accessory engineered with a high performance capability in mind to offer adventurers with the perfect option to add to their everyday carry  edc   the watch is positioned to be the lightest model within the pro trek range ever created and weighs in at 37 grams to prevent it from weighing down the wrist  this is made possible thanks to the bio based resin case that s lightweight yet rugged  while the tough solar technology inside keeps the watch running for extended periods 

the casio pro trek prjb001b 2 timepiece has bluetooth to enable time syncing and more through the casio app  while the led backlight supports viewing in any lighting conditions  priced at  160  the watch can be worn on the wrist or even affixed onto a bag  depending on preferences

title: accessible supreme sound earbuds
texto:
accessible supreme sound earbuds the oneplus buds pro 3 earbuds are an accessible yet high quality audio accessory engineered with the needs of music enthusiasts alike in mind to help them enjoy immersive experiences from anywhere 

the earbuds are engineered with dual drivers including an 11mm woofer and a 6mm tweeter with dedicated dacs that will producer rich  deep bass alongside crisp highs  the headphones are hi res certified with lhdc 5 0 support with a 1mbps bitrate and playback support for 24 bit 192khz 

the oneplus buds pro 3 earbuds are equipped with anc technology to block out disturbances and harness the power of artificial intelligence  ai  to deliver custom tuned audio experiences from anywhere  the lightweight design of the earbuds give them a comfortable profile for all day wear and also have extended battery life to boot

title: enriching beauty care products
texto:
enriching beauty care products plant based beauty products are at the core of renpure s commitment to natural hair and skin care  the  castor oil   moringa curl collection  enhances curl definition and moisture retention  castor oil  rich in ricinoleic acid and omega 9 fatty acids  controls frizz while maintaining hydration  moringa seed oil  a lightweight  miracle oil   nourishes with oleic acid and vitamins a  c  and e 

the collection includes  curl enhancing shampoo   which gently cleanses without stripping moisture   curl enhancing conditioner  for detangling and hydration  and  curl enhancing gel  for smooth  defined curls 

for sensitive skin  the  oat milk   ceramides  line offers soothing hydration  oat milk   rich in beta glucan and antioxidants  reduces redness  while ceramides strengthen the skin s barrier   the  sensitive skin body wash  cleanses while preserving essential moisture  overall  renpure s plant based beauty products harness natural ingredients to promote healthy  nourished hair and skin 

image credit  renpure

title: veteran supporting grocery deliveries
texto:
veteran supporting grocery deliveries this new instacart pilot program is being run through a joint colalboration with the rockefeller foundation  the us department of veteran affairs  va  and the university of syracuse to support military veterans  the program is meant to better understand how medically tailored groceries can affect military veterans and comes in respose to the food insecurity and hunger that can be experienced by this demographic  the pilot program will include 250 rural  homebound and low income veterans who have diabetes or hypertension along with limited access to food 

vp of policy and government affairs casey aden wansbury commented on the instacart pilot program saying   we re honored to play a role in this important work   because when veterans and military families have access to the food they need to thrive  we all benefit

title: qsr voting promotions
texto:
qsr voting promotions shake shack is encouraging customers to have their say with the shake shack showdown that will see the brand pitting two of its menu items against one another to see which one comes out as the more popular option 

the promotion is taking place from march 12 through saturday  march 15  2025 and encourages customers to vote on whether they are team chicken shack or team avocado bacon burger  the company will be tallying up the votes before announcing the ultimate winner on instagram on sunday  march 16  the brand will then be offering customers a complimentary sandwich of either variety with any  10 minimum order 

the shake shack showdown comes as one of a growing number of promotions that sees brands engaging consumers in a more immersive way 

image credit  shake shack

title: triple action eye drops
texto:
triple action eye drops the systane pro pf eye drops are a preservative free  pf  over the counter eye care product formulated with dry eye relief in mind 

the product is reported by the brand to have the longest lasting formulation in the systane lineup and boasts a triple action effect that will alleviate the discomfort of dry eyes  the product will work effectively to hydrate the eyes  help restore the stability of the tear film and even protect against additional irritation that might occur  the product is targeted towards the estimated 45 5 million americans who have dry eye issues and the 1 5 billion people globally who do as well 

chief medical officer and head of global medical safety terry kim commented on the systane pro pf eye drops saying   we are proud to introduce systane pro pf  the first and only multi dose preservative free triple action formula with hyaluronate  nano sized lipids and hp guar that support the active ingredient giving patients long lasting relief from the symptoms of dry eye

title: seasonal spring lunch menus
texto:
seasonal spring lunch menus the greenland spring menu has debuted at all three of the brand s locations in tampa  florida as a series of fresh  delicious options perfect for customers to enjoy this season  the menu was crafted by the brand s culinary team under the leadership of chris kern and includes a number of familiar flavors with new updates to keep them relevant for today s customer  the menu has four main options to choose from including the cuban salad wrap  hibiscus tea and lemonade  the mango sushie and the chocolate chip cookie 

co founder and president chris kern spoke on the greenland spring menu saying   our seasonal menu changes four times a year  and this spring lineup is all about bright  refreshing flavors  from the tangy twist on a tampa staple to a tropical slushie and our latest sweet treat  these enhancements are designed to celebrate the best of the season

title: relaxed minimalist bags
texto:
relaxed minimalist bags the  valera collection  and campaign  styled by the esteemed la based stylist veneda carter  marks a significant evolution for rains  unveiling a more relaxed and refined interpretation of the brand s iconic minimalist  tailored designs  the collection captures modern sophistication and adaptability  featuring a design that effortlessly drapes across the body for a comfortable yet stylish look 

comprising four versatile styles the  shoulder bag large    shoulder bag    bum bag   and  bucket backpack  the valera collection is crafted from rains  signature matte pu fabric  this material offers waterproof durability while maintaining a sleek  functional silhouette  thoughtfully designed details  such as  a coated zipper  an interior slip pocket  and detachable  adjustable shoulder straps in contrasting colors  elevate the practicality and aesthetic of each piece  

in creating the  valera  concept  veneda carter explored rains  entire archive  curating key pieces to highlight the collection s versatility 

image credit  rains

title: celebratory spring holiday donuts
texto:
celebratory spring holiday donuts the voodoo doughnuts bottom s up donut is a new seasonal treat being offered by the brand to offer customers with a delicious option to pick up on their next visit  the donut has a pint glass shaped profile that is covered with a rich coating of chocolate on the top alongside an irish cream fluff on the inside to make it a sweet  creamy indulgence  the donut is being offered from march 13 to 17  2025 and the brand is encouraging customers to place their order ahead of time to avoid missing out on one 

ceo chris schultz spoke on the voodoo doughnuts bottom s up donut saying   at voodoo doughnut  we believe every holiday deserves a little magic and st  patrick s day is no exception  our bottom s up doughnut brings a bit of luck  mischief  and a whole lot of flavor to the celebration  

image credit  voodoo doughnuts

title: iconic chicago towers
texto:
iconic chicago towers tribune tower  a prominent landmark in chicago  is commemorating its 100th anniversary in 2025  completed in 1925  the neo gothic structure was the result of a design competition aimed at creating a distinctive office building  over the past century  the tower has undergone several transitions  including serving as the offices of the chicago tribune and wgn radio  before being repurposed five years ago as a luxury residential building 

designated as a chicago landmark in 1989  tribune tower is notable for housing  stones of the world  nearly  150 fragments from renowned global sites embedded within its façade   today  the building stands as a well known example of adaptive reuse  with its residential spaces offering a blend of historical architecture and modern design elements  its transformation into luxury residences reflects the ongoing development of the area while maintaining the building s historical significance 

image credit  tribune tower residences

title: real time slot insights
texto:
real time slot insights slotstat provides real time statistics and data driven insights for slot machine players  the tool focuses on key performance indicators  kpis  such as return to player  rtp   win spin rate  and other relevant metrics to guide players in making informed decisions while gambling  by leveraging real time data  slotstat helps users track the performance of various slot games  increasing their chances of selecting the most favorable machines 

the service aims to enhance the gambling experience by offering valuable insights that improve strategic choices  it is particularly useful for players who want to optimize their gameplay or explore new slots based on statistical advantages  businesses and developers in the gaming industry can also benefit from slotstat by gaining insights into player behaviors  game popularity  and performance trends  contributing to more informed game design and marketing strategies 

image credit  slotstat

title: browser task automation
texto:
browser task automation unifill is an ai driven browser automation tool that simplifies repetitive web tasks  by using natural language  users can automate complex workflows without the need for programming skills  this accessibility allows individuals and businesses to enhance productivity by eliminating manual  time consuming actions such as form filling  data extraction  and content management 

for businesses  unifill offers the potential to optimize internal processes and improve efficiency  tasks such as customer outreach  data entry  and web scraping can be automated  saving both time and resources  additionally  unifill s user friendly interface makes it an ideal solution for teams without technical expertise  as a growing startup  unifill s mission is to make automation accessible to everyone  ultimately helping businesses streamline their digital operations and improve overall efficiency 

image credit  unifill ai

title: ai recipe generators
texto:
ai recipe generators granny cooks for me is an ai powered recipe generator that creates personalized meal ideas based on the ingredients you provide  users input available items in their pantry or fridge  and the tool suggests various recipes that can be made from those ingredients  this tool uses advanced algorithms to create recipes that are both practical and delicious  catering to different tastes and dietary preferences 

for businesses in the food industry  granny cooks for me presents opportunities for customer engagement and data collection  it can be used as a value added feature on recipe websites or as part of food delivery services  providing a personalized experience  additionally  the platform could be integrated with grocery delivery services  making it easier for customers to purchase the required ingredients for their ai generated meals  this innovation streamlines meal planning and optimizes the cooking process for users 

image credit  granny cooks for me

title: ai tarot card readings
texto:
ai tarot card readings taroteller is an ai tarot card reading service designed to offer personalized insights into your future  combining the mystique of traditional tarot cards with advanced artificial intelligence  taroteller provides users with unique  tailored readings that reflect their individual life situations  the ai analyzes data and applies tarot card meanings to deliver predictions and advice 

this service appeals to individuals seeking a more personalized  tech driven approach to tarot readings  it simplifies the process of tarot reading by removing the need for a physical deck and an expert reader  making it more accessible  taroteller can be used for self reflection  personal guidance  or as a conversation starter  while it offers an engaging  futuristic twist on a centuries old practice  users should remember that ai based readings are based on algorithmic interpretations and are not a substitute for professional advice 

image credit  taroteller

title: sun mimicking computer peripherals
texto:
sun mimicking computer peripherals the sunled sunbooster is a computer peripheral engineered to help mimc the beneficial effects of sun exposure to support those who spend extended periods of time at a desk or simply indoors  the device features a webcam like design that works by being positioned on top of a monitor where it will go to work transmitting near infrared light thanks to a series of specialized leds inside  this is the wavelength that can provide benefits to vitality and cognition  but which is filtered out by modern windows 

the sunled sunbooster will deliver a targeted beam of near infrared light directly to the user s face and has a motion sensor to automatically detect when the user is present to start the therapy

title: contact data scrapers
texto:
contact data scrapers dozenleads is a tool designed to extract contact details  such as emails and phone numbers  from a wide array of social media and online platforms  it supports data scraping from google maps  linkedin  facebook  instagram  twitter  reddit  youtube  tiktok  telegram  and threads  making it a versatile solution for businesses looking to gather leads  by automating the process of locating and compiling contact information  dozenleads helps streamline outreach efforts  saving time and improving efficiency 

this tool is useful for marketers  sales teams  and business development professionals looking to build targeted contact lists quickly  however  businesses should be aware of potential legal and ethical concerns surrounding data scraping  as platforms may have policies in place restricting such activities  dozenleads offers a powerful way to access contact data  but users should ensure compliance with relevant laws and platform terms of service 

image credit  dozenleads

title: diy dog treat mixes
texto:
diy dog treat mixes woof s enriching pupsicle toy is made to be filled with a spherical treat and the brand dropped a trio of dog treat mixes so that pet owners can easily replenish the edible content once pets have finished it  the treat mixes are available in three just add water flavors  bacon and cheese mix  calming mix  and belly mix  two of which boast functional benefits 

preparing these diy dog treats is as simple as mixing the formula with water  and then filling and freezing the diy treat tray  alternatively  these treats can be sprinkled dry over pet food or served as gravy

title: spritz inspired fragrances
texto:
spritz inspired fragrances cocktail culture is making its way into fragrance  with new releases like maison margiela fragrances  never ending summer eau de toilette inspired by the classic  colorful italian spritz  this fresh and summery addition to the brand s beloved replica range is for fans of aperol spritz  and it captures its effervescent  sun soaked energy with a spritz accord and bright orange notes that add a juicy  bittersweet twist  as the perfume settles  earthy vetiver grounds the experience with a sophisticated finish

title: expansive podcast transcripts
texto:
expansive podcast transcripts metacast is a podcast app designed for users who value learning from audio content  it provides transcripts for every podcast episode ever published  allowing users to read along  skim through content  and search for specific topics or keywords within episodes  this feature enhances the podcast experience by making it easy to locate important quotes  insights  or ideas without having to replay sections of the show 

with metacast  users can bookmark key moments  making it easier to revisit valuable information  this app serves as a powerful tool for podcast enthusiasts  especially for professionals and students who prefer to engage with podcast content in a more interactive and efficient manner  by combining the convenience of listening with the utility of transcripts  metacast creates a seamless learning experience for podcast users 

image credit  metacast

creative ui exploration silly what ifs is a website that allows users to upload and explore imaginative user interface  ui  concepts for existing apps  the platform provides a space for creativity  where individuals can share their speculative ideas about how apps might look or function with different design elements or features  by enabling users to visualize and experiment with  what if  scenarios  silly what ifs fosters innovation and discussion around app development and design 

for businesses in the app development and ui ux design industries  silly what ifs offers insights into user preferences and creative trends  it can also serve as a source of inspiration for product teams seeking new design concepts or features  the website encourages collaboration and interaction  providing a unique space for both designers and app enthusiasts to engage with potential new ideas

title: ai generated gin spirits
texto:
ai generated gin spirits spanish spirits company beveland distillers developed aigin using algorithms capable of analyzing over two million combinations of ingredients  distillation techniques  and maceration methods 

beveland is a family owned company established in 1994 and based in the province of girona in northeast spain  the gin co created with artificial intelligence is the company s first ai created distillate  aigin represents a union of tradition  technique  and technology 

aigin features an aromatic profile that blends botanicals like lavender  hibiscus  and lychee  promising to offer a refreshing experience of classic gin cocktails like the gin fizz  g t  or martini  in the food and beverage space  companies are tapping into the power of ai to craft unique flavor and aroma profiles for innovative sensory experiences

title: anonymous ai dashboards
texto:
anonymous ai dashboards hoody ai is a comprehensive dashboard designed to provide anonymous access to a variety of large language models  llms   including openai  anthropic  google  and meta  users can interact with multiple models simultaneously  either through text or voice  upload documents  and edit prompts all within one secure platform  the service is designed with privacy in mind  requiring no personal information like email or phone numbers  and ensures data encryption for added security 

for businesses in ai and data privacy sectors  hoody ai presents a valuable tool for users seeking versatile  secure interactions with multiple models without compromising anonymity  the ability to use various models within a single dashboard could appeal to companies looking to experiment with different ai systems or improve ai related workflows while maintaining high standards of privacy and data protection 

image credit  hoody ai

title: local event discovery tools
texto:
local event discovery tools place to be is a mobile app designed to help users discover and share events in their local area  available on the play store  the app uses a 3d map interface to display events as pins  each showing the event s date and title  users can explore a wide range of events  including festivals  exhibitions  garage sales  flea markets  and more  making it a comprehensive tool for staying informed about local happenings 

for businesses  place to be represents a potential platform for local event promotion and community engagement  it also offers opportunities for event organizers to reach a wider audience through visibility on the app  the app s 3d map interface enhances user experience  offering an intuitive and visually appealing way to explore nearby events  potentially driving foot traffic to local venues and activities

title: limited time ketchup dip offerings
texto:
limited time ketchup dip offerings heinz has introduced a limited time offering  the  heinz chip dip   designed specifically for pairing with potato chips  while ketchup has long been a popular choice for dipping french fries and other fried potatoes  the combination with potato chips has been less common  in response  heinz is encouraging fans to try something new with this specially crafted dip 

the brand s survey findings show that while many enjoy dipping french fries in ketchup  fewer people do the same with chips however  a significant number expressed interest in trying this pairing  heinz chip dip makes it easy for consumers to experiment by offering a convenient set  including a bottle of ketchup  a wide mouthed dipping jar  and a bag of chips 

available starting march 12 at walmart com while supplies last  just in time for national potato chip day  the chip dip offering invites fans to share their experiences using  heinzchipdipchallenge  allowing heinz to assess consumer feedback for potential future releases 

image credit  heinz

title: ai quiz generators
texto:
ai quiz generators quizcraft is an ai powered tool that enables users to create interactive quizzes from any text with a single click  the platform is designed for teachers  students  and knowledge enthusiasts  offering an efficient way to generate quizzes for educational or personal use  by automating quiz creation  quizcraft saves time and ensures quizzes are tailored to the provided content 

this tool is particularly useful for educators looking to quickly assess learning or reinforce knowledge  as well as for students creating self assessments  for businesses in the education technology sector  quizcraft represents a potential solution to streamline content creation  improve user engagement  and foster interactive learning  it highlights the growing role of ai in education  providing scalable and customizable tools for knowledge assessment

title: spicy pepper infused cheeses
texto:
spicy pepper infused cheeses the borden cheese flavor sensations range is a new lineup of cheese slices crafted with convenience and adventurous flavors in mind to work well for consumers seeking out something unexpected 

the product comes in two flavor options including jalapeño jack and habanero cheddar  which will each offer a satisfying burst of spice to every bite  the cheese slices are positioned as the perfect option for elevating the taste profile of sandwiches like ham and cheese or even cheeseburgers  the product range also includes pepper jack and provolone cheeses in six ounce resealable packs

title: daily learning tools
texto:
daily learning tools runway is a free  daily learning app designed to make education quick  engaging  and accessible  users can learn something new in just two minutes each day  providing a bite sized approach to personal development  the app is designed to be intuitive  with a beautiful interface that enhances the learning experience  it aims to make building learning habits easier  turning daily education into a seamless part of users  routines 

for businesses focused on education or personal development  runway presents a model for delivering short form  high quality content that aligns with the growing trend of micro learning  the app s user friendly design ensures it is accessible to a broad audience  offering an efficient way to enhance skills without overwhelming users  as habits form through consistent  quick learning sessions  it can drive engagement for companies in education and content delivery

texto:
influencer approved beauty brands  point of view beauty  is shaking up the beauty industry with a skin first approach to flawless makeup  created by tiktok sensation mikayla nogueira  the brand is launching on march 26 with a five product lineup designed to perfect skin prep    an essential step often overlooked in beauty routines 

nogueira  who built a following of over 16 million on tiktok  was inspired by her experience at ulta beauty  where customers constantly asked how to achieve a smooth  long lasting makeup look  her answer  it s all in the prep  now  she s offering a streamlined solution with products that hydrate  prime  and perfect the skin before makeup application 

developed in south korea with cutting edge formulations  the range includes a hydrating priming milk  a molecular serum  a barrier boosting moisturizer  a tack primer  and an elastin enhancing lip treatment

title: ai songwriting generators
texto:
ai songwriting generators ai lyrics generator is a digital tool designed to assist songwriters and musicians in generating original lyrics using artificial intelligence  by analyzing language patterns and musical themes  the tool produces unique lyrics based on user input  helping streamline the creative process  it caters to artists  producers  and content creators looking for lyrical inspiration or structured songwriting assistance 

for the music industry  ai powered tools like this highlight the growing role of technology in creative fields  automation in songwriting can support professionals by reducing writer s block  providing alternative phrasing  or generating ideas tailored to specific genres  while ai cannot replace human creativity  it serves as a complementary resource for artists and businesses seeking efficiency in music production  the tool may also benefit emerging musicians looking to develop lyrics without extensive writing experience

title: sustainable tinned sardines
texto:
sustainable tinned sardines fish4ever cornish sardines are being added to the artisan fish brand s product portfolio as a deliciously natural option for consumers to incorporate into their rotation 

the product is targeted towards shoppers seeking out an all natural  sustainable protein source and is perfect for snacking occasions while also being great in a variety of meal recipes  the sardines are naturally packed with healthy oils and vitamins like omega 3 fatty acids  vitamins d and b12 and more  each pack also has a protected designation of origin status stamp and a qr code for consumers to scan to learn more 

founder charles redfern spoke on the fish4ever cornish sardines saying   as a uk protected  designated origin hero  cornish sardines are a  local shores  success story we ve been seeking to champion for many years at fish4ever  it was also imperative we worked with a like minded  home grown cannery in keeping with our  socially positive  priorities

title: hair density focused collections
texto:
hair density focused collections oribe hair care has expanded its best selling scalp care line with its  serene scalp densifying collection   a science backed three step regimen designed to give thinning hair a visible boost in fullness and vitality 

developed in collaboration with board certified trichologist penny james  this collection delivers luxury and performance in equal measure  featuring the  densifying shampoo    conditioner   and  treatment spray   the system works to fortify the scalp  reduce shedding caused by breakage  and amplify the look of each strand  key ingredients like capixyl   redensyl   and pea sprout extract help stimulate the scalp while promoting stronger  healthier hair over time 

consumer testing results are already promising    after just one month  85  of users saw improved hair appearance  with even more dramatic results over three months  as thinning hair continues to be a top beauty concern  oribe is bridging the gap between luxury and efficacy  delivering professional grade solutions that transform confidence as much as they transform hair 

the serene scalp densifying collection is now available at oribe com  oribe salons  and select retailers 

image credit  oribe

title: insurance appeal support
texto:
insurance appeal support honest care is a service designed to assist individuals in overturning insurance denials for prescription medications  it provides guidance in navigating the appeals process  helping users submit the necessary documentation to their health insurance providers  by streamlining the appeal process  honest care aims to increase access to essential medications that may have been initially denied 

for businesses in the healthcare and pharmaceutical sectors  services like honest care highlight ongoing challenges in insurance approvals and the need for patient advocacy solutions  the platform s role in assisting over 1 000 individuals suggests a demand for efficient appeal support  as healthcare regulations evolve  tools that simplify administrative processes and improve patient outcomes may become increasingly valuable to both consumers and industry professionals

title: performance inspired designer shoes
texto:
performance inspired designer shoes balenciaga x puma are bringing a stripped down  high fashion take on performance footwear with the unveiling of a collaborative  speedcat ultrasoft  sneaker  revealed at balenciaga s winter 2025 show during paris fashion week  this collaboration blends puma s deep rooted sportswear heritage with balenciaga s avant garde aesthetic 

originally launched in 1999 for motorsport enthusiasts  the  puma speedcat  was designed with a flat sole for maximum pedal feedback  balenciaga s reimagined version transforms the sneaker with worn in suede  a pliable sock like fit  and a deconstructed cut off formstrip  offering a softer  more sculptural silhouette 

the collaboration extends beyond footwear into technical sweatsuits  archival inspired tracksuits  and bold accessories  including a crushed dyneema shopper bag    a high strength fabric commonly used in paragliding and ballistic gear  while the first wave of the collection drops this year  balenciaga has confirmed an extended lineup arriving in late 2025 

image credit  balenciaga

title: pina colada inspired canned cocktails
texto:
pina colada inspired canned cocktails the cîroc colada spritz has been announced by the brand as its latest ready to drink  rtd  refreshment that s latest to offer consumers a decidedly lighter take on a classic cocktail  the drink features the cîroc coconut vodka in the mix alongside sparkling water and natural flavors that combine to offer a lightly refreshing beverage perfect for summertime enjoyment  the drink draws inspiration from the classic pina colada cocktail and comes in with a 7  abv to give it a modest profile that can be casually enjoyed straight from the can or poured over ice 

senior brand manager pippa lewis spoke on the cîroc colada spritz saying   we are delighted to launch cîroc colada just in time for the spring and summer seasons  a period where consumers look to connect and enjoy meaningful moments together  whether shoppers are on the go  at a picnic  or gathering with friends  cîroc colada is the perfect addition to fridges  helping retailers tap into these occasions and drive sales

title: complimentary plant milk coffees
texto:
complimentary plant milk coffees oatly has announced a new integrated marketing campaign that will see the plant based milk brand giving away free oat milk coffees to consumers in the uk to encourage them to try something different  the campaign will see 20 000 free coffees crafted with the oatly barista edition oat milk given away in bristol  birmingham  edinburgh  leeds and glasgow during march and april  the campaign comes hot on the heels of a blind taste test performed by the brand that saw participants comparing coffees with oat milk and cow s milk  which saw oat milk taking a strong share of favor 

executive creative director filip nilsson spoke on the oatly free oat milk coffees initiative saying   people love oatly in their coffee  they just don t know it yet  our blind taste tests showed there are potentially millions of people missing out on a first class taste experience  so we re going on a journey to sample delicious oatly coffees to people across the uk who may never have had the chance to try it before  proving what we know to be true   our oat drinks taste delicious  

image credit  oatly

title: custom audio playback
texto:
custom audio playback repeatbeats is a digital tool that allows users to customize their music and video playback experience  it enables precise control over audio content by offering features such as looping specific sections  skipping unwanted parts  and compiling personalized playlists  users can also integrate their favorite songs into video collections  creating tailored multimedia experiences 

designed for both casual listeners and content creators  repeatbeats enhances how individuals engage with digital media  businesses in the entertainment and fitness industries may find applications in refining audio content for training sessions  curated experiences  or branding purposes  by offering flexibility in playback  repeatbeats provides a user driven approach to media consumption  its customization capabilities could also appeal to professionals in music production and editing who require more granular control over soundtracks 

image credit  repeatbeats

title: cherry cola whiskey refreshments
texto:
cherry cola whiskey refreshments jack   coke is a classic drink that has stood the test of time  so the jack daniel s   coca cola cherry has been unveiled as a new take on the boozy concoction  the product builds on the original jack daniel s   coca cola ready to drink  rtd  beverage by giving it a decidedly fruit forward update that s expected to be a hit amongst consumers this summer  the drink comes in 330ml cans and features a 5  abv to give it a modest profile that can be enjoyed in moderation just like a hard seltzer or conventional beer 

associate director for alcoholic ready to rink  artd  at ccep gb elaine maher spoke on the jack daniel s   coca cola cherry saying   with the rtd category now worth  554million in great britain  this launch is about more than just giving fans something fresh   it s a brilliant opportunity to bring flavoured cola lovers into the category for the first time  with coca cola and coca cola zero cherry alone clocking up nearly  107million in sales to date

title: sustainable performance apparel
texto:
sustainable performance apparel craft sportswear has unveiled collective  a premium activewear line that seamlessly integrates performance  style  and sustainability  the collection features a comprehensive range of essentials crafted from recycled materials  including tencel blends and eco friendly fabrics that deliver superior moisture management while minimizing environmental impact  drawing inspiration from its scandinavian roots  the brand emphasizes minimalist design principles alongside technical performance features 

the collective line spans versatile pieces like the structure pants   79 99   bi blend tees   39 99  54 99   and women s padded sports bra   54 99   all designed with thoughtful details that enhance functionality during workouts  each garment incorporates technical elements such as bonded necklines  strategically placed pockets  and adjustable waistbands while maintaining a clean aesthetic suitable for both training sessions and everyday wear  this approach aligns with the growing market demand for activewear that transitions effortlessly between performance contexts and casual settings while supporting sustainability goals 

the brand s tagline  remember your goal  reflects its commitment to supporting consumers  athletic journeys with apparel that combines purpose driven design and environmental consciousness

title: luxury fragrance launches

luxury fragrance launches maison francis kurkdjian s  kurky  is putting a playful twist on luxury fragrance  launching exclusively at bloomingdale s on march 18  with a two week lead at the retailer  kurky is set to make a bold impression through immersive pop ups  in store experiences  and striking window displays on third avenue 

inspired by childhood memories  kurky blends tangy tutti frutti notes with creamy musks  offering a nostalgic and modern scent  housed in a peach lacquered bottle with whimsical doodles  the fragrance captures the essence of pure joy  originally crafted by francis kurkdjian as a personal gift for friends and family celebrating new beginnings  kurky now invites fragrance lovers to embrace their inner child with every spritz 

bloomingdale s  riding a wave of record breaking fragrance sales  is pulling out all the stops for this launch  proving once again that luxury can be fun  vibrant  and deeply personal

formerra  offers improved navigation  advanced search and filtering tools  streamlined checkout processes  and additional payment options  the upgrades are expected to make it easier for customers to order materials  access technical information  and manage documentation  the commerce platform also provides 24 7 accessibility  catering to the needs of purchasing  engineering  and quality control professionals across industries such as healthcare  consumer goods  industrial manufacturing  and mobility  this tailored approach enhances user satisfaction and loyalty 

formerra  aims to set a new standard for convenience and efficiency while supporting supplier partners with better visibility into material demand  the platform reflects formerra s commitment to digital innovation  sustainability  and delivering reliable supply chain solutions

title: cost effective housing exchange platforms
texto:
cost effective housing exchange platforms the house exchange app is a housing exchange platform designed to offer users a unique and cost effective way to experience new locations while maintaining the comfort of a home like environment  the app allows users to exchange their homes with others  whether for travel purposes or to reduce commuting time by living closer to their workplace  by facilitating property swaps  the platform enables users to explore local cultures more deeply  save on accommodation costs  and improve their quality of life through shorter commutes 

the house exchange app features a user friendly interface that makes it easier to find suitable exchange partners while ensuring safety through a strict verification system  real name registration  and deposit requirements  additionally  the platform supports various exchange methods  such as simultaneous and non simultaneous swaps  to accommodate diverse user needs 

image credit  house exchange

title: ai powered career exploration plaforms
texto:
ai powered career exploration plaforms career dreamer  an experimental ai powered tool by google  is designed to help individuals explore career possibilities by identifying transferable skills and aligning them with potential job opportunities  the platform guides users through creating a career identity statement  which highlights their unique strengths and experiences and assists in crafting resumes and cover letters 

by leveraging u s  labor market data and ai insights  career dreamer provides personalized career recommendations  the tool is particularly beneficial for those with unconventional career paths  such as recent graduates  military veterans  or individuals reentering the workforce  the platform emphasizes simplicity and accessibility as it requires minimal input from users while offering data driven  actionable insights to help them make informed career decisions  the tool s emphasis on personalization and ease of use makes it a valuable resource

title: reclamation inspired collaborative coffee dyed t shirts
texto:
reclamation inspired collaborative coffee dyed t shirts cxffeeblack  a memphis based coffee and culture brand  has partnered with comoco cotton  a sustainable textile company founded by stephen satterfield  to create a unique coffee dyed t shirt made with unbleached cotton  this collaboration represents a transformative effort to reclaim and redefine industries historically built on black labor and exploitation 

the coffee dyed t shirt is made from ethically sourced cotton and dyed with cxffeeblack s guji mane coffee from ethiopian farms  the design carries the phrase  god don t make no junk  and symbolizes self worth  cultural pride  and resilience 

the collaboration between cxffeeblack and comoco cotton stands as more than a product   t s a movement aimed at shifting narratives  restoring cultural ownership  and creating sustainable black ecosystems  by connecting black agriculture  art  and entrepreneurship  this collaboration seeks to empower black creatives and communities through long term ownership and supply chain control

title: comprehensive virtual healthcare solutions

disaster preparedness homeowner solutions domidocs  a leader in digital home management solutions  has introduced the documenting for disaster  program to help american homeowners prepare for and recover from catastrophic weather events  this free  cloud based platform provides tools and resources to organize  store  and manage critical property records  including insurance documents  home inventories  and vendor contacts  this has the potential to ensure homeowners are better equipped to handle disasters like wildfires  hurricanes  and floods  domidocs  documenting for disaster  platform also includes advanced features such as accounting  calendaring  and inventory tracking

texto:

the product features the signature blend of pretzels in waffle  twist and rings  which are covered with a bold sour cream   onion seasoning  the final result is a textural snack with tangy sour cream and onion tasting notes that works well for enjoyment on its own or even with your choice of libation  the snack comes in 16 ounce packs and is great for enjoyment with or without dip

texto:

title: rapid water deliveries
texto:
rapid water deliveries susosu water is a premium hydrogen infused mineral water brand and recently  it partnered with gopuff to offer rapid delivery of its products in the mid atlantic region  this collaboration allows customers to receive susosu water within 30 minutes or less  which enhances its appeal due to the emphasis on last minute convenience

title: cold pressed electrolyte drink lines
texto:
cold pressed electrolyte drink lines miami based beverage company iso has introduced a new line of cold pressed electrolyte drinks developed using hiperbaric s high pressure processing  hpp  technology  these premium hydration products are designed to deliver superior hydration with over 700mg of essential electrolytes per bottle  making them ideal for active individuals seeking effective and natural hydration solutions  the beverages are crafted with whole food ingredients and are free from artificial additives

title: rapid self tanning solutions

the australian brand  already known for transforming the self tanning industry with its original 1 hour express foam in 2018  developed this world first express formula as part of its ongoing commitment to research and innovation  this latest addition extends the express product line  which has seen increasing consumer demand for instant gratification tanning solutions that don t compromise on quality  the ultra express self tanning foam will launch exclusively at shoppers drug mart on march 12  2025  offering consumers a cost effective alternative to professional spray tans

title: latino inspired rebranding initiatives

texto:

title: software enhanced game consoles
texto:
software enhanced game consoles sony and amd are collaborating to bring fidelityfx super resolution 4  fsr 4  support to the playstation 5 pro  with a targeted launch in 2026  this initiative  known as project amethyst  aims to enhance the console s graphical fidelity by integrating amd s latest upscaling technology  fsr 4  which was recently introduced alongside amd s radeon rx 9070 and rx 9070 xt graphics cards  leverages hardware based machine learning to optimize performance and visual clarity  unlike its predecessors  fsr 4 utilizes a more advanced approach that surpasses the current playstation spectral super resolution  pssr  technology  the integration of fsr 4 into the ps5 pro is expected to deliver image quality comparable to nvidia s deep learning super sampling  dlss   providing gamers with crisper and more stable visuals in future titles 

mark cerny  playstation s lead system architect  has expressed confidence in the ps5 pro s machine learning capabilities  noting its peak performance of 300 8 bit tera operations per second  tops   this aligns favorably with amd s latest gpus and supports the implementation of fsr 4  the collaboration between sony and amd is focused on adapting the technology to the console s architecture  with ongoing efforts to integrate the new neural network and training methodologies developed through project amethyst  the introduction of fsr 4 is expected to be a significant enhancement for the ps5 pro  promising improved graphical performance and a more immersive gaming experience for users

texto:

title: plant based hydrating foaming cleansers
texto:
plant based hydrating foaming cleansers the botanity makiol foaming cleanser is one of the star selections in univera s roster with its gentle ph balanced formula  the cleanser maintains a healthy barrier while preventing dryness and is designed to match the user s skin s natural ph  it also has a mild exfoliation to leave the skin feeling and looking smooth with the lha infusion

title: wooden pendant lamp collections
texto:
wooden pendant lamp collections new york based design firm blue green works presents the wood collection  which is comprised of lighting units inspired by skateboard culture  the inspiration can be seen with the smooth curvatures drawn from skateboarding half pipes  the founder and creative director of the firm  peter b  staples redefines the elements of wood for the capsule  bringing it to the forefront

image credit  blue green works

title: ultra slim international adapters
texto:
ultra slim international adapters the anker nano travel adapter is a new tech product from the brand targeted towards avid travelers to help them keep their essential devices powered up in an intuitive way 

the device measures in at less than an inch in thickness and boasts two usb c ports alongside two usb a ports to accommodate up to four devices at once  the unit also has a us style type a outlet on the front to accommodate being used with additional chargers or devices  the adapter offers compatibility with australia  usa  uk and european outlets to work in more than 200 countries worldwide
