image credit  anker

title: hydrating brightening serums
texto:
hydrating brightening serums one of the standout products to join univera s lineup is the botanity flavon serum  the formula is developed to create a supple glow to the skin by hydrating  soothing its barriers  and strengthening overall  the serum evens and brightens the skin by reducing redness and creating an even toned complexion

title: telecom connectivity speed boosts
texto:
telecom connectivity speed boosts the comcast xfinity speeds have been increased by the brand at no additional costs to help subscribers enjoy faster internet speeds without having to worry about upgrading their plan  the announcement will reportedly affect more than 20 millions subscribers who could see their upload speeds doubled with download speeds increased as well  the update will thus see the top plan download speed increased to 2 1gbps from 2gbps and comes as part of the brand s continued commitment to offering 2gbps service to more than 50 million locations by the end of the year 

the increased comcast xfinity speeds are being brought online alongside a freebie for new and existing subscribers  which will offer an unlimited xfinity mobile line for free for one year with all 400mbps or faster plans

title: tex mex instant noodles
texto:
tex mex instant noodles consumers craving comfort food want the convenience of instant noodles with bold flavors for quick  satisfying mini meals  and general mills dropped two types of old el paso ramen noodles infused with the flavors of mexican cuisine  with over 174 million posts about instant ramen recipes on tiktok  general mills is tapping into the desires of gen z noodle lovers with all new zesty  flavor packed varieties like rich and smoky fajita with bell peppers  onions  and cumin in chicken broth  and beef birria featuring slow cooked beef flavors with balanced spice and an umami essence

title: crispy freeze dried hard candies
texto:
crispy freeze dried hard candies freeze dried candy is continuing to make waves in the category thanks to support from social media sites like tiktok  which is seeing major brands respond with new products like jolly rancher freeze dried  the product consists of the brand s signature hard candies that have been treated to freeze drying to give them a crunchy texture with an airy finish  the candy comes in the classic blue raspberry  green apple and watermelon flavor options  and are reported to have a more intense taste thanks to the freeze drying process 

senior manager of equity and activation vivek mehrotra spoke on the jolly rancher freeze dried candy saying   jolly rancher freeze dried isn t just a new way to snack it s a total flavor revolution  it s an entirely different way to experience jolly rancher unexpected  playful  and  of course  impossibly fruity  

image credit  jolly rancher

title: social media meditation features
texto:
social media meditation features the tiktok meditation feature has been announced by the social media platform as a new in app tool that will encourage users under 16 years of age to be more mindful about their screen time 

the feature works by displaying relaxing graphics and soothing music after 10pm to encourage teens to take a break instead of spending their night scrolling  the feature can be ignored before a second one will be presented that s harder for teens to dismiss  the app tool responds to increasing calls from parents for ways to help them manage the sometimes compulsive usage of social media apps like tiktok 

the tiktok meditation feature will be rolling out in the coming weeks with additional exercises for helping teens to reduce their screen time 

image credit  tiktok

title: smart hydration packs
texto:
smart hydration packs proper hydration is essential for energy  endurance  and safety  and the fluidlogic gpr50 is the world s first intelligent hydration pack providing personalized hydration for two wheeled adventurers with proprietary active hydration technology 

according to studies  a 1  drop in hydration can lead to a 12  drop in performance  and a hydration loss of 3 4  could result in a 25 50  decrease in performance and productivity  fluidlogic s proprietary active hydration algorithm considers users  unique biometrics  level of exertion  and environmental data to provide a supportive experience that delivers exactly the right amount of water they need to perform high performance activities at their peak  with this smart hydration pack  users unlock the hydration technology trusted by the military and professional motorsports drivers in nascar and indycar like jimmie johnson  alex palou  and ricky stenhouse jr

title: friend focused wellness apps
texto:
friend focused wellness apps  with gratitude  is here to change how we connect  reflect  and appreciate the little things  created by actress musician suki waterhouse and mental health advocate poppy jamie  this app makes practicing gratitude a shared experience  allowing friends and family to uplift each other through a simple daily ritual 

designed for effortless positivity  with gratitude encourages users to jot down three things they re grateful for daily and share them in private circles  whether it s celebrating big wins or appreciating life s simple joys  like a perfectly made latte   the app fosters connection in a way that s easy  authentic  and surprisingly fun 

born from waterhouse and jamie s own decade long friendship and daily gratitude practice  the concept proved so effective that it organically evolved into a full fledged platform  the waitlist has already hit 10 000  proving its resonance  with gratitude slows things down in a world that moves fast  turning small moments into meaningful memories 

image credit  wwd com

balanced electrolyte beverages as an alternative to beverages loaded with sugar  artificial flavors  and unnecessary additives  be love crafts energizing  well balanced  zero sugar drinks that replenish without the junk  be love varieties like berry bliss  citrus zest  and orange blossom are ready to sip straight from slim cans that deliver potassium  magnesium  and sodium in formulas that balance blood ph levels  maintain fluid balance  transport nutrients to cells  and more

title: gamified in airport activations
texto:
gamified in airport activations in the uk and europe  confectionary brand haribo launched gamified in airport activations that give people of all ages the chance to win branded items and fan favorite haribo goldbears  the gamified experience centers on the giant wheel of fortune and uncover more fun mobile games  and attracts travelers on the move with a hyper personalized experience fueled by ai

title: entertaining ai driven experiences
texto:
entertaining ai driven experiences lotte group has launched the  lotte caliverse   an ai driven  3d entertainment experience integrated with blockchain technology  this innovative virtual world is supported by over 90 lotte group businesses spanning multiple industries  including  retail  chemicals  financial services  and hospitality  featuring prominent brands such as givenchy  mcm  l occitane  and 7 eleven  alongside lotte subsidiaries like lotte duty free  lotte himart  and lotte cinema

title: ai powered bakery pop ups
texto:
ai powered bakery pop ups to inspire bakers and engage people with a sweet tooth  the betty crocker dream bake studio is launching at the trafford centre  manchester to serve up inspiration and interaction  at the pop up  passersby can tap into the power of artificial intelligence to digitally sketch their dream cake design and input prompts to bring their creative vision to life  with this image  the ai will curate ingredients and a bespoke cake box with a personalized image  guests will walk away with their complimentary cake kit so that they can realize their cake making dreams

title: ranch flavored cookies
texto:
ranch flavored cookies cheryl s cookies has announced a new ranch flavored cookie for national ranch day to offer avid fans of the signature dressing with an unexpected way to enjoy it  the cookie is crafted with the brand s signature sugar cookie dough that s infused with potato chips for an unexpectedly savory crunch  the cookie is then baked to perfection before being topped with a ranch flavored buttercream frosting and a final sprinkling of parsley to further drive home the dressing flavored theme 

the ranch cookie from cheryl s cookies comes as the brand s latest savory baked good on the heels of the frank s redhot buttercream frosted cookie  the treat thus responds to the increasing market for baked goods and limited edition food items that put unexpected flavor experiences in the spotlight

title: regeneratively farmed pancake mixes
texto:
regeneratively farmed pancake mixes consumers who value rich flavors  nutrient density  and sustainable farming practices are investing in baking mixes like jovial foods  einkorn pancake   waffle mix 

einkorn is an ancient wheat variety known for its rich  nutty flavor and higher nutrient content compared to modern wheat  and jovial foods sources this regeneratively grown ingredient from farmers in tuscany  italy  this regeneratively grown ancient grain supports soil health and biodiversity  and it offers the advantage of being easy to digest 

in the natural products expo west nexty awards 2025  jovial foods  einkorn pancake   waffle mix took home the title of editor s choice award winner  this baking mix simplifies the process of making waffles or pancakes with the brand s all purpose einkorn flour  which is abundant in protein  lower in starch and carbohydrates  certified glyphosate free  and said to taste better than modern wheat

title: ready to pour mango mimosas
texto:
ready to pour mango mimosas to meet the growing consumer demand for wine based cocktails  cupcake vineyards launched ready to serve mimosas crafted with bubbly brut from spain and real fruit juice  cupcake vineyards mimosas boast 7  alcohol and brighten brunches with juicy tropical notes and bright acidity  cupcake vineyards mimosas are not reserved for special occasions  they make it easy to turn everyday moments into opportunities to indulge  alongside a classic mimosa variety with orange juice  there s one made with bubbly brut wine and real mango juice 

with this new offering  cupcake vineyards introduced a refreshed logo across its entire product portfolio  the modern design centers the wordmark with a bold font and emphasizes the world class wine growing regions for each varietal

title: seasonal cinnamon roll desserts
texto:
seasonal cinnamon roll desserts the cinnaholic springtime desserts have been announced just in time to coincide with the seasonal shift as a series of treats perfect for satisfying cravings  the product range includes the strawberry fields roll  berry crumble roll  chocolate dipped roll  berry patch four box  lemonberry coffee cake and the lemonberry loaf  the various items put a fruit flavor in the spotlight along with lighter notes to work well for consumers who are looking for treats that aren t as heavy as wintertime alternatives

texto:
cake flavored alt creamers at expo west 2025  califia farms debuted birthday cake almond creamer  an indulgent treat that offers indulgence beyond special occasions  the sweet taste of birthday cake has become a flavor in its own right  making the signature taste of vanilla  butter  and colorful sprinkles available for everyday enjoyment  ready to enhance hot and cold beverages alike  this cake flavored creamer stands out for its vegan friendly formula and reduced sugar  this 100  plant based creamer made with almonds boasts 25  less sugar than the leading sweetened creamer brand  and it shares a straightforward formula crafted without carrageenan  gluten  soy  or bpa 

this dessert like plant based creamer is one of several decadent varieties from the brand and it appeals to fans of previous releases like chocolate chip cookie almond creamer  caramel macchiato almond creamer  and toasted hazelnut almond creamer

title: legend inspired snack chips
texto:
legend inspired snack chips the mister bee mothman style mysterious spice blend chips have been announced by the brand as a new legend inspired snack product perfect for lore loving consumers to try out  the product is rolling out now to local retailers and features the brand s signature potato chip base that s paired with a spice blend that offers savory flavor in every bite  the snack product draws its inspiration from the west virginia legend  which consists of a winged  humanoid creature who has beed reportedly spotted throughout the state since 1966

title: exclusive high performance pieces
texto:
exclusive high performance pieces pirelli design partners with acclaimed designer denis dekovic to unveil a collection of high performance pieces  starting with the  special edition podium caps   these crafted caps  worn by formula 1 drivers atop the podium at 14 grand prix events in the 2025 season   embody precision engineering  premium materials  and an unmistakable racing heritage   the first releases will be available in the coming months through an exclusive e commerce platform and select luxury retailers worldwide 

expanding beyond headwear  the collaboration will introduce a series of capsule collections throughout the year  featuring apparel and accessories that fuse motorsport aesthetics with state of the art materials and modern craftsmanship  each drop will showcase bold yet refined designs  channeling pirelli s relentless pursuit of speed and innovation  while redefining the intersection of fashion and high performance engineering

title: high protein bottled milkshakes
texto:
high protein bottled milkshakes the quest protein milkshakes have been announced by quest nutrition as its latest lineup of ready to drink  rtd  protein supplements that are perfect for athletes and nutrition minded consumers alike  the drink range includes vanilla  strawberry and chocolate flavor options  which are each packed with 45 grams of protein  four grams or less of net carbs and two grams of sugar  the drinks are positioned as one of the highest protein refreshments out there and are sure to catch the attention of those looking to up their intake 

senior vice president and general manager stuart heflin spoke on the quest protein milkshakes saying   at quest  we re constantly pushing the boundaries to create products that are big on protein  without compromising on flavor  as seen in our recent bake shop line  and now  we re thrilled to expand on this by entering a brand new territory with our protein milkshakes  offering our fans even more delicious options that fuel them with 45 grams of protein  the highest protein in this category on the market  

image credit  quest nutrition

title: plant based egg patties
texto:
plant based egg patties the patty one by yo egg is a convenient solution for grab and go breakfasts  offering a 100  plant based format that rivals the look of a pan fried egg  this plant based egg alternative is made with a protein blend and tinted with beta carotene and paprika  preparing these plant based egg patties is as easy from frozen is as easy as heating them in the air fryer or stovetop for a quick  savory meal at home  the office  or elsewhere 

amidst egg shortages and soaring prices  plant based egg alternatives are flying off shelves as consumers seek affordable substitutes  alongside the patty one which won the 2025 nexty award in the vegan category yo egg offers the poached one and the sunny one with a unique runny yolk  all of these egg alternatives boast 0  cholesterol

title: european inspired camper vans
texto:
european inspired camper vans the westfalia americas wave srt camper van is the latest offering from the north american brand that leverages a number of details from european alternatives for domestic travelers to enjoy  the camper offers space for up to four people to comfortably sleep  while the vehicle still maintains a compact form that s highly maneuverable  the vehicle also offers 6 2 feet of headroom inside to make it great for average sized campers to not feel cramped 

the westfalia americas wave srt camper van also has an impressive electrical system that includes a 600ah lithium battery along with a 3 000w inverter and 300w solar panel  the vehicle is rounded out with a galley kitchen  seating area and bathroom for off grid comfort 

image credit  westfalia americas

title: honey sweetened ice creams
texto:
honey sweetened ice creams as an alternative to the way ice cream is traditionally sweetened with sugar  ice cream for bears creates delicious frozen desserts sweetened only with raw honey  this refreshingly simple ice cream boasts a short ingredient list that includes a base of milk and cream  raw honey  skim milk  and egg yolk  because the brand only adds the honey after the pasteurization process and after the mixture has cooled  the honey remains in its raw  unfiltered state 

ice cream for bears  honey honey took home the winning title in the frozen dessert category of natural products expo west s 2025 nexty awards  the honey honey swirl french ice cream is one of several honey sweetened ice cream varieties from the brand  which offers flavors for fans of chocolate  mint chip  and classic vanilla

title: international professional neobanks
texto:
international professional neobanks  zolve  is a neobank solution created with a focus on helping global citizens to access financial products when settling down in a new location where they don t have access to their previous credit or account history 

the online only bank provides skilled workers who move to new locations like the united states with access to financial products like credit cards and loans that traditional banks would likely deny them for  this responds to the needs of newcomers who are low risk yet can t leverage their credit history from a different country or bank  the startup thus accesses their credit history from their home country and assumes the underwriting risk 

founder and ceo raghunandan g spoke on  zolve  saying   financial institutions in one country don t talk to financial institutions in another country because sufficiently low risk individuals end up being treated as high risk  that s the problem we are trying to solve  

image credit  zolve

title: glowing lunar eclipse inspired drinks
texto:
glowing lunar eclipse inspired drinks to commemorate the total lunar eclipse on march 14  capri sun introduces its first ever glow in the dark drink   moon punch   this limited edition product will be available later in march at major retailers including amazon  walmart  target  and kroger  among others 

timed to coincide with the celestial event  moon punch features  a cherry flavored juice and is packaged in eight collectible pouches  each representing a different moon phase   designed to spark the imagination  the glow in the dark effect allows consumers to enjoy a unique  nighttime experience  bringing the magic of the night sky to their beverage 

moon punch will only be available for a limited time  from its debut through 09   also coinciding with summer outdoor activities like camping and star gazing  moreover  this temporary release reflects the rare occurrence of the total lunar eclipse  adding a special touch to capri sun s offerings for those seeking a one of a kind product 

image credit  capri sun

title: flavor enhancing crumbled cheeses
texto:
flavor enhancing crumbled cheeses bel brands usa has announced a new product under its boursin cheese lineup that s expected to make waves amongst foodies looking to elevate the flavor of their favorite recipes  boursin crumbles  the product comes in a resealable tub that will allow for multiple serving occasions and features a crumbled texture that can be sprinkled into salads or even soups  the cheese product comes in two flavors including garlic   fine herbs and caramelized onion   herbs  which are both arriving at a variety of retailers in the us for  5 99 each 

brand director katie hermann spoke on boursin crumbles saying   whether entertaining for a large group or cooking for one  boursin crumbles will empower people to effortlessly elevate their meals bringing the distinct flavor and texture of boursin to any recipe with a simple sprinkle  

image credit  boursin cheese

title: snack cake protein supplements
texto:
snack cake protein supplements redcon1 and hostess have announced a new partnership that will see the sports nutrition brand leveraging the recognizable flavors of the latter snack cake brand for delicious results  the partnership is seeing redcon1 creating protein shakes and powders in flavors from hostess including twinkies  cupcakes and ding dongs to give them more of a treat inspired flavor  the products are arriving now and are expected to be the first of several new options hitting the market over the course of the year ahead 

the redcon1 and hostess partnership comes as part of a wider shift towards nutrition brands incorporating classic flavor experiences to help catch the attention of consumers  the products also leverage the popularity of limited edition foods amongst consumers eager to try the latest treat

title: ranch flavored frozen chicken snacks
texto:
ranch flavored frozen chicken snacks the white castle ranch chicken rings have been announced by the qsr brand as its latest product headed to the freezer case in the grocery store thanks to an ongoing partnership with bellisio foods  the product was announced to coincide with national ranch day and features the brand s signature chicken rings that are infused with the herbs and spices associated with the ranch flavor profile  the product is crafted with white meat chicken and a light breading in the base to make it a quick yet satisfying snack for consumers of all ages 

cmo lynn blashford spoke on the white castle ranch chicken rings saying   we are thrilled to introduce new ranch flavored chicken rings  ranch is a beloved flavor that is consistently ranked high in popularity among consumers  yet surprisingly underrepresented in the frozen chicken category  we believe our ranch flavored rings will fill this gap and become a craveable favorite for consumers of all ages  

image credit  bellisio foods white castle

title: price driven fast casual menus
texto:
price driven fast casual menus the farmer boys farmstand fresh   affordable menu is a new offering from the fast casual restaurant brand targeted towards price conscious consumers on the hunt for high quality  low cost dining options  the menu showcases seven dishes to choose from each priced at  9 99 including the big cheese box  double big cheese box  three or four piece chicken strips box and more  the various options on the menu are crafted with high quality ingredients and are made to order to ensure the utmost attention to freshness

title: money inspired footwear collabs
texto:
money inspired footwear collabs the concepts x new balance 1000  milé  is turning an obsolete  1 000 bill into one of the most coveted sneaker drops of the season  drawing inspiration from the legendary 1890  grand watermelon  treasury note  this collaboration infuses history  high fashion  and a touch of bank heist lore into a bold sneaker design

launching march 14 through concepts  website and stores  the concepts x new balance 1000  milé  is a collector s piece wrapped in history

title: celeb crafted canned iced lattes
texto:
celeb crafted canned iced lattes canned coffee is the most consumed format among gen z and millennials  and florence by mills coffee launched ready to drink iced lattes with competitive prices in shelf stable formats exclusively at walmart

 millie s fans are year round iced coffee enthusiasts  so it was essential to us that florence by mills coffee deliver on both taste and value   said danny wright  ceo   founder of collab coffee florence by mills coffee s coffee partner

title: coffee citrus kombuchas
texto:

title: rugged waterproof rubber boots
texto:

title: intern application automation
texto:

title: entertainment discovery hubs

4 in 1 back wraps therabody s innovative lineup of products for recovery  pain relief  and skin health expanded to include thermback led  an advanced back wrap with far infrared  led  heat  and vibration  this four in one back wrap combines four treatments in a single device to deliver comfortable  convenient  and fast acting lower back pain relief 

for many  lasting relief from back pain only comes in medical settings  but the thermback led enhances mobility  reduces stiffness  and accelerates recovery all from the comfort of home 

according to the world health organization  lower back pain is the most prevalent musculoskeletal condition globally and the leading cause of disability worldwide  therabody is working with scientists from the university of buffalo s department of emergency medicine to conduct its first ever registered clinical trial to prove the efficacy of combining therapies

title: curated online fashion storefronts
texto:
curated online fashion storefronts shein has introduced its  trend stores   a collection of curated online fashion storefronts designed to match various personal styles  these stores offer a personalized shopping experience  allowing customers to easily find clothing tailored to their specific preferences and occasions by searching for a trend store on shein com 

the  missguided  and  shein bae  stores cater to bold fashion choices  featuring bodycon dresses and daring silhouettes  meanwhile   anewsta  and  motf  focus on refined elegance  offering sophisticated wardrobe staples  for vacation ready styles   enchnt  and  travachic  provide relaxed  stylish options 

streetwear lovers can explore  musera  and  shein icon  for edgy  urban inspired designs  while  dazy weekend  and  shein mod  offer relaxed  playful pieces with retro influences  moreover  shein consumers are encouraged to share their trend store finds on social media by tagging  shein_us and using  sheintrends 

image credit  shein

title: low sugar chocolate bites
texto:
low sugar chocolate bites curbing a sweet tooth craving often means consuming treats loaded with sugar and filler ingredients  but whims offers low sugar alternatives made without gluten  dairy  palm oil  or sugar alcohols  allowing for guilt free indulgence without the sugar crash 

these decadent plant based bites are available in varieties like oat milk chocolate peanut butter cups  oat milk peanut nougat bars  and oat milk caramel cookie bars and all of the bites contain just a single gram of sugar per piece 

while fans of sweet and salty peanut butter cups will appreciate the brand s efforts to scale back sugar and completely avoid dairy  the brand s take on caramel cookie bites and peanut nougat bites deliver a satisfying crunch with 91  less sugar than the originals that inspired them

title: indulgently layered easter chocolates
texto:
indulgently layered easter chocolates the deluxe layered eggs have been announced by lidl in the uk for its 2025 easter egg collection as a series of treats that elevate the humble springtime chocolate into a rich  indulgent option for shoppers to pick up this springtime 

the chocolate product looks like a traditional hollow chocolate easter egg yet will reveal a layered form that places sweet fillings in the spotlight  the product thus comes in two options including the deluxe salted caramel milk chocolate layered egg and the deluxe caramelised biscuit milk chocolate layered egg  which are each priced at  8 99 

the deluxe layered eggs are slated to be right at home within the collection of additional easter treats that include such options as the mister choc eggs in popcorn and caramel biscuit fudge flavors  and more

title: premium tequila boxes
texto:
premium tequila boxes reserva de la familia by jose cuervo celebrates mexican artistry with the 2025 edition of its annual collector s box  which features the  extra añejo  tequila  this release  marking the 30th anniversary of the brand s public debut  underscores the rich tradition of combining premium tequila craftsmanship with mexican culture 

designed by contemporary mexican artist ana segovia  the box is titled  no señorita  esos colores son prohibidos   drawing inspiration from  the traditional charro suit  segovia incorporates vibrant fluorescent colors  giving this iconic symbol of mexican rodeo a modern twist   in doing so  this collaboration beautifully honors the longstanding tradition of fusing tequila with art to celebrate mexican heritage 

as a result  limited quantities of the 2025 collector s box will be available at select u s  retailers and reservebar for  189  offering a unique collectible that combines art  culture  and exceptional tequila

title: unisex trucker hats
texto:
unisex trucker hats morning nudes  a sustainable  female founded brand from vancouver  introduces a cheeky addition to any spring wardrobe  unisex trucker hats  these curved brim caps feature bold  morning nudes  graphics and an adjustable strap  making them perfect for city days and spring break escapes  available in camo  blue  red white  and black white  each hat blends playful design with everyday ease and is rooted in quality craftsmanship  notably  these hats were featured on the vancouver fashion week runway  highlighting their stylish appeal 

whether you re hiding from the sun  between hair wash days  or spicing up an outfit  these trucker hats offer a versatile and fashionable solution  their unisex design ensures they complement any wardrobe  providing both function and flair  by choosing morning nudes  you re elevating your style and supporting sustainable fashion practices

title: miniature creamy pops
texto:
miniature creamy pops johnnypops  minis with cream debut at expo west 2025  treating all ages to indulgent sweet treats made without artificial dyes 

jonnypops  new cream minis are dropping in three brand new flavors birthday surprise minis with cream  neapolitan minis with cream  and unicorn minis with cream with a proprietary layered pop design  of the three  birthday surprise minis with cream is the most highly anticipated thanks to its frosting inspired outer layer  and rainbow colored interior created without artificial food colorants  these gluten free novelties made in a peanut free facility are fueled by simple ingredients yet deliver layers upon layers of flavor 

these creamy  snackable pops offer a scaled down version of a beloved product for afternoon snacks  evening desserts  or eating anytime in between

title: tooth gap cleaning tools
texto:
tooth gap cleaning tools the ordo denta reach oral care tool is a new product from the brand created with tooth gaps in mind to help consumers more easily perform cleanings from the comfort of home  the tool is crafted with a dentist approved design that includes flexible bristles for a soft yet effective cleaning  while the ergonomic grip enables easier cleaning in hard to reach areas  the metal free design is more gentle on gums and is made with a 97  recyclable form that only needs to have the head cut off before being recycled 

founder of ordo barty walsh spoke on the ordo denta reach oral care tool saying   at ordo  we re committed to designing products that people genuinely need but can t find elsewhere  we recently launched a range of accessible toothbrushes to help those with dexterity challenges  and we wanted to continue that mission creating innovative  inclusive solutions that make oral care easier for everyone  denta reach is another step towards that goal  bringing professional quality cleaning to at home routines in a way that s simple  effective  and accessible

title: international women s day campaigns
texto:
international women s day campaigns in response to google quietly removing international women s day from its calendar app  ywca metro vancouver is taking action with its new  rebook it  initiative    a simple yet powerful tool that allows users to restore march 8 as an annual event on their digital calendars 

international women s day has been a pivotal moment for progress for over a century  ywca s campaign ensures it stays visible despite the tech giant s quiet decision to phase out certain diversity  equity  and inclusion initiatives  anyone can add iwd to their google calendar with a single click  reinforcing the day s importance in the fight for gender equality 

 if tech won t mark the date  we will   says amy juschka  director of communications and advocacy at ywca metro vancouver  join the movement and ensure international women s day remains a priority  visit rebook it com to reclaim the date and keep the momentum going 

image credit  ywca

title: style conscious body washes
texto:
style conscious body washes the limited time olay x wantable power edit collection unites the power of olay body with a leader in the personalized styling space to help women feel their most confident 

 our research shows that seven in 10 women avoid fashion choices that might expose their body skin concerns like dryness or rough and bumpy texture  often letting these insecurities impact their style   said kate dicarlo  senior communications director for procter   gamble s personal care portfolio

title: creamy hard soda variety packs
texto:

together  these flavors evoke a nostalgic taste experience while maintaining the crisp  refreshing qualities that vizzy is known for

title: cutting edge entertainment amphitheaters
texto:
cutting edge entertainment amphitheaters set to open in late 2025  vai resort s amphitheater is designed to provide a technologically advanced venue for live performances  to bring this vision to life  tait  a leader in live event production  has engineered the venue with cutting edge stage capabilities  now open for artist bookings  the amphitheater is built to accommodate a diverse range of performances with precision and innovation

title: honey sweetened chili sauces
texto:
honey sweetened chili sauces lee kum kee honey sriracha sauce is the latest addition to the sauce brand s product portfolio that s crafted with a sweet and spicy  swicy  flavor in mind to work well for foodies seeking to elevate their favorite recipes  the sauce starts off with the signature flavor of sriracha  which is elevated with the taste of honey in the mix to achieve a hot honey taste perfect for elevating a wide range of meals  the product is positioned as being great for drizzling over your favorite recipes  while also being perfect for use as a marinade  a glaze or even a stir fry sauce

title: pickle brine packs
texto:
pickle brine packs consumers  obsession with pickles goes beyond the crunch  as many crave the tangy brine for its bold flavor and the added benefit of replenishing electrolytes  and claussen dropped a limited edition just the brine for them 

in 10    claussen teased just the brine on social media and promised to make the concept a reality if its community showed enough support  thousands of requests flowed in and six months later  just the brine is launching ahead of st  patrick s day celebrations  offering an alternative to dubiously colored green beverages 

just the brine is ready to be enjoyed by day for a replenishing boost of electrolytes and by night as a delicious mixer  just the brine is launching in six packs featuring three bottles for  pickling  in the evening and three for  unpickling  the day after

title: pancake inspired fragrances
texto:
pancake inspired fragrances snif is gearing up to launch hot cakes  a pancake inspired fragrance for fans of sweet breakfasts and brunches with notes of maple syrup  melted butter  berry compote  buttermilk  and sugared musk  the nostalgic hot cakes and mists collection perfectly feeds into the brand s mission to make fragrance fun again 

perfume lovers crave more than just unique fragrances they want entire scent systems designed for layering  allowing them to mix and match notes for a personalized olfactory experience  with this in mind  snif is launching its pancake inspired fragrance alongside a brand new line of body mist  toppings   while extra whip shares cool  creamy notes of whipped cream  vanilla  and fluffy musk  berry styles brings in blueberry and raspberry notes  and hazel split amps up the decadence with the scent of cocoa  hazelnut spread  and creamy banana

title: canned tea brand kombuchas
texto:
canned tea brand kombuchas lipton kombucha has been launched by the brand in the uk as a range of effervescent canned refreshments perfect for curious foodies who are new to the fermented tea or who are simply on the hunt for a more convenient way to enjoy it 

the drink range consists of three flavor options including mango passionfruit  raspberry and strawberry mint  which are each sweet yet low in sugar  the beverages each feature a blend of naturally fermented kombucha tea with natural fruit flavors and come in 250ml single cans as well as four serving multipacks 

vp sales off trade  carlsberg britvic ben parker spoke on lipton kombucha saying   we know how popular the kombucha trend is and believe lipton has created a product that can introduce even more people to the category and its benefits  as a brand  we are in a good position to grow an exciting category and we re really looking forward to shoppers being able to try the flavours and for retailers to reap the current untapped rewards of stocking it

title: refreshing demand driven ciders
texto:
refreshing demand driven ciders heineken uk owned inch s cider has debuted two new products just ahead of the entertaining season that each respond to consumer demand for authentic libations  the products include inch s cloudy and inch s 0 0  which are each craft with 100  british apples and come in 440ml cans with price points ranging from  4 to  4 75  inch s cloudy features a a naturally cloudy cider that s crisp  refreshing and light  while inch s 0 0 comes as the first dealcoholized cider in the uk in response to increasing calls for low and no alcohol drinks 

cider brand director at heineken uk rachel holms spoke on the new products from inch s cider saying   we re confident these new additions will drive further growth in the category while reinforcing inch s reputation as a fresh  modern cider brand   encouraging existing inch s fans to explore new tastes  and providing a credible option for those who are looking to moderate their alcohol consumption

title: pizza style pretzel bites
texto:
pizza style pretzel bites national ranch day is the perfect excuse to stock up on snacks for dipping and with this holiday in mind  auntie anne s invites ranch lovers to pair its iconic bite sized pepperoni nuggets with hidden valley ranch dip as part of the limited time pretzelria delivery service 

for a limited time  snackers can enter a sweepstakes for the chance to win a prize bundle that includes a year of free auntie anne s pretzels  hidden valley ranch  an exclusive merch pack  and a  500 delivery gift card  prize winners in new york city  detroit  and chicago will also get a custom box of pepperoni nuggets with hidden valleyranch  delivered via the white glove pretzelria delivery service  the dippable pizza inspired snack features signature dough baked to perfection  then topped with pepperoni and a cheese blend

title: weed centric women s campaigns
texto:
weed centric women s campaigns the  women of weed  campaign is here to shatter outdated stereotypes and reframe the narrative around women who consume cannabis  launched by sundae school and sundae flowers  this groundbreaking campaign spotlights four high achieving women who smoke  create  lead  and disrupt    on their own terms 

for too long  cannabis has been linked to laziness and indulgence  particularly when associated with women  women of weed challenges that perception with a docuseries that dives deep into the lives of patia borja  nimay ndolo  georgia rae lyken  and emily lee    each redefining what it means to be high functioning and high achieving  from activism to software engineering  these women are proof that success and cannabis consumption are not mutually exclusive 

paired with the ss25  smokewear matcha  collection  the campaign is a visual and cultural statement  championing style and substance  women of weed isn t about asking for validation  it s about taking up space  prioritizing rest  and rejecting the grind first mentality 

image credit  sundae school

title: ranch bottle auctions
texto:
ranch bottle auctions consumers  obsession with all things ranch has grown so strong that they observe national ranch day  and wingstop is giving ranch lovers more to celebrate in 2025 by auctioning off the first ever  official  bottle of wingstop ranch  for years  guests have pleaded for wingstop s iconic ranch to be bottled  and for the first time in its history  wingstop is bottling its ranch which comes with access to a year s supply of ranch refills at their local wingstop 

the highest bidder will also get a certificate signed by wingstop s head of culinary  chef larry bellah  to prove its authenticity  on ebay  the highest bid for the bottled wingstop ranch is currently  511  all proceeds from the sale will benefit wingstop charities 

all the ranch lovers who won t be taking home the first official bottle from wingstop can still celebrate with free ranch at any wingstop on national ranch day

title: organic beverage expansions
texto:
organic beverage expansions  sparkling cherry jubilation   a nexty award finalist at expo west  takes center stage in guayakí yerba mate s newest lineup  delivering a nostalgic yet modern twist on the classic shirley temple  crafted with organic  regenerative ingredients  this effervescent blend of cherry and subtle floral notes offers a refreshing take on naturally caffeinated energy 

joining the expansion   bravo mango  introduces a tropical  non carbonated fusion of floral mango and citrus  while  strawberry hibiscus  reimagines a beloved bottled brew with juicy fruit and rich herbal depth   summer peach  balances rooibos and yerba mate with delicate white flower undertones for a smooth  uplifting experience 

additionally  guayakí refreshes fan favorites with enhanced flavors and updated names  including  awakening orange    citrus spark   and  berrymint bliss   with this latest evolution  guayakí continues to celebrate yerba mate s heritage while embracing bold  innovative expressions

title: immersive fashion pop ups
texto:
immersive fashion pop ups shein is elevating the retail landscape with an innovative pop up experience at toronto s eaton centre from march 28th to april 6th  2025  following the success of previous temporary retail activations  this latest installation delivers a carefully curated showcase of the brand s most popular collections including maija  dazy  shein mod  and shein ezwear  the pop up emphasizes accessibility with inclusive sizing options while blending digital first retail concepts with tangible shopping experiences 

the immersive event transcends traditional retail by incorporating interactive elements  exclusive giveaways  and limited time discounts for visitors  located strategically near the apple store on the main level  the installation represents a convergence of convenience and experiential retail that responds to evolving consumer preferences  this physical manifestation of the primarily digital brand demonstrates a strategic shift toward hybrid retail models that combine e commerce efficiency with sensory in person engagement  creating memorable brand touchpoints beyond the screen 

image credit  shein

title: dessert like gut health snacks
texto:
dessert like gut health snacks maintaining good gut health has become easier and more delicious than ever with the latest additions to the activia gut health range in the uk that will offer flavorful ways to curb hunger  while also supporting nutritional needs 

the new products from the danone owned yogurt brand include a larger format of the activia kefir natural alongside the activia kefir peach passion fruit  the brand is also introducing activia fibre berries with cereals in four packs exclusively at tesco before expanding to additional retailers later in the year  the various items each respond to increasing calls amongst consumers for ways to boost their intake of fiber  but also support their gut health 

head of marketing at danone rachel wright commented on the new additions to the activia gut health range saying   we ve seen strong demand for our kefir and fibre ranges as consumers become increasingly aware of the gut health benefits of these products   we re excited to bring these new flavours and formats to market as we continue to provide consumers with delicious and nutritious options to support their gut health

title: crispy flavorful fish entrees
texto:
crispy flavorful fish entrees the birds eye captain s discoveries range is a new lineup of products created with high quality  convenient cuisine in mind to work well for consumers on the hunt for ways to liven up weekday meal plans  the frozen fish products come in four options including the new mexican inspired tortilla crumb fish fillets and the mediterranean inspired focaccia crumb fish fillets alongside the mexican inspired fish fillet bake and the indian inspired fish fillet bake  the products each put high quality taste and texture in the spotlight to work well as the main course in a variety of meals 

marketing director at birds eye uk i mike sowerby spoke on the birds eye captain s discoveries range saying   as a brand that is loved and trusted by consumers to consistently deliver great tasting  quality products  we wanted to bring real excitement to the frozen fish category with a totally new range of flavours  birds eye s new captain s discoveries range is inspired by cuisines from across the seven seas  celebrating captain birds eye s passion for exploration and freshness  inviting consumers to join him on a  voyage of taste

title: immersive women targeted travel tours
texto:
immersive women targeted travel tours with  86  of women expressing interest in traveling within all female groups   ef go ahead tours has launched its first ever  women only solo tours   designed to foster meaningful connections and personal growth through immersive experiences  these curated journeys provide a supportive environment for solo travelers seeking cultural exploration and community 

survey findings highlight that  women prioritize connection whether with fellow travelers  local communities  or the stories of remarkable women throughout history   while many enjoy the independence of solo travel  they find comfort and confidence in exploring alongside a like minded group 

timed with women s history month  these tours span italy  the uk   ireland  spain   portugal  greece  thailand  peru  and egypt  each itinerary emphasizes cultural immersion  supports women owned businesses  and celebrates historic female contributions  all guided by expert female tour directors for a uniquely enriching experience

texto:

title: cocktail card games
texto:
cocktail card games award winning  female founded infused tequila brand 21seeds teamed up with media personality danielle robay to create shot callers  a co branded card deck inspired by the question everything game danielle plays with podcast guests 

shot callers is a card game that inspires meaningful conversation and connections over 21seeds cocktails  and the playing cards are color coordinated to match infused tequila varietals like valencia orange  cucumber jalapeño  and grapefruit hibiscus  in all  there are 49 questions and prompts to discover  including  what celebrity s closet would you love to raid   or  what s the most important lesson you ve learned in the past five years  

21seeds x question everything shot callers underscores the simplicity of making cocktails with the infused tequila and how it helps drinkers buy back more time with friends

title: smoothie bowl brand expansions
texto:
smoothie bowl brand expansions bonita bowls  a fast casual restaurant chain specializing in smoothie bowls  poke bowls  wraps  and other healthy menu options  has expanded its presence with the opening of a new location in la grange  illinois  this marks the chain s fifth corporate location  joining existing outlets in glen ellyn  elmhurst  downers grove  and park ridge  situated at 114 w calendar avenue  the la grange store features vibrant design elements  including colorful floral displays and eye catching artwork  the menu offers a variety of health conscious options  such as the bali bowl  made with acai  gluten free granola  blueberries  strawberries  and honey  as well as the nama colada smoothie  which combines coconut  pineapple  and agave blended in coconut milk 

the expansion into la grange is part of bonita bowls  broader growth strategy  which focuses on suburban areas around chicago  the company  founded in 2021 by illinois native kyle kissane  has experienced steady growth over the past four years  in addition to the la grange location  bonita bowls plans to launch its franchise division with a new store in wheaton  illinois  later this year  this move reflects the brand s commitment to making healthy dining options accessible to a wider audience  the wheaton store will be operated by franchisees traci and oscar suazo  who aim to bring bonita bowls  wellness inspired menu to the downtown area 

image credit  bonita bowls

title: limited edition easter gummies
texto:
limited edition easter gummies swizzels squashies drumchick candies are being added to the brand s product portfolio in the uk as a new take on its signature gummy candy with a foam like consistency  the candies feature an orange and pineapple flavor as well as a chick inspire shape that further drives home the easter inspired experience to make them great for springtime enjoyment  the treat comes in 120 gram bags and is branded with bright colors to give them a fresh profile that shopper will immediately spot on store shelves 

trade marketing manager clare newton spoke on the swizzels squashies drumchick candies saying   whilst easter is usually associated with chocolate  we ve noted rising demand for alternative sweet treats  as a result  we ve launched squashies drumchick to help retailers elevate their easter offerings and boost sales  squashies drumchick play into the popularity of fruity flavours and limited edition  seasonal treats and are ideal for retailers looking to diversify their easter range  compliment chocolate confectionery and appeal to a broader range of shoppers looking for something refreshing  fun and affordable this year

title: seaweed inspired soapless cleansers
texto:
seaweed inspired soapless cleansers lush s bara lawr cleansing roll is a unique soapless cleanser inspired by laverbread a traditional welsh dish made from cooked seaweed and it features hydrating laver seaweed  leek  and irish moss gel as ingredients  this freshly made facial cleanser also includes beneficial additions like green clay  oat milk  and organic lemon juice  this unconventionally shaped cleanser abundant in vitamin a is ready to be broken into pieces and mixed with water to form a paste 

lush s subscription exclusive bara lawr is available in the 2025 march fresh   flowers box  alongside other freshly made products inspired by welsh culture  recipes  and stories  the body care box also includes pampering products like a face mask  a flower shaped bubble blower  and a solid hand cream sculpted to look like an ornately carved spoon

title: updated handheld console return policies
texto:
updated handheld console return policies go retroid has announced that it will accept returns for its retroid pocket mini handheld gaming device due to screen scaling issues that cannot be resolved  the issue  which affects the appearance of games when specific crt shaders are applied  results in misplaced scanlines  uneven pixels  or distorted images  the company has attributed the problem to the screen driver and confirmed that it cannot be fixed  to address customer concerns  retroid has opened a return window from march 8 to march 14  2025  allowing affected users to request refunds  however  the return policy includes limitations  such as a cap of 200 overseas returns and the requirement for customers to cover return shipping costs 

in addition to the return option  retroid is offering all retroid pocket mini owners a  10 coupon that can be applied to future purchases  including the upcoming retroid flip2 and retroid classic devices  the company has acknowledged the challenges of managing the return process and has encouraged users who do not heavily rely on crt shaders or pixel grid effects to reserve the opportunity for those who genuinely need it  this development follows months of customer feedback and discussions within the retro gaming community regarding the screen scaling issue  retroid s response reflects its effort to address the concerns of its user base while managing the logistical and financial implications of the returns 

image credit  go retroid

title: affordable decorative pieces
texto:

title: affordable celebrity endorsed kitchenwares
texto:

in addition to the spring collection  dollar general plans to release two more seasonal collections later in the year  a summer entertaining collection is scheduled for may  followed by a christmas themed collection for the holiday season  these expansions build on the success of the initial dolly parton product line launched in 2024  dollar general s collaboration with dolly parton reflects the retailer s commitment to offering unique and affordable products while celebrating the cultural influence of the iconic artist  this initiative also aligns with the company s goal of surprising and delighting its customers through exclusive and themed product offerings

title: gaming ready external ssd enclosures
texto:
gaming ready external ssd enclosures the patriot viper ev330 is a compact and portable ssd enclosure designed to accommodate m 2 2230 ssds  weighing only 52 grams  the enclosure is constructed from aluminum alloy  which provides durability and aids in heat dissipation  its dimensions of 1 77 inches by 1 77 inches by 0 47 inches make it highly portable  suitable for carrying in a pocket or bag  the enclosure features a usb c connection that supports usb 3 2 gen 2  enabling data transfer speeds of up to 1000 mb s under optimal conditions  additionally  the ev330 includes a silicone bumper for added protection and a built in usb c cable  ensuring convenience for users on the go 

the ev330 is designed with practicality in mind  offering a straightforward installation process with the included screwdriver for securing the ssd  the enclosure also features a window on one side  allowing users to view the internal ssd  its compatibility with the m 2 2230 form factor makes it an ideal choice for portable game consoles and other compact devices  by combining robust construction  high speed connectivity  and user friendly features  the patriot viper ev330 serves as a reliable solution for those seeking portable and efficient external storage 

image credit  patriot viper
