by automating the transition from short form to long form content  typedd helps professionals and businesses maximize their reach without additional content creation efforts  the platform also enables gated content and lead generation  allowing users to capture audience engagement more effectively  with integrations like zapier  plunk  and resend  typedd simplifies newsletter distribution and marketing workflows  this tool is particularly beneficial for thought leaders  marketers  and content creators looking to extend the lifespan of their social media posts while maintaining an efficient content strategy 

image credit  typedd

title: persistent screen overlays
texto:
persistent screen overlays screenhint is a productivity tool that allows users to capture and pin snapshots of their screens for easy reference  instead of switching between multiple apps or tabs  users can keep essential information visible in a floating window that stays on top of other applications 

this can be particularly useful for tasks that require constant reference  such as coding  writing  data entry  or design work  by reducing the need to toggle between windows  screenhint streamlines workflows and minimizes distractions  the tool is designed for professionals who want to enhance focus  retain key details  or stay inspired while working  as remote and hybrid work environments continue to evolve  solutions like screenhint address the growing need for efficiency and seamless multitasking 

image credit  screenhint

title: micro meditation apps
texto:
micro meditation apps shut up   breathe is a micro meditation app designed for quick  effective mindfulness sessions  it offers users a simple way to incorporate short  two minute meditation breaks into their daily routines  making it ideal for busy professionals and individuals seeking brief moments of calm 

the app features customizable calming backgrounds and gentle prompts to guide users through breathing exercises  helping to reduce stress and improve focus  unlike traditional meditation apps that require longer time commitments  shut up   breathe prioritizes accessibility  ensuring mindfulness can be practiced anytime  anywhere  this approach aligns with growing workplace wellness trends  catering to users looking for quick stress relief solutions  by encouraging consistency with short  daily meditations  the app promotes a sustainable mindfulness habit without disrupting productivity 

image credit  shut up   breathe

title: artful versatile rug collections
texto:
artful versatile rug collections spanish design imprint nanimarquina has unveiled a wide range of rugs  and it stems from a plethora of influences  including a string of beds and some that mimic the profile of a human face  german artist sabine finkenauer joins the brand on a collection of circular rugs that are detailed with contrasting hues 

the pearl capsule has a circle shaped theme with longer rugs and runners in the series  it evokes a sense of joyfulness  which translates through the choice of colors  the colorado rugs are from the brand and were contributed by french designer inga sempa  with themes that blend modern and traditional  the work of basque sculptor eduardo chillida inspires the chillida rug capsule 

image credit  nanimarquina

title: fish lifestyle inspired residences
texto:
fish lifestyle inspired residences beef architekti is a design studio based in bratislava  and it has just created the house of hills  the home is defined by a series of concrete slabs that are inspired by how fish gills allow light and air through  it has a monolithic look and the slabs are brushed in an organic white plaster on the sides  the bedrooms each open into an individual terrace which are uniquely formed with the unaligned walls at the exterior 

the studio explains the design to dezeen   the analogy of the fish gills emerged as a way to describe the design  conveying the idea of a house that breathes like a fish  the connection to gills is most pronounced on the side facade of the kitchen  where the angled elements create a dynamic visual effect  each gill is carefully positioned at a different angle to optimise the view from the kitchen into the garden  reinforcing the sense of movement and adaptability seen in nature  

image credit  matej hakár

title: ai music creators
texto:
ai music creators jamboss is an ai powered music generation app that enables users to create personalized songs with minimal effort  designed for ease of use  the platform allows users to generate custom tracks and share them instantly with friends and family  with ai handling the composition process  users don t need musical expertise to create engaging and unique songs 

this makes jamboss particularly appealing for casual music enthusiasts  content creators  and anyone looking to add a personal touch to special occasions  the app streamlines song creation  offering a quick and interactive way to generate music on demand  as ai generated content continues to gain traction across industries  jamboss represents a step toward making music production more accessible  expanding creative possibilities for users of all skill levels 

image credit  jamboss

title: expansive lounge furniture capsules
texto:
expansive lounge furniture capsules symbol home  which was previously symbol audio has launched the first living room and workspace furniture capsules  this is a milestone for the brand as it has been known for its premium audio and vinyl storage systems  now  symbol home pushes its design ethos to encompass more than audio but the entire home 

music is always going to be at the core part of the brand  and this influence is evident in all of the pieces in the new range  the living room capsule is made for deep listening with comfortable seats and sleek coffee tables  the workspace collection evokes a sense of elegance with elements that foster creativity  there are sophisticated desks  bookcases  and storage solutions 

image credit  symbol home

title: salvaged material made saunas
texto:
salvaged material made saunas czech design studio ika architekti designed the upcycled sauna  which is a small structure resting under an apple tree in a garden  the structure measures four square meters and it is actually in the garden of the ika architekti s co founder tomás dvo ák  the sauna is a personal project which terms from the studio s dedication of working sustainably and he has the  desire to build something with our own hands instead of just clicking and answering emails  

ika architekti explains the design process   this is what happens when you scroll through second hand websites and when you love collecting materials that might still come in handy  it might sound like hoarding  but when you re also an architect  you suddenly have a lot of great stuff to build with   and that s exactly how we sometimes spend our free weekends as architects  

image credit  tomas slavik

title: rural architecture honoring homes
texto:
rural architecture honoring homes architecture firm loader monteith has designed the cairnconon byre house which replaced what was once a farm building  located in angus  scotland  the home is defined by its stone finishing with a black painted pine  it is topped off with a red corrugated metal roof  the clients were looking for a space that honors the rural scottish architecture 

the project architect jamie mack explains to dezeen   a byre is an ancillary farm building often used to stable animals over the winter  in this area of angus  byres are typically unrendered stone buildings with pitched roofs  across rural scotland  failed thatched roofs are often replaced with metal  which subsequently rust down to red  these were the forms and materiality that inspired cairnconon byre 

image credit  jim stephenson

title: modular upholstered bright furniture
texto:
modular upholstered bright furniture the flipster is a beautiful furniture piece that joins the roster at the latvian brand wigiwama  it was designed in house by litvyakov and joins the modular children s furniture lineup  working as essentially an evolution of the flip chair by the brand  the flipster works as a chair  a play mat  or a lounger and is comprised of four upholstered modules made from polyurethane  there are two seat cushions that can be stacked to use as a chair or laid to create a lounger 

the two backrest cushions can be connected together or apart to support different positions  litvyakov explains   we want to encourage children s independence by designing furniture that they can easily manage themselves  that is why our pieces  including the flipster  are lightweight and easy to move  it allows children to take charge of their space  rearrange it as they like  and create their own little worlds  encouraging both creativity and self sufficiency  

image credit  wigiwama

title: plug socket cladded armchairs
texto:
plug socket cladded armchairs iranian french architect india mahdavi worked in collaboration with omer arbel to design the smiley chair  it is an armchair that is detailed with 10 yellow plug sockets  the furniture is made in a pink hue and the sockets are round and yellow 

for this project  mahdavi revives her oliver chair    a compact armble clad with geometric textile which was made for a private home in london and at the time  named after the client s newborn baby  mahdavi explains more about the design   smiley is about celebrating the small details that bring joy to our daily lives  by reimagining the electrical outlet as a design element  we invite people to see the beauty in the functional and the familiar  

image credit  india mahdavi

title: bold spring ready sneakers
texto:
bold spring ready sneakers nike introduces yet another tonal iteration of the air max dn8 sneaker model  and this time around  it features a fierce purple colorway palette  the silhouette has been making its rounds lately with various hues on the market and the fierce purple joins the spring season 

the retro model is designed with a gradient hue starting from a deep purple and fading to a black color  the dynamic air midsole unit is accented with a touch of purple to bring attention to the og tuned air system which add some comfort and cushioning  the black lacing system at the forefoot adds a premium look and feel  the breathable mesh enhances durability and adds some stability 

image credit  nike

title: pink tonal performance sneakers
texto:
pink tonal performance sneakers nike introduces a new tonal update of the pegasus premium sneaker model with the launch of the atmosphere colorway palette to join the roster  designed for the spring 2025 season  it is created for comfort and responsiveness with an elevated and playful color palette 

the new model is made with a progressive cushioning system by integrating both the reactx form and the zoomx foam    this delivers impressive energy return with each step  the upper is made with a circular knit finish  which delivers breathability and flexibility while ensuring it has a lightweight feel  the tpu panel supports the structure and adds a sleek look  tonal pink makes up the entire silhouette with metallic accents for a slight contrast 

image credit  nike

title: dynamic glass incense burners
texto:
dynamic glass incense burners 6 am glassworks is a design brand based in milan and it has just created the palo santo burner using a special natural cooling process of cast glass  every single piece is unique to its own as it is shaped with heat and the core retains more heat than the surface does 

this means that it will contract and organically create the cavity which holds the palo santo stick as it burns  the burner is carefully cut from a taller cast cylinder and the rest of the material is used for other creations to reduce waste  it is designed to hold a single stick and the burner can notably hold various types of incense which makes it versatile and accessible 

image credit  6 am glassworks

title: minimal monochromatic sneakers
texto:
minimal monochromatic sneakers new balance introduces a new tonal iteration of the 992 sneaker model with the launch of the nimbus cloud colorway to join the lineup  it provides a classic look with a timeless palette and brings attention to the premium aesthetics and craftsmanship  the shoe is made from elevated leather materials joined by suede at the upper with overlay accents on top 

smooth leather joins the breathable mesh panels  which is done in metallic silver  the sneaker also has hues of cream  grey  and white to deliver a clean and versatile feeling  the n logo on the lateral side of the shoe is applied in silver which adds a slight pop of color  it rests on top of the brand s abzorb cushioning technology 

image credit  new balance

title: gummy candy inspired clogs
texto:
gummy candy inspired clogs crocs and haribo work in collaboration on a special design with bright hues and aesthetics of the gummy bear snack  the bright colors and translucent bodies finished with a glossy surface is visually appealing and make its way onto the shoe  the upper is made with a clear green design  whereas the heel strap is finished in a banana yellow 

the haribo branding motif is on the outer side  crocs branding is on the same strap  and the sole unit is designed with a rainbow style gradient palette  this section transitions from green and fades to yellow and then red  there are also some shades of orange which is on the top and bottom surfaces to round it all out 

image credit  crocs  haribo

title: toughened glass teardrop campers
texto:
toughened glass teardrop campers south african rv designers naledi campers has unveiled its latest model dubbed after its own brand  it boasts a teardrop structure and is impressively made with floor to ceiling glass windows on both sides of the structure  it is like most teardrop trailers but the sides welcome in plenty of natural lighting  the entire space is full of windows  which are notably made with 4mm toughened glass materials 

the interior is also enjoyable as it opens up panoramic views of the environment it is nestled in  other details include the fully aluminum nose cone and towable feature that is constructed from aluminum composite  it is also fully insulated with the high density insulation to keep temperatures regulated 

image credit  naledi campers

title: customizable minimal lamps
texto:
customizable minimal lamps christoph hauf is the creative mind behind the design of the delta lamp  it is one of the diy projects that is defined by elements of minimalism and geometric forms  it has a simple design that allows users to assemble it with ease  in addition to its function as a light source  it also works as a structural work of art 

the delta lamp is made up of adaptable connectors along with a lampshade with a double walled form and is 3d printed  the progressive design allows users to create the wall lamp by integrating the lampshade with a standard light bulb socket and a dowel  the length of the dowel determines how far the lamp extends away from the wall 

image credit  christoph hauf

title: stealthy compact comfortable homes
texto:
stealthy compact comfortable homes tiny homes of noosa designs the coral home  which is a dual level structure that effectively uses vertical space  it creates a sense of comfort blended with functional elements without taking up too much space  the coral measures just under 22 feet in length  8 feet in in width  and has a height that ranges from 6 8 to 12 feet 

the bedroom upstairs delivers captvaitng views and has a two person bed  other components include a full wardrobe and plenty of space to move around  the master bedroom is also very impressive as it has a full set of windows that allow users to enjoy a panoramic view on both sides  the windows also enhance light and create an immersive feeling 

image credit  tiny homes of noosa

title: recycled rope made footwear
texto:
recycled rope made footwear london based company shore has been working on a mission to reduce waste in playful ways  which include using reclaimed materials and bright hues  there are four different styles and five contemporary hues to select from in the new capsule  it is fully made by hand with recycled nautical rope  and all shoes are made to order  so no waste is produced 

it is all made with the brand s signature weave pattern  which can be seen throughout the lineup  it also rests on top of a full vibram outsole unit to add some durability  the rope is made from recycled material and it comes in five colorways   lava stone  dune glow  golden grain  midnight tide  and party lights  

image credit  shore

title: sriracha inspired music campaigns
texto:
sriracha inspired music campaigns lee kum kee  known for its iconic asian sauces and condiments  is launching a new campaign that features a saucy summers playlist  livestreams  and music partnerships  marking the brand s entry into the music space 

at the heart of the campaign is a reimagined rendition of the classic  cha cha slide  into the  sriracha cha slide   lee kum kee has acquired the rights to this iconic song  infusing it with a spicy  modern twist  the campaign is further highlighted by a 24 hour livestream on twitch  sponsored by lee kum kee and featuring hyperpop artist ericadoa  additionally  lee kum kee is partnering with emerging musical talents such as hayd and alt pop artist alex porat  among others  to underscore its support for rising artists 

to complement the campaign  lee kum kee has also launched a spotify playlist   saucy summers with lee kum kee   designed to enhance the campaign s thematic experience and provide a vibrant musical backdrop that appeals to gen z consumers 

image credit  lee kum kee

title: playlist paired candle launches
texto:
playlist paired candle launches brooklyn based candle shop nose best definitely stands out in the market with its comprehensive and eclectic candle offerings  what sets this brand and its products apart is that each candle is paired with a dedicated spotify playlist and an accompanying cocktail recipe  the poc  queer  and woman led small business currently calls attention to its  eerily cool haunted fall collection  which also includes strong multi sensory elements and even movie recommendations for individuals to indulge in 

nose best s fall collection include bone daddy  witching hour  and midnight viewing  the first scent combines lavender and ember for a soothing experience  the brand recommends the nightmare before christmas soundtrack for this offering  witching hour  on the other hand  boasts apple harvest and birch which is excellent alongside the hocus pocus soundtrack  finally  midnight viewing betrays notes of cyprus and sage while one enjoys the rocky horror picture show 

image credit  nose best

title: passenger skincare kits
texto:
passenger skincare kits on tiktok  countless videos document the joys of being a  passenger princess  and brands are celebrating guilt free indulgence and relaxation with pampering products like the teddi mellencamp x bliss passenger princess kit  tv personality teddi mellencamp has been open about her driving anxiety  and as a proud passenger princess  she was the perfect partner for this kit 

this limited edition kit is stocked with skincare solutions for the car that help passengers feel confident and cared for on their journeys  within the passenger princess mesh travel bag  there s an aromatic mini lemon   sage hand cream  fabulips balm in sheer glow  block star sheer tinted daily sunscreen spf 30 and an eye got this under eye mask 

to help drivers and passengers road trip in style  bliss also created a curated spotify playlist

title: playlist paired puzzles
texto:
playlist paired puzzles while assembling a puzzle keeps hands busy  many people appreciate other sensory input in the form of an audiobook  a favorite tv show  or music in the background to entertain the mind  and piecework puzzles are matched with playlists to set the mood 

had me at jello is one of the latest launches from the puzzle company and it s a 1 000 piece puzzle wholly dedicated to gelatin  this colorful  adult targeted puzzle has features consumers with an eye for detail will appreciate  such as thick stock  quality art paper  and a puzzle board crafted with recycled paper 

piecework s had me at jello playlist  described as a  neon lit sugar rush of pure pop perfection   includes a mix of today s hits like chappel roan s pink pony club and apple by charli xcx and 2000s tracks to inspire nostalgia

title: mesmerizing bright furniture
texto:
mesmerizing bright furniture design firm draga   aurel unveils a captivating collection during design miami this year  and it is made in conjunction with todd merrill studio  the team fuses elements that are beyond lucite and light refractions as the main inspiration  as a result  the collection features the ribbon pendant lamps  the flare dining table  and a flare cabinet 

the pieces are an extension of the studio s notable works  which explore light  transparency  and color  with each product  the studio continues to blend notions of art and furniture  shining a spotlight on the ribbon pendant lamp  it has a curved ribbon structure made from acrylic resin  it gently wraps over the led lit capsule and has bright inserts of neon colors 

image credit  draga   aurel

title: dynamic bold statement jewelry
texto:
dynamic bold statement jewelry norwegian jewelry imprint tom wood works together with japanese fashion name kozue akimoto on the chiyu collection  it is made up of ring designs that bring forth feelings of protection  armor  and bandaging  designer mona jensen was looking to explore ideas of renewal through jewelry after breaking her finger 

akimoto notes in a statement   the original idea came from healing an injury  which is why we decided on chiyu as the name of the project  it means healing  treatment  and recovery from an injury  but it can also mean regeneration and renewal  the improvement of something old   the rings come in various widths and can be worn on both the upper and lower parts of the finger  stacking where the bandaid may be on an injured hand 

image credit  tom wood

title: collaborative lightweight bright sandals
texto:
collaborative lightweight bright sandals keen is a brand known for its hybrid footwear created in a holistic and accessible manner  and it joins madhappy to create a special shanti clog  the model is one of the most notable from the brand and it is defined by its open air foam clog  which debuted in 2007 and is now the star of the collaboration  the colorways feature an earthy brown and a pink 

the global product line manager at keen johanna koeberle notes   keen is thrilled to collaborate with madhappy on a style that s all about finding ways to reset and find happiness and comfort in everyday life  madhappy s design aesthetic and the work they do to positively impact the mental health movement add even more joy to a silhouette that s made people smile for almost two decades  

image credit  keen  madhappy

title: earthy warm ambiant restaurants
texto:
earthy warm ambiant restaurants the team at marc ange design studio are the creative minds behind the muse space  the modern french restaurant is detailed with ribbed velvet materials on the walls and has curved wooden details  it has reopened recently following the unfortunate fires that went through the area 

the founder of the studio  marc ange notes   in los angeles  where such elegance is special  muse is a haven for those who seek beauty in both design and cuisine   an oasis for art lovers  culinary enthusiasts  and anyone yearning for authenticity  dining nooks are enveloped in rich wood paneling and a palette of warm  earthy tones   beige  brick  and gold   creating a cocoon like environment that invites comfort and conversation  

image credit  pablo enriquez

title: urban explorer centric accessories
texto:
urban explorer centric accessories topologies shines a spotlight on its latest collection  which is designed for the spring summer 2025 season  comprised of functional bags that cater to daily needs  the design is inspired by urban mobility  its minimal look and urban functionality define the products  the capsule unveils a new set of designs    all of which are made from the brand s notable elements 

this includes  the sling messenger  mobilitt sacoche  messenger saoche  utlity sahoce  and utlity phone saccoche   new designs of wares system straps include the twisted strap  puffer strap  new colors of the classic straps in various measurements  and the braided o rope  the first of the seasonal drops is the messenger series and utility series  which delivers elevated daily bags with smart functional components  the second drop will follow in april with bolder statements 

image credit  kengo wakahara  maxim wunsch  miki kubota  sion takahashi   sofia ayuri kai  takuya sugiyama  tarmac slapper  tommy corbridge

title: artist collaborated sporty apparel
texto:
artist collaborated sporty apparel the major league baseball joins forces with iconic japanese artist takashi murakami to unveil a limited tokyo series collection  it has a whimsical design language and aligns with the mlb tokyo series taking place this year  this is when the los angeles dodgers and the chicago cubs will come head to head at the tokyo dome next week 

the jerseys  apparel  and collectible memorabilia will be detailed with the iconic motifs by murakami  the collection is representative of the artist s most extensive work with the league  fans will be excited to find a wide range of products  including nike mlb tees and hoodies  followed by limited jerseys  beyond clothing are new era caps  baseballs and globes  bats  and trading cards 

image credit  universal music  pr times

title: elevated qsr fish sandwiches
texto:
elevated qsr fish sandwiches consumers who observe lent but want to enjoy an elevated meal experience are sure to welcome the news of the bojangler deluxe fish sandwich from bojangles as the perfect option for enjoying this season  the sandwich builds on the recipe of the returning bojangler fish sandwich and boasts the same ingredients alongside the brand s signature bo sauce along with lettuce and tomatoes  the result is a slightly elevated take on a classic and comes as a first for the brand  but also in the qsr industry as a way for consumers to observe lent without skimping on flavor 

vice president of menu and culinary innovations marshall scarborough spoke on the bojangler deluxe fish sandwich saying   we re stepping up our fish sandwich game by introducing the new bojangler deluxe  our fans expect big flavor when they come to bojangles  and this sandwich really brings it  you can t go wrong combining bo sauce and fresh produce with a bo seasoned crispy fish filet  

image credit  bojangles

title: italian made classic sneakers
texto:
italian made classic sneakers the adidas gazelle indoor made in italy sneakers have been created by the german performance brand as a modernized take on the iconic shoe style  the sneakers are characterized by their refined profile that sees them crafted in italy  as per the name  with calfskin leather on the upper along with a suede toecap  the sneakers are paired with waxed laces that further increases the opulent nature of the relaxed footwear  which helps them to look even more suited for pairing with formalwear  if desired 

the adidas gazelle indoor made in italy sneakers are slated to release  march 13  2025 and will be available through select retailers as well as on the confirm app where shoppers can pick them up for  350

title: demonic parenting apps
texto:
demonic parenting apps the  oni kara denwa  app has been created by media active in collaboration with japanese comedian kintalo as a digital parenting tool that will offer parents a way to chastise their youngsters for not behaving 

the app  which translates to phone call from a demon  works by having parents prompt a call from a demon when kids are misbehaving as a way to encourage them to enhance their manners  parents can choose from five scolding scenarios including when kids won t listen  won t go to bed  won t eat their food  get into fights with siblings or break their promises 

the  oni kara denwa  app is paired with humorous albeit slightly horrific imagery of kintalo in a demonic disguise that will be displayed when kids listen to the call

title: militant springtime jacket designs
texto:
militant springtime jacket designs the relwen sailcloth tanker jacket is a heritage honoring outerwear style created by the ohio based brand as a garment inspired by standard issue garments for outdoor aficionados alike to pick up for the spring 

the jacket is designed with layering in mind and offers ample storage space throughout to work well as a garment for adventuring  but also everyday commuting by keeping essentials securely stowed  the jacket is constructed out of a woven cotton shell and lightweight nylon that work together to offer protection from the elements 

the relwen sailcloth tanker jacket comes in muted olive  black and midnight color options  which are each characterized by their classic cut that includes a tapered waist and just the right amount of room up top

title: dynamic meal ordering kiosks
texto:
dynamic meal ordering kiosks mr  pickle s sandwich shop is introducing samsung kiosks powered by grubbrr to help enhance the in store experience and provide customers with an intuitive way to place their order 

customers will be abler to enjoy a dynamic user experience that will contribute towards greater efficiency for them as well as the operators  the in store kiosks will be joined by dynamic digital menu boards that will enable operators to keep signage updated at all times in an intuitive manner  the technology solutions will be integrated into more than 60 locations 

head of sales  display division  samsung electronics america sara grofcsik spoke on the release saying   today s diners seek convenience  quality service  personalized choices and seamless technology  mr  pickle s sandwich shop embraces these expectations by leveraging samsung and grubbrr solutions to enhance every dining experience  through frictionless ordering and dynamic content management  the brand is able to stand out and create lasting connections with its loyal customers

title: creamy cafe lemonades
texto:
creamy cafe lemonades the pj s coffee frosted strawberry lemonade is being added to the cafe brand s springtime beverage menu as a sweet  tart and creamy option for patrons to try out on their next visit  the drink starts off with a tangy lemonade base that s paired with strawberry flavors before being paired with a sweet cream for a truly distinct taste and texture experience  the drink comes either iced or frozen and is launching alongside the returning honey brûlée shaken espresso as the base for several beverage options 

vice president of marketing reid nolte commented on the pj s coffee frosted strawberry lemonade saying   flavor is a way of life in new orleans  and each season brings fresh inspiration  this spring  the frosted strawberry lemonade puts a bright twist on a classic  while our honey brûlée favorites return with the rich  caramelized sweetness our guests love  these drinks capture the vibrant energy of the season   crafted with the same passion and bold flavors that define our city  

image credit  pj s coffee

title: customizable acai bowl menus
texto:
customizable acai bowl menus the vitality bowls create your own bowl program is headed to participating locations nationwide in the us just in time for spring to provide customers with the perfect way to start the season off on a fresh  customized note  the program will enable customers to customize their bowl to suit their specific dietary restrictions or preferences  nutritional needs and their flavor cravings  the program can be accessed when ordering in store  online  via the brand s app as well as third party delivery services to maximize access for customers 

co founder and president tara gilad commented on the vitality bowls create your own bowl program saying   at vitality bowls  our goal has always been to make healthy eating accessible  delicious and meaningful   the new create your own bowl is a natural next step in that journey  giving our guests more control in building açaí bowl creations with their favorite superfood ingredients  this new way to order an açaí bowl at vitality bowls reflects our commitment to staying ahead of the curve and continually redefining how community members can enjoy nutritious food that doesn t compromise taste  we can t wait to see the unique creations our guests come up with  

image credit  instagram

title: targeted cooling ac systems
texto:
targeted cooling ac systems the lg artcool ai air is an advanced air conditioning solution that s engineered to offer homeowners with an optimized way to keep their cool in the heat  the artificial intelligence  ai  powered system maintains an ultramodern profile that will fit in neatly into a space where it will utilize mmwave radar sensing technology to target cooling directly to the occupants of the room  the unit will also detect such anomalies as a window being left open to automatically make energy saving adjustments 

the lg artcool ai air connects to the lg thinq app where users can make adjustments on the fly  set up at a schedule and even keep a close eye on energy consumption by setting a power usage limit 

image credit  lg

title: comfort driven open earbuds
texto:
comfort driven open earbuds the baseus bowie mc1 open ear earbuds are a comfort driven audio accessory created with the needs of everyday listeners  commuters and athletes alike in mind to help them enjoy their favorite content from anywhere  the earbuds are characterized by their open style construction that will sit outside of the ear and eliminate the discomfort that can come with conventional earbuds that sit snuggly inside the ear  the buds weigh in at 5 2 grams each and offer high performance capabilities like the artificial intelligence  ai  enhanced dynamic base adaptive call noise cancellation and more 

the baseus bowie mc1 open ear earbuds have an ip57 rating to make them suited for use when working out or in the great outdoors  the earbuds are rounded out with a customizable button control to accommodate easier controlling

title: entertainment group qsr meals
texto:
entertainment group qsr meals the mooyah x dude perfect burger battle box has been created in collaboration with the qsr brand and the entertainment group as a new meal that s packed with a variety of fare 

the meal starts off with four mooyah cheeseburgers that can be customized to the guest s preferences thanks to various toppings and fixings on the side  the meal then comes with a family sized portion of hand cut fries along with two little moo shakes  priced at  39 99  the meal comes packaged in a themed box style packaging that s paired with fun challenges for families to try out along with exclusive trick shot tutorials 

vice president of marketing sarah morris spoke on the mooyah x dude perfect burger battle box saying   we re thrilled to team up with dude perfect for the launch of the  burger battle box  this partnership is about more than just great tasting burgers it s about creating unforgettable moments for families  with exclusive trick shot tutorials and fun  family friendly challenges  we re transforming mealtime into a playful adventure where everyone can feel like a trick shot pro

title: accessible all electric cars
texto:
accessible all electric cars electric vehicles are continuing to trend down in terms of price but oftentimes still come with a higher price point than alternatives  which is something the volkswagen id  every1 concept is intended to help change  the vehicle aims to be the electric vehicle for the everyman that would offer access to impressive technology without breaking the bank  the vehicle is designed with a 12 7 foot length that holds a modest electric motor within alongside ample tech accoutrements in the cabin 

the volkswagen id  every1 concept is rated with a top speed of 80mph to make it more suited towards city life and is projected to offer 155 miles of range per charge  th concept vehicle is scheduled to go into production in 2027 with an estimated price point of  20 000 

image credit  volkswagen

title: royal streaming service shows
texto:
royal streaming service shows apple music the king s music room has been announced as a new apple music show and playlist created with king charles iii to take listeners on a music journey with the king himself  the music streaming service collaboration will see the king s music room hosted and recorded by king charles iii at buckingham palace in his office to give listeners intimate insight into some recognizable tunes  the show will also have the king sharing stories of his interactions with the artists for an inside scoop on experiences through the years 

apple music the king s music room will make its debut on the apple music 1 radio station for free on march 10 to coincide with commonwealth day and will be available thereafter for subscribers to check out

title: inspirational athlete campaigns
texto:
inspirational athlete campaigns in anticipation of march madness  2025  powerade has launched its latest national marketing campaign   titled it takes more to get this far  as the official hydration partner of the tournament  the campaign highlights the dedication  sacrifices  and relentless effort required for athletes to excel at the highest level 

it takes more to get this far features star college basketball players like alex karaban  uconn   caleb love  arizona   and saniya rivers  nc state   the marketing initiative underscores powerade s role in providing athletes with enhanced electrolytes to fuel their performance  the campaign will be amplified through tv spots  digital content  social media  and retail activations  with additional collaborations planned  including one with returning partner flau jae johnson 

the initiative builds on the brand s previous  it takes more  campaigns

title: running inspired global campaigns
texto:
running inspired global campaigns saucony s latest global campaign is dubbed  run as one  and the initiative emphasizes the unifying power of running and the sense of community it fosters 

the run as one campaign s 30 second anthem video features saucony athlete vanessa fraser and creative collaborator jae tips  the visuals and narrative highlight how running transforms from an individual activity into a collective experience that creates connections and shared purpose 

the run as one campaign is supported by out of home advertising in key cities like boston  london  and paris  as well as through ctv  online video  and social media channels  to bring the campaign to life  saucony is organizing a series of global run club events  both in person and virtual  these activations start with coffee shop residencies in major cities  including new york city s ludlow coffee supply 

image credit  saucony

title: rejuvenating bath salt lines
texto:
rejuvenating bath salt lines formulary 55 s bath salt soaks offer a luxurious and rejuvenating bathing experience  the product combines the therapeutic benefits of epsom salt  magnesium  and pink himalayan salt to effectively soothe muscles  hydrate skin  and promote relaxation 

designed to transform your bath into a calming sanctuary  formulary 55 s bath salt soaks promises to alleviate stiffness  reduce inflammation  and improve overall skin health  this will be of particular interest to individuals who have busy lifestyles  the bath salt soaks include magnesium  which helps ease muscle tension and supports better sleep  while pink himalayan salt provides essential minerals that enhance circulation and detoxification  additionally  the fine crystals gently exfoliate to leave the skin soft and hydrated  available in captivating scents like sea salt   sage  jasmine   marigold  and palo santo   oud  the soaks are free from phthalates  parabens  sls  and dyes  and are both cruelty free and vegan 

image credit  formulary 55

title: nutrient packed chocolate bars
texto:
nutrient packed chocolate bars chocolate bars aren t often associated with many health benefits  but these new chocolove bars have been debuted by the boulder  colorado based brand as a series of treats that could help to change this 

the bars are each crafted with the brand s signature chocolate  while also featuring nuts and sea salt in the mix that contribute towards elevating the taste as well as the nutritional value  the bars come in three options including milk chocolate with pistachios   sea salt  milk chocolate with pecans  cookies   sea salt and dark chocolate with walnuts   sea salt  the treats were created in collaboration between founder timothy moley and the brand s european trained master chocolatier patrick peeters 

peeters himself commented on the new chocolove bars saying   the nuts for each of these bars were thoughtfully sourced  selected  and prepared to perfectly complement and balance our smooth and delicious chocolate  the combination of ingredients  including sea salt  results in a unique eating experience in terms of both texture and taste  

image credit  chocolove

title: ultra luxurious eyewear collections
texto:
ultra luxurious eyewear collections christian louboutin has introduced its first luxurious eyewear collection and the designs effortlessly blend timeless elegance with contemporary design  the offerings are catered to both women and men 

the luxurious eyewear collection by christian louboutin features five distinct silhouettes   miss z  so kate  greggo  roller  and georges  each style reflects the label s iconic design ethos  miss z  for example  draws inspiration from art deco with architectural frames and palmette detailing  while so kate incorporates curves reminiscent of louboutin s famous red soles  greggo  on the other hand  offers a minimalist look with polished black acetate  and georges stands out with avant garde gold accents  studs  and subtle red touches  crafted from custom acetates and equipped with high performance zeiss lenses  the eyewear is sure to appeal to those seeking functionality and luxury 

image credit  christian louboutin

title: irish queen inspired rebranding initiatives
texto:
irish queen inspired rebranding initiatives seattle chocolate recently announced its rebrand as maeve  this move marks a new chapter for the company while maintaining its commitment to ethical practices  empowering women  and supporting cocoa farmers 

seattle chocolate s transformation to maeve was led by owner jean thompson and her daughter ellie thompson  inspired by the legendary irish queen  maeve embodies boldness  creativity  and joy  the rebrand introduces whimsical packaging and playful characters  designed in collaboration with young jerks  the aesthetic creates a fun and immersive experience for consumers while staying true to the brand s values 

maeve s product line includes a variety of truffle bars and bonbons in unique flavors  such as magical mint and blackberry bramble  all offerings are crafted with responsibly sourced cocoa  the brand also continues its philanthropic efforts  dedicating 10  of net profits to initiatives that improve the lives of cocoa farmers 

image credit  maeve

title: convenience focused electrolyte tablets
texto:
convenience focused electrolyte tablets saltstick has released the results of a groundbreaking clinical study demonstrating the rapid absorption capabilities of its fastchews  electrolyte tablets  conducted in partnership with western colorado university  the study revealed that nearly 50  of the sodium content in fastchews can be absorbed within the first 45 seconds of consumption  this is significantly faster than traditional hydration products like sports drinks or electrolyte powders  which typically take at least 20 minutes to enter the bloodstream 

fastchews  electrolyte tablets  rapid absorption is attributed to the buccal mucosa in the mouth  which allows nutrients to bypass the digestive system and enter the bloodstream directly  fastchews offers a practical solution for those needing immediate electrolyte replenishment during or after intense physical activity while also preventing symptoms like muscle cramps  fatigue  and lightheadedness 

image credit  saltstick

title: spicy textural chicken wraps
texto:
spicy textural chicken wraps the taco bell southwest hot chicken crunchwrap is being test marketed by the brand as a new hot chicken inspired menu item perfect for customers to try out this season  the menu item is making its debut at participating locations in the cincinnati region and starts off with the brand s signature crunchwrap format that s packed with decidedly delicious ingredients  this includes crispy chicken strips tossed in a chile seasoning to elevate the spicy flavor before being paired with a three cheese blend  shredded cabbage  a sweet   spicy hot sauce and a finishing touch of reduce fat sour cream 

the taco bell southwest hot chicken crunchwrap is expected to be a must try amongst fans of nashville style hot chicken  which has been showing up more prominently in the qsr industry 

image credit  taco bell

title: 10 port usb c chargers
texto:
10 port usb c chargers plugable has introduced the ps 10cc  the world s first usb c 10 port charger  this innovative computer accessory features intelligent power allocation and priority based charging  it is designed to meet the needs of tech enthusiasts  families  small businesses  and travelers 

plugable s ps 10cc addresses common issues like cable clutter  limited outlets  and slow charging speeds  the 10 port charger uses real time current sensing technology to dynamically distribute power across all connected devices and prioritize those in the leftmost ports for faster charging  this ensures efficient energy use  prevents overheating  and optimizes charging speeds for up to 10 devices simultaneously 

additionally  the ps 10cc 10 port charger promotes sustainability by allowing users to utilize existing usb c power supplies  this has the potential to reduce e waste and shipping emissions  built with 50  post consumer recycled aluminum and 75  recycled pc abs  the ps 10cc aligns with plugable s commitment to environmental responsibility 

image credit  plugable

title: smoothie inspired lip treatments
texto:
smoothie inspired lip treatments esw beauty has made a name for itself with its creative  food inspired skincare products and recently  the brand celebrated an expansion of its popular smoothie lip treatments line with three new tinted lip balms   the cherry tart smoothie  the raspberry acai smoothie  and the strawberry banana smoothie  the food inspired flavor and lightweight textures of these products offer a sensory experience that enhances their appeal 

each flavor of esw beauty s new smoothie lip treatments is designed to deliver specific benefits  such as intense hydration  enhanced protection  and advanced smoothing  formulated with vegan  cruelty free  and non toxic ingredients like shea butter  vitamin e  hyaluronic acid  and fruit extracts  these lip treatments nourish  protect  and revitalize dry or cracked lips while providing a natural looking tint 

while individuals can purchase the new smoothie lip treatments separately  esw beauty also offers them in a kit as the berry kisses lip treatment trio set 

image credit  esw beauty

title: icon inspired guitar designs
texto:
icon inspired guitar designs the eric clapton 1958 les paul custom by gibsom is a meticulously crafted recreation of the iconic guitar used by eric clapton during his time with cream and later gifted to fellow guitarist albert lee  this limited edition model is part of gibson s murphy lab series 

the eric clapton 1958 les paul custom stands out with its precise aging techniques  which replicate the wear and character of the original instrument  the guitar boasts a one piece mahogany body  an ebony fretboard with mother of pearl inlays  and aged gold hardware  including grover tuners and custombucker pickups  only 150 units have been produced and each is accompanied by a second pickguard signed by both clapton and lee  a collectible wooden display case  and a certificate of authenticity 

the guitar s association with eric clapton and albert lee adds significant historical and emotional value while the meticulous attention to detail ensures that the instrument not only looks authentic but also delivers the tonal excellence expected from gibson custom 

image credit  gibson custom

title: adaptive bike initiatives
texto:
adaptive bike initiatives the rikert outdoor center in ripton  vermont  has introduced adaptive bike days  this new initiative is designed to make winter outdoor activities more accessible to individuals with mobility challenges 

running every wednesday through march  rikert outdoor center s adaptive bike days offers free sessions where participants can explore vermont s winter landscapes using specially designed bikes  the program provides expert guidance from adaptive biking specialist anja wrede and a team of volunteers  who ensure each rider is matched with the appropriate equipment and receives personalized support 

participants can start in a safe  controlled area before potentially venturing onto longer trails  depending on their comfort level and snow conditions  the program also welcomes those who own adaptive bikes with tires 4 0 or larger 

image credit  rikert outdoor center

title: app powered assistive museum experiences
texto:
app powered assistive museum experiences the art museum of south texas has partnered with rebokeh vision technologies  a baltimore based assistive technology company  to enhance accessibility for visitors with low vision  through this collaboration  the institution will offer free access to rebokeh s mobile app  which allows users to customize their visual experience by adjusting contrast  color  zoom  and lighting in real time using their device s camera  the app also includes an ai powered image description feature  which will provide detailed text descriptions of visual content 

the art museum of south texas  partnership with rebokeh vision technologies was announced alongside the  home  love  and loss  exhibition  the initiative certainly enhances inclusivity in the museum as it makes rotating displays and permanent collections more accessible and engaging for low vision visitors  the app s premium features will be available to all visitors within the museum at no cost 

image credit  art museum of south texas x rebpokeh

title: accessible live event resources
texto:
accessible live event resources attitude is everything has launched a revamped online version of its live events access charter  a document that works toward more accessible experiences for audiences  artists  and professionals 

the charter  a cornerstone of the charity s mission since 2000  provides a framework for venues and festivals to integrate disability equality into their operations  following a thorough audit and pilot program  the updated live events access charter has been transformed into a dynamic online platform that offers user friendly resources  templates  and guidance to help event organizers implement inclusive practices 

the charity recently celebrated the launch of the new live events access charter and its 25th anniversary with an event at london s sinfonia smith square  the relaunch was supported by industry leaders such as live  prs for music  and ppl  the event featured panel discussions  live performances  and awards recognizing venues and individuals for their commitment to accessibility 

image credit  attitude is everything

title: accessibility focused video series
texto:
accessibility focused video series surrey schools has launched the second installment of its four part video series focused on accessibility  the latest release addresses the concept of barriers and their impact on individuals with disabilities  the video was developed by the district s accessibility working group and advisory committee  at its core  the initiative aims to foster a shared understanding of how barriers   whether physical  sensory  or attitudinal   can hinder full participation in everyday activities for people with disabilities 

in its video  surrey schools highlights real world examples  such as inaccessible buildings  lack of assistive technologies  and societal stigma  while the video educates viewers on the challenges faced by individuals with disabilities  it also emphasizes the importance of identifying and removing these obstacles 

the series is part of surrey schools  broader accessibility plan  which includes gathering community feedback to inform initiatives and ensure new facilities are designed to be barrier free from the outset 

image credit  surrey schools

title: inclusivity focused housing standards
texto:
inclusivity focused housing standards the daniels corporation has taken a significant step toward promoting inclusivity in the housing industry by publicly releasing its accessibility designed program  adp  technical standards guide  originally created in 2017 for the company s own construction projects  the guide outlines detailed accessibility features that go beyond the minimum requirements of the ontario building code  these standards are designed to enhance livability for individuals with mobility challenges  sensory impairments  cognitive disabilities  and those who wish to age comfortably in their homes  the guide includes comprehensive specifications for appliances  plumbing fixtures  and fixed items  as well as design elements such as roll in showers  height adjusted countertops  braille signage  wider doorways  and grab bars  these features are tailored for both private living spaces and common areas 

by sharing this resource  the daniels corporation aims to set up industry wide collaboration and encourage developers  architects  builders  and designers to adopt these practices 

image credit  the daniels corporation

title: student focused wheelchair accessible vehicle rides
texto:
student focused wheelchair accessible vehicle rides hopskipdrive has expanded its convenience focused transportation services to include wheelchair accessible vehicle rides for students in 10 major metropolitan areas  including los angeles  denver  seattle  and san diego  this initiative represents a significant step in addressing the transportation needs of students with disabilities and ensuring they have reliable  safe  and comfortable access to school  field trips  and other educational opportunities 

by partnering with school districts  hopskipdrive supplements traditional transportation options like yellow buses  the company s ride service is facilitated through a network of highly vetted carepartners   who are professional drivers with specialized training in transporting students with heightened needs  these drivers undergo rigorous certification processes  including background checks  vehicle inspections  and training in trauma informed care  hopskipdrive plans to further extend its wheelchair accessible vehicle rides to additional cities in the fall of 2025 

image credit  hopskipdrive

title: grocery store quiet hours
texto:
grocery store quiet hours woolworths has significantly broadened its quiet hour initiative  now  the brand offers a low sensory shopping experience five days a week in most of its australian stores 

the quiet hour initiative was designed to reduce auditory and visual stimuli in order to create a calmer environment tailored to the needs of individuals with sensory sensitivities  such as those with autism  adhd  or other sensory processing conditions  during quiet hour  stores implement several adjustments  including dimming lights  lowering register and phone volumes  silencing bakery and kitchen equipment buzzers  pausing music  and halting non emergency pa announcements  these changes aim to make shopping less overwhelming and more accessible for customers who may find traditional retail environments stressful 

the expansion of quiet hour reflects woolworths  commitment to inclusivity and customer autonomy  by extending this initiative to weekdays  woolworths is responding to positive customer feedback and addressing a growing demand for accessible shopping options 

image credit  woolworths

title: soft serve inspired frozen desserts
texto:
soft serve inspired frozen desserts the blue bunny soft scoopable frozen dairy dessert is introducing two new flavor options to satisfy consumer demand for familiar taste experiences from their favorite products  the frozen dessert now comes in the butter pecan and churo flavor options  which are both characterized by their sweet flavor and deliciously soft consistency  the product will thus work well for bringing the soft serve ice cream experience home in a decidedly delicious way 

the new additions to the blue bunny soft scoopable frozen dairy dessert range are hitting store shelves now and brings up the total number of flavor options to nine  this speaks to the increased interest in the product range  which could be influenced by consumer behaviors related to creating authentic experiences from home rather than going out

title: sandalwood inspired ceramic collections
texto:
sandalwood inspired ceramic collections gina desantis ceramics has introduced its latest sandalwood collection  a thoughtfully designed line of ceramic pieces that aim to evoke a sense of tranquility and warmth within the home  inspired by elements found in gina desantis s own living space  the collection is handcrafted in lakewood  ohio  by her and her team 

as the name might suggest  the sandalwood collection channels the soothing and aromatic qualities of sandalwood to produce highly textured designs that reflect a serene  summery aesthetic  the pieces in gina desantis ceramics  latest capsule include trays  planters  and other functional items  throughout the products  one can identify caned furniture inspired patterns  simple linear carvings  and even tropical motifs 

all of gina desantis ceramics  products are handcrafted  ensuring each piece is unique and imbued with a personal touch 

image credit  gina desantis ceramics gina desantis ceramics

title: reality star approved swimwear lines
texto:
reality star approved swimwear lines the collaboration between bachelor nation s mari pepin and onewith swim introduces a limited edition swimwear collection that blends personal storytelling with innovative design  known for its patent pending  second skin swimwear that fits seamlessly like underwear  onewith has partnered with mari pepin to create a capsule collection featuring three of the brand s popular silhouettes in two unique colorways  each design is said to reflect mari s personal journey  cultural heritage  and vibrant personality  the mariposa pop print  for instance  incorporates tropical flowers  taíno symbols  and butterflies to symbolize her hawaiian upbringing  puerto rican roots  and lively spirit  meanwhile  the lucky colorway  inspired by her trip to ireland  radiates positivity and abundance in a rich kelly green hue 

this collaboration is particularly noteworthy as it brings together two figures known for taking bold risks   mari pepin as a beloved reality tv personality and hayley segar  onewith s founder  who gained recognition on shark tank 

image credit  onewith

title: inclusive romance inspired activations
texto:
inclusive romance inspired activations generation love s  giving love  campaign offered a heartfelt and inclusive way to celebrate valentine s day this year  at its core  the initiative emphasized connection  creativity  and generosity 

generation love s  giving love  featured both in store and online experiences designed to foster a sense of community and shared joy  the bouquet bar  a temporary event held on february 14th at the brand s new york city location  was a centerpiece for the initiative  visitors were invited to create their own handcrafted bouquets  this interactive experience  hosted in part by co founder roni hirshberg  encouraged participants to engage in a meaningful activity that symbolizes love and togetherness 

for those unable to attend in person  generation love extended the celebration online  sharing acts of kindness and encouraging followers to participate by posting their own moments of love using the hashtag  givinglove 

image credit  generation love

title: thoughtfully designed activewear lines
texto:
thoughtfully designed activewear lines betterme store s new motion collection is a thoughtfully designed activewear line tailored for both high performance workouts and everyday wear  the collection emphasizes functionality and style with intentional material choices and strategic cuts  the silhouettes boast breathable  stretchable fabrics and moisture wicking mesh technology to ensure comfort and support during physical activities  with a sleek  minimalist aesthetic and ergonomic construction  the pieces are crafted to provide a secure  distraction free fit 

key items in the motion collection include the ultimate mesh top  the airy active strap top  and the high impact mesh leggings   shorts  while the mesh top is designed with breathable fabric and mesh back details for improved airflow  the strap top offers adjustable straps and a supportive fit for high intensity workouts  the leggings and shorts  on the other hand  feature strategically placed mesh panels for ventilation and quick drying materials for added comfort  additionally  the everyday active sweatshirt and cropped tees provide a relaxed yet performance ready option 

the range includes versatile color options like black  ivory  mocha  and dark moss 

image credit  betterme

title: vibrant mid century modern miniatures
texto:
vibrant mid century modern miniatures minimcm s spring 2025 clear hues collection is a great example of vibrant mid century modern miniatures that immediately capture the attention while offering seamless integration into one s living quarters  a key highlight of the brand s collection is the microshell chair   which is offered in translucent materials and three fresh  spring inspired colors   clear magenta  clear seafoam  and clear yellow 

by incorporating translucent finishes  minimcm explores how light interacts with the design of the seating and in doing so  creates dynamic visual effects that shift as light passes through the chairs  this approach boldly revitalizes a classic design but also offers a contemporary interpretation that will likely appeal to both collectors and design enthusiasts 

the vibrant mid century modern furniture miniatures join minimcm s broader portfolio  which includes the heritage collection and the metallics series 

image credit  minimcm

title: star approved fiber supplements
texto:
star approved fiber supplements  lemme no  2  is set to make fiber supplements the next must have in your wellness routine  kourtney kardashian barker s latest launch under her lemme brand is a strawberry flavored gummy that delivers 4 grams of prebiotic fiber per serving  plus two clinically studied probiotics to support gut health  regularity  and digestion    all without sugar 

with only 5  of adults getting enough fiber daily  lemme no  2 steps in to help fill the gap  not only does fiber aid in digestion  but it plays a crucial role in metabolism  bloating relief  and even hormone balance  plus  with added vitamin d  this formula boosts immunity and supports a healthy gut microbiome 

lemme no  2 is available exclusively on lemmelive com for  30  as fiber supplements surge in popularity  lemme is redefining the category with a clean  effective  and delicious solution 

image credit  lemme

title: subscription based coffee services
texto:
subscription based coffee services noma kaffe is redefining coffee culture with a new monthly subscription that delivers the restaurant s expertly curated beans straight to your home  after years of crafting exceptional coffee experiences at its world renowned restaurant  noma is now sharing its passion for coffee with a global audience 

subscribers will receive two bags of meticulously sourced  hand roasted beans each month  carefully selected by the noma team in copenhagen  the subscription offers an evolving journey through different origins and roasting profiles  providing coffee lovers an unparalleled opportunity to taste and learn  alongside each delivery  subscribers gain exclusive insights into brewing techniques  origin stories  and behind the scenes notes from the noma kaffe team 

this immersive coffee experience connects drinkers to their morning cup and the farmers  traditions  and craftsmanship behind it  available from march 6  noma kaffe can be purchased at www nomaprojects com 

image credit  noma

title: pet centric in store recycling programs
texto:
pet centric in store recycling programs the petco in store recycling program allows customers to recycle non curbside plastic waste  such as used plastic shopping bags and other plastic films  at participating petco stores  in addition  petco stores will recycle plastic waste generated from the business  shipping and operations  the initiative is made possible through a collaboration with trex s nextrex collection program  the recycled plastic will be converted into composite decking material by trex for commercial and residential use 

it is estimated that the petco in store recycling program could divert nearly 40 000 pounds of plastic waste initially  with the potential to reach approximately 864 000 pounds as the program grows  this initiative responds to feedback from both consumers and petco employees and is part of petco s broader sustainability strategy  which emphasizes the importance of sustainable practices in improving pets  health and wellbeing 

image credit  petco

title: extravagant dad inspired shoes
texto:
extravagant dad inspired shoes new balance s  tech explosion  redefines the dad shoe with an audacious  futuristic take on the iconic 1906 sneaker  known for blending cutting edge design with all day comfort  new balance has taken things to the next level with the 1906  tech explosion   a shoe that looks like it was pulled straight from the future 

unlike the deconstructed aesthetic of the brand s famed  protection pack   the tech explosion 1906 dials up the details with exaggerated paneling  bold stitching  and layered textures  it s a maximalist dream  featuring vibrant color accents and jagged leather overlays that seem to burst off the sneaker s breathable mesh base  the two standout colorways     inkwell   a deep blue  and  olive juice   an earthy green     each bring a unique  almost custom feel to the silhouette 

the tech explosion 1906 is now available at new balance and highsnobiety

title: skincare product range expansions
texto:
skincare product range expansions paula s choice expands its powerhouse skincare lineup with four new products  now available at sephora canada  known for science backed formulations and no nonsense transparency  the brand is bringing innovation to hydration  skin barrier support  and radiance boosting solutions 

leading the launch is the  c5 super boost moisturizer   a vitamin c powered formula designed to brighten  even skin tone  and provide up to 24 hour hydration  its 5  vitamin c blend  hexapeptide 5  and polyglutamic acid visibly firm while delivering a radiant glow  for those seeking a deep cleanse  the  perfectly balanced foaming cleanser  removes excess oil and makeup without stripping the skin  thanks to soothing hyaluronic acid  a triple ceramide blend  and aloe vera 

to restore and nourish  the  advanced replenishing toner  acts as a liquid lotion  packed with hyaluronic acid  linoleic acid  and ferulic acid to replenish essential nutrients and boost moisture retention  finally  the  barrier repair advanced moisturizer  locks in hydration while strengthening the skin barrier with ceramides  watermelon seed oil  and tripeptide 5  clinically proven to prevent moisture loss for up to 100 hours 

image credit  paula s choice

title: gaming focused high end processors
texto:
gaming focused high end processors the amd ryzen 9 9900x3d is a high performance desktop processor designed for gaming and content creation  it features 12 cpu cores and 24 threads  with a base clock speed of 4 4 ghz and a boost clock speed of up to 5 5 ghz  the processor is built on amd s zen 5 architecture and incorporates second generation 3d v cache technology  which stacks additional cache memory on top of the cpu cores to enhance performance  this technology allows the 9900x3d to deliver improved gaming performance and faster processing speeds for demanding applications 

the ryzen 9 9900x3d is compatible with the am5 platform  which supports ddr5 ram and pcie 5 0 connectivity  this ensures that users can take advantage of the latest advancements in memory and storage technology  the processor has a thermal design power  tdp  of 120w  making it suitable for high performance cooling solutions  with its combination of advanced features and powerful performance  the amd ryzen 9 9900x3d is positioned as a top choice for gamers and content creators seeking a cutting edge processor 

image credit  amd

title: coffee themed limited edition keyboards
texto:
coffee themed limited edition keyboards the signature series cappuccino keyboard from drop is a mechanical keyboard designed with a coffee themed aesthetic  it features an 88 key tenkeyless  tkl  layout and is built around the cstm80 model  which allows for extensive customization  the keyboard includes a dcx latte keycap set  which provides a warm and sculpted typing experience  additionally  the cappuccino keyboard comes with a magnetically detachable latte decorative case  enhancing its visual appeal and making it easy to personalize 

the keyboard is equipped with gateron yellow ks 3 switches  known for their smooth linear travel  it also includes interchangeable polycarbonate weights and switch plates  as well as a full array of typing foam for a comfortable typing experience  the cappuccino keyboard supports hot swappable switch sockets  allowing users to easily change switches without soldering  furthermore  it features per key south facing rgb lighting  which can be customized using the stm32 chipset with qmk  via  and vial support  this combination of features makes the signature series cappuccino keyboard a versatile and customizable option for keyboard enthusiasts 

image credit  drop

title: feminine spring apparel collabs
texto:
feminine spring apparel collabs h m s latest designer collaboration   femininity in bloom   brings magda butrym s signature romance to the high street market  known for her intricate craftsmanship and bold yet delicate aesthetic  the polish designer marks her 10 year anniversary with a collection that reimagines some of her most celebrated pieces 

at the heart of the collection lies butrym s love for roses  a symbol of strong and graceful womanhood  this floral inspiration takes center stage in 3d rosette covered bodysuits  flowing gowns  and floral printed catsuits  offering a perfect blend of structure and softness  oversized coats meet ultra feminine silhouettes  creating a wardrobe that balances classic elegance with modern confidence 

with styles designed to turn heads and stand the test of time  h m x magda butrym is set to be a must have for spring  this collection will drop on april 24

title: distinct tasting menus
texto:
distinct tasting menus under the leadership of chef quinton bennett  enigma yorkville presents a refined dining experience that merges global influences with locally sourced ingredients  with a career spanning south africa  london  and copenhagen  chef bennett crafts tasting menus that highlight technical precision and culinary artistry  offering a distinctive approach to contemporary fine dining

title: tech inspired luxury accessories

tech inspired luxury accessories the  tamagotchi handbag  is uniquely coperni  known for pushing the boundaries between fashion and technology  the french luxury label has fused its signature  swipe bag  with one of the most iconic digital pets of the 2000s  the result is a futuristic meets nostalgic masterpiece that perfectly encapsulates the brand s vision 

coperni has made waves with ai powered accessories  robotic dog runways  and viral fashion moments  yes  that bella hadid spray on dress   they ve taken the y2k obsession to a new level with a miniature  tech infused handbag that speaks directly to the internet generation 

while this tamagotchi swipe bag is unlikely to see mass production  it symbolizes coperni s playful  experimental spirit  much like their cd playing handbag and meteorite crafted pieces  whether or not this accessory drops for the public  it s proof that coperni remains ahead of the curve

title: minimalist camper butane stoves
texto:
minimalist camper butane stoves the snow peak home   camp burner is a sleek  folding solution for camping enthusiasts to incorporate into their gear collection that will work effectively both on the campsite and in the kitchen 

the unit is designed in japan with minimalism in the spotlight and is crafted out of high performance materials that will ensure years of continuous use  the burner is compact enough to be carried in a backpack  while also featuring an adjustable flame control and auto igniter to maximize ease of use 

the snow peak home   camp burner is powered by a4 cb style butane canisters and will deliver up to 8 300btus of cooking power for up to 110 minutes per canister  the stove comes in khaki  black and silver color options

title: lightweight spf products
texto:

the clear  fast absorbing formula is intended to blend seamlessly into all skin tones without leaving a white cast or greasy residue  its serum lotion texture provides hydration for up to 48 hours  aiming to keep skin feeling smooth and primed for makeup application  with continued use  it is formulated to support a more refined and hydrated complexion  designed for daily wear  this spf product offers a practical addition to a skincare routine focused on sun protection and hydration

title: adventurous alpine ready coats
texto:

texto:

title: cloud based game streaming services
texto:

title: levelling up with reinvention
texto:
levelling up with reinvention innovation and hip hop share a powerful principle  reinvention  in his keynote at the future festival miami  jonathan brown  chief growth officer at trend hunter  explained how both thrive by blending ideas  breaking conventions  and anticipating what s next  hip hop reshaped music by sampling jazz  funk  rock  and r b  while marketing succeeds by reimagining messaging and creating fresh narratives 

now  with artificial intelligence  ai   this reinvention reaches new levels  ai allows marketers to draw from past inspirations while creating innovative  personalized strategies  using ai powered tools  brands can analyze consumer behavior  predict trends  and craft hyper targeted campaigns that feel both fresh and familiar  this fusion of nostalgia and innovation  coupled with data driven insights  keeps brands ahead of the curve 

both hip hop and marketing operate in  wicked learning environments   where unpredictability demands adaptability  ai enhances this by enabling real time campaign optimization and content creation  just as hip hop reinvented music  ai empowers marketers to push creative boundaries and build cultural movements 

by embracing ai s potential  marketers can create campaigns that do more than sell products they create lasting impacts  this intersection of hip hop  innovation  and ai in marketing is reshaping how brands connect with consumers  making them relevant in an ever evolving world

title: the evolution of retail   ai
texto:
the evolution of retail   ai artificial intelligence is revolutionizing retail  transforming both in store and online shopping  as ai continues to evolve  retailers must balance innovation with human connection to meet shifting consumer expectations  in her  retail   ai  keynote  jennifer kang explored three key trends driving this transformation  experience  personalization  and simplicity 

consumers today seek more than efficiency  they crave immersive and memorable shopping experiences  ai has made shopping faster and more convenient  but predictive shopping technology raises questions about whether it removes the spontaneity of discovery  ai powered chatbots and virtual assistants enhance customer support  ensuring seamless service beyond business hours  mobile shopping apps like klarna further streamline shopping by allowing users to snap a product photo and instantly locate the best prices 

despite ai s efficiency  in store shopping remains vital  over three quarters of consumers still prefer physical stores for social interaction and hands on service  to merge digital convenience with real world engagement  retailers are adopting  retailtainment   brands like jellycat have introduced interactive storefronts  while farfetch s  store of the future  features connected racks and holographic displays for real time customization 

personalization is a powerful ai tool  enabling curated recommendations based on consumer behavior  meanwhile  ai driven automation is revolutionizing retail operations  from product descriptions to social media content  as ai continues reshaping retail  brands must integrate automation while preserving meaningful human interactions

title: future festival miami coverage
texto:
future festival miami coverage at future festival miami  the miami herald covered how different generations are adopting ai in unique ways  hosted by trend hunter  the event explored how ai shapes consumer behavior across baby boomers  gen x  millennials  and gen z    but with a twist  armida ascano  chief content officer  introduced the idea of microgenerations  breaking down how each group interacts with ai differently 

baby boomers embrace ai for productivity and social connection  but only if it s practical  they re not interested in tech for tech s sake it has to make life easier 

gen x  balancing careers  kids  and aging parents  sees ai as a multitasking tool  as many hold leadership roles  they re crucial for securing ai buy in at work 

millennials  despite their reliance on technology  want less screen time  ai could help improve work life balance  set boundaries for kids  or simplify daily tasks  reducing digital fatigue 

gen z  fully immersed in ai  uses it seamlessly in work  school  and social media  for them  it s not about whether to use ai but whether they need to hide it from teachers or employers 

ai adoption isn t universal    it s generational  understanding these shifts is key to the future of ai driven business
