title: fishing inspired beer brand giveaways
texto:
fishing inspired beer brand giveaways as spring fishing season approaches  busch light is introducing the  stream home makeover  giveaway  offering one passionate angler the unique opportunity to create a private fishing retreat right at home  this exciting initiative provides the winner with funding to transform their yard into a fully stocked fishing spot  allowing for convenient and personal access to their favorite pastime 

in addition to the makeover  the winner will also receive beer money to stock up on busch light s seasonal  fishing cans   this year s limited edition release  which highlights four popular fish species walleye  largemouth bass  yellowfin tuna  and sockeye salmon comes in a newly designed tackle bag pack 

through the stream home makeover  busch light continues to foster its connection with the fishing community  combining its love for the outdoors with a one of a kind opportunity for fans to enjoy fishing from the comfort of their backyard 

image credit  busch light

title: irish drone executed deliveries
texto:
irish drone executed deliveries just eat takeaway com has partnered with manna to introduce drone operated deliveries  enhancing the customer experience  as a result of this initiative  there is now an option for drone delivery from select partners  with manna managing operations through its local delivery hubs  after the food is securely loaded onto a drone  the order is dispatched and can arrive at its destination in as little as three minutes 

initially  the just eat takeaway com drone service will be launched in dublin  ireland 

 this partnership represents a major milestone for drone delivery in europe  by combining manna s proven expertise in scalable drone operations with just eat takeaway com s vast customer base and logistics network  we re setting the standard for sustainable  convenient  and safe food delivery   said bobby healy  ceo at manna 

image credit  just eat

title: versatile lip products
texto:
versatile lip products the  signature lip sheer lip liner  marks merit s first ever lip liner  designed for a barely there  natural definition that enhances without overpowering  this impossible to mess up formula delivers a sheer gel color that glides effortlessly across the lips  creating soft contouring without harsh lines  whether applied alone for a hydrating  all over wash of color or used as a primer to extend wear  it s the perfect blend of ease and elegance 

available in eight neutral shades  the lip liner adapts to your natural lip color  offering buildable pigment and a satin finish that never settles into fine lines  packed with pomegranate and jojoba oil  it nourishes while defining  ensuring hydrated  plump lips throughout the day 

paired with merit s new  shade slick sheen   available in four luminous shades  this semi opaque gloss delivers a pearlescent finish that complements the lip liners for a naturally polished look 

available march 18 at meritbeauty com  this launch is all about effortless definition  hydration  and sheer  buildable color  join the waitlist now 

image credit  merit beauty

title: groundbreaking anti aging overnight creams
texto:
groundbreaking anti aging overnight creams skinbetter science has introduced the alpharet overnight cream  a groundbreaking anti aging overnight cream that is designed to address the appearance of fine lines  wrinkles  and uneven skin tone 

skinbetter science s innovative cream combines two powerhouse ingredients   a retinoid and an aha  lactic acid    through the brand s proprietary alpharet technology  which minimizes irritation while delivering effective skin rejuvenation  the anti aging overnight cream formula is enriched with antioxidants to neutralize free radicals and provides hydration to counteract the dryness often associated with traditional retinoid products 

clinical trials of skinbetter science s alpharet overnight cream have shown visible improvements in skin texture and tone in as little as four weeks  with results continuing to improve over 12 weeks of nightly use  the cream is dermatologist tested  non comedogenic  and free from parabens and fragrances 

image credit  skinbetter science

title: ocean inspired glasses campaigns
texto:
ocean inspired glasses campaigns costa sunglasses has partnered with renowned underwater photographer ben thouard to showcase the beauty and power of the ocean through his lens while introducing the new los alijos lifestyle frames 

ben thouard is celebrated for his ability to capture the ocean s dynamic interplay of light and water  his work  which ranges from the legendary waves of teahupo o to ethereal seascapes  reflects a deep connection to the ocean and a commitment to inspiring others to explore and protect it  costa sunglasses  los alijos lifestyle frames fit perfectly into this narrative  designed for coastal adventurers  the eyewear silhouettes combine clarity  durability  and comfort  as such  they are presented as ideal for activities like surfing  photography  or simply relaxing by the water 

alongside los alijos  costa sunglasses has launched the corrientes frames  worn by tahitian waterwoman angie pambrun 

image credit  costa sunglasses

title: dual filtration tumblers
texto:
dual filtration tumblers the lifestraw  go series water filter tumbler  features a dual filtration system independently tested to remove microplastics  bacteria  and other contaminants  its two stage filtration process includes  a membrane microfilter that protects against bacteria  such as e  coli and salmonella   parasites  microplastics  sand  and dirt  while an activated carbon filter reduces chlorine  odors  and organic chemicals  enhancing taste  

this 18 ounce stainless steel tumbler  keeps water cool throughout the day and fits standard car cupholders  making it ideal for work  exercise  and travel   designed for convenience  it ensures access to cleaner  better tasting water from various sources 

moreover  each purchase of a lifestraw product provides one year of safe drinking water to a child in need  supporting a global initiative that has reached over 11 million children  this commitment transforms hydration into a meaningful contribution to clean water accessibility worldwide 

image credit  lifestraw

title: limited edition luminous matte lipstick
texto:
limited edition luminous matte lipstick chanel has just launched the limited edition rouge allure velvet les perles lipstick collection  a luminous matte interpretation of its iconic lipstick line  inspired by the pearls famously worn by mademoiselle chanel to enhance her radiance  this capsule features eight sophisticated shades ranging from red brown to light beige 

the luminous matte lipstick offers a buildable finish  achieved through soft focus microspheres and ultra fine pearly particles that provide a subtle glow while maintaining a matte look  enriched with shea butter and a jojoba oil derivative  the formula ensures long lasting hydration  comfort  and a plumping effect  as well 

chanel s new limited edition rouge allure velvet les perles lipstick collection is housed in an exclusive case adorned with shiny gold trim  this packaging aesthetic delivers a touch of elegance while emphasizing luxury  innovation  and timeless inspiration 

image credit  chanel

title: refreshing plum inspired ciders
texto:
refreshing plum inspired ciders seattle cider company expands its vivid light cider lineup with ripe plum  a refreshing and flavorful beverage offering that blends fresh pressed washington apples with locally sourced plum juice  seattle cider company s latest release aligns with the growing consumer demand for lower alcohol beverages made with high quality  locally sourced ingredients 

with a 4 2  abv  ripe plum delivers a balanced combination of crisp apple notes and the sweet  tangy richness of sun ripened plums  the lower abv makes the beverage an attractive option for those seeking a lighter drinking option  plum  as a flavor  is gaining popularity for its versatility and depth  as well 

ripe plum will be available in 12oz cans and on draft starting march 2025  with a release party at the seattle cider taproom on march 6  featuring cider cocktails  local food trucks  and packaged cider to go 

image credit  seattle cider company

title: community project micro grant programs
texto:
community project micro grant programs big grove brewery has launched a groundbreaking neighborhood micro grant program  the first of its kind in the beer industry  the initiative aims at supporting small scale and high impact community projects 

through its newly established big grove for good foundation  the brewery will provide grants ranging from  250 to  1 000 to individuals and organizations in iowa  nebraska  and western illinois  the brand plans to expand its neighborhood micro grant program to other midwest states in 2025  funding for the program comes from sales of the neighborhood beer  a new lager that will see one dollar from every case sold going directly to the foundation 

projects that are eligible for the neighborhood micro grant program by big grove brewery include initiatives like improving public spaces  building community libraries  planting trees  or purchasing equipment for local events 

image credit  big grove brewery

title: convenient single serve honey condiments
texto:
convenient single serve honey condiments nature nate s honey co  s latest product offering   the hot honey minis   brings the brand s award winning sweet and spicy honey to a convenient  single serve format  these portable packets are designed to make it easy for consumers to enjoy the bold flavor of hot honey on the go  whether drizzled on pizza  added to sandwiches  or paired with snacks like charcuterie boards  the minis are also ideal for lunchboxes  family gatherings  and outdoor adventures 

nature nate s honey co  s hot honey minis taps into the growing popularity of the hot honey subsegment  the brand s commitment to quality remains evident  as the minis are made with the same 100  pure  raw  and unfiltered honey that has defined the brand since 1972 

image credit  nature nate s honey co

title: flavorful non alcoholic beers
texto:
flavorful non alcoholic beers switchback brewing co  expands into the no alcohol segment with a favorful non alcoholic beer   the switchback n a  the product offers a guilt free experience of the brewery s popular switchback ale  claiming that the new version is  crafted with the same dedication to flavor and quality   minus the alcohol  

the switchback n a  has been positioned as an excellent and refreshing beverage choice for many occasions such as  a post run hangout  a weeknight dinner  or simply taking it easy  the flavorful non alcoholic beer retains high quality due to a pioneering  nested fermentation  process  which was made possible through switchback brewing co  s partnership with brewvo na 

according to bill cherry  founder   brewmaster of switchback brewing co   the brand s expansion and bold venture into the non alcoholic beer market is  an evolution  not a departure 

image credit  switchback brewing co

title: peanut butter inspired protein bars
texto:
peanut butter inspired protein bars genius gourmet has partnered with the makers of skippy  peanut butter to launch skippy inspired protein nut rolls  this new addition to the protein snack market combines the iconic flavor of skippy peanut butter with a chewy  candy bar like texture that blends gooey caramel  salted roasted peanuts  and a peanut butter flavored core 

each skippy inspired protein nut roll contains 210 calories  11 grams of protein  six grams of fiber  and zero grams of added sugar  genius gourmet unveiled the collaborative product at expo west 2025  the combination of skippy s iconic peanut butter flavor with a protein rich  low sugar snack format offers a guilt free indulgence for those seeking a balance between taste and nutrition  the product can be utilized as a pre  or post workout snack  lunchbox addition  or everyday treat 

image credit  genius gourmet x skippy

title: digital hiv resource centers
texto:
digital hiv resource centers medisafe  a leading digital health platform for medication management  has partnered with emd serono to launch the hiv resource center by medisafe  this global digital tool aims to support individuals living with hiv  the initiative reflects emd serono s commitment to digital first patient engagement and medisafe s mission to improve health outcomes through advanced technology and behavioral science 

the collaboration between medisafe and emd serono focuses on addressing key health challenges such as hiv associated wasting and fatigue by providing personalized  proactive support through medisafe s innovative just in time interventions  jiti   technology  the hiv resource center by medisafe offers medically vetted resources  educational content  and health tracking tools tailored to the hiv patient journey  users receive personalized alerts and recommendations if they experience symptoms like unintentional weight loss  for example 

image credit  medisafe x emd serono

title: cutting edge deep reasoning models
texto:
cutting edge deep reasoning models babbily has introduced boba  a cutting edge deep reasoning model designed to advance problem solving  analytical thinking  and contextual understanding  building on the success of its earlier web search focused model   mochi  boba represents a significant leap forward in ai capabilities 

the deep reasoning model is built on deepseek r1 and perplexity s solar search technologies  this enables the innovation to handle complex queries with improved logic  critical thinking  and real world applicability  boba excels in advanced reasoning tasks and offers features such as coding support  enhanced contextual understanding  and precision driven search integration  it can generate  debug  and optimize code across multiple programming languages  as well 

additionally  boba leverages real time  citation supported sources to provide highly accurate and nuanced responses  the model is now available to all babbily users  babbily also announced plans to expand its ai ecosystem further  including enhancements to its text to speech capabilities with new models from eleven labs and deepgram 

image credit  babbily

title: ai powered strength training platforms
texto:
ai powered strength training platforms the whichweight app is a strength training platform tailored for endurance athletes and their coaches  the innovation leverages artificial intelligence technology to deliver personalized  data driven workouts 

the platform was developed with input from olympians  at its core  the whichweight app aims to bridge the gap between endurance and strength training while helping athletes optimize performance and reduce injury risks  key features of the platform include ai powered automation  seasonal adaptation  and real time monitoring  the artificial intelligence feature works to adjust strength programs in real time based on athlete data while the seasonal adaptation allows coaches to align strength phases with an athlete s training cycle  finally  real time monitoring provides coaches with insights into progress and potential injury risks 

by integrating these tools  whichweight offers a scalable solution that enhances training efficiency and precision  making it a valuable resource for elite endurance athletes and coaches seeking to maximize performance 

image credit  whichweight

title: confidence celebrating fashion campaigns
texto:
confidence celebrating fashion campaigns lulus fashion lounge has launched a comprehensive  multi phased brand campaign aimed at strengthening its market presence and deepening customer loyalty  titled  we are lulus   the marketing celebrates women  confidence  and the transformative power of fashion  its themes align with the values of international women s month 

lulus fashion lounge s initiative highlights the brand s commitment to its female audience by showcasing the creativity and dedication of its team while reinforcing its identity as a brand built by women for women  we are lulus combines emotional storytelling  product focused messaging  and cultural relevance to drive engagement and long term loyalty  it includes out of home advertising in high traffic areas like new york s times square and near college campuses in key markets  influencer collaborations  and in person events  this multi channel approach builds on the success of previous campaigns  aiming to expand lulus  reach beyond digital platforms and foster early brand loyalty among younger demographics 

image credit  lulus fashion lounge

title: women celebrating wig discounts
texto:
women celebrating wig discounts luvme hair is celebrating international women s day 2025 with a special sale offering significant discounts on its premium human hair wigs and extensions  from march 5 to march 31  customers can enjoy savings of up to  120 on a wide range of products  including front wigs  curly wigs  and hair extensions  discounts are available for various purchase tiers  with first time buyers eligible for an additional 30  off 

luvme hair s collections emphasize comfort  versatility  and natural appearance  with options such as the all day comfort  wig  curly wigs  blonde wigs  no lace wigs  glueless lace wigs  and 13x4 lace frontal wigs  the brand s founder  helena li  highlights the sale as an opportunity for customers to express their individuality and confidence through high quality hair solutions 

image credit  luvme hair

title: comprehensive fiber in a box solutions
texto:
comprehensive fiber in a box solutions amdocs  fiberone is a comprehensive fiber in a box solution designed to streamline the deployment  management  and monetization of fiber networks for communication service providers  this end to end offering leverages generative ai to enhance automation  reduce deployment costs  and improve operational efficiency  through these functionalities  the innovation can address key challenges such as regulatory hurdles  workforce limitations  and the complexity of digital infrastructure 

fiberone integrates advanced features like geospatial network lifecycle management  zero touch automation  and ai driven decision making  additionally  the fiber in a box solution enables communication service providers to rapidly launch innovative digital brands and services  supported by flexible billing models and a robust digital platform 

with a proven track record of designing over 1 2 million fiber route miles globally  amdocs aims to help companies meet the growing demand for high speed connectivity while driving revenue growth and improving customer experiences 

image credit  amdocs

title: sauce inspired qsr menus
texto:
sauce inspired qsr menus hardee s has teamed up with duke s mayo to introduce a new menu offering that combines the quick serve restaurant s hand breaded chicken tenders with duke s carolina gold bbq sauce  a tangy  sweet  and slightly spicy condiment  this collaboration is timed to coincide with the excitement of basketball season and aims to cater to fans who enjoy pairing their sports viewing with flavorful  indulgent food 

the hardee s x duke s mayo platter includes fries  coleslaw  garlic toast  and a drink  hardee s is leveraging its my rewards loyalty program to attract new members by offering free menu items  such as a hand breaded chicken sandwich or a five piece chicken tender offer  with a minimum purchase  to further enhance the seasonal appeal  the chain has also launched a limited time strawberry lemon biscuit 

image credit  hardee s

title: michelin star airline cuisine partnerships
texto:
michelin star airline cuisine partnerships air canada has partnered with michelin starred chef masaki hashimoto to enhance its signature class dining experience on flights to and from japan 

chef masaki hashimoto is renowned for his mastery of kaiseki cuisine   a traditional japanese multi course dining style   and he brings his culinary expertise to the airline  offering passengers a rotating menu of meticulously crafted dishes  the menu includes appetizers like sautéed lotus root  side dishes such as sesame tofu with wasabi sauce  and main courses featuring beef sukiyaki with simmered tofu and vegetables  all served with calrose rice and miso soup  the experience is further elevated with premium sake pairings selected by chef masaki hashimoto s son  kei hashimoto  who is a certified sake sommelier 

additionally  air canada plans to introduce traditional japanese dishware and tray presentations curated by chef hashimoto in collaboration with noritake 

image credit  air canada x chef masaki hashimoto

title: productivity focused ai powered pcs
texto:
productivity focused ai powered pcs in a campaign that emphasizes its highly efficient ai powered pcs  hp canada turns to the productivity challenges faced by canadian workers  particularly those exacerbated by disruptions like daylight savings  long weekends  and extended leave  according to a recent survey conducted by hp  many workers struggle with time consuming administrative tasks  such as managing emails and balancing personal obligations  which can lead to decreased productivity and increased stress  the survey also highlights the impact of sleep deprivation on workplace behavior  with 35  of respondents reporting irritability and reduced patience after losing sleep  to combat these issues  hp is promoting its next generation ai powered pcs   such as the hp omnibook x and hp elitebook ultra   which are designed to streamline workflows  automate repetitive tasks  and enhance overall efficiency  these devices leverage ai to help users catch up on emails  organize schedules  and even assist with content creation 

image credit  hp canada

title: collegiate athlete supporting brands
texto:
collegiate athlete supporting brands c4 energy has made a groundbreaking move by signing 128 collegiate basketball players  marking the largest name  image  and likeness  nil  deal in history  this initiative is part of the brand s  made for athletes  certified for sport   campaign  which highlights c4 energy commitment to supporting athletes with its nsf certified energy drinks 

this latest development is dubbed  c4 bracket breakers  and features standout collegiate basketball players ike johni broome  mark sears  madison booker  and lauren betts  through a mix of athlete driven content  behind the scenes footage  and targeted media campaigns  c4 aims to celebrate these athletes  journeys and connect with sports enthusiasts on a deeper level while empowering a youthful demographic 

by tapping into the excitement of college basketball and the cultural significance of nil partnerships  c4 energy not only strengthens its position in the market but also appeals to a broad audience of athletes  students  and sports fans 

image credit  c4 energy

title: women empowering mountaineering initiatives
texto:
women empowering mountaineering initiatives arc teryx s initiative    she  the mountain    brings together a diverse group of accomplished women to explore the intersection of mountaineering  personal growth  and gender empowerment  the project is set against the stunning backdrop of mont blanc in chamonix  france  the campaign boldly features yang xiaohua  a trailblazing climber aiming to become the first chinese woman to achieve ifmga certification  alongside actress ni ni and writer director zhou yijun  through their shared experiences in  the mountain classroom   the documentary highlights the parallels between these women s professional journeys and the challenges of alpine climbing 

arc teryx s  she  the mountain  boldly emphasizes resilience  collaboration  and the breaking of societal barriers  consumers   particularly those interested in outdoor sports  gender equality  and personal development   would find this initiative compelling 

image credit  arc teryx

title: arched garden topped cultural centers
texto:
arched garden topped cultural centers architecture firm atelier apeiron has completed the design of the hengqin culture and art complex  which is located in zhuhai  china  the space features a library  museum  and theater under the roof  which also has a terraced roof garden  one of the most defining features of the space is the arched detail of the building supporting the stacked roof with three platforms 

the lead architect at the firm  yunchao xu explains   arches have been embraced as a critical form of architecture since the beginning of time and are prevalent in both eastern and western culture  to create strong structures with available materials  arches have been used to convert shear force in a horizontal direction into vertical force  ensuring that all points of the structure carry a shared load  

image credit  shengliang su

title: street food stall furniture designs
texto:
street food stall furniture designs thai design firm jhanyar presents the new gageenang collection of products for bangkok design week  founders of the firm watcharavit chanyakul and siriwan wattanajindawong are both fans of street food  and the gageenang capsule builds on these experiences at some of the most casual dining spots in the city  they reimagined familiar pieces  including plastic stools and folded tables  by adding a functional touch  like a table top 

the duo explain the design process to dezeen  noting  the project aims to enhance the quality of thailand s charming street food culture while experimenting with new ideas such as highlighting gaps in behaviours and lifestyles  this project adopts a chinese word that conveys a sense of warmth  simplicity and inclusiveness  making it accessible to everyone  

image credit  jhanyar

title: slate based facade systems
texto:
slate based facade systems spanish brand cupa pizarras has presented the cupaclad system  which is a slate based cladding structure meant to offer a sustainable alternative to conventional facades  the system is made with a natural monochromatic grey look with the goal of protecting and insulating a building with a practical and stylish angle 

it blends performance  sustainability  and elegance with a wide range of rainscreen cladding options and direct apply selections for homeowners and builders to achieve their visions  the brand explains   each slate used in cupaclad systems is carefully selected for its technical properties and natural beauty  ensuring an outstanding finish for any project  slate is a completely natural product with unbeatable technical properties that provide considerable added value to any facade project  

image credit  cupa pizarras

title: brutalist inpsired nature getaways
texto:
brutalist inpsired nature getaways danish design imprint vipp continues to breach international borders with the launch of its latest guesthouse  dubbed vipp tunnel  this can be found on the bruny island in tasmani  which is designed by room11  a design firm based in hobart  the brutalist structure is the perfect blend of nature  architecture  and art into one form 

it overlooks views of the ocean and the landscape surrounding the home  overall  it balances a brutalist theme with nature and inside  there is the v3 kitchen with an all aluminum design that roots the main living space  this is joined by the vipp swivel chairs which are upholstered in australian sheepskin to add some soft contrast against the raw exterior 

image credit  adam gibson

title: victorian inspired london homes
texto:
victorian inspired london homes british architecture firm mailen design draws in some historic influence when creating the lee terrace house nestled in south london  the modern home has three storeys and it is at the end of a long garden connected to the home in greenwich  the front facade has angled brick details to create a modern take on victorian cornicing 

the studio s managing director ben mailen notes   the material palette was carefully selected to integrate sensitively with the surrounding architecture whilst maintaining a high level of quality and craftsmanship  by incorporating a courtyard and large expanses of glazing to dual aspects  the design creates a sense of openness and flow  bringing in natural light and extending views beyond the immediate boundaries  

image credit  alex dormon

title: hearty stacked breakfast sandwiches
texto:
hearty stacked breakfast sandwiches the bruegger s bagels double stack egg sandwich is making its way to the brand s participating locations as a hearty breakfast option for customers to pick up in the morning hours  the sandwich is crafted with a cheesy hash brown gourmet bagel as the base  which is topped with two layers of american cheese  peppered bacon and eggs to prioritize a large serving size  the sandwich can be ordered by heading in store  placing an order online or through the brand s ap for pickup 

the bruegger s bagels double stack egg sandwich prioritizes indulgence to make it a must try amongst customers who are seeking out an alternative to the classics  the sandwich also comes as a high quality alternative to fast food breakfast options

title: bright tonal lifestyle sneakers
texto:
bright tonal lifestyle sneakers new balance prepares for the warmer seasons ahead with two new tonal iterations of the iconic 2002r sneaker model  with green suede and ice wine joining the lineup  both of the editions embody the signature neo vintage feel of the model with a suede centric build throughout the upper 

it also rests on top of a midsole unit that has been pre yellowed for a retro and worn in feeling  the green suede ietraion has a lush green palette detailed with contrasting hrey leather at the underlays and white accents making its way to th etoe box  logo  and backtab  the ice wine edition offers a deeper red hue to channel spring with the same comfortable abzorb cushioning base 

image credit  new balance

title: expanding camper van concepts
texto:
expanding camper van concepts the chery journeo concept camper van is a feature rich vehicle designed with domestic travelers and weekend warriors alike in mind to help them set up a comfortable living space wherever they go  the vehicle is imagined with a hybrid engine that includes a 2 0 liter turbo engine and the brand s kunpeng super performance electric hybrid c dm system that will work together to offer up to 1 550 miles of range  the vehicle offers comfortable seating inside for all passengers  but will evolve upon arrival at a destination to offer a full bed  a small kitchen space and even an outdoor loveseat that will fold down in the front 

the chery journeo concept camper van is also imagined with adaptable air suspension to help maximize comfort when driving on rugged terrain

title: modular photography smartphone concepts
texto:
modular photography smartphone concepts the xiaomi modular optical system has been debuted by the tech brand as a conceptual rendering of what could be done to make mobile devices even better at snapping photos in the field  the platform imagines the ability to attach high quality lenses to the rear of the smartphone  which would enable users to enjoy premium experiences and simply remove it when not in use  the system utilizes a proprietary setup that would see the lens module positioned onto the rear magnetically  just adjacent to the built in camera lenses  for an intuitive user experience 

the xiaomi modular optical system was shown off by the brand at the mobile world conference  mwc  2025 and will remain a concept for the time being

title: brown tonal dynamic footwear
texto:
brown tonal dynamic footwear nike introduces a look at its latest tonal iteration of the air flightposite sneaker model ith the baroque brown colorway palette joining its roster  the model is a part of the brand s holiday 2025 series  so there is a long way to go before the official launch 

the silhouette made its first launch back in 1999 and it has since been a cult favorite amongst fans throughout the years  it takes the foamposite shell at the exterior and completes it with a zippered shroud with an upper detailed with a neoprene textile  this gives it a close fit that is secured with a zipper with nike branding at the tongue and swoosh logos placed on the heels 

image credit  bitchlikemykicks

title: historic inspired thin timepieces
texto:
historic inspired thin timepieces ming has unveiled a look at its new project 21 timepiece which is a special launch that came into fruition from a challenge that was given by the founder of the brand  ming thein  this occurred back at a collector s dinner that took place in 2023 

the challenge was to create a timepiece for himself that has limits that are feasible but free of other constraints  ten collectors partook in the project s commitment and worked on creating a unique horological piece that meets his personal design preferences and practical manufacturing  the root of the project is the frederic piguet 21 which is a movement known for its historic significance and its extremely thin profile first launched in 1925 

image credit  ming

title: portable phone attached mini speakers
texto:
portable phone attached mini speakers miatone introduces a look at one of its latest products with a spotlight on the miatone magboom mini speaker  it is a magnetic device that is designed to snap right onto the back of the smartphone through magsafe capabilities  not only does it function as an audio device  but it also works as a prop stand as well 

the audio dock allows the phone to automatically alter into a small entertainment center with elevated audio and visuals with the screen  the miatone magboom mini was presented during mwc 2024  and it is a compact device that essentially gives phones their own woofer  it is created as an add on feature with an output of 3w  which is very powerful for its size 

image credit  miatone

title: ai powered data solutions
texto:
ai powered data solutions swedish innovator ecodatacenter  renowned for constructing eco friendly data centers that support central ai compute providers  has secured  478 million   450 million  from a consortium of institutional investors  this substantial equity infusion is earmarked for advancing cutting edge technologies and expanding its portfolio of green data centers 

ecodatacenter s investment accelerates sustainable digital infrastructure development in an era of ai demand  it reinforces its market leadership in eco conscious technology solutions  positioning the company to capitalize on the growing need for environmentally responsible data management 

 we are focused on scaling ecodatacenter and delivering long term value  supported by the strong backing of our investors   said robert björk  an investment manager for areim and board member ecodatacenter   while we continuously evaluate strategic opportunities for the company  including potential future financing options  an ipo is not something we are actively pursuing at this stage  

image credit  nicoelnino

title: versatile modern compact homes
texto:
versatile modern compact homes imagine tiny homes has created the atlas home  which is a sustainable and compact structure measuring 28 feet  the idaho based company first started in 2021  and it specializes in high quality small homes to promote a simple and intentional way of living 

the atlas house is a noah certified home meant for versatility and serves as a full time home or rental  it is also suitable as a tranquil getaway retreat or a guest house  atlas rests on top of a triple axle trailer and is defined by its wooden framing and water resistant rockwool insulation  the home also has a smartpanel siding and a durable metal roof to top it all off while ensuring that it has longevity and efficiency to last through time 

image credit  imagine tiny homes

title: sustainable woven exhibitions
texto:
sustainable woven exhibitions svenskt tenn has just launched frank in the loom  which is an exhibition that is currently on display at stockholm design week  it blends elements of sustainability  handcraftsmanship  and theory  the collection features include  limited range of rag rugs  which are all carefully made using josef frank fabrics and it is double woven into the floor covers 

this inspiration stems from the schackruta rug by margit thoren  it is woven by vandra rugs in ukraine and is a reflection of the resilience of textile culture  frank in the loom brings the process to the forefront of the exhibition with a loom with a runner in the middle of the space to encourage a thoughtful approach to observing the art 

image credit  svenskt tenn

title: stealthy rare wooden instruments
texto:
stealthy rare wooden instruments the torch t01 is a captivatingly beautiful new instrument designed by yamaha  it is a digital piano that is recognized by its stealthy black keyboard and the fine materials that are used to create it  the main materials include the use of the rare wood  which is grenadilla or african blackwood 

usually  this is used to create wind instruments  so instead of wasting it  the unused wood is integrated into the torch t01 to form a tactile and striking piano  it is used with natural oils to create a hand finished look on the wooden parts  the natural beauty is truly enhanced and joined by hand finished surfaces and the fine laser engraved patterns for close attention to detail 

image credit  yamaha

title: geometric ceramic collections
texto:
geometric ceramic collections jessica rust brings attention to the old japanese pottery technique of nerikomi when creating the new limn collection  the technique involves blending layers of colored clay together to form unique patterns  for five years  rust has immersed herself in the craft to create the collection  it is comprised of a drink table  vases  and lighting that are all made by hand 

shining a spotlight on the limn vase    it comes in various sizes from short  tall  and wide  it explores a range of color variations that are produced from the technique  the vases ensure that no two are alike and each one is unique to its own with an organic sense of human creation 

image credit  jessica rust

title: jet black sustainable artful cabins
texto:
jet black sustainable artful cabins atelier nyp is a beautiful new cabin design by the team at studio bua  it is built on a historic site of what was once a ruined sheep shed nestled in western iceland  the name of the space is dubbed after the nypurhyrna mountain that rises up from behind the cabin  atelier nyp is created as an artist s studio and a guest house

title: fully integrated smart helmets
texto:

title: ultra rare single malt whiskeys
texto:
ultra rare single malt whiskeys the glen grant splendours collection has been launched by the campari group owned distillery as a lineup of high end spirits that take inspiration from its garden of splendours  the collection puts a 65 year old single malt scotch whiskey in the spotlight that was distilled in 1958 and pays homage to the natural elements that are allowed to flourish within the landscape  the rare spirit is limited to just 151 bottles and comes packaged in handcrafted decanters created by john galvin and glasstorm with a price point of  50 000 

master distiller greig stables spoke on the glen grant splendours collection saying   the true scarcity of this spirit at 65 years old is testament to the unwavering approach to whisky making and visionary innovation that has defined the glen grant  although distilled in 1958  the methods remain almost entirely the same today  reflecting our forefathers  legacy

title: easter celebrating snack chips
texto:
easter celebrating snack chips the walkers sensations chips are being launched in a series of new flavors in the uk as a way to help consumers satisfy guests when entertaining this easter  the snack chips come in two flavors including slow roasted pork   apple sauce and thai sweet chilli  which are each characterized by their sweet yet savory taste profile  the products each come in 150 gram packets and respond to increasing consumer interest in seasonal food items with a limited time profile 

senior marketing director wayne newton commented on the new walkers sensations chips saying   walkers sensations has always been about delivering a premium snacking experience and the limited edition slow roasted pork   apple sauce flavour will give people looking for a delicious snack an unrivalled taste experience  easter is a crucial opportunity for retailers to be driving their savoury snacking sales  during this time  shoppers look for extra special snacking options that will elevate special occasions  such as limited edition flavours   pack designs

title: billowing modular art installations
texto:
billowing modular art installations people s architecture office  otherwise known as pao has designed the curly cube  this is a modular art installation developed to transform an ordinary urban space into an area of light  shade  and artful interaction  nestled in shanghai  it is a captivating piece of art  when looking at the curly cube  it appears as a juxtaposing look    soft but structured  fluid yet angular 

it is made with inspiration drawn from the gyroid minimal surface  the complex is brought to life with the curvilinear tensile membranes  which were conceived by serge ferrari  the structure stretches over the square frames  which are lightweight and open  this is joined by a softness that the light reflects off of the fabric materials and membranes 

image credit  people s architecture office

title: pouch packaged meal ranges
texto:
pouch packaged meal ranges tilda easy meals are a new lineup of products from the rice brand that are targeted towards the increasing number of consumers interested in heat and eat meal options  the product range consists of three options including sundried tomato   beans  vegetable paella and chickpea korma  which are each packaged in pouches and ready to be heated up in the microwave  the meals are each crafted with flavor in the spotlight  but also nutrition with protein  vegetables and beans in the recipe  depending on the variety 

head of marketing anna beheshti spoke on the tilda easy meals saying   we re all so busy these days   short on inspiration and always on the lookout for shortcuts to elevate mealtimes  our easy meals range offers up a complete meal  providing tasty vegetables and protein  in just two minutes   making healthy eating effortless  across any occasion

title: compact red wooden homes
texto:
compact red wooden homes studio test presents the new prefab house changeover  which is a compact structure designed in a bold red hue resting on top of a collection of shorcrete pillars  it is nestled in the woodlands of barcelona  and the spanish design firm has worked on a unique approach when faced with the challenges of restoring the dilapidated wooden home  which was originally constructed on a nine pillar base 

it was left to decay in the mountains  and instead of going for a full demolition  the studio proposed three replacement strategies to the owners  they landed on a modular prefabricated system and brought attention to a more flexible living experience for both indoor and outdoors  it covers 60 square metres and is made up of eight balloon framed modules 

image credit  studio test

title: shamrock inspired frog cakes
texto:
shamrock inspired frog cakes carvel is bringing back its beloved cookie o puss cake just in time for st  patrick s day  offering customers a festive and indulgent way to celebrate  available for a limited time at participating locations  this seasonal favorite is crafted with layers of rich chocolate ice cream  crunchy chocolate cookie pieces  and creamy vanilla ice cream  topped with a scoop of mint or pistachio ice cream placed in a sugar cone  the cake is decorated with two chocolate chip cookies and a white and green whipped topping 

as one of carvel s signature seasonal offerings  the cookie o puss cake has become a tradition for many customers  the cake will be available while supplies last 

for those looking to purchase the cookie o puss cake  carvel encourages customers to visit their nearest store or check online for availability at participating locations 

image credit  carvel

title: ready to eat chocolate pancakes
texto:
ready to eat chocolate pancakes the brioche pasquier choc chips pancakes are being added to the brand s ready to eat pancake range as a chocolatey version perfect for snacking occasions  desserts and more  the product is  like all the brand s products  crafted with fresh eggs and milk with a vegetarian friendly recipe that also features rainforest alliance certified chocolate  the pancakes come in packs of two pancakes to prioritize enjoyment out of the house or as a portioned snack or meal option to enjoy from home 

retail sales manager fabien pasquier commented on the brioche pasquier choc chips pancakes saying   pancakes make a delicious breakfast that is particularly popular with families  parents love them because they are quick and easy to prepare  and children love them because they taste so good  they make a great base for breakfast or lunch dishes and can be successfully paired with sweet or savoury toppings  and of course  with pancake day coming up  these are perfect for a quick treat  topped however you like

title: hawaiian inspired slow cooker concepts
texto:
hawaiian inspired slow cooker concepts julian koebbe is the creative mind behind the new slow cooker concept  which is developed with inspiration from traditional hawaiian underground pit cooking  slow cookers themselves are a modern appliance  but the concept is not new at all  the hawaiian people had a tradition of burying and covering large amounts of food in a put to cook  it creates a communal experience and feeds a large number of people 

it is specifically inspired by the  imu  underground oven pits  and the slow cooker design is also tweaked with some elements that make the process more convenient and meaningful  this is translated through elements such as the separate section for the actual cooker  which allows users to lift the hot pot away safely and prepare the food 

image credit  julian koebbe

title: crystal clear citrus libations
texto:
crystal clear citrus libations vk lemon   lime is making its debut in the uk this spring as the brand s latest ready to drink  rtd  refreshment that s perfect for consumers to enjoy as the seasons change and the weather starts to heat up  the drink features the zesty flavors of lemon and lime in every sip  and is crafted with a crystal clear color that s positioned as much different to the brand s existing options that spotlight neon hues  the drink will come in 700ml bottles this month  while april will see  tesco  asda and morrisons stocking a mixed pack with 275ml bottles 

senior brand manager for vk holly bolus spoke on vk lemon   lime saying   flavour is at the heart of what makes vk stand out  and we re thrilled to bring vk lemon   lime to our range  it s a flavour that gen z love and one that millennials remember fondly  plus  with our first ever clear fruity vk  we re proving that the flavour speaks for itself   it s a clear choice in every way  we ve gone all out to make this our biggest launch year  with huge activations  retail expansion and party experiences to match

title: pizza inspired carbonated beverages
texto:
pizza inspired carbonated beverages beverage company brings attention to its pepperoni pizza soda  which is a low sugar drink  and the carbonated beverage is inspired by the cheesy  savory dish  it also has hints of spicy notes with the classic pepperoni taste  the soda is health conscious as well 

each can of pepperoni pizza soda has only 3 grams of sugar and 30 calories  making it a much healthier alternative to traditional sodas on the market  other details are that it is free of caffeine  vegan  and made entirely with natural ingredients  according to the brand  the playful nature of the launch is dubbed as  gabagool approved  and  vegan vinny approved   all of the orders will be shipping out this month

image credit  perft  igor ilnitski

title: titanium twist ballpoint pens
texto:
titanium twist ballpoint pens the james brand has designed the bolen  which is a sleek ballpoint pen with a titanium twisting mechanism  the very core component of what makes a pen great is a smooth ink flow  which is also comfortable to hold  the bolen embodies these features  and it is also pleasing to look at 

the pen boasts a striking design and has a minimal look overall  with a milled dot pattern at the grip  it also looks like it is made entirely from only a single piece of metal material  the pen itself has a twist retractable design  and it clicks when it is in place to ensure that there is no accidental activation or leaking inks 

image credit  the james brand

title: adapative futuristic greenery systems
texto:
adapative futuristic greenery systems the loopo green system is an impressive approach developed for bujnie by izabela serej and aleksandra majdzik cisowska  the system offers a flexible and progressive approach defined by its modular components  the design is also enhanced with greenery and constructed to evolve with the brand s needs to put users in control of designing spaces that are productive and inviting 

one of the most appealing features of loopo is not only its aesthetics but its ability to form a wide range of office furniture with the various pieces  with one system  the design has hanging or standalone planters  coffee tables  office lockers  tv stands  shelving  and more  all of these are available in a plethora of configurations  which are compact and expansive 

image credit  izabela serej and aleksandra majdzik cisowska  bujnie

title: marshmallow inspired plush collaborations
texto:
marshmallow inspired plush collaborations peeps and sanrio work in collaboration on a new collection comprised of adorable plush toys and other products inspired by both of their contributing efforts  the charming capsule merges the two companies together for the spring season ahead  what results is a limited edition collection of peeps and hello kitty   friends 

all of the products are themed around the two forces  starting with the themed plush toys and following with cosmetics and bath products  the collection brings attention to beloved characters  including hello kitty  my melody  pompompurin  and kuromi  transformed into peeps inspired designs  these come in a range of colors  and each plush is priced at  15  the plush baskets come in yellow  pink  white  and purple 

image credit  sanrio

title: chocolate covered frozen fruit treats
texto:
chocolate covered frozen fruit treats the trüfrü frozen fruit snacks are making their arrival in four new varieties in the uk as a series of options consumers to pick up that will satisfy cravings for a sweet treat with a healthful spin 

the product now comes in the blueberries in white chocolate  blueberries in dark chocolate  raspberries in white chocolate and raspberries in milk chocolate options for shoppers to peruse this springtime  the products are arriving at retailers in the uk in retail exclusive manners with the blueberry options arriving at waitrose now with the raspberry varieties headed to tesco locations starting march 10  2025 

general manager carrie martin commented on the trüfrü frozen fruit snacks saying   we are so pleased to see such strong and continued success for the trüfrü range  it tastes like real indulgence and fulfils a permissible need that we know consumers are looking for in the frozen category  in fact our research shows that it over indexes on two key areas  with shoppers saying it improves their mood and that it doesn t make them feel guilty

title: desert oasis gin spirits
texto:
desert oasis gin spirits hendrick s oasium has been debuted by the brand as part of its cabinet of curiosities series as its sixth limited edition spirit that prioritizes an expedition themed profile  the spirit is reported to have citrus notes with lush botanical tastes that were chosen to help complement the crisp profile of the gin base  the spirit is inspired by master distiller lesley gracie s visit to a desert oasis to bring a touch of the arid landscape to any cocktail recipe or experience 

gracie commented on the hendrick s oasium gin saying   as someone who s always in search of new flavours  it was fascinating to see what plants grow and thrive in an oasis  there s a very distinct  fresh green character and bright citrus note to hendrick s oasium  rounded off by aromatic herbs that play delightfully well together

title: quirky luxury collabs
texto:
quirky luxury collabs the moschino x milano handbag is turning heads on and off the runway  marking an irresistible collaboration between the world of high fashion and gourmet indulgence  debuting at milan fashion week  this exclusive handbag is inspired by pepperidge farm s first ever  milano white chocolate  cookie  combining moschino s bold aesthetic with the timeless elegance of this iconic treat 

just as designers set trends for the season  pepperidge farm is unveiling its latest must have  the milano white chocolate    a delicate balance of premium white chocolate and bright fruit flavors  in celebration of this new cookie  moschino has crafted a handbag that mimics the signature milano bag shape  blending whimsical design with high fashion 

available for pre order on moschino com  this collector s piece embodies luxury  indulgence  and craftsmanship    a true must have for fashion lovers and cookie enthusiasts alike 

image credit  moschino

title: soccer star sports drinks
texto:
soccer star sports drinks the lucozade sport ice kick sports drink is being added to the brand s product portfolio as a new hydration option that doesn t skimp on taste or function  the drink is being launched with the help of soccer star jude bellingham whose likeness is placed front and center on every bottle to help catch the attention of fans and curious shoppers alike  the drink itself boasts an ultra refreshing formulation that s citrusy and zesty  and is arriving just ahead of the warm weather months to position it perfectly for athletes to try out 

marketing director at sbf gb i tom bell commented on the new lucozade sport ice kick sports drink saying   we have loved working closely with jude to bring this icy new team member to chillers this season  this refreshing new addition to lucozade sport s range is set to be a huge hit with shoppers and football fans  and our proven track record of launching new flavours with our sport stars means we re confident that retailers will see it kick off an unbeatable summer of sales

title: savory fruit infused waffle meals
texto:
savory fruit infused waffle meals sweet and savory fare fans alike are sure to rejoice at the new of the bojangles chicken and bo berry waffles that are headed to participating locations as the ideal option for enjoyment during brunch 

the meal starts off with the brand s signature cajun filet served on top of a bo berry waffle before being drizzled with the bo berry honey glaze  the waffles are arriving as an a la carte option  as part of a combo or even a side  the brand is celebrating the new menu item s arrival with a special limited time promotion that will see customers enjoying a free order of the meal with any order of  20 or more 

chief marketing officer tom boland spoke on the new bojangles chicken and bo berry waffles saying   for many people  sunday brunch has become a highlight of the weekend  our chicken and bo berry waffles are the ultimate indulgence  whether you re enjoying brunch with company or treating yourself  we re making sure guests never have to settle   because brunch should never be put on hold

title: floating level aesthetic residences
texto:
floating level aesthetic residences the oak house is a beautifully designed home by muka arquitecture  and it is found in the pedrezuela municipality of madrid  spain  it brings attention to how architecture and integrates with its natural surroundings with ease  the structure also nods to the site s defining components which are the pair of majestic oak trees  hence the namesake  it is also defined by its reflective water surface nearby and the wide horizon 

the form of the house is dynamic as the southern entrance his minimal and has a continuous curve with a slight transition into the dwelling of the home with a double glass wall  this element embraces the landscape whilst bending to accommodate the aforementioned oak tree 

image credit  muka arquitectura

title: everyday luxury seafood soups
texto:
everyday luxury seafood soups canned foods and luxury aren t usually associated with one another  but these new elsinore seafood soups have been debuted by golden acres foods to help change this  the products are crafted with everyday luxury in mind to prioritize ease of access for consumers looking to quickly and conveniently enjoy a soup that they might find at a high end restaurant  the soups come in two options including mediterranean style seafood and fish chowder  which are both arriving in 400 gram cans for  2 80 each 

head of marketing for golden acre foods rebecca cutter commented on the elsinore seafood soups saying   not everyone can afford to dine out and not everyone has the time to make their own homemade soup from scratch  we know that many consumers are looking for long life options to provide a quick  easy and affordable meal for themselves and their families  but whilst convenience is important  consumers are not prepared to compromise on taste and luxury when they dine at home or host a dinner party  the new elsinore soups have been developed based on trends and inspired by restaurants and offer a taste of everyday luxury at an affordable price

title: superfood inspired serums
texto:
superfood inspired serums the  moon boost serum  is set to elevate skincare routines with its science backed sustainability  graydon skincare  the beloved canadian clean beauty brand  unveils this groundbreaking formula featuring palmless  torula oil  a revolutionary bio designed ingredient developed by c16 biosciences  as the first product in canada to incorporate this advanced oil  moon boost serum delivers deep hydration  enhanced brightness  and powerful antioxidant protection    all while championing sustainable beauty 

packed with vitamins a  c  e  d  f  and k  the serum works to even skin tone  boost elasticity  and combat visible signs of aging  its lightweight texture and bio fermented formulation make it ideal for sensitive skin  ensuring a nourishing experience with every drop  its commitment to eco conscious innovation sets it apart  eliminating reliance on palm oil derivatives  a major contributor to environmental degradation 

the moon boost serum launches on march 21  2025  at graydonskincare com and select retailers 

image credit  graydon

title: co designed fashionable sneakers
texto:
co designed fashionable sneakers fashion brand marni works in collaboration with hoka on the new bondi b3ls sneaker model  it comes in four colorways  and it joins the former s fall winter 2025 season as a part of the pink sun collection  the two detail the bondi b3ls model  which first hit the market last year 

the upper has a chunky look made from polyester materials with a partially rubberized build and lightly padded feel  all of this rests on top of a sturdy sole unit at the bottom  which uses a responsive rubber material and cushioned eva insoles for comfort with every step    it also has co branding  more branding for the duo can be seen in the packaging  the tongue pull tab  which nods to hoka and marni at the heel s pull tab 

image credit  marni  hoka

title: supple blue lifestyle sneakers
texto:
supple blue lifestyle sneakers nike introduces a new tonal and textural iteration of the iconic air force 1 low sneaker model with the launch of the blue suede colorway palette  joining its roster for the warmer seasons ahead  it embodies details of its namesake  the model is constructed from all suede materials across the upper for a soft feel 

this is applied in a deep turquoise color  and the same hue extends to the suede panel in the form of the swoosh logo  continuing through at the branded tongue tag over the forefoot  the heel notch  and the insoles  some tonal contrast follows with a white embroidered nike air logo  and it all rests on top of a white midsole and outsole base 

image credit  nike

title: athlete approved deodorant ranges
texto:
athlete approved deodorant ranges degree whole body deodorant is making its way to walmart and being promoted with the help of usc women s basketball player juju watkins to highlight how it can enhance one s everyday personal care routine  the deodorant range is formulated with total body use in mind to allow consumers to apply it anywhere they want to prevent odor to maintain freshness throughout the day  the partnership with watkins includes a humorous commercial that sees the athlete checking out at a walmart location with an entire cart full of the deodorants 

watkins spoke on her partnership for degree whole body deodorant saying   as a college athlete  i m constantly on the move running from class to practice  reviewing game tapes  and spending time with my team  with the long days and intense workouts  stress and sweat are just part of the game  and i need a deodorant that can keep up  degree s whole body deodorant is a game changer for me  a few quick sprays in between classes  before team meetings  or after practice  and i m fresh all over and ready to go

title: rodeo ready whisky cocktails
texto:
rodeo ready whisky cocktails as the 2025 houston livestock show and rodeo approaches  sirdavis american whisky  an official sponsor  is celebrating the event with its signature rodeo inspired cocktail  the  texas buckiin   founded by houston native beyoncé knowles carter in partnership with moët hennessy  the brand embraces the rodeo s bold spirit with a handcrafted drink that blends whisky s rich warmth with bright citrus and a crisp  refreshing finish 

the texas buckiin  is crafted by  pouring 1 5 ounces of sirdavis american whisky over ice  followed by 0 25 ounces of fresh lemon juice and 0 25 ounces of honey syrup   after a gentle stir to mix the flavors  the cocktail is topped with 4 ounces of ginger beer and garnished with a lemon wedge  designed to complement the excitement of the rodeo  this vibrant cocktail offers a smooth  invigorating taste suited for both seasoned attendees  first time spectators  and fans of the global pop star 

image credit  sirdavis american whisky

title: stealthy sustainable portable chargers
texto:
stealthy sustainable portable chargers sharge unveils its new carbonblade charger  which is a portable design that is defined by its ultra slim structure to fit into the pocket  the dynamic power bank measures only 0 46 inches in thickness  and it also has an impressive battery size of 10 000 mah 

it boasts a lightweight feel and is made with a recycled carbon fiber design to deliver a healthy aesthetic  the battery bank is unique and has an all black design  there are red highlights for a touch of tonal contrast at the power button and usb ports  this also allows it to stand out  and it is complete with usb c and usb a ports for a seamless charging experience with a quick 22 5w power output 

image credit  sharge

title: plant based pulled meat products
texto:
plant based pulled meat products these new chunk pulled products are making their retail debut to offer foodies a way to transform their favorite pulled meat recipes with a plant based twist  the product comes in four flavor options to choose from including teriyaki  bbq sauce  korean bbq and barbacoa sauce  which are each crafted with the brand s plant based protein along with delicious simmer sauces  the products are each high in protein  made with simply ingredients and gmo free  while also being versatile enough for use in a wide range of recipes 

founder and ceo amos golan commented on the new chunk pulled products saying   these new chunk pulled products with simmer sauces deliver convenience without compromise  we re bringing bold flavors made with high quality ingredients to home kitchens no prep required  just sauté  add sauce  simmer  and enjoy

title: contemporary athleisure brands
texto:
contemporary athleisure brands los angeles based fashion label staud has unveiled staud sport  its first dedicated activewear collection  building on past collaborations with brands like new balance and keds  the line merges functionality with staud s signature style 

key pieces include convertible anoraks  lightweight nylon jackets  packable ballet flats  and versatile mini dresses and skirts designed for movement and comfort  the collection also features accessories such as oversized scrunchies that double as mini bags  reinforcing staud s practicality and fashion forward design blend  the staud sport collection is available online and in staud s retail locations 

 we ve created a collection that delivers on comfort and performance without compromising style  these aren t just clothes for sport   they re clothes for life  because we believe life is sport   said sarah  staud  staudinger  ceo and creative director of the brand 

image credit  staud  hypebae  staud clothing

title: minimal aesthetic power bricks
texto:
minimal aesthetic power bricks avolt introduces its latest device  the avolt square 1 power solution  it is defined by a scandinavian design backed by function  in the middle of the square 1  it has a vube detailed with power outlets on each side  which features three standard us power outputs and two usb c ports 

it supports power delivery that goes up to 30 watts  so it can power various devices at once  it also has a 5 9 foot long flexible cable  which allows users to plug it into a power outlet nearby without too many restrictions  visually  it has a minimal look  and it comes in seven contemporary colors  these include  stockholm black  gotland grey  shark blue  new pink  oak green  nomad sand  and opal white  

image credit  avolt

title: revamped flagship menus
texto:
revamped flagship menus perkins american food co  is launching a new flagship restaurant in orlando  florida  this follows the brand s recent rebranding back in 06   2024  transforming its offerings through a new name  restaurant design  and logos  additionally  it offers a revamped menu curated by mindy armstrong  vice president of menu innovation  a new beverage menu  and more exciting updates 

menu highlights include omelets  eggs benedicts and toasts  build your own breakfast options  and more  beverages span frozen margaritas and mojitos to irish coffee freezes and boba chillers  the perkins american brand has plans to focus on a broader expansion in the coming months  catering to a new consumer demographic while inviting existing customers back to experience its new menu offerings 

image credit  perkins american food co

title: savory parmesan encrusted pizzas
texto:
savory parmesan encrusted pizzas the domino s parmesan stuffed crust pizza is being offered by the brand as a crust option for customers to order that will elevate the taste and texture of the pizza for a new kind of flavor experience  the crust option sees the buttery dough filled with 100  real mozzarella cheese in the crust to give it a chewy  cheesy profile before being finished with a dusting of garlic seasoning along with parmesan cheese  the crust thus puts several textures in the spotlight alongside different flavors that will work well with a variety of topping choices 

the domino s parmesan stuffed crust pizza is making its debut alongside the domino s parmesan stuffed crust giveaway that will reward customers to submit their receipts from another pizza brand with a free pizza 

image credit  domino s

title: game inspired aquarium events
texto:
game inspired aquarium events sea life centers across australia and new zealand are bringing animal crossing  new horizons to life through an interactive marine experience  the partnership between nintendo and merlin entertainments allows visitors to explore marine life alongside beloved game characters in an immersive and adorably themed setting 

guests will embark on a guided journey through sea life islands  meeting characters like aurora and octavian while discovering diverse sea creatures  activities include a fossil dig showcasing prehistoric marine ancestors and a search for gulliver  who has washed ashore  visitors can also collect character stamps  learn fun facts about marine life  and meet tom nook and isabelle 

the experience wraps up with exclusive animal crossing  new horizons merchandise available at the aquarium store  sea life locations across kelly tarlton s  auckland  sunshine coast  melbourne and sydney will offer this unique experience for a limited time 

image credit  sea life

title: low sugar functional drinks
texto:
low sugar functional drinks pulmuone green juice is redefining health conscious refreshment with an expanded range of low sugar functional drinks  building on the success of its sugar management beverage   dangisam x2   the brand is doubling on demand for better for you beverages supporting blood sugar balance and overall wellness 

with consumers increasingly prioritizing nutrition without compromising on taste  pulmuone green juice offers an innovative dual format approach    combining probiotic infused liquids with functional tablets  each sip delivers a powerful blend of corosolic acid from banaba leaf  fiber  and lactobacillus plantarum pm008  a probiotic strain derived from kimchi  helping to stabilize blood sugar and promote gut health 

having sold over 350 000 bottles of dangisam x2 in just four months  pulmuone green juice is now working on new low sugar beverage options to meet evolving consumer preferences  expect more delicious  functional drinks that align with modern wellness trends  proving that nutrition and convenience can go hand in hand 

image credit  pulmuone green juice

title: opulent custom finish suvs
texto:
opulent custom finish suvs bentley has introduced the bentayga atelier edition  a limited edition luxury suv showcasing mulliner s bespoke craftsmanship  available for the bentayga v8  hybrid  and extended wheelbase  ewb  models  this exclusive variant features handpicked exterior and interior finishes 

the atelier edition revives five classic mulliner colors light onyx  rubino  porcelain  quartzite  and light emerald while introducing a new obsidian crystal paint  exterior enhancements include a vertical vane chrome grille  22 inch ten spoke wheels  and atelier edition specific wing vents  adding an opulent touch to the new vehicle model 

inside  bentley equips the model with premium mulliner features  such as self leveling wheel badges  a jewel fuel cap  mood lighting  bentley diamond illumination  and the five seat comfort specification  the v8 version also benefits from bentley dynamic ride and all wheel steering  further elevating its performance 

image credit  bentley  hypebeast  bentleymotors

title: investment focused esports deals
texto:
investment focused esports deals bookmaker estrelabet has inked a deal with brazilian esports organization vivo keyd stars  securing front of jersey branding on the team s esports kits  the deal also includes investment in the team s infrastructure  content  and training programs that aim to elevate both parties to new heights 

vivo keyd stars competes in league of legends  lta south  which recently finished 7th 8th after losses to leviatan and loud  the organization has also fielded teams in valorant  counter strike 2  honor of kings  and rainbow six siege  making it a key player in brazil s esports scene 

 we are very happy to resume our partnership with estrelabet  a company that has technology and gaming in its dna  this support will be essential to boost the team s performance and further strengthen our connection with the gaming community  which is the true soul of esports   said hugo tristão  ceo of vivo keyd stars 

image credit  vivo keyd stars

title: modern travel nylon bags
texto:
modern travel nylon bags the  gry mattr weekender bag  is a refined travel essential that combines modern style with everyday practicality  constructed from durable nylon  this versatile bag is designed to accommodate weekend escapes  gym sessions  and daily commutes with ease  its sleek silhouette and functional design cater to those who prioritize both efficiency and aesthetics in their travel gear 

engineered for convenience  the gry mattr weekender bag offers a spacious main compartment for clothing and essentials  while a dedicated shoe compartment keeps footwear separate and organized  a front zippered pocket provides quick access to smaller items  and the removable shoulder strap allows for customizable carrying options  additionally  the integrated luggage strap ensures effortless attachment to rolling suitcases  making it a hassle free companion for any journey 

with its sophisticated design and well considered features  the gry mattr weekender bag delivers a balance of practicality and contemporary elegance  making it an indispensable choice for those on the move 

image credit  staples

title: additive free tequila seltzers
texto:
additive free tequila seltzers quality often comes at the cost of affordability  and affordability can mean sacrificing quality  but yacht water is an additive free tequila seltzer line that challenges this trade off by delivering premium ingredients and great taste at a price accessible to all 

yacht water is introducing itself with bold  refreshing varieties like key lime  jalapeño  and sunrise flavors that are simply made with aged reposado tequila  sea salt  key lime juice  and sparkling water  by design  these canned beverages appeal to ingredient conscious consumers by being free from preservatives  artificial agents  and processing agents 

the new venture launched by rapper lil yachty and liquor industry veterans rachel and peter kiley the founders of sneaky spirits centers on honest  great tasting ingredients  and a consumer first approach

title: ai powered creator platforms
texto:
ai powered creator platforms tiktok is set to discontinue its creator marketplace on march 1  replacing it with tiktok one  an ai driven platform designed to streamline brand collaborations  launched in may 2024  tiktok one serves as a central hub for brands to connect with creators  production partners  and performance insights 

beyond influencer matchmaking  the platform introduces symphony  an ai powered assistant capable of generating scripts  translating audio with ai voice dubbing  and creating digital avatars 

this new swap will see the removal of ad campaigns for tiktok creators through the creator marketplace  instead  users will be directed to tiktok one  encouraging them to swap to the new ai driven platform  to prevent content deletion  tiktok advises that existing creators migrate their data to tiktok one 

image credit  tiktok

title: ai powered medspas
