floral pinkish springtime donuts the mister donut sakura mochitto donuts are a new series of menu items from the brand in japan that are arriving to offer consumers with a way to celebrate the impending arrival of cherry blossom season  the donuts include the sakura mochitto kurosu kinako  sakura mochitto salted azuki  sakura mochitto strawberry daifuku style and the sakura mochitto strawberry custard  each of the menu items put a series of familiar textures in mind  but pair them with sweet tasting notes that will call to mind warmer weather and are thus great for hanami season  cherry blossom viewing season  

the mister donut sakura mochitto donuts are making their debut at participating locations in japan starting march 5  2025 but will only be on offer for a short period

title: extra rugged everyday backpack designs
texto:
extra rugged everyday backpack designs the yeti ranchero backpacks a new accessory created by the brand with everyday storage requirements in mind to work well for students  professionals and commuters alike  the backpack is constructed with a three way zipper called the ripzip on the main compartment that enables the largest storage section to be completely opened to maximize access  the pack features a total of 27 liters of storage space and is constructed out of the brand s tuffskin nylon that s water resistant to help resist light rain or moisture 

the yeti ranchero backpack is paired with straps that will more closely hug the body of the wearer to keep it in place when moving  this also enables the pack to be used for impromptu activities like hiking to accommodate active lifestyles

title: industrial aluminum block turntables
texto:
industrial aluminum block turntables the waiting for ideas pp 1 turntable has been created by the paris based creative studio as a minimalist take on the classic media player that s crafted with impressive elegance and performance in mind 

the turntable doesn t feature a tonearm and is crafted with a cubic body that s made out of a solid block of anodized aluminum  the result is an ultra industrial solution that takes 12 weeks to be manufactured  the inverted cartridge design of the unit means the player requires records to be positioned upside down during playback  hill a set of metal doors conceal the components when not in use 

the waiting for ideas pp 1 turntable is priced at  5 800 and can also be paired with a set of 85db 80w speakers that match for an additional  3 200 

image credit  waiting for ideas

title: hawaiian taro snack bars
texto:
hawaiian taro snack bars the aloha taro bar is the brand s third creation as part of its hawaii special edition range that s crafted with taste  texture and community support in mind  the snack bar is made with locally grown ingredients sourced from farms in hawaii  which includes the lehua variety of taro from family farms in hanalei valley  kaua i to give it a naturally sweet  nutty profile with vanilla undertones  the bar is also socially supportive with 10  from every one sold being donated to the kupu nonprofit to help empower hawaiian youth 

ceo brad charron spoke on the aloha taro bar saying   hawai i sets the gold standard for sustainable farming  where local farmers care for the land with future generations in mind  the belief that  if you take care of the land  it will take care of you  is evident in every step of how food is grown here  i ve learned what truly sets the food and ingredients from hawai i apart is not just quality  but the deep connection to place and purpose the origin story  traceability  and respect for crops that have nourished generations  there s so much the food industry can learn from the way hawai i respects and stewards its land and it s time to pay attention  

image credit  aloha

title: nostalgic special edition earbuds
texto:
nostalgic special edition earbuds colorware has introduced the airpods retro  a nostalgic tribute to apple s early computers  designed for the airpods pro 2 and airpods 4  these special edition earbuds feature the iconic beige color of vintage macs  complete with finely machined side grooves reminiscent of classic macintosh vents  the design preserves the familiar airpods shape while incorporating subtle retro themed refinements 

the matte finish case enhances the vintage aesthetic while reducing fingerprints for a balance of style and practicality  a dark variant is also available for those seeking a unique twist on the iconic mac inspired design 

the airpods 4 with anc retro is priced at  239 usd  while the airpods pro 2 retro costs  499 usd  both models are now available for purchase on colorware s website 

image credit  colorware  hypebeast  colorware

title: game inspired market events
texto:
game inspired market events as the valorant masters bangkok playoffs approach  riot games is rolling out immersive  game themed experiences for fans  from february 27 to march 2  attendees can visit the valorant night market and val lobby at emsphere  a free event celebrating the game and its competitive scene 

located at g floor  em market hall  the night market runs daily from 10 am to 10 pm  local time   featuring exclusive valorant inspired attractions and rewards  including the tuk tuk wingman  hongthai v25 limited edition inhaler  and five bearhouse bubble tea flavors  adding to the excitement  attendees can explore a real life night market board and enjoy agent inspired makeovers with hair highlights  tattoos  and more 

 we re giving it our all to bring the valorant community and players an immersive experience like never before  leading up to the adrenaline fueled masters bangkok   siriya kallayasiri  brand manager of valorant thailand  told esports insider 

image credit  riot games

title: functional mushroom powered lattes
texto:
functional mushroom powered lattes the focus organic coffee lattes are a lineup of new offerings from the functional mushroom beverage brand that are crafted with flavor and performance in mind  the product comes in original  mocha and vanilla flavors  which are each crafted with a blend of coconut milk in the recipe along with monk fruit and coconut sugar with just one gram of sugar per serving  the latte mixes are crafted with a blend of medium roast organic arabica coffee along with lion s mane mushroom that work synergistically to offer sustained energy throughout the day along with impressive mental clarity 

the focus organic coffee lattes come in pouch style packaging that can be resealed between uses and come with 15 servings  the products are great for boosting energy  but also providing enhanced mental clarity to help a person focus

title: ai enhanced camera tablets
texto:
ai enhanced camera tablets the oscal pad 100 is a 12 inch tablet designed to cater to various user needs  including work  study  and entertainment  it features an ips display with a resolution of 1200 x 2000 pixels  providing clear and vibrant visuals  the tablet is powered by an octa core unisoc t615 processor  ensuring smooth performance for multitasking and running applications  it comes with 8gb of ram and 256gb of internal storage  which can be expanded up to 2tb using a tf card  the pad 100 runs on android 15 and includes a 9000mah battery with 18w fast charging capabilities  offering extended usage time and quick recharging 

in addition to its hardware specifications  the oscal pad 100 is equipped with ai powered features that enhance user experience  the tablet includes an 8mp front camera and a 16mp rear camera  both integrated with ai algorithms for improved photo quality  features such as the ai magic eraser  one tap sky replacement  and ai portrait blur make photo editing more accessible and efficient  the pad 100 also supports dual sim cards and various connectivity options  including wi fi  gps  glonass  and beidou  with its combination of advanced hardware and ai capabilities  the oscal pad 100 aims to provide a versatile and user friendly experience for a wide range of applications 

image credit  blackview  oscal

title: youth focused mentorship programs
texto:
youth focused mentorship programs career accelerator is a new service that aims to provide younger students with the skills to advance their careers  the company offers lgbt  business mentoring programs three times a year autumn  09   12     spring  january april   and summer  may 07    designed to help young lgbt  individuals aged 18 to 30 prepare for careers in professional sectors  the program pairs mentees with lgbt  mentors and allies from inclusive companies like linkedin  snapchat  astrazeneca  pearson  and gocardless for personalized  one on one mentorship over three months 

this initiative provides mentees with industry insights  career development strategies  and support for navigating workplace challenges  beyond mentorship  participants gain access to networking opportunities  workshops  and resources tailored to their professional goals  career accelerator fosters a more inclusive workforce by partnering with forward thinking businesses while empowering the next generation of lgbt  professionals to succeed 

image credit  fizkes

title: multitasking hair products
texto:
multitasking hair products the  hold me styling cream  is here to revolutionize your hair routine  offering the perfect balance of hydration  shine  and frizz control in one lightweight formula  whether you re blow drying  smoothing  or defining your style  this all in one product ensures effortless  salon worthy results 

powered by definicire  technology  a 100  natural ingredient  hold me repels water to speed up blow dry time  smooths the cuticle for a polished finish  and prevents friction  keeping your hair looking sleek all day  the formula provides a soft  touchable hold without greasiness  offering heat protection up to 400 f to defend against styling damage 

infused with apricot oil  argan oil  and aloe vera  it nourishes strands while delivering long lasting humidity resistance  plus  the new tropical fragrance blend of mango  nectarine  and peach blossom makes every styling session feel like a mini getaway  now available at designmehair com 

image credit  designme

title: musician friendly chairs
texto:
musician friendly chairs the  throne x  aims to revolutionize how musicians experience rhythm  designed by cooler master  a brand known for high tech gaming gear  this innovative seat takes haptic feedback technology to the stage  transforming beats into a full body experience 

using sound to vibration technology  throne x acts as a haptic metronome  allowing musicians to physically feel the rhythm as they play  whether syncing with a pre set beat or amplifying the groove of live music  this stool ensures players are locked into the rhythm like never before  drummers  bassists  and performers who rely on precision can now connect with their music on a whole new level    literally through their seat 

while some may see it as a luxury  throne x could be the ultimate tool for seamless synchronization for musicians who thrive on tight timing and immersive performance 

image credit  cooler master

title: artist streetwear collabs
texto:
artist streetwear collabs pietro terzini is teaming up again with max co  for the latest  co llaboration collection   here we go again   known for his sharp witted phrases and eye catching word art  terzini injects his signature style into streetwear essentials  turning everyday wardrobe staples into statement pieces 

this collection blends nostalgia  sports culture  and a dose of irony  drawing inspiration from terzini s early love for basketball and hip hop aesthetics  the lineup includes varsity jackets  hoodies  bombers  and flannel shirts  all featuring his signature text based graphics  expect tongue in cheek phrases like  i hope your email won t find me  on pinstriped suits   i ll check and let you know  on plaid overshirts  and  i d rather stay home  on duffel bags each piece offering a humorous take on modern life 

designed with a genderless approach  the collection speaks to the universality of streetwear  launching this 09    it s set to redefine casual fashion with a bold  smart  and effortlessly cool attitude 

image credit  max co

title: fruit soda flavor additions
texto:
fruit soda flavor additions fruit soda flavors are getting a refresh as evolution fresh unveils two new additions to its real fruit soda collection     black cherry cola  and  pineapple dragon fruit   set to debut at natural products expo west  these vibrant  organic sodas bring a better for you twist to classic favorites 

made with real squeezed fruit juice  never from concentrate  these sodas offer traditional soft drinks  bold  nostalgic taste without artificial additives  each can is usda organic certified  non gmo project verified  and gluten free  packing only 5g of prebiotic fiber  no added sugar  and 45 calories or less 

as consumers look for healthier soda alternatives  evolution fresh continues to innovate with real ingredients and unexpected flavor combinations  black cherry cola delivers a rich  deep cherry essence  while pineapple dragon fruit blends tropical sweetness with an exotic edge 

image credit  evolution fresh

title: star approved bag campaigns
texto:
star approved bag campaigns louis vuitton x zendaya are celebrating takashi murakami s cherry blossom motif  bringing a fresh  floral wave of y2k nostalgia  set to launch in stores on march 21  just in time for japan s cherry blossom season  this collection reimagines one of the most iconic collaborations in luxury fashion 

captured by inez van lamsweerde and vinoodh matadin  zendaya stars in dreamlike visuals that blend softly lit cityscapes with murakami s signature smiling pink flowers a vibrant nod to both spring and the early 2000s archive revival  this follows the highly anticipated new year s day reedition  which saw pieces snapped up in preorders 

featuring over 40 new designs  including papillon bags  platform sandals  and perfume cases  this drop proves murakami s playful aesthetic is timeless   the collaboration has remained relevant thanks to the hip hop artists and fans who kept its spirit alive   said murakami 

image credit  inez and vinoodh courtesy of louis vuitton

title: flavor forward alcohol free beers
texto:
flavor forward alcohol free beers the madrí excepcional zero 0 0  beer has been created by the brand with the low and no alcohol market in mind that will offer consumers with a new option to try out this springtime  the beer was created in partnership with the la sagra brewery in spain and is crafted with the brand s original recipe  which has had the alcohol removed thanks to cutting edge technology  the beer is making its way to waitrose in the uk starting in arch and will come in four packs of 330ml bottles 

marketing controller sophie mitchell spoke on the madrí excepcional zero 0 0  beer saying   consumers increasingly expect to see a no  and low alcohol version of their favourite beers  with madrí excepcional fast becoming the flagship brand of the world beer category  launching 0 0  is a natural evolution for us

title: college basketball celebrating burgers
texto:
college basketball celebrating burgers the red robin buzzer beater bacon cheeseburger is headed to the brand s participating locations as an option for diners to try out that pays homage to the excitement surrounding college basketball 

the burger features three beef patties topped with four strips of hardwood smoked bacon along with six slices of american cheese  the burger is rounded out with red s secret tavern sauce and served on a plain toasted bun  the burger is also being served in the two pointer option  which has one less beef patty 

the red robin buzzer beater bacon cheeseburger is being offered starting march 3 but will only be available through april 7  2025 for fans to try out  this is meant to coincide with the college basketball tournament season 

image credit  red robin

title: korean cuisine soccer snacks
texto:
korean cuisine soccer snacks la galaxy and nongshim have announced a new partnership that will see soccer fans able to enjoy some delicious korean cuisine at the next game they catch  the partnership will see the nongnshim station concessions stand open at the home opener for la galaxy  which will offer fans with access to a wide range of menu items  this includes noddle dishes and snacks like the galaxy ramun bowl  cozmos toomba noodle bow  the ramyun burrito and the pitch vegan ramyun bowl 

the la galaxy and nongshim partnership comes as the korea noodle and snack food brand s first establishment inside a professional sports stadium  the brand will also serve as the title sponsor for one of the team s home games in each season

title: removable headlight ebikes
texto:
removable headlight ebikes this electric bike concept design has been created by kyungjin ju as an ultra modern take on the ebike that s intended to make it even more intuitive and realistic for urbanites to incorporate into their lifestyle  the bike is characterized by its stylish  tubular form that is compact  lightweight and agile  and imagined as the perfect option for riders of any age to use as a way to get around town  the bike also features a powerful headlight that can be removed and used in handheld mode when required to accommodate riders making a delivery after dark  navigating the city streets to their home and more 

the electric bike concept design prioritizes a safety focused form that would also offer support in the event of an emergency to provide the rider with greater peace of mind

title: themed pizza dough presses
texto:
themed pizza dough presses the  pizza form  is a piece of equipment for avid pizza enthusiasts to use as a way to transform their ordinary dough into a true work of art  the press features a durable construction that eliminates the need for the chef to manually press the dough out  while a series of shapes will press it perfectly into a fun symbol that looks good enough to eat  the press currently has three shapes to choose from including flower  star and heart  but also comes with the classic circle option to accommodate easy preparation of traditional pizzas 

the  pizza form  is perfect for transforming pizza dough into a fun food that s suited for consumers of all ages and ideal for serving at events

title: collaboration snack inspired slides
texto:
collaboration snack inspired slides ground up and pepsico announced a new partnership that will see the latter brand leveraging the former brand s prowess with creating licensed footwear to offer fans with the perfect option to add into their wardrobe this spring 

the collaboration collection features slides and clogs that put the doritos and mountain dew brands in the spotlight  this is done through themed colors  while also putting their respective logos front and center for fans to show off with pride 

the ground up and pepsico collection is being launched in men s sizes  and comes as the first ever collection featuring mountain dew and doritos  the entire collection will be available for consumers to shop at walmart for fans to pick up for wear this spring and summer 

image credit  ground up

title: beauty brand development courses
texto:
beauty brand development courses the lipstick lesbians aka alexis androulakis and dr  christina basias androulakis have announced the launch of a new beauty product development course to help offer participants the ability to leverage their professional prowess 

the course from the social media influencers  entitled let s learn about beauty  is an educational program that will be complemented by an online platform that will help break down the process of creating a new color cosmetics product  the beauty mastery course is broken down into four modules including lip  cheek  eye and face to help participants get insight into each category for a holistic approach to product development 

alexis androulakis commented on the new course from the lipstick lesbians saying   we re thrilled to launch the first ever beauty product development curriculum that s accessible to everyone  in the past  beauty industry professionals had no options other than trying to learn on the job  picking up whatever knowledge and skills they could on their own  we recognized the need for a holistic program that would leverage christina s expertise in creating innovative digital educational programs and my extensive background in product development

title: e waste portable game systems
texto:
e waste portable game systems this steam deck motherboard case concept has been designed by colliboy as an alternative piece of mobile gaming technology that incorporates a number of unexpected attributes  the unit is crafted with a decidedly industrial exterior case that s made out of e waste to give components that might otherwise be headed to the landfill with a new purpose  the unit is devoid from controls and displays with only the computer and a battery inside with the user needing to utilize ar glasses from xreal or rokid to access its functionality 

the steam deck motherboard case concept is also designed with a large ring in the upper section of one corner that further reinforces its ability to be carried around and even attached to a keychain

title: sparkling sicilian refreshment ranges
texto:
sparkling sicilian refreshment ranges the sanpellegrino ciao  sparkling waters are a new range of flavored water refreshments that pay homage to sicily in a decidedly crisp  flavorful way  the drinks come in four flavors including peach  blood orange  cherry and lime  which are each made with their respective fruit juice  sparkling water and a hint of salt to help the fruit forward flavor shine through  the drinks come in 11 15 ounce cans with zero grams of sugar and 10 calories or less to make them a permissible refreshments consumers will be confident about picking up this springtime 

senior marketing manager sara mayer spoke on the sanpellegrino ciao  sparkling waters saying   for more than 90 years  sanpellegrino has been dedicated to crafting beverages that celebrate tradition and quality  with ciao   we bring the best of italy into one can  ciao  embodies the spirit of italy while celebrating its craft  passion and culture  we hope ciao  brings a little more joy  a little more zest  and a lot more flavor to your everyday moments

title: upcycled private label breads
texto:
upcycled private label breads the odds   ends breads have been announced as a new private label bread range created by upcycled foods  inc  and misfits market as a product lineup that offers consumers sustainable  nutritious options to try out  the bread products are upcycled certified and crafted with regrained supergrain  along with sourdough from puratos to achieve a premium flavor profile  the breads come in two options including honey wheat and multigrain  which are both making their debut exclusively at misfits market where shoppers can pick them up in 24 ounce loaves priced at  4 49 each 

senior director of private label at misfits market morgan drummond spoke on the odds   ends breads saying   introducing upcycled breads under our odds   ends label is a natural evolution of misfits market s commitment to reducing waste across the supply chain delivering high quality  purpose driven products that give consumers a tangible way to make a positive impact  the team at up  inc  was an invaluable partner from day one  working alongside us from formulation to commercialization to bring this product to life  

image credit  upcycled foods  inc

title: mountain ready footwear ranges
texto:
mountain ready footwear ranges this new arc teryx footwear collection has been shown off by the brand as a lineup of outdoor lifestyle shoe styles perfect for supporting the needs of athletes and explorers alike  the shoes come in four models including the norvan ld4  vertex speed  norvan nivalis and konseal  which are each constructed with performance in mind to support wearers who are navigating rugged terrain  the shoes are each intended to accommodate different wearer preferences and needs with the norvan ld4 great for stability  the vertex speed for trail runners  the norvan nivalis for weather resistance and the konseal for the toughest conditions 

the arc teryx footwear collection will make its formal debut in march to coincide with the start of the season and will be priced ranging from  170 to  200 

image credit  arc teryx  hypebeast  arcteryx

title: airy pencil thin smartphones
texto:
airy pencil thin smartphones the tecno spark slim smartphone has been debuted by the tech brand as an airy  ultra slim mobile device that will offer users with a slender handset that s powerful and stylishly compact  the smartphone measures in at 5 75mm in thickness and is powered by an octa core processor alongside a 5 200mah battery pack that will deliver impressive usage times  the smartphone has a 6 78 inch curved oled screen that offers resolution up to 1 5k  while also offering a 144hz refresh rate and a peak brightness of 4 500 nites to offer impressive visibility in most conditions 

the tecno spark slim smartphone will reportedly offer 45w wired charging with additional details on the mobile device expected to be announced at mwc barcelona 2025  which starts next week

title: accessible high performance earbuds
texto:
accessible high performance earbuds the final audio ze3000 sv earbuds have been announced by the brand as a premium audio accessory that puts an elevated experience in the spotlight to work well for value minded listeners alike  the headphones are engineered with the new comfort anc feature that s reported to strike a balance between offering impressive sound quality and sound isolation to work well for everyday listeners  the headphones allow for multipoint connectivity with the option to connect to two devices at once and feature the sony hi res ldac codec in place of the aptx adaptive codec 

the final audio ze3000 sv earbuds are engineered with 10mm f core sv drivers and utilize f link port technology to reportedly optimize the pressure of the acoustic space  while still maintaining a waterproof construction 

image credit  final audio

title: protein packed overnight oat mixes
texto:
protein packed overnight oat mixes bob s red mill overnight protein oats are being added to the brand s product portfolio as a ready to mix breakfast item ideal for consumers to incorporate into their morning routine 

the product is mixed with oats and additional ingredients for flavor that are individually portioned out into packets that only need to be poured into a container before being paired with your choice of dairy or alt milk  the product comes in two flavors including blueberries   cream and vanilla almond  which are each packed with 10 grams of protein per serving with eight grams of sugar or less  the product also doesn t contain added fillers or protein powders 

vice president of marketing daniel barba spoke on the bob s red mill overnight protein oats saying   the introduction of overnight protein oats marries the great taste and high quality that bob s red mill is known for with the convenience modern consumers crave  stemming from the success of protein oats  we ve expanded our protein rich breakfast offerings to create the ultimate shortcut  focusing on new flavors and formats that meet the needs of longtime fans and new customers alike  

image credit  bob s red mill

title: energizing springtime cafe drinks
texto:
energizing springtime cafe drinks the black rock coffee bar bloom power drinks are headed to the brand s participating locations as a series of energizing refreshments perfect for consumers to try out this spring as a way to start the season off on the right foot 

the drink menu consists of three option to choose from including the toffee delight  honey haze shaken espresso and the matcha with lavender cold foam  which are each characterized by their flavorful  energy boosting profile  the toffee delight features a blend of english toffee  caramel and hazelnut latte  while the honey haze shaken espresso incorporates honey into a coffee recipe  finally  the matcha with lavender cold foam takes a floral approach to the classic recipe 

the black rock coffee bar bloom power drinks will be available march 1 and be on offer through april 30  2025

title: ai assistant smart glasses
texto:
ai assistant smart glasses the tecno ai glasses are a new wearable from the brand created with an immersive user experience in mind to help them stay connected in a decidedly discreet way  the eyewear comes in the ai glasses and the ai glasses pro models that are both powered by tecno ai to let users perform voice commands by simply tapping on the temple to start the system listening  users can take advantage of object recognition  while also enjoying information summarization  recommendations and tourist information to support travelers 

the tecno ai glasses are crafted out of aluminum alloy for the frame and are paired with ultra light composite materials to have them look and feel like regular eyewear  the glasses will come in eyebrow frame and aviator style color options

title: midrange performance smartphone models
texto:
midrange performance smartphone models the huawei mate 70 pro premium edition smartphone has been announced by the brand as a mobile device that aims to hit the midrange when it comes to performance to support the needs of everyday users  the smartphone boasts 12gb of ram and puts a 6 9 inch oled screen in the spotlight with a 120hz refresh rate to offer immersive graphics and visual performance  the device has a triple camera lens system that has a 50mp main sensor with an ultra wide 40mp sensor and a 48mp macro telephoto sensor 

the huawei mate 70 pro premium edition smartphone comes in purple  white  green and black color options  which each have a 5 500mah battery with compatibility with 100w wired and 80w wireless charging

title: bite sized gluten free coolkies
texto:
bite sized gluten free coolkies tate s bake shop gluten free mini cookies have been announced by the brand as a smaller version of its signature cookies that are also formulated with a free from recipe to make them a permissible treat for consumers 

the cookies  formally called tiny tate s chocolate chip cookies  are bite sized and come in 5 5 ounce bags that are resealable to accommodate multiple impromptu snacking occasions  the cookies are made with rice flour  while also being nut free and crafted in a dedicated gluten free facility before being third party tested  the cookies are also recognized by the national celiac association to further provide peace of mind for consumers who need to avoid gluten intake 

the tate s bake shop gluten free mini cookies are available now on amazon  will arrive into retailers in march and will be available via the brand s website april 1 

image credit  tate s bake shop

title: kid friendly cooked meat snacks
texto:
kid friendly cooked meat snacks the golden acre foods billy bear snacks are a new range of products created in partnership with the feldhues group that are targeted towards offering kids a delicious and nutritious way to stay fueled 

the product range includes bear shaped chicken snacks that are crafted with chicken along with 30  vegetables in the mix including cauliflower  parsnips and sweet potato  the snacks maintain a free from recipe that has no artificial colors or flavors in the mix  while also being lactose free  gluten free and soy free 

head of marketing rebecca cutter commented on the golden acre foods billy bear snacks saying   billy bear is a nostalgic brand that has been around for nearly 40 years  appealing to children young and old   and their parents  recently  there has been a movement towards convenient  high protein snacks and these new billy bear chicken bites tap into this trend  offering an opportunity to gain penetration among younger families who are looking for healthier snacking choices to offer their children

title: skin friendly retinal serums
texto:
skin friendly retinal serums green people age defy  retinal booster serum is a new product from the organic skincare brand that s formulated with a gentle yet effective function to help consumers combat against fine lines  while also strengthening their skin 

the serum is formulated with 100  natural retinal at a 0 05  concentration that works with hyaluronic acid  aloe vera and a series of additional plant oils to maximize hydration  these ingredients work together to minimize the appearance of fine lines  help with increasing skin elasticity and give skin a dewy appearance 

green people age defy  retinal booster serum has 28 actives in the formulation and is suited for application across the face  neck and décolletage without having to worry about retinol related irritation

title: soccer star hydration drinks
texto:
soccer star hydration drinks the más  by messi  drink is making its way to the uk market to provide athletes and avid fans of lionel messi himself with a new way to stay hydrated 

the drink is formulated with an electrolyte complex to help with hydration  while also featuring vitamins and minerals with no artificial colors  sweeteners or caffeine in the mix  the drink comes in four flavors including miami punch  limon lime league  berry copa crush and orange d or  the products respond to increasing calls for free from performance supporting solutions and are expected to be a hit amongst avid fans of messi 

global chief marketing officer jeremy kanter commented on the más  by messi  drinks saying   with leo  we ve achieved something almost unbelievable  a delicious tasting drink that has just 1g of sugar  10 calories per 500ml bottle  and no artificial sweeteners or colours  better still  its unique blend of electrolytes  vitamins  and minerals absorb rapidly into your body  keeping you well hydrated so you can show up at your best all throughout the day  put simply  we ve reinvented the idea of daily hydration  we call it positive hydration

title: marine algae supplement ranges
texto:
marine algae supplement ranges o3omega  smoothies have been created by anthropologist and brain health advocate sara fenn as a new range of brain nourishing drinks that prioritize nutrition as well as convenience  the smoothies were developed in partnership with virun nutrabiosciences founder philip bromley and feature omega 3 dha sourced from algal oil with mct oil in the mix to support dietary preferences  the products also feature liposomal formulations technology to enhance absorption  while also containing no sugars or sweeteners in the mix 

fenn commented on the o3omega  smoothies saying   most supplements are plain boring or difficult to absorb  we ve created something that s not only beneficial but enjoyable for everyone  easily added to smoothies  yogurt  ice cream  or morning coffee  at o3omega  smoothies  we re passionate about bringing you closer to nature while embracing modern convenience  it s about nourishing our brains  honouring our ancestral health  and finding balance in today s world

title: unlimited pancake restaurant menus
texto:
unlimited pancake restaurant menus the tgi fridays bottomless pancakes menu is making its debut at participating locations in the uk as an option for diners to help them enjoy ample fare in celebration of mardi gras  aka pancake day   the promotion is being run now through march 7  2025 and is priced at  12 per person  which will grant customers access to up to two hours of triple stack pancakes  the promotion offers access to four kinds of pancakes including strawberry delight  caramelised biscuit bliss  oreo crunch and bacon   maple glaze  which can be enjoyed as breakfast  lunch or dinner options 

the tgi fridays bottomless pancakes menu promotion is being run with a two for one cocktail offer and could help to increase patronage as diners seek out ways to indulge without breaking the bank

title: home chef appliance partnerships
texto:
home chef appliance partnerships sharkninja and nathan anthony have announced a new partnership that will see the kitchen appliance brand working with the chef behind bored of lunch to create recipes that each incorporate ninja products into the mix 

the partnership will see four seasonally relevant recipe lists being features on the ninja website  which will link to anthony as a way to help at home chefs along  the partnership will also see anthony using several of ninja s kitchen solutions to create the recipes including the ninja crispi 4 in 1 portable glass air fryer that will arrive in the uk in march 

anthony himself commented on the sharkninja and nathan anthony partnership saying   partnering with ninja felt like a no brainer  i ve been a fan since i can remember  ninja appliances are essential tools in my kitchen  and this collaboration allows me to take my cooking to the next level  i m excited to develop even more delicious and accessible recipes using ninja s innovative technology and share them with my incredible community

title: health rewards games

mysterious cartoon board games the clue  peanuts edition board game is a new take on the classic pastime that s themed with the iconic cartoon franchise in mind to provide players with a decidedly wholesome alternative to the original  the game requires players to try their hand at going around town to find clues to see what has happened to character linus  signature security blanket  the game features a details game board with cards and game tokens to boot that will all call to mind the cartoon strip for fans to immediately recognize 

the clue  peanuts edition board game is priced at  44 99 and celebrates the cartoon s 75th anniversary  the game is suited for up to six players to try their hand at

title: celebratory mountain ready outerwear
texto:
celebratory mountain ready outerwear the north face mountain jacket is being launched in two new options to pay homage to the garment s history and celebrate its 40th anniversary of offering impressive protection in the wilderness  the jacket comes in the dryvent mono 2l fabric options alongside the gore tex version  which are each paired with a 100  recycled polyester lining  the jacket keeps the signature relaxed fit of the original garment and prioritizes a mono material build that will aid future recycling to keep the products end of life in mind 

the north face mountain jacket comes in black  red  white dune and deep nori colors for the dryvent mono 2l version  while the gore tex option comes in black  red and estate blue  the jackets are priced ranging from  250 to  400 

image credit  the north face

title: textured velvet covered clogs
texto:
textured velvet covered clogs the crocs classic clog velvet pack is an upcoming take on the brand s recognizable footwear style that will offer wearers a decidedly textured option to incorporate into their wardrobe  the clogs features the classic silhouette of the original  but see the exterior covered in a velvet material that will give them a touch of softness from both a physical and visual perspective  the clogs have the same perforated upper  soft molded footbed and heel strap as the original  but have a less shiny finish thanks to the velvet material 

the crocs classic clog velvet pack will come in maroon and black color options  which will be available for consumers to pick up for  175 per pair this spring or summer 

image credit  hypebeast  crocs

title: low profile connectivity blocking backpacks
texto:
low profile connectivity blocking backpacks the slnt incognito faraday backpack is a privacy focused accessory engineered and crafted with an array of features that will help the owner to combat against unwanted connectivity  the backpack is crafted in the usa and boasts a subtle design aesthetic that maintains a low profile that doesn t have any logos or branding in the spotlight  the pack features ample area for storage with two compartments that will block out connectivity and signals to provide peace of mind for professionals who need to stay disconnected for security purposes 

the slnt incognito faraday backpack also boasts a series of convenience features like a hanger for keys and a hidden passport compartment to work well as a daily commuter accessory  despite its advanced design

title: off grid exploration camping trailers
texto:
off grid exploration camping trailers the stockman rover 02 all terrain camper is a versatile  durable and compact solution for adventurers seeking out a way to stay agile and comfortable no matter where their journey takes them  the unit is equipped with ample storage space to accommodate all essential equipment  while also featuring a flip up fiberglass door that  will do double duty as a shade and a shelter  the kitchen area includes a swing out gas stovetop and a sink  while also featuring a small fridge freezer with a five bottle wine rack  equipment storage space and more 

the stockman rover 02 all terrain camper holds a queen sized bed inside along with a roof mounted air conditioner unit for added comfort in the summer months  the trailer measures in at 18 feet in length and is an australian exclusive

title: protein enriched granolas
texto:
protein enriched granolas kodiak protein packed granola is the brane s latest addition to its product portfolio that s crafted with taste  texture and nutrition in mind to work well for today s consumer  the granola is crafted with a 100  whole grain oat recipe along with coconut oil and is enriched with whey protein isolate along with pea protein to give it 16 grams or more of protein per serving  the granola comes in three flavors including honey oat  cookie butter and chocolate  which are each great on their own  using as a yogurt topper and much more 

ceo valerie oswalt commented on the kodiak protein packed granola saying   this launch is especially exciting for kodiak as we expand into a new category  bringing even more protein packed  whole grain options to our customers  favorite foods  this innovation has been a long time in the making  and we couldn t be prouder of the three delicious flavors we re introducing  made with high quality ingredients  these new offerings provide a convenient way for our consumers to fuel their next adventure delivering both nourishment and great taste in every bite  

image credit  kodiak

title: multifunctional outdoor grill ranges
texto:
multifunctional outdoor grill ranges cuisinart outdoors has announced two new grills that will be hitting retailers in 2025 to offer consumers a multifunctional option to incorporate into their setup for preparing meals al fresco  the units include the 28 inch outdoor griddler   2 in 1 griddle   broiler and the propel  four burner 3 in 1 gas grill  grill  griddle  pizza oven   which are both hitting the market march 1  2025 to position them perfectly ahead of the upcoming grilling season  the grills both put an array of features in the spotlight including a patent pending contour lid and baffle system and more to accommodate preparing breakfasts  lunches or dinners outdoors 

the new grills from propel  four burner 3 in 1 gas grill  grill  griddle  pizza oven  are priced at  499 99 and will be available for hands on exploration at a variety of home shows this spring

title: textural chocolate fruit cups
texto:
textural chocolate fruit cups the milkshake factory molten chocolate cups are a new lineup of treat options arriving at participating locations as a permanent option for customers to pick up as a dessert or snack  the menu item comes in two flavor options including the peanut butter bananas   cream molten chocolate cup and the strawberries   cream molten chocolate cup  which are both characterized by their fresh  sweet and creamy profile  the peanut butter bananas   cream molten chocolate cup features bananas  whipped cream  peanut butter sauce and melted ilk chocolate  while the strawberries   cream molten chocolate cup has strawberries  whipped cream and melted milk chocolate 

founder and ceo dana edwards manatos spoke on the milkshake factory molten chocolate cups saying   our family has been perfecting chocolate recipes for over a century  and we love finding new ways to share that tradition with our guests  the launch of our new molten chocolate cups is a special milestone for us melding our signature chocolate with fresh  vibrant flavors to create something truly memorable  

image credit  instagram   themilkshakefactory

title: high fi wifi connected earbuds
texto:
high fi wifi connected earbuds the xiaomi buds 5 pro earbuds are a new audio accessory from the tech brand engineered with high performance capabilities in mind to help set them apart from the competition  the headphones feature a compact design that offers bluetooth connectivity for everyday listening up to 2 1mbps  but also features wifi that can boost the bitrate up to 4 2mbps when paired with the xiaomi 15 ultra smartphone  the headphones boast dual dacs along with dual amps that power the dual drivers inside with a frequency response between 15hz and 50khz 

the xiaomi buds 5 pro earbuds are rounded out with three microphones to support active noise cancellation  while the battery is rated to support eight hours over a bluetooth connection with wifi connections pushing it up to 10 hours

title: southern cuisine bagel sandwiches
texto:
southern cuisine bagel sandwiches the einstein bros  country bagels   gravy egg sandwich is making its debut at participating locations as a new southern cuisine inspired menu item perfect for customers to try out now  the sandwich starts off with a freshly baked country sausage gourmet bagel that s topped with eggs  a pork sausage patty  bacon  cheddar cheese and country pepper cream cheese  the sandwich offers a wide blend of flavors and textures to make it an indulgent option for fans of southern cuisine to try out during the cold winter months 

the einstein bros  country bagels   gravy egg sandwich is available now  but will only be on offer for a limited time and is priced at around  9 29 when purchased a la carte 

image credit  einstein bros  bagels

title: vibrant superfood fries
texto:
vibrant superfood fries people love sweet potato fries for their crispy texture and natural sweetness  and actual veggies kicks them up a notch with purple sweet potato fries a colorful  flavorful twist that adds fun to any meal for all ages  these are not just sliced up purple sweet potatoes either  these super fries cooked with avocado oil are prepared with a blend of purple sweet potato  cauliflower  and chickpea to provide five grams of protein and four grams of fiber per serving 

as a finalist in the plant party  category  actual veggies  purple sweet potato super fries are up for a 2025 expo west nexty awards  these fries align with other colorful eats from actual veggies  like its purple roots veggie burger  which includes beet as the first ingredient in the patty

title: connected urban commuter ebikes
texto:
connected urban commuter ebikes the aventon level 3 urban commuter electric bike is a transportation solution engineered with the needs of professionals who want to get around down on their own terms  the electric bike is powered by the 500w rear hub drive motor and the 708wh lg 21700 battery that are rated to support up to 70 miles of range at the lowest level  the bike is paired with the aventon control unit  acu  that incorporates 4g connectivity to accommodate remote unlocking  gps tracking and more directly from the accompanying smartphone app 

the aventon level 3 urban commuter electric bike is available now for preorder for  1 899 and is one of several new electric transportation solutions hitting the market that allow for emissions free commuting 

image credit  aventon

title: plant based eggless salads
texto:
plant based eggless salads eating plant based doesn t mean giving up favorite foods  but it can require sacrificing convenience  as alternative versions of products like ready made egg salad aren t always as widely available but crafty counter s wundereggs plant based eggless salad changes that 

crafty counter offers inventive products like hard boiled wundereggs and deviled wundereggs  and the plant based eggless salad serves up another egg alternative  this remix on the classic egg salad is made with fabalish s vegan friendly mayo  nutrient dense almonds and cashews  and a hint of seasonings for a flavorful boost  this side dish is exclusive to safeway and albertsons stores  offering an enticing option for spring picnics  summer barbecues  and beyond 

crafty counter s wundereggs plant based eggless salad is a finalist in the vegan category in the 2025 expo west nexty awards

title: all day running inspired sneakers
texto:
all day running inspired sneakers adidas unveiled  lightblaze   a new addition to its  sportswear  category and the brand s first running inspired sneaker designed for all day wear  engineered for comfort and versatility  lightblaze features lightweight construction and advanced cushioning  making it ideal for consumers with active lifestyles who also take an interest in being fashion forward 

launched in collaboration with tate mcrae  the canadian singer and dancer known for her dynamic movement  lightblaze embodies performance and self expression  drawing inspiration  from the record breaking adizero series  the sneaker integrates a full length lightstrike midsole  offering responsive cushioning for effortless wear throughout the day  

blending function with contemporary style  lightblaze supports wearers through busy routines and schedules  whether navigating daily activities or embracing an on the go lifestyle  this innovative sneaker ensures lightweight comfort and all day support  redefining everyday footwear with performance driven design 

image credit  adidas

title: peachy yuzu forward kombuchas
texto:
peachy yuzu forward kombuchas jarr peach   yuzu kombucha is a new flavor being added to the brand s existing range of effervescent teas that will satisfy increasing consumer demand for indulgent taste experiences that are naturally low in calories 

the drink features a soft kombucha that s paired with the flavors of peach and yuzu  which can be enjoyed as is or served over ice with a slice of lime and a sprig of mint for an extra refreshing beverage  the drink also maintains a vegan friendly formulation that s organic and low in sugar to position it as the perfect alternative to traditional soft drinks 

general manager steve behan commented on the jarr peach   yuzu kombucha saying   peach   yuzu has been a long time in the making and gave us the opportunity to refresh the range of kombucha s  replacing raspberry and updating the recipe to add even more health benefits without losing the distinctive flavour consumers love  the jarr journey has always been driven by a passion to change drinking habits and changing perceptions  we re reimagining what a soft drink can be using ancient traditions adapted for the modern world  it s an exciting journey

title: extra green juice drinks
texto:
extra green juice drinks the original chopshop evergreen juice is being added to the fast casual brand s menu as a refreshment option that s perfect for helping consumers to jumpstart their healthy springtime eating endeavors  the juice is arriving in celebration of juice week    march 3 to 7    and features a blend of celery  kale  romaine lettuce  lime  ginger and parsley to give it an ultra green profile  the juice is packed with nutrients and is positioned as the perfect option for enjoyment during national celery month  march  

ceo jason morgan commented on the original chopshop evergreen juice saying   we look forward to juice week every year  juices are an essential part of our menu  we keep it simple with wholesome  nutrient packed juices made from roots  fruits and veggies  this week is all about rewarding our loyal guests and also providing an opportunity for more guests to discover the many benefits of our juices

title: steakhouse inspired qsr burgers
texto:
steakhouse inspired qsr burgers the burger king steakhouse bacon whopper is a new take on the brand s signature burger that s expected to catch the attention of new and existing fans alike as a foodie focused menu option to try out  the sandwich starts off with a quarter pound flame grilled beef patty topped with swiss cheese  bacon  onions  lettuce  peppercorn aioli and a1 sauce  which all comes served on a toasted sesame seed bun  the sandwich will make its debut at participating locations march 6  2025 and be on offer for a limited time for order a la carte or as part of a combo meal 

the burger king steakhouse bacon whopper responds to increasing calls amongst consumers for everyday indulgence options that deliver a restaurant inspired flavor experience on a shoestring budget 

image credit  burger king

title: genai gameplay ideators
texto:
genai gameplay ideators the journal nature recently published microsoft s latest research introducing what it calls muse  the first world and human action model  wham   that can generate game visuals  controller actions  or both and this generative ai model of a video game can generate minutes of cohesive gameplay from a single second of frames and controller actions 

unlike many ai models that focus on text or image generation  muse was made to understand 3d game environments and respond dynamically to in game actions meaning it opens up a world of possibility for developers  who can now quickly prototype ideas  refine game mechanics  and more 

developed by the microsoft research game intelligence and teachable ai experiences teams in collaboration with xbox games studios  ninja theory  muse is trained on over a billion images and controller actions

title: brown orchid perfumes
texto:
brown orchid perfumes brown flowers by d s    durga is a new perfume that conjures the images of antique glass vials  dried botanicals  and rich aromas steeped in time  brown flowers also paints a clear picture of the type of person who experiments with all manner of dried flowers and herbs  her collection of personally crafted perfumes  and her latest creation  described by the brand as both chic and drab 

the immersive fragrance brand s latest creation opens with a crisp  slightly citrusy brightness from dried cedrat and queen anne s lace  quickly deepening into a rich  floral heart of brown orchid and coffee flower  evoking a warm  velvety elegance  as it settles  the scent transforms into an earthy  musky blend of aged musk  roots  and roasted coffee  leaving a unique yet grounding trail

title: hydrating sun protection cosmetics
texto:
hydrating sun protection cosmetics eucerin advanced hydration face spf 50 is being added to the brand s sun care product lineup as a way to help consumers to incorporate skincare benefits into their everyday routine of staying protected from uv damage 

the product features a lightweight formulation that s easy to apply and formulated with the 5aox shield that includes five antioxidants  the product utilizes hyaluronic acid and humectants in its formulation to deliver all day hydration as it offers protection from uva uvb rays 

marketing director emily kiely commented on the eucerin advanced hydration face spf 50 saying   suncare should be an integral part of your daily skincare routine  not a separate step  our new advanced hydration face spf 50 seamlessly blends the best of both worlds  broad spectrum sun protection with the hydration your skin craves  this fluid formula feels incredibly light on the skin and wears beautifully under makeup  making it perfect for everyday use what s more  it s portable so you can simply grab it and go  and protect your skin every day

title: video game inspired makeup ranges
texto:
video game inspired makeup ranges the pat mcgrath labs x candy crush saga range is a new collaboration lineup of makeup products perfect for avid fans of the namesake video game to pick up as a way to pay homage to the franchise in a decidedly playful manner  the product collection includes lipsticks  nail polishes and glosses that are each inspired by various aspects of the candy themed video game  this includes the mattetrance lipstick  lust gloss and nail polish  which each come in candy crush saga themed packaging that will be instantly recognizable amongst fans 

founder and ceo pat mcgrath herself spoke on the pat mcgrath labs x candy crush saga range saying   beauty should always be an adventure  this collection is all about joy  play  and opulence and now  three lucky individuals will win a truly one of a kind treasure  how divine is that

title: fashion forward shapewear
texto:
fashion forward shapewear iconic underwear brand calvin klein is breaking into new territory with the launch of calvin klein shapewear  fusing the brand s  signature sensuality  with  innovative shaping solutions  

calvin klein shapewear introduces items like bodysuits  leggings  briefs  and dresses in four compression levels  while second skin smoothing is the lightest option  stay put mesh offers medium compression  stay put stretch delivers firmer shaping with flexible microfibers  and secure sculpt rounds out the offerings with extra firm compression  plus targeted support  with shapewear becoming more sought after and offering more than just basic styles meant to be concealed under clothes  calvin klein shapewear also includes fashion forward styles with lace accents and the brand s instantly recognizable logo 

eve hewson is the face of the debut calvin klein shapewear campaign  directed and photographed by charlotte wales

title: spiced plantain chips
texto:
spiced plantain chips zambos with tajín is a new premium plantain chip snack with a bold  flavorful upgrade from the signature taste of the top selling chili lime seasoning in the united states 

by coming together  zambos  a leader in authentic latin snacks  and tajín are treating fans to plantain chips coated in the classic chili lime flavor of tajín clásico seasoning with just the right touch of sea salt  although these plantain chips are boldly flavored enough to be appreciated on their own straight out of the bag  they re also ready for dunking into dips or scooping up salsa 

this fusion of flavors is zesty and an exciting alternative to potato chips and other crispy bites in the category  though just as fitting for anytime snacking experiences

title: superfruit bodycare collections
texto:
superfruit bodycare collections nativa spa introduced its acerola cherry collection as a first of its kind superfruit bodycare innovation in the united states  and it taps into a multi benefit fruit rich in antioxidants 

acerola cherry is beloved in brazil for its skin renewing properties and abundance in vitamin c  and this new bodycare collection harnesses the power of this nutrient dense fruit  nativa spa s acerola cherry collection blends the vitamin c rich superfruit with fermented fruit enzymes and patented 100  pure quinoa oil to deliver next level hydration  a radiant glow  and free radical fighting properties 

the acerola cherry collection features four powerhouse products  a lightweight  fast absorbing renewing body serum  a rich  non greasy renewing body butter  a renewing body scrub formulated with quartz powder and lactic acid  and a renewing body oil

title: regional cuisine cheese ranges
texto:
regional cuisine cheese ranges the pilgrims choice inclusions cheeses are headed to retailers in the uk as a series of regional cuisine inspired cheeses that are packed with flavor and put convenience in the spotlight  the cheeses come in four flavor options including the italian one  the mexican one  the american one and the british one  which have garlic   herb  smoked paprika  hot honey and caramelized onion flavors  respectively  the cheeses come in block  sliced and grated formats to work well for a variety of recipes 

ornua foods uk marketing director nicola blackmore squires spoke on the pilgrims choice inclusions cheeses saying   as a brand we want to ensure that the exciting developments we are making to the pilgrims choice range are ultimately what consumers really want  by tapping into cutting edge food trends  we are focused on addressing unmet usage occasions and driving mealtime inspiration to enable them to live a life full of flavour

title: sour fruit snack products
texto:
sour fruit snack products these new bear fruit snacks are headed to the uk market as a series of sweet treats for children aged six to 10 to provide them with a delicious yet healthful option  the new products come in two varieties including the bear fruit splits in mango   sour berry alongside the strawberry yoyos that call to mind strip style fruit snacks  but with no added sugars in the mix  the products are each suited for being counted as part of a child s five a day intake of fruit thanks to their nutritious recipe and are hitting store shelves starting at  2 85 

marketing director at natural foods uk jo agnew commented on the new bear fruit snacks saying   demand for sour flavours is surging  especially among  grown up  kids  driving growth across the confectionery sector in the uk and beyond  we re excited to bring this trend into the fruit snacking category with bear fruit splits mango   sour berry  giving kids an exciting flavour they can really feel good about eating

title: ripened apple cider libations
texto:
ripened apple cider libations kopparberg sweet vintage apple cider is one of several new offerings from the brand slated to hit store shelves in the spring to help liven up the category with some unexpected flavor experiences  the cider is crafted with the flavor of ripened apples in the mix when they are at their peak of sweetness so give it a different profile when compared to tart alternatives  the cider features a 7  abv that positions it as a boozier option for beer and cider drinkers alike to try out when it starts hitting retails in march 

senior customer marketing manager axel tulip spoke on the kopparberg sweet vintage apple cider saying   our sweet vintage apple cider is all about bringing bold  refreshing flavour with a sweeter twist than other  more dry offerings within the vintage category  at 7  abv  it s the perfect choice for those who love a fuller  sweeter cider without compromising on the unmistakable kopparberg character

title: free from high protein yogurts
texto:
free from high protein yogurts the danone skyr yogurt range is making its debut in the uk as an icelandic style lineup of dairy products that respond to increasing calls amongst consumers for high protein  free from solutions 

the product range starts off with the skyr yogurt that has a thick  creamy and nutritious profile with 12 grams or more of protein along with no added sugar  the skyr drinks are also in the spotlight with their 16 grams of protein per serving formulation that will stay fresh for up to four hours outside of the fridge to maximize convenience  the products are all made with only milk and live cultures to prioritize a free from recipe 

head of category and commercial planning dairy at danone uk   ireland commented on the inspiration for the danone skyr yogurt range saying   we are launching this new range at an exciting moment for the uk market  with growing momentum for natural yogurts  which have seen 51  value increase over the last two years

title: meat free mexican cuisine products
texto:
meat free mexican cuisine products heura tex mex chunks have been debuted by the spain based brand as a plant based meat product perfect for helping consumers to transform their favorite recipes into meat free ones  the product has a high level of protein in the mix along with vitamins b12 and fiber to give it a well rounded profile that will work well as a healthy addition to a wide range of recipes  the product is great for use in fajitas  wraps and more with a flavorful seasoning that will help chefs to incorporate mexican cuisine inspired tastes into their dishes 

ceo and co founder marc coloma commented on the heura tex mex chunks saying   at heura  we continue to push for foods with a greater impact on our health and the planet  so we can enjoy every day  our chunks  which are the best selling product in the category  together with the growing trend of mexican cuisine  have led us to create an alternative that responds to what consumers want  nutrition  sustainability  and a delicious experience  

image credit  heura

title: plant based meat snack sticks
texto:
plant based meat snack sticks the before the butcher the original butcher stick has been launched as a new snack for consumers to enjoy that s crafted with no meat in the mix despite its meaty profile  the snack is crafted with sunflower protein and has no soy  gluten  gmos or cholesterol in the mix and has a pepperoni inspired taste and texture  the snack offers a competitive vegetarian friendly alternative to conventional meat snacks found at convenience stores  grocery retailers and beyond 

founder and president danny o malley commented on the before the butcher the original butcher stick saying   the original butcher stick is a flavorful  plant based alternative to traditional meat snacks  delivering great taste and convenience without compromise  with its bold  satisfying flavor and natural ingredients  it s a standout choice for consumers looking for a nutritious on the go bite  

image credit  before the butcher

title: ai powered asl sites
texto:
ai powered asl sites signs x nvidia introduces an ai powered platform that teaches american sign language  asl  and bridges communication gaps between deaf and hearing communities  created in partnership with the american society for deaf children and creative agency hello monday  signs employs 3d avatars and real time ai feedback to create an interactive learning environment for all 

nvidia trained its ai model on a broad dataset of over 400 000 video clips  covering approximately 1 000 signed words  with the clips validated by fluent asl users and interpreters  learners on signs are assured that they re getting a quality educational experience 

currently  signs focuses on hand movements and finger positions but non manual signals like facial expressions and head movements are useful for adding meaning  and there s potential for them to be incorporated into future updates

title: water activated pet toys
texto:
water activated pet toys countless variations of growing pet toys have been created for kids but luki lab s blossom pets reinvent the experience with a fresh  interactive twist for a new generation 

blossom pets are made to be misted so that their delicate fabric flower petals can reveal vibrant colors  once dry  the experience can be had all over again to keep the flowers looking like their best  brightest  boldest expression  the sensory experience is enhanced with a flower scented butterfly that attaches to the flower stem 

luki lab s award winning blossom pets are ready to collect in the form of sweet characters like rosie the bunny  dewy the dog  and daisy the pig  each of which has a different look and unique personality traits waiting to be discovered

title: travel ready racing toys
texto:
travel ready racing toys luki labs  flat 2 fast card racers toy line a 2025 toy of the year award finalist will be expanding at the upcoming new york toy fair  introducing all new innovations for little speedsters 

created for kids ages five and up  the toy racing car is optimized for travel thanks to its compact  low profile design  the toy cars are made to flatten so that they can be loaded into a launcher and then rocketed out with the press of a button  with transformative designs  and different models to collect  these toy cars offer multiple ways for kids to play 

the expanded toy vehicle line will introduce the new flat 2 fast stunt card racers  the flat 2 fast 2 pack stunt playset  and the new super fast flat 2 fast speed card racers

title: korean style crunchy chicken
texto:
korean style crunchy chicken consumers usually have to choose between saucy or crunchy eating experiences but bibigo is changing the game with sobaba crunchy glazed chicken that delivers the best of both in every bite 

this innovation from the united states  top korean food brand blends three korean words meaning  sauce glazed crunch  and uses a unique process to pre glaze battered white chicken meat with bold  traditionally inspired flavors  as such  bibigo sobaba crunchy glazed chicken is crunchy on the outside and juicy on the inside 

 bibigo s new sobaba crunchy glazed chicken revolutionized the frozen chicken market in south korea  and we feel strongly that it will do the same in the united states   said megan elliott  director of marketing for bibigo   the product is very reminiscent of the food you would find in a korean fried chicken restaurant in seoul

title: twistable refill packaging
texto:
twistable refill packaging driven by the desire to recycle  reduce  and reuse  hyléance beauté developed pure refillable packaging innovations for the beauty industry 

while pure stick is optimized for targeted applications and products such as sun care  deodorants  face care  or makeup  pure roll on enhances the application of formulas with a massage motion 

at paris packaging week  hyléance beauté introduced the newest addition to its pure range of refillable solutions pure twist  ideal for solid formulas  this component introduces a cap  a body  and an interior cap that can be replenished with a stick refill  with this design  plastic waste is significantly reduced  as only the internal ring of the refill component needs to be disposed of when the product is empty  this refillable packaging innovation suits everything from solid moisturizers and swipe on haircare to highlighters and blushes

title: mango flavored fruit cider
texto:
mango flavored fruit cider  kopparberg mango  brings a tropical refresh to a popular uk fruit cider lineup  launching in stores on march 10  2025  this juicy new flavor blends the sweetness of ripe mangoes with kopparberg s signature crisp apple cider  creating the ultimate summer sip just in time for longer days  bbqs  and festival season 

with 3 4  abv  kopparberg mango is light  refreshing  and bursting with fruity goodness  crafted for those who love bold  juicy flavors  available in both 330ml cans and 500ml bottles  this new release brings versatility and convenience  making it the perfect drink for any occasion 

 as the uk s no 1 fruit cider brand  we know what drinkers love   says axel tulip  senior customer marketing manager at kopparberg   mango is a bold  fresh addition  and we can t wait for cider lovers to experience it  

image credit  grocerytrader

title: selfie trampoline pop ups
texto:

for a limited time  the brand invites fans to experience themed rooms  shoot hoops on the court  take selfies on a trampoline  and learn more about the best features of badgal bounce mascara  like its custom engineered hybrid brush for fuller looking lashes from root to tip in fact  the product is said to offer 242  more volume after three coats 

at benefit s club bounce  visitors can pick up bestselling mascara from the brand  as well as basketball inspired merch  guests can also hop on the chance to receive one on one make up advice from benefit experts

title: gut friendly pickles
texto:
gut friendly pickles the pickle party line by edible garden introduces the world s first functional pickle  consumers can t get enough pickles for their bold  tangy flavor but also for their gut friendly probiotics and health benefits 

developed in partnership with hermann pickle company  the pickle party features sustainably sourced  fermented kosher  non gmo pickles  as well as sauerkraut  alongside fan favorite fermented flavors like whole sour with garlic   dill  the pickle lineup includes options like spears with chili flakes  whole chilis  garlic   dill for those who like their briny pickles with a hint of heat  these functional fermented products are packed with probiotics  rich in antioxidants  a source of fiber  and supportive of gut health 

the pickle party is debuting at natural products expo west 2025

title: mix and match scented bracelets
texto:
mix and match scented bracelets concert culture reinvigorated all ages  love of making friendship bracelets and wecool toys created jelly bands as a simpler way for kids to snap  mix  and style endless designs 

scented jelly bands packs come with 200 beads to make up to 12 bracelets  kids can look forward to customizing their own wearables by snapping beads with letters  shapes  and more 

at the upcoming toy fair new york  wecool toys  jelly bands will make its debut  introducing more than just an interactive jewelry making experience for kids   jelly bands are more than just bracelets they re a movement   said jim downey  ceo of paladone   wecool toys   with their fun snap together design and limitless customization  they bring creativity and self expression to the next level

title: targeted anti aging concentrates
texto:
targeted anti aging concentrates leading quebec based skincare brand idc dermo launched the ultime premium expression    which is marketed as a powerful and targeted anti aging concentrate  the advanced formula is designed to address fine lines and wrinkles without the need for injections 

idc dermo s ultime premium expression   combines advanced ingredients like seven grades of hyaluronic acid  peptides  phyto retinol  and plant collagen with the brand s patented regen16 anti aging protocol  the formula aims to deliver both instant and long term results  it targets nine key areas of the face  lips  and neck

title: emotion adjustable ai voices
texto:
emotion adjustable ai voices hume has introduced octave  a new text to speech ai model designed to generate lifelike and emotionally nuanced speech  unlike conventional text to speech systems that merely read words  octave is powered by a large language model  llm  trained on both text and speech  enabling it to understand words in context and adjust tone  rhythm  and cadence accordingly  this allows octave to produce more natural and expressive speech  making it suitable for various applications such as audiobooks  podcasts  video game characters  and video voiceovers  users can also customize the generated voice by providing text instructions to adjust emotions and styles  such as making the voice sound happier  sadder  or more sarcastic 

octave s capabilities extend beyond basic voice generation  as it can interpret character traits and styles from a script alone  adjusting vocal inflections to match implied emotions  for example  a sarcastic remark will be spoken sarcastically  and a panicked sentence will sound urgent  the model also supports multiple languages  including english and spanish  with plans to expand its language capabilities in the future  hume offers access to octave through its website and api  allowing developers to integrate the model into their projects and create realistic  character specific voices for various content types

title: celebratory anniversary exhibitions
texto:
celebratory anniversary exhibitions the k way exhibition at milan s museo della permanente marks the brand s 60th anniversary with a creative twist  transforming its legacy into an interactive experience  far from a traditional retrospective  the exhibit    titled  in y our life    the hidden side of everyday things     spotlights not only k way s iconic windbreaker but also showcases everyday essentials from equally legendary brands like bic pens  moleskine notebooks  borsalino hats  and post it notes 

kicking off alongside k way s fall 2025 fashion show  the exhibition dives into k way s six decade journey while exploring the cultural impact of everyday objects  divided into three sections  it highlights k way s heritage in  happy when it rains   celebrates iconic brands in  everyday icons   and reimagines classic objects through the lens of 13 artists in  in y our life  

rather than launching a capsule collection  k way will offer limited edition collector s items  after milan  the exhibition will travel globally  with stops at photo london  frieze seoul  and art basel paris  this celebration reinforces k way s legacy while opening new doors for future growth 

image credit  k way

title: snacking friendly springtime candies
texto:

the haribo spring mix is launching alongside a series of returning springtime favorites like the haribo goldbears easter filled tube  haribo goldbears easter egg  haribo happy chicks and more  the products are hitting store shelves now for shoppers to pick up ahead of the april holiday

title: extra sporty electric suv models
texto:
extra sporty electric suv models the audi q4 40 e tron is being added to the automotive brand s vehicle lineup as an entry level option that s targeted towards millennial consumers seeking out a sporty  high range transportation option  the vehicle is equipped with a 63kwh battery that will offer up to 256 miles of range per charge and boasts a rear mounted motor that will achieve 150kw of power  this will enable the vehicle to go from zero to 60mp in 8 1 seconds with a top speed of 100mph

title: ketosis accelerating supplement packets
texto:
ketosis accelerating supplement packets the medterra rapid keto dietary supplement is a solution for consumers on the keto diet that will enable them to achieve ketosis faster by harnessing the power of some specific nutrients  the packets are formulated with mcts and dha omega 3s that will help the body to enhance overall energy  support  ketosis and optimize how the body metabolizes fats  the boosters can be consumed on their own or with your choice of beverage and is reported to help the essential nutrients in the formula reach the body s cells far faster

title: floral spring inspired appliances
texto:
floral spring inspired appliances the beautiful by drew barrymore products are being launched in a new color that will help consumers to elevate the style of their kitchen and get ready to welcome the impending arrival of springtime  the walmart exclusive appliances come in the new hydrangea color option  which is fresh and crisp yet neutral enough to blend in with a kitchen s existing decor  the new color comes in the brand s electric gooseneck kettle  perfect grind coffeemaker  stand mixer  toaster with touch activated display  rotating belgian waffle maker and more

title: sustainable easter chocolate packaging
texto:
sustainable easter chocolate packaging happi  a vegan friendly oat milk chocolate brand  is demonstrating its with its latest easter confectionery line  recognizing the environmental impact of traditional easter eggs often packaged with excessive materials the company has reimagined its seasonal offerings to minimize waste without compromising quality or appeal 

instead of traditional egg shaped chocolates  happi is introducing a new range of chocolate bars that require significantly less packaging  the latest collection is available in three flavors plain milk  salted honeycomb  and white raspberry offering eco conscious consumers a guilt free way to enjoy easter treats
