mexican actress supported jewelry campaigns leading contemporary luxury jewelry brand david yurman has named the popular mexican actress and singer eiza gonzález as its latest global ambassador  she joins iris law in the spring 2025 campaign for the exquisite sculpted cable collection 

the sculpted cable campaign is shot at new york s guggenheim museum and draws parallels between the museum s iconic curves and the brand s signature cable design  photographed by tyrone lebon and directed by frank lebon  the visuals portray eiza gonzález as a modern woman shaping her own destiny  this aligns with the collection s theme of self discovery and empowerment 

the sculpted cable line reinterprets david yurman s classic helix motif into a wavelike pattern  the approach maintains the original s dimensional appeal while introducing a fresh perspective 

image credit  david yurman

title: rapper launched tequila brands
texto:
rapper launched tequila brands celebrated grammy winning artist and entrepreneur megan thee stallion has launched her premium tequila brand   chicas divertidas  the new venture boasts two distinct varieties   blanco and reposado 

chicas divertidas is crafted from 100  blue weber agave sourced from the volcanic highlands of jalisco  mexico  and produced at casa centinela  a distillery with over a century of tradition  the tequila s traditional production includes masonry ovens and copper stills  the blanco variant offers a smooth  citrus forward taste with herbal undertones  while the reposado presents a richer blend of caramelized agave and oak  which may appeal to those who enjoy a more complex spirit 

chicas divertidas  aesthetic is equally striking with its vibrant gradient colors and dagger pierced heart emblems  the bottle designs are inspired by the angel s trumpet flower and agave plant 

image credit  chicas divertidas

title: healthcare focused shared decision making tools
texto:
healthcare focused shared decision making tools nonprofit organization fair health has introduced a new shared decision making tool designed to assist older adults and their caregivers in navigating alzheimer s disease care  this initiative is supported by the john a  hartford foundation and aligns with the 4ms framework of age friendly care  emphasizing what matters most to patients  medication management  mental health  and mobility 

the platform provides free access to clinical and cost related information  with the hopes of empowering users to make informed decisions about treatment options  the tool includes details on self care practices  such as maintaining a healthy lifestyle and reviewing medications  as well as drug therapies like cholinesterase inhibitors and monoclonal antibodies  accompanying resources  such as printable checklists and links to caregiver support organizations  further enhance its utility  fair health further enhances alzheimer s disease care by making its tool available in both english and spanish 

image credit  fair health

title: cutting edge skin rejuvenation solutions
texto:
cutting edge skin rejuvenation solutions maypharm co  has unveiled skincolla  a pioneering skin rejuvenation product that stands as the first recombinant human collagen filler on the global market  this innovative treatment integrates demulcent  type i recombinant collagen with hyaluronic acid to offer a dual action approach to enhance skin texture  elasticity  and hydration  by closely replicating the body s natural collagen  skincolla aims to address aging concerns such as wrinkles  sagging  and volume loss  the product is said to deliver both immediate and enduring results 

one of the recombinant human collagen filler s key advantages is its emphasis on patient comfort and convenience  the treatment is minimally invasive  with reduced discomfort and no recovery time required  skincolla s advanced formulation is designed to be highly compatible with the human body  which reduces the likelihood of adverse reactions and ensures a smoother  more natural outcome 

image credit  maypharm co

title: ai driven diagnostic solutions
texto:
ai driven diagnostic solutions light ai inc  is a healthcare technology company specializing in ai driven diagnostic solutions  the brand was recently featured in a beast philanthropy video  which highlighted light ai s collaboration with mrbeast industries to combat strep a in african communities 

strep a is a bacterial infection that can lead to severe complications like rheumatic heart disease if untreated  there has been a significant rise in cases  particularly in regions with limited healthcare access  light ai s ai driven diagnostic solution uses smartphone based ai algorithms to diagnose strep a quickly and accurately  this eliminates the need for traditional lab tests or swabs  the technology has shown a 96 57  accuracy rate in pre fda studies 

the partnership with mrbeast industries aims to distribute light ai s diagnostic tools across africa 

image credit  light ai inc

title: remixed artist designed logos
texto:
remixed artist designed logos timeless  a lifestyle brand rooted in cannabis culture  has partnered with acclaimed artist kevin lyons for its first artist logo remix campaign  the venture is a new iteration of the brand s ongoing artist legacy program 

kevin lyons is known for his iconic monster characters and extensive work with brands like nike  urban outfitters  and diesel  as part of the artist logo remix program  the creative reimagined timeless s logo by infusing it with his playful  cartoon inspired style  the collaboration features a redesigned flip case and battery  incorporating lyons s signature characters and the brand s signature mood colors  the launch is also accompanied by three new cannabis flavors   wet dream  papayahuasca  and black water og 

this initiative reflects timeless s commitment to blending art  culture  and cannabis  it showcases how creativity can elevate everyday products 

image credit  timeless x kevin lyons

title: ultra stylish scent diffusers
texto:
ultra stylish scent diffusers neom wellbeing has unveiled its latest offering   the matcha and mocha wellbeing pods  this release is presented as a limited edition line that promises to elevate both personal spaces and overall wellness 

the matcha and mocha wellbeing pods by neom wellbeing feature beautifully hand blown glass covers in matcha green and mocha tones  these are paired with sustainably sourced wooden bases  the pods are equipped with features like light control  a guided breathing mode  and a larger tank for up to seven hours of continuous scent diffusion using 100  natural essential oil blends 

the elegant and handcrafted design is certainly what makes the matcha and mocha wellbeing pods stand out  a stylish addition to any space  the product works to enhance home aesthetics while delivering a relaxing ambiance in the home 

image credit  neom wellbeing

title: comprehensive suncare collections
texto:
comprehensive suncare collections kopari beauty  a brand known for its comprehensive suncare collections  recently introduced three new spf offerings   the golden sunglaze sheer body mist 50  the sunglaze sheer setting mist 50  and the pure protect mineral stick spf 50 

ideal for summer outings and festival season  this suncare collection spotlights performance and convenience  the golden sunglaze sheer body mist 50  for example  comes in a new shade  higher spf protection  and a juicy guava scent that is bound to delight consumers  the sunglaze sheer setting mist formulation  on the other hand  is enhanced for the face while the pure protect mineral stick spf 50 stands as an all purpose face and body spf that delivers nourishing  hydrating  and soothing properties to one s skin  all three products are lightweight  non aerosol  and non sticky 

image credit  kopari beauty

title: curated high end v day collections
texto:
curated high end v day collections cartier s 2025 valentine s day gift selection presented a curated assortment of luxurious pieces designed to celebrate love in its many forms  showcasing jewelry  watches  accessories  and fragrances  the curated collection highlighted some of the maison s most iconic designs  such as the love pendant  juste un clou ring  and classic diamond pieces 

beyond traditional jewelry  cartier s 2025 valentine s day gift selection spotlighted the label s sophisticated statement items  including sunglasses and cufflinks  for those seeking a personal touch  the luxury jewelry label highlighted that select creations can be customized with initials or handwritten messages 

consumers may find this collection appealing not only for its timeless craftsmanship but also for its ability to capture deep emotional significance  cartier s offerings were shared with an interactive lookbook to enhance the shopping experience  

image credit  cartier

title: untamed nature inspired jewelry designs
texto:
untamed nature inspired jewelry designs boucheron s untamed nature high jewelry collection reimagines the relationship between nature and adornment through 28 innovative pieces  inspired by frédéric boucheron s fascination with the untamed and natural world  the collection draws from humble elements like thistles  flies  and bumblebees 

claire choisne  the creative force behind the collection  offers a modern interpretation of boucheron s vision by blurring the boundaries between the human body and its natural surroundings  each piece in the untamed nature collection is designed to be worn in unconventional ways  allowing nature to  take over  the wearer and create harmonious fusion of art and ecology 

boucheron s untamed nature high jewelry collection not only celebrates the beauty of the natural world but also pushes the boundaries of traditional jewelry design  the capsule is a standout addition to boucheron s histoire de style series 

image credit  boucheron

title: special lunchtime date promotions
texto:
special lunchtime date promotions this valentine s day  panera introduced a nationwide promotion to celebrate the holiday with a special lunchtime date offer  customers were invited to enjoy the new asiago bagel stack sandwiches  which featured panera s signature asiago bagel paired with bold flavors like chicken roma  spicy steak  and zesty tuscan 

as part of the lunch date promotion  customers receive a free second sandwich for their significant other when making a purchase on february 13 and 14  to add a festive touch  panera also unveiled heart shaped cinnamon crunch baegels  which were available for free in limited quantities at select new york city locations on the same dates  these heart shaped bagels were designed to celebrate the holiday and the popularity of panera s most beloved bagel flavor 

by blending a practical deal with a creative  holiday themed treat  panera successfully created an engaging and memorable experience for its customers 

image credit  panera

title: canadian seafood delivery services
texto:
canadian seafood delivery services larry s catch is a canadian seafood delivery service that aims to revolutionize how ontarians access and enjoy sustainable  locally sourced seafood  founded by glen creaser  james quinn  and javier mejorada  the company was inspired by glen s upbringing in nova scotia  where his father provided fresh seafood for family meals  after moving to ontario  glen noticed a lack of high quality and locally sourced fish  this prompted him to create a service that connects consumers with msc certified family fisheries across canada s atlantic  pacific  and arctic coasts 

larry s catch offers individually quick frozen seafood that emphasizes freshness and flavors  customers can choose from pre curated subscription boxes  build their own custom orders  or opt for special packages like the date night box  which includes lobster and scallops for a romantic meal  the canadian seafood delivery service emphasizes convenience  sustainability  and support for rural fishing communities 

image credit  larry s catch

title: footwear branded heart health initiatives
texto:
footwear branded heart health initiatives chinese laundry has launched the wear your heart campaign in collaboration with the american heart association   the initiative aims to raise awareness and funds for women s heart health during american heart month  the project highlights the stories of three inspiring women   toshawa andrews  zuleyma santos  and kelsey muir   who have overcome significant heart health challenges 

central to the wear your heart campaign is chinese laundry s limited edition heartful heel  a stylish shoe featuring a heart motif  the silhouette is available in red and rhinestone designs  for every purchase of this footwear model  30  of proceeds will support the american heart association s life is why campaign   with a guaranteed minimum donation of  40 000  additionally  customers can contribute to the cause through an in cart donation feature on chinese laundry s website 

image credit  chinese laundry

title: luxury valentine s day campaigns
texto:
luxury valentine s day campaigns gucci s together valentine s day campaign offers a heartfelt celebration of love in its many forms  the initiative captures authentic connections between real families  couples  and friends 

directed by acclaimed artist tina barney  who is known for her ability to blend beauty with truth  the together valentine s day campaign portrays intimate  everyday moments that highlight the unique ways people express affection  set in warm  home like environments  the visuals focus on subtle gestures  shared glances  and the quiet comfort of togetherness  alongside the personal emotional narratives  the campaign features a curated selection of valentine s day gifts from gucci s latest collections   from the rosso ancora tinted gucci horsebit 1955 soft handbags and the gg emblem pieces in new colors to accessories like horsebit shoes  flora scarves  fine jewelry  eyewear  and fragrances 

image credit  gucci

title: luxury motorsport collaborations
texto:
luxury motorsport collaborations louis vuitton and formula 1 are attempting to fuse the world of luxury fashion and the excitement of motorsports through a significant 10 year partnership that is set to begin in 2025  this alliance will see louis vuitton deeply integrated into f1 events with prominent trackside branding and a central role in celebratory moments  such as the opening ceremonies and podium presentations  the luxury fashion label will introduce its iconic trophy trunks  adorned with the classic monogram and a unique color scheme for each race  to honor the top three drivers 

the partnership between louis vuitton and formula 1 builds on the high end label s legacy in sports  the first trophy trunk was created in honor of the monaco grand prix 

image credit  louis vuitton and formula 1

title: collaborative superyacht designs
texto:
collaborative superyacht designs kitson yachts has unveiled its latest project   the 88 meter admiral superyacht project spyder  set for delivery in 2027  this design was created in collaboration with renowned studios espen øino international and fm architettura  the custom built yacht emphasizes personalized luxury by offering expansive spaces for entertainment and relaxation tailored to the owner s exact preferences 

the admiral superyacht project spyder features a steel hull and aluminum superstructure  its advanced diesel electric propulsion system  powered by electric azipods  ensures reduced emissions and fuel consumption  the exterior layout seamlessly integrates indoor and outdoor living areas  including a 10 3 meter swimming pool  a 100 square meter beach club with expandable terraces  and a versatile bow area that can transform into a sports court or helipad  inside  the yacht accommodates up to 18 guests across nine staterooms  with a master suite on the bridge deck offering panoramic views and unmatched privacy 

image credit  kitson yachts

title: it girl inspired fashion lines
texto:
it girl inspired fashion lines veronica beard s spring summer 2025 capsule brings a fresh and dynamic energy to spring fashion  the collection draws its inspiration from the effortlessly iconic style of the it girl 

the spring summer 2025 lineup masterfully blends contrasts as it pairs demure and edgy elements to create looks that are both timeless and contemporary  key pieces in veronica beard s collection include sexy knit halter dresses  sleek pencil skirts  and playful pedal pushers  all complemented by structured boxy jackets and tailored shirts  this styling approach delivers a balanced mix of sophistication and boldness  linen suits  on the other hand  introduce a relaxed yet polished vibe  while mini dresses styled with chunky sneakers and silk gowns paired with flat sandals offer a blend of casual elegance  luxurious black napa and gold full grain leather pieces add a touch of opulence without sacrificing wearability 

image credit  veronica beard

title: low level laser therapy hats
texto:
low level laser therapy hats growell s groundbreaking product   the growell cap   aims to address hair thinning and loss through advanced low level laser therapy  this innovative device combines cutting edge technology with a sleek  modern design  ultimately  the product will capture attention because it stands as a non invasive solution to stimulate hair follicles and promote regrowth 

the growell cap features strategic laser placement and optimized light intensity  its lightweight  ergonomic design makes it comfortable for regular use  while its stylish appearance allows it to blend seamlessly into everyday life  alongside the low level laser therapy cap  growell offers a comprehensive hair care regimen  including shampoo  conditioner  scalp massagers  supplements  and a hair dryer  this enables the brand to address multiple aspects of hair health and potentially enhance the overall user experience 

image credit  growell

title: green tea inspired sunscreens
texto:
green tea inspired sunscreens renowned korean beauty brand tonymoly has introduced an antioxidant rich sun care product that is sure to appeal to individuals seeking functionality in their skincare solutions  the green tea superlight daily defense spf 50 is the brand s sunscreen  the formula is lightweight and non greasy  it features a blend of antioxidant rich green tea extract  hyaluronic acid  niacinamide  panthenol  and vitamin e  these ingredients work together to shield skin from uv rays  blue light  and environmental stressors while providing hydration  soothing inflammation  and improving skin texture and elasticity 

designed for daily use  the green tea superlight daily defense spf 50 is easy to apply and can be seamlessly integrated into any skincare or makeup routine  the inclusion of skincare focused ingredients in the antioxidant rich sun care products is sure to appeal to those looking for hydration and anti aging benefits  in particular 

image credit  tonymoly

title: vibrant interactive digital artworks
texto:
vibrant interactive digital artworks british nigerian artist yinka ilori has partnered with google arts   culture lab to create his first interactive digital artwork    dreaming with flamingos   this project blends ilori s nigerian heritage  storytelling  and vibrant artistic style with cutting edge ai technology to craft a unique  immersive experience 

set in a 3d digital playground inspired by a real life flamingo themed park in barking  london  dreaming with flamingos invites users to play as a young flamingo tasked with restoring a park s lost song  through solving riddles  players unlock a dynamic soundtrack influenced by west african instruments  which is generated using google s musiclm ai model  completing levels rewards users with collectible digital artworks that are created using ai trained on ilori s signature designs 

yinka ilori s interactive digital artwork explores themes of memory  community  and joy through merging ancient folklore with modern innovation to create an accessible and engaging experience for all 

image credit  yinka ilori

title: wellness focused stationery brands
texto:
wellness focused stationery brands pleasenotes is a wellness focused stationery brand that combines functionality with mindfulness through its affirmation gel pens  these pens  which are made available as a three pack  are designed to inspire confidence and positivity with affirmations printed on each barrel  the sets come in four distinct color collections   grounded  focused  inspired  and abundant  each capsule of affirmation gel pens includes unique  uplifting  and powerful messages such as  success is who i am   i deserve the best   and  i am a gift to the world  

pleasenotes  affirmation gel pen promises a smooth and consistent writing experience  the black gel ink ensures crisp lines  while the plastic barrel provides durability  additionally  the brand offers bundle options  including affirmation filled sticky notes and mirror decals to round off the empowering stationary experience 

by combining everyday tools with uplifting messages  pleasenotes offers a simple yet impactful way to infuse positivity into daily life 

image credit  pleasenotes

title: empowering menstrual care solutions
texto:
empowering menstrual care solutions skaly lingerie is a luxury brand that focuses on redefining comfort and inclusivity in intimate apparel  with a particular emphasis on empowering individuals through innovative menstrual care solutions  the label s period panties  for example  are designed to combine functionality with style while offering a sustainable alternative to traditional sanitary products 

skaly lingerie s menstrual care solutions feature trustworthy leak proof technology  multiple absorbent layers  and a seamless construction  due to this  the panties are equipped to provide a discreet and comfortable fit that remains invisible under clothing  made from high quality and durable fabrics  the intimates are also machine washable and designed to maintain their integrity over time 

skaly lingerie emphasizes eco conscious practices  with products certified under the oeko tex standard 100  additionally  three percent of the brand s annual revenue is invested in supporting women s health initiatives 

image credit  skaly lingerie

title: brazilian inspired valentine s chocolates
texto:
brazilian inspired valentine s chocolates mary s brigadeiro sweets is a toronto based chocolatier who specializes in brazilian inspired  handcrafted gourmet chocolates  the brand recently debuted the limited edition brigadeiro chocolate bar from the amor valentine s collection  the decadent product features a 33  milk chocolate base filled with a crunchy red fruit praline  adorned with a chocolate heart shape  the full list of ingredients includes milk  nuts  wheat based crepes  and dried red fruits  with potential allergens such as dairy  soy  eggs  tree nuts  coconut  and wheat due to shared equipment 

each limited edition bar is meticulously crafted by a team led by chef chocolatier nicoleta  packaged in a clear cello wrap  mary s brigadeiro sweets  bar is designed for gifting  while it was a great choice for valentine s day  the universality of chocolate makes it ideal to celebrate any occasion 

image credit  mary s brigadeiro sweets

title: virgin clip in hair extensions
texto:
virgin clip in hair extensions dark shugar offers premium virgin clip in hair extensions that are designed to help individuals achieve a natural look  sourced from single donors  the hair is 100  virgin remy and boasts minimal tangling and shedding 

each dark shugar bundle has a silky texture  beautiful shine  and a soft feel  the brand s premium virgin clip in hair extensions are suitable for various styling options  including dyeing  straightening  and curling  despite these styling stresses  dark shugar maintains that its product will still revert to its natural state 

available in multiple lengths and textures  the extensions are durable and may last up to two years or more with proper care  the brand also provides guidance on the number of bundles needed based on the desired length 

image credit  dark shugar

title: high quality energy drinks
texto:
high quality energy drinks duma energy stands out on the market for providing high quality energy drinks designed to meet the demands of a fast paced lifestyle  the brand emphasizes its commitment to using exceptional  herbal ingredients that are not commonly found in traditional energy drinks  this makes it an attractive option for health conscious individuals looking for cleaner  more functional energy solutions  duma energy s offerings   like the ginger energy drink  for example   combine unique and powerful ingredients like lion s mane extract  ginger  and tropical flavor accents like pineapple and mint to create a refreshing and energizing beverage  the full line up of flavors include ginger  mango  and hibiscus 

with a focus on overcoming daily challenges  duma energy positions its products as a source of vitality and refreshment for those seeking a natural boost 

image credit  duma energy

title: superhero chocolate products
texto:
superhero chocolate products kinder  dc and funko announced a new collaboration that will see fans able to pick up a range of treat products that are inspired by their favorite superhero characters as well as collectible toys alike  the products include the kinder joy limited edition dc funko pop  eggs and the limited edition dc funko pop  kinder chocolate  which each come in a number of options to collect  the products each come with premium kinder chocolate along with a toy  where applicable  or a trading card to reinforce the collectible nature of the various treats 

vp of marketing  kinder snacking shalini stansberry spoke on the kinder  dc and funko collaboration saying   at kinder chocolate  we aim to provide parents with small  but impactful  ways to create a connection with their children  we hope that our exclusive dc funko pop  kinder chocolate bar allows families to bond over their love of dc in exciting new ways  

image credit  ferrero north america

title: plant based springtime gummy candies
texto:
plant based springtime gummy candies the katjes wild   free foam gummies are headed to the market this spring to provide consumers with a plant based candy option that doesn t skimp on taste or texture  the product is crafted with no animal gelatin in the mix and comes in a series of playful shapes that will call to mind the wild west like boots  cowboy hats  cacti  bandanas and more  the candies are plant based with colors derived from plants and algae  while also being free from palm oil and high fructose corn syrup 

the katjes wild   free foam gummies come in orange  peach  raspberry  strawberry  cherry and grape flavor options  and is available now on amazon with retail expansion coming in april

title: athletic family snack products
texto:
athletic family snack products the mccaffrey protein bites have been developed by football player ed mccaffrey and his wife lisa along with their three sons to help bring their passion for performance focused nutrition to the wider market  the product is making its debut online via the brand s website and prioritizes an on the go profile to work well for athletes who are limited on time to stay fueled  the plant based product is non gmo and gluten free  and comes in three flavor options including chocolate chip cookie dough  birthday cake and fudge brownie 

the mccaffrey protein bites are crafted with five grams of protein in each serving and prioritize flavor to work well for consumers who are seeking out a richer  more satisfying snack or dessert option

title: v day breakfast in bed bundles
texto:
v day breakfast in bed bundles this year  valentine s day coincided with a friday  offering an opportunity for couples to extend the celebration into a relaxing weekend and to mark the occasion  contemporary floral company urbanstems collaborated with renowned new york city bagel institution h h bagels to introduce a unique breakfast in bed bundle 

priced at  147  the urbanstems x h h bagels breakfast in bed bundle combined a floral arrangement from the flower shop s valentine s day collection with a dozen bagels  traditional plain cream cheese  and a special valentine s themed cream cheese flavor   chocolate covered strawberry  the bouquet  named risky dm  featured a blend of pink  fuchsia  and cream flowers  while the bagel selection included six plain and six cinnamon raisin varieties 

overall  the partnership highlights innovation and quality  catering to consumers who value both aesthetics and taste in their gift selections 

image credit  urbanstems x h h bagels

title: pro grade multi day smartwatches
texto:
pro grade multi day smartwatches the lava prowatch x smartwatch has been formally unveiled by the brand as a pro grade wearable for users to incorporate into their collection as a way to maximize connectivity and style alike  the smartwatch puts a 1 43 inch amoled screen in the spotlight and is constructed with an aluminum alloy frame that has been treated to a sandblasted  oxidized finish  the watch is paired with gorilla glass 3 for added protection  500 nits of brightness for easy viewing and has support for more than 100 watch faces for customization 

the lava prowatch x smartwatch is rated to offer up to 10 days of use per charge with sleep tracking  vo2 max  heart rate variability monitoring  and manual and automatic spo2 tracking

title: accessible retro futurism timepieces
texto:
accessible retro futurism timepieces the vostra vector chronograph has been debuted by the brand as part of a kickstarter campaign that puts an accessible yet elegant accessory in the spotlight for avid or amateur timepiece fans alike to consider  the watch is constructed with a 40mm brushed 316l stainless steel for rigidity  which keeps the vk63 mecha quartz chronograph movement inside to ensure dependability but also keep costs low  the watch comes in three options each with a differently colored dial including blue  yellow and gray  which are each further accented by hands in contrasting colors for greater fashion intrigue 

the vostra vector chronograph is slated to be priced at  279 when made widely available  but is being offered at early bird prices down to  199 to maximize affordability 

image credit  vostra

title: ultra bright daytime friendly projectors
texto:
ultra bright daytime friendly projectors the benq lh750 projector has bene developed by the brand as a solution for the conference room that will support seamless use during the daylight hours without having to worry about glare or muted graphics 

the projector is equipped with the 4led light source that s rated to pump out up to 5 000 ansi lumens of brightness and can function with the lights on in rooms that can accommodate up to 40 people  the projector also features instant wake and power down functionalities to eliminate the need to wait for warmups 

the benq lh750 projector is rated to provide around 20 000 hours of use in standard mode or up to 30 000 hours in eco mode with the light source  the projector is targeted towards the education and business sectors  and is available now for  1 499 

image credit  benq

title: ergonomic suspended camping tents
texto:
ergonomic suspended camping tents the switra  swisstrail  tree tent is an agile piece of equipment for camping enthusiasts that promises to provide impressive comfort and capability for explorers  the one person tent is characterized by its ergonomic construction that s ready to use after a five minute setup and will prevent discomfort in the morning by prioritizing a flat back design  the weatherproof tent also boasts added features like insect protection and a compact design that can be stored almost anywhere between uses to maximize portability 

the switra  swisstrail  tree tent comes in four camouflage color options including forest  swissalp  sunset and mountain to blend in seamlessly with the surrounding natural landscape  the tent is also rated to resist wind speeds up to 50kmh to make it suited for harsh conditions 

image credit  switra

title: foldable luxury luggage pieces
texto:
foldable luxury luggage pieces the rimowa foldable range is a new lineup of accessories from the luggage brand that are crafted with convenience  quality and style in mind to work well for discerning professionals alike  the product range consists of two styles including the foldable backpack and the foldable gym bag  which are both built with a crease resistant polyester along with a matte black palladium hardware for a stealthy profile  the naturally lightweight and water resistant bags are integrated with zippers that will enable them to collapse into themselves for easier storage between uses 

the rimowa foldable range is ideal for avid travelers thanks to its durable and demure aesthetic that can be packed into existing suitcases or bags for use at leisure

title: vintage sparkling wines
texto:
vintage sparkling wines the grange of prince edward winery has introduced the 2021 vintage of lafontaine du loup brut  this sparkling wine release was developed in collaboration with winemaker jonas newman  the beverage is composed of 70  pinot noir and 30  chardonnay  a composition that results in a refined balance of bright fruit notes  delicate brioche  and subtle almond undertones  the wine s lively mousse and a touch of salinity contribute to its depth and complexity  making it a sophisticated addition to the winery s opinion series 

beyond its craftsmanship  the 2021 vintage lafontaine du loup series is steeped in historical inspiration  it draws from the legend of lafontaine  a northern francophone ontario town united by a shared challenge  the legend centers around a lone wolf that terrorized the town s people and their livestock  to community banded together to banish the wolf and until this day  the animal remains a symbol of unity in the village 

image credit  the grange of prince edward winery

title: tropical avian inspired timepieces
texto:
tropical avian inspired timepieces the seiko alpinist gmt spb493j timepiece has been debuted by the japanese watchmaker as an elegant accessory that takes on an unexpected inspiration  the watch measures in with a 39 5mm case  which is crafted out of stainless steel and accented by hands covered in pvd gold to give it a touch of glimmer  the watch is paired with a textured dial that  in combination with the warmly hued hands  will call to mind the look and texture of the tropical hornbill bird 

the seiko alpinist gmt spb493j timepiece is powered by the seiko 6r54 automatic gmt movement and is priced at  1 650  the watch is only available for customers in asia to pick up  but is limited to 500 examples 

image credit  seiko

title: sophisticated modern residencies
texto:
sophisticated modern residencies this newcastle residence seamlessly balances modern sophistication with timeless charm  at the heart of its design is havwoods  plano herringbone flooring from the venture plank collection  which enhances the home s aesthetic with its intricate pattern and warm  natural tones  the carefully selected blonde colorway contributes to a bright  airy ambiance  this creates a sense of openness while complementing both contemporary and classic design elements throughout the interiors 

the open plan layout of the newcastle residence is accentuated by large windows that flood the home with natural light  a striking kitchen island  paired with wooden breakfast stools  serves as a focal point in the kitchen  the herringbone pattern extends into the hallway while a glass paneled wall enhances the connection between rooms and maximizes light distribution  the high ceilings and carefully curated furnishings contribute to the newcastle residence s atmosphere of understated luxury 

image credit  havwoods

title: complimentary advanced search services
texto:
complimentary advanced search services singtel has introduced a new initiative that makes its perplexity ai s advanced search service free for broadband  tv  and mobile customers  the offer lasts one year and is valued at approximately  197 

perplexity pro is compatible with multiple languages including english  chinese  french  and japanese  it allows users to choose from various ai models such as openai  anthropic  and grok  as well as its own proprietary models built on meta s llama 3 1  this flexibility enables users to customize their search experience to suit their specific needs  singtel s decision follows a notable 20  increase in traffic to ai assistant domains over the past six months  these numbers reflect rising consumer interest in ai driven solutions for everyday tasks  the initiative is also compatible with the growing trend of telecom operators who integrate ai tools into their service offerings

image credit  singtel

title: multifunctional advanced hair tools
texto:
multifunctional advanced hair tools the ya man spa styler  blow dry   scalp massage is a multifunctional hair tool designed to combine efficient drying with scalp care  featuring a custom engineered motor that operates at 103 000 rpm  this device dries hair 30  faster than previous models while maintaining a low temperature of 140ºf to minimize heat damage 

the ya man spa styler  blow dry   scalp massage incorporates red light and infrared therapy to stimulate the scalp and retain hair moisture  alongside ion reset technology to eliminate static and reduce frizz  a standout feature is the scalp lift attachment  which delivers 100 vibrations per second and warm airflow to relax and soften the scalp and promote healthier hair growth  weighing less than a pound  the spa styler is lightweight and easy to handle  with three speed settings and a cool shot button to accommodate various hair types and textures 

image credit  ya man

title: limited edition book inspired beers

title: reusable framework systems
texto:
reusable framework systems  unfold form  is a groundbreaking formwork system designed to minimize material waste in construction  developed by eth zurich phd student lotte scheder bieschin  this reusable system enables the creation of vaulted concrete structures while cutting concrete use by 60  and reinforcement steel by 90   unlike traditional methods that rely on single use styrofoam molds  unfold form uses lightweight  flexible plywood strips connected with textile hinges and staples  making it both sustainable and cost effective 

beyond material efficiency  unfold form is designed for accessibility and ease of use  unlike conventional digital fabrication processes requiring specialized equipment  this system can be assembled with minimal tools  making it ideal for regions with limited resources  by leveraging strength through geometry  the formwork ensures durability while remaining lightweight    each unit weighs just 24kg but can support a ton of concrete 

to date  unfold form has been successfully used in structures at eth zurich and south africa  with plans to bring the system to market  scheder bieschin s innovation has the potential to revolutionize sustainable construction worldwide 

image credit  core77   lotte scheder bieschin

title: wine inspired weekend sweepstakes
texto:
wine inspired weekend sweepstakes wsj wine is marking the departure of dry january and ushering in the era of wet february with a wine inspired weekend sweepstakes  featuring best in class wines and exciting adventures 

the wine inspired weekend experience will bring the winner and a guest to new york city in may  the grand prize includes tickets to wsj wine s exclusive tasting event  a  200 egift card for the brand s online store  round trip airfare  hotel accommodation  and reservations for a hudson river dinner cruise  during the tasting  wsj wine will showcase an impressive array of over 60 wines while the guests will be able to meet  extraordinary winemakers from tuscany  bordeaux  california  and beyond  

to enter wsj wine s sweepstakes  one must sign up for wsj wine s newsletter  follow the brand on instagram  like and tag a friend on its wet feb sweepstakes post  and mail a letter 

image credit  wsj wine

title: affordability focused sports partnerships
texto:
affordability focused sports partnerships usa triathlon and buycycle recognize that affordability of sports equipment is a key barrier to participation for many and in a bid to make cycling more accessible to a greater audience  the two entities are partnering 

born out of a passion for cycling  buycycle is known as  the world s leading marketplace for pre owned bikes  and the company will be usa triathlon s official online bicycle and bicycle component marketplace throughout the 2025 season  ben pickel  usa triathlon senior director of foundation and partnerships  expressed excitement about the collaboration   we are excited to partner with buycycle in 2025 and see  its  marketplace help increase access to the sport of triathlon  by connecting sellers and buyers of quality used bikes and equipment  buycycle is helping to break down barriers and make the sport more accessible for athletes of all levels  

image credit  usa triathlon x buycycle

title: advanced spatial 3d scanners
texto:
advanced spatial 3d scanners 3dmakerpro has introduced its eagle series spatial 3d scanners  a new line of devices that leverage advanced lidar and imaging sensor technology to capture detailed spatial data  these scanners are designed for a wide range of applications  including reverse engineering  digital twinning  asset management  extended reality  precision mapping  and 3d printing  with a scanning range of up to 140 meters and an accuracy of within two centimeters at 10 meters  the eagle series spatial 3d scanners are well suited for projects requiring high precision  the devices also boast a lightweight design at just 1 5 kilograms and a built in battery that supports an hour of continuous operation 

the series includes two models   the standard and the max  the latter option stands out with its four 48 megapixel cameras that enable 8k panoramic photos and enhanced color accuracy  even in difficult lighting conditions  both models integrate seamlessly with raystudio software 

image credit  3dmakerpro

title: family supporting restaurant initiatives
texto:
family supporting restaurant initiatives white spot  a well known restaurant chain in british columbia  has launched a charitable initiative aimed at supporting local families  the business partners with variety   the children s charity for this important philanthropic initiative 

from february 18 to 21  white spot will donate  2 from every burger sold  either in store or take out  to help children and youth in bc with disabilities and complex medical needs  this campaign allows customers to enjoy the restaurant s signature burgers while contributing to a meaningful cause  as the funds raised will provide essential programs  services  and resources for families who rely on variety s support  this year s fundraiser coincides with variety s show of hearts telethon  an event white spot has actively participated in for years  not only through donations but also by providing meals for the event crew 

image credit  white spot

title: elevated pickleball on court experiences
texto:
elevated pickleball on court experiences pickleheads has announced that it will be elevating the pickleball on court experience through newly acquired  2 5 million usd in funding  this highlights the growing popularity of the activity  which has been recognized as  the fastest growing sport for three consecutive years  now with over 36 5 million players in the us  

pickleheads has distinguished itself as the   1 pickleball app on ios and android  with a user growth of 405  year over year  with the funding  pickleheads will elevate the pickleball on court experience through what it calls  structured programming   building on the gold standard of open play  the company is championing  level based formats of play that preserve the magic of open play while ensuring balanced  competitive games   this focus will ensure that all players will have a fun and challenging experience on the court 

image credit  pickleheads

title: on campus quantum computers
texto:
on campus quantum computers leading quantum computing company quantinuum has achieved a significant milestone with the successful installation of its advanced  reimei quantum computer  at riken s wako campus in japan  this collaboration with japan s premier research institution marks the first on site deployment of quantinuum s technology outside the united states 

the reimei system is a trapped ion quantum computer and distinguishes itself through its unique architecture  which physically moves qubits  the device is now fully operational and integrated with riken s renowned fugaku supercomputer to create a hybrid quantum high performance computing platform  this innovative setup is designed to tackle complex computations beyond the reach of traditional supercomputers  opening new possibilities for scientific research in fields such as physics  chemistry  and materials discovery 

named after the japanese word for  dawn   reimei symbolizes the beginning of a new era in quantum computing

image credit  quantinuum

title: football athlete headed footwear campaigns
texto:
football athlete headed footwear campaigns heydude  the casual footwear brand celebrated for its lightweight and stylish designs  is launching a new global campaign titled  unlike anything  with heisman trophy winner and standout college football player travis hunter  known for his exceptional versatility on the field and his distinctive personality off it  this young athlete embodies the campaign s core message of celebrating individuality and self confidence  this partnership marks heydude s first collaboration with an nfl prospect 

 unlike anything  highlights travis hunter s off field interests  such as fishing and gaming while emphasizing how heydude s wally shoe styles provide the comfort and ease he relies on during downtime  the wally stretch sox and wally slipper silhouettes are highlighted  in particular 

in addition to the ad  the  unlike anything  initiative will also include new product launches  social media activations  and marketing efforts designed to deepen connections with the brand s community 

image credit  heydude

title: indulgent seasonal spring menus
texto:
indulgent seasonal spring menus cracker barrel old country store is ushering in the spring season with a refreshed menu that blends indulgent sweets and hearty southern inspired dishes  the new offerings aim to cater to a variety of tastes   from those seeking decadent breakfast options to fans of bold  savory flavors 

highlights from cracker barrel old country store s seasonal menu include the oreo  stuffed cheesecake pancakes  which figures as a creative twist on the brand s popular stuffed pancake lineup  featuring layers of cheesecake filling  oreo  cookie pieces  and chocolate drizzle  for those who prefer savory meals  the louisiana style shrimp skillet and shrimp n  grits bring a taste of creole inspired cuisine to the table  complete with rich  creamy grits and zesty sauces  the menu also introduces a range of signature pancake platters with six distinct toppings and served with eggs and a choice of bacon or sausage  beyond breakfast  cracker barrel is adding shareable items like onion petals with country comeback sauce  dessert lovers can enjoy the strawberry icebox pie  a refreshing blend of creamy filling and fresh strawberries in a graham cracker crust 

image credit  cracker barrel old country store

title: sleep apnea management devices
texto:
sleep apnea management devices wesper is making significant strides in the field of sleep apnea management by combining advanced home sleep testing technology with insights into metabolic health  the company s innovative approach is particularly relevant following the fda s approval of glp 1 receptor agonists for treating sleep apnea 

a recent study conducted by wesper highlights the interplay between obesity  age  and gender in influencing sleep apnea severity  key metrics such as the apnea hypopnea index  ahi  and hypoxic burden  hb  were analyzed  with the latter emerging as a crucial indicator of cardiovascular risks associated with sleep apnea  the study  which included over 1 300 patients  revealed that weight gain and aging significantly exacerbate sleep apnea  with men facing higher risks compared to women 

in response to these findings and in the hopes of improving sleep apnea management  wesper launched a highly accurate home sleep apnea test  the system also tracks advanced metrics like hypoxic burden and provides healthcare providers with detailed data to tailor treatments effectively  its user friendly design and ability to record multi night data further enhance its appeal 

image credit  wesper

title: red brick social housing blocks
texto:
red brick social housing blocks london design firm satish jassal architects has completed the build of the rowan court  which is a range of social housing blocks in seven sister  all of the buildings have a red brick cladding and it aims to retain the existing 1970s estate  the project was commissioned by the haringey council to create 46 apartments  the intervention was to create a diverse housing type at the location to accommodate various needs 

the founder of the studio satish jassal explained the process  stating  the core concept revolves around repairing the frayed edges of the urban fabric  this involves enhancing the public space and developing sustainable and inclusive housing for the community  the most significant gesture is the creation of a new public square and mews street  which transforms a neglected  unsafe area into a gentle  secure  and community oriented space for all residents  both new and existing  

image credit  richard chivers

title: contemporary modernist mexican homes
texto:
contemporary modernist mexican homes as a part of mexico city art week  the house and studio of notable mexcian architect max cetto has been filled with a collection of modern designs  this includes rugs by doshi levien and eny lee parker and lighting by flos  for example  the overall exhibition is curated by the local design team at studio 84 dubbed metamorphosis 

unno gallery also brings in some of its collections to be unveiled at the grounds and interior of casa estudio max cetto  unno gallery noted to dezeen   exploring the theme of metamorphosis  the exhibition invites viewers on a profound journey of transformation   both physical and symbolic  it examines the evolution of forms  ideas  and materials  revealing new perspectives that shape our understanding of existence  

image credit  alejandro ramirez orozco

title: muted tonal breathable sneakers
texto:
muted tonal breathable sneakers saucony introduces its new progrid omni 9 armor sneaker model with three colorway palettes    it joins the iconic progrid omni 9 series  the progrid omni 9 armor was first showcased to the public in 11   of last year with parisian brand starcow  the partnership brought attention to the functional design which caters to an urban and adventure space 

now  it is joining the brand s main collection with premium materials including the kpu molded cage unit and breathable mesh build at the upper  it comes in three colorways  green  grey  and black  the new model is also made with a new design which ensures running performance with rubberized armor overlays  this gives it a sleek look and an elevated on foot stability 

image credit  saucony

title: art deco hotel renovations
texto:
art deco hotel renovations italian designer andrea rosso has taken on the renovation project of updating the interior and restoring historic accents at the pelican hotel in miami  the city of miami beach had given the location a day of commemoration  it was first built in 1948 by henry hohauser and has since become an iconic spot for visitors with its art deco style and special themed rooms 

the pelican has gone through a renovation in 2022 and now  the bar expands with a more modern look  the hotel shared with dezeen   soft tones were carefully chosen to complement the blue sky and natural surroundings  enhancing the airy  coastal ambiance  this redesign balances modern functionality with the timeless elegance of miami beach s architectural heritage  ensuring the pelican remains a seamless part of the city s vibrant landscape  

image credit  pelican hotel

title: ribbon like riverfront parks
texto:
ribbon like riverfront parks british architecture firm heatherwick studio has taken on a design project creating a structure on top of the elevated belvedere park  this is nestled in louisville and is meant to be a powerful and exciting addition to the city  it is currently in the design phase of the process and it will be at the event space overlooking the ohio river 

the executive partner at heatherwick studio  stuart wood shared with dezeen   belvedere has an incredible potential to become a new green  living room  for louisville and its people  our design will stitch together the ohio riverfront and connect it to the expansive parks beyond  we ve been listening to the community and hear a huge appetite for something powerful  exciting and new to happen  

image credit  heatherwick studio

title: black denim adorned sneakers
texto:
black denim adorned sneakers nike introduces a new black label colorway palette which is seen on the nike book 1 sneaker silhouette  the model is limited to only 1 996 pairs and the exclusive edition is a specific nod to the birth year of devin booker  it strays away from the usual vibrant colorways of previous book 1 releases and opts for a much more stealthy hue 

the black label gets an all black sleek look  the upper is made with a premium black denim material finished with frayed white edges for a touch of contrast  this forms a refined yet rugged look with subtle details enhancing the overall design  the black nike swoosh adds a striking branding touch as it is finished with a metallic silver outline to perfectly elevate the monochromatic base 

image credit  nike

title: at home ice cream machines
texto:
at home ice cream machines ninja is introducing a new soft serve and hard scoop ice cream machine that offers a unique feature distinct from its predecessor  the ninja creami  the ninja swirl is a versatile new ice cream maker that builds on the ninja creami with a key upgrade soft serve capability  the process remains simple  mix ingredients  freeze overnight  then churn 

designed for more than just traditional ice cream  the swirl can make frozen yogurt  custard  non dairy options  and even high protein ice cream using protein powder  the device appeals to ice cream lovers looking to save time and money on their favorite snack 

the ninja swirl is available now on ninja s website  with retail store availability coming this spring and a global launch later this year  offering an easy way to create custom  homemade frozen treats 

image credit  ninja

title: firming lower face masks
texto:
firming lower face masks  the uplift mask  is redefining skincare by targeting one of the first areas to show signs of aging the jawline and lower face  created by mantra mask  this advanced sheet mask is designed to firm  tighten  and sculpt with a powerful blend of peptides  antioxidants  and hydrating botanicals 

infused with matrixyl  3000 peptide complex  the mask boosts collagen production  visibly reducing fine lines and restoring skin elasticity  hyaluronic acid and niacinamide deeply hydrate and brighten  while green tea  pomegranate  and centella asiatica extracts protect against environmental stress and promote healing  the unique v line design comfortably hooks onto the ears  lifting and defining facial contours in just 30 minutes 

inspired by korean beauty innovation but made in the usa with vegan  clean ingredients  the uplift mask is the non invasive  at home solution for a sculpted  youthful glow  whether prepping for a big event or adding a boost to a daily routine  this mask is the ultimate confidence enhancer  available now at mantramask com 

image credit  mantra mask

title: premium headwear collections
texto:
premium headwear collections pyper malone is redefining premium headwear with a debut collection that blends heritage craftsmanship  sustainable materials  and timeless design  founded by danna haydar  the brand has been a decade in the making    prioritizing quality  longevity  and american artistry over speed 

each pyper malone hat is meticulously handcrafted in the u s  using the finest materials from around the world  virgin wool is hand scoured in texas  ecuadorian artisans weave premium straw  and custom bands and hardware are sourced from a third generation new york manufacturer  the signature emerald green liner  a hallmark of the brand  adds a touch of sophistication to every piece  with styles available for men  women  and children  these hats are designed to be just as relevant today as they will be decades from now 

the pyper malone collection is available exclusively at pypermalone com  more than just an accessory  these hats embody confidence and refinement 

image credit  pyper malone

title: one on one esports coaching services
texto:
one on one esports coaching services achieveminds coaching  an esports coaching platform founded by former excel esports head of performance fabian broich  is redefining the way players train and develop in the competitive gaming world  more than just a tool for improving in game skills  achieveminds takes a holistic approach to player development 

the platform offers personalized one on one coaching tailored to each player s needs  beyond traditional gameplay strategy  achieveminds provides expert guidance on fitness  sleep  nutrition  and mental health  ensuring that players cultivate sustainable habits for peak performance  the goal is to help gamers excel both inside and outside of the game by providing a structured support system that nurtures long term growth 

 achieveminds coaching is about equipping esports athletes and organisations with the tools to thrive in a competitive and high pressure environment   said broich   we understand the unique demands of esports  and our platform provides seamless access to experts who can make a real difference in performance and well being  together with nordic group ltd  we re building a future where excellence and mental health go hand in hand  

image credit  achieveminds

title: collaborative flower motif footwaer
texto:
collaborative flower motif footwaer cecilie bahnsen continues to grow her partnership with asics as the duo presents the new variation of the gel terrain mt sneaker model  it comes in two colorway palettes  pure silver and midnight  the collaboration is set to launch officially on february 13th and will be available to buy online at cecilie bahnsen 

the pure silver has a quick lace system over the forefoot and midnight is equipped with a zipper fastening  the pure silver palette is designed to have a mid top cut and is made with a glossy and quilted material  the model is finished with floral embroidery to stay aligned with the designer s motif  it is joined by a neoprene sock with floral overlays  midnight has a structured and fluid form with clear tpu layers and floral emblems 

image credit  cecile bahnsen  asics

title: purple tonal performance footwear
texto:
purple tonal performance footwear nike introduces a new tonal iteration of the kobe 9 elite low protro sneaker model with the launch of the moonwalker colorway palette  the colorway is made with a blend of hyper grape  white  and cave purple  set to launch officially on 07   12th  the model is doused in purple and black tones 

in terms of the branding accents  the swoosh motif on the side of the shoe is complete in white for some tonal contrast  the same hue follows at the tongue section    it all rests on top of a black midsole unit  the lacing system over the forefoot secures the foot in place in the same purple hue as the breathable upper 

image credit  nike

title: micro living compact residences
texto:
micro living compact residences havenwood tiny homes introduces a look at the joely  which is a portable home catering to the various needs of micro living  this is perfect for modern families as the joely is constructed on top of a triple axle trailer and comes in the finish of either vinyl or practical steel    both of which are topped by a steel roof 

an additional add on component is the option to build a drop down porch area  which can be folded away when it is not in use  the home also has sliding glass doors  which lead right into the living room    this is a comfortable space with a sofa and tv unit  there is also enough room to accommodate three bedrooms 

image credit  havenwood tiny homes

title: crisp tonal basketball sneakers
texto:
crisp tonal basketball sneakers nike introduces a new tonal variation of the air jordan 3 sneaker model with the lucky shorts colorway palette to join the roster  the palette fuses hues of summit white  hydrogen blue  legend blue  photon dust  sail  and pure platinum across the entire silhouette 

the colorway is set to launch officially on february 22nd and it is inspired by michael jordan s special pair of shorts he wore to practice from college  he wore the shorts under his chicago bulls uniform as a lucky charm and the color is white with unc blue details  there is also a special care tag inspired tag that rests just under the tongue to tie the entire lucky shorts theme altogether 

image credit  nike

title: adorable pebble shaped warmers
texto:
adorable pebble shaped warmers the team at muid has presented the new cellphone hand warmer  which is a playful twist on how modern day people are addicted to their smartphones  even if we are not using smartphones  we always have them nearby as a feeling of comfort 

the handwarmer builds on this notion and creates a product that serves the function of keeping users warm and comfortable with no distractions  it looks like a phone but is not an actual phone  creating the device to look like something familiar  at the front of the design are three preset temperatures and a small display to showcase the selected temperature and confirm that the correct one is selected  it comes in two colors    white or brown 

image credit  muid

title: wood created progressive jackets
texto:
wood created progressive jackets london based brand vollebak is known for its sportswear and adventure apparel and its latest piece with an impressive build is the wooden jacket  just as the namesake suggests  the extraordinary design takes what seems to be an impossible material for clothing and redefines the notion entirely 

to create the wooden jacket  the team turned to a tree extracting wood    this is a natural material with plenty of sources  however  it is not been a wood used in textiles so the result is merely a prototype of a wooden jacket  the images highlight the jacket and it is seen with a hood and two large pockets at the front for more function  there are also crosshatched small blocks of wood at a closer look 

image credit  vollebak

title: introspective charred pine extension
texto:
introspective charred pine extension swedish architecture firm förstberg ling leads the new extension design of the house with a hidden atrium located in denmark  the home is defined by its cluster of volumes which are clad in blackened pine    this conceals a small courtyard at the middle of the residence  the extension has two stories and is designed to add more living spaces to the cabin first built in the 50s 

the studio spoke to dezeen about the project  noting  the old house contains the public rooms  living room and kitchen and it sits on the high point of the plot with panoramic views overlooking the sea  we couldn t really compete with this view  so instead we focused on and worked with the qualities of more private spaces  having the rooms and volumes being more introspective and vertical  

image credit  markus linderoth

title: blocky water purifier concepts
texto:
blocky water purifier concepts a team of designers comprised of yejin shin  cheolsu park  hyunjeong lee work together to dream up the quming delight  this is a uniquely created water purifier concept with a structural build using geometric shapes  what makes the concept stand out is that the sides of the block elements can be replaced by other colored panels 

this opens up more opportunities to customize the purifier and create a sense of expression  the design is clear of any visible controls and the only way to operate the device is through the touch control panel  this panel is at the front and cleverly hidden behind a clear color finish  the lighting for the buttons also have a light white glow 

image credit  yejin shin  cheolsu park  hyunjeong lee

title: fitness earphones campaigns
texto:
fitness earphones campaigns listen to your heart    that s the name and message behind beats  latest campaign  bringing together three of the world s greatest athletes    lebron james  lionel messi  and shohei ohtani    to showcase the passion and determination that drive them to greatness  timed with the launch of  powerbeats pro 2   this campaign is a tribute to the relentless pursuit of excellence 

through powerful visuals and storytelling  the campaign highlights how the heart is the true source of motivation  whether it s lebron dominating the court  messi weaving through defenders  or ohtani crushing home runs  each athlete s journey is fueled by unwavering dedication  their heartbeat becomes a rhythm of resilience  mirroring the drive of athletes at every level 

this campaign isn t just about elite sports  it s about anyone pushing themselves to be better  by tapping into the universal connection between passion and performance  beats delivers a campaign that s as inspiring as it is electrifying 

image credit  beats

title: iconic brand jackets
texto:
iconic brand jackets the jordan brand gore tex collection is redefining outerwear with a striking new jacket that blends history  innovation  and high performance design  featuring the legendary image of michael jordan soaring through the air against a chicago sunset  this waterproof gore tex piece is more than just apparel    it s a tribute to basketball and sneaker culture 

the back of the jacket showcases the jumpman s origin photo  the very image that inspired the now iconic logo  while the front displays the chicago skyline bathed in warm hues  designed to handle the elements  its gore tex construction ensures both durability and breathability  making it perfect for city streets or courtside style 

arriving alongside a matching pair of gore tex pants  this set debuts in spring 2025  coinciding with the 40th anniversary of the air jordan 1    the very shoes jordan wore in the iconic photo  as nike celebrates this milestone with major drops and high profile collaborations  this statement jacket cements the jordan legacy in both sports and streetwear culture 

image credit  nike

title: series inspired luggage collabs
texto:
series inspired luggage collabs the white lotus  a hit series set in luxurious resorts around the world naturally aligned with a luggage brand synonymous with travel  resulting in the limited edition the white lotus x away collection  with the show s highly anticipated third season set to release soon  this collaboration taps into the majesty of a new destination by seamlessly blending storytelling and style 

this luggage collaboration captures the raw natural beauty of thailand  blending raffia inspired accents and luxurious saffiano leather touches with a custom lotus flower print on the inside  ready to support travelers no matter where their adventures take them  the white lotus x away collection reimagines fan favorite styles like the carry on  the trunk  and the mini everywhere bag  for simplified organization and stylish trips from start to finish  there are also coordinated packing cubes

title: pink socialite smartphones
texto:
pink socialite smartphones motorola is teaming up with celebrity socialite paris hilton to launch an exclusive  limited edition razr plus that perfectly blends nostalgia  luxury  and hilton s signature aesthetic  drenched in iconic pink  this special edition foldable phone arrives in customized packaging and includes a baby pink vegan leather case styled like a mini handbag 

for extra flair  motorola has also thrown in a sparkly pink case strap  allowing users to carry their device with hilton worthy glam  notably  this edition also features pre loaded exclusive content  including wallpapers and custom ringtones notifications recorded by paris hilton herself  fans can even enjoy a fresh take on the legendary  hello moto  jingle  reimagined in hilton s signature voice 

with only a limited number available  this collector s item will drop exclusively on motorola s website starting february 13 

image credit  motorola

title: celebrity made wellness drinks
texto:
celebrity made wellness drinks kourtney kardashian barker s wellness brand  lemme  has tapped fitness studio barry s to launch the lemme tone shake  a nutrient packed smoothie priced at  15  available exclusively at barry s fuel bars across the country from this friday through february 28  the shake is designed to complement an active lifestyle with a blend of metabolism boosting and inflammation fighting ingredients 

alll proceeds from smoothie sales in the los angeles area will be donated to the los angeles fire department foundation  supporting recovery efforts following the recent wildfires  kardashian barker will also host a private workout session for close friends and family at barry s studio city location 

crafted with a delectable mix of pure coconut water  plant based protein powder  fresh fruit  ginger  and l carnitine  the lemme tone shake is perfect for today s fitness focused consumer 

image credit  lemme

title: functional oral films
texto:
functional oral films no matter how beneficial  supplements in pill or powder form can be a hassle to take  whereas gummies may be tastier but are usually loaded with fillers and sugar medhugs offers an alternative experience with oral thin films that work faster and are more easily absorbed compared to other formats 

medhugs are available in a wide range of varieties  including strips for blood and bone support  sleep support and energy support  the innovative lineup also includes targeted nutrihugs gut health films that are ready to peel  pick from their package  and place on the tongue to share the benefits of ingredients that prevent bloating  ease digestion  and support insulin sensitivity 

when it comes to daily care  nutrihugs multivitamins offer a sugar free  vegan friendly dose of essentials like iron  folate  magnesium  and vitamins

title: ai powered menopause platforms
texto:
ai powered menopause platforms for too long  women have been left in the dark about perimenopause and menopause natural stages of aging that have been overlooked  misunderstood  and shrouded in silence and roon perimenopause   menopause launched to help women feel more supported and better prepared for change 

roon  the app that partners leading healthcare providers with artificial intelligence to bring reliable health information to individuals  recently launched the roon perimenopause   menopause platform to provide a trustworthy guide for all women  this free resource covers everything from the basics to symptoms and diagnoses  sharing thousands of answers and perspectives from experts in obstetrics and gynecology  internal medicine  reproductive endocrinology  psychology  nutrition  and beyond 

on the platform  users learn about everything from the qualities of candidates for hormone therapy to dietary tips for managing weight gain

title: empowering youth bank accounts
texto:
empowering youth bank accounts gen alpha needs financial literacy to navigate a complex economy and secure their future  and ocbc the singaporean multinational banking and financial services corporation launched ocbc myown account with the next generation in mind 

in singapore  the minimum age to own a bank account is usually 16  but ocbc myown account was created for kids between the ages of seven and 15  parents who are existing ocbc customers benefit from being able to open an ocbc myown account for their children via the ocbc app and let them operate their bank account  with parental controls in place  with the app  gen alpha can make digital payments  scan qr codes at merchants  and use paynow 

young account holders also get their own debit cards  and ocbc myown account kicked off ocbc s five year collaboration with disney  offering up fun designs featuring beloved characters

title: online exploitation education courses
texto:
online exploitation education courses childhelp  in partnership with meta  has launched a free  meta funded curriculum designed to help middle schoolers recognize and respond to online dangers like grooming and sextortion scams  this initiative empowers schools  parents  and organizations with essential tools to keep kids safe in an increasingly digital world 

developed with leading child safety experts    including the national center for missing   exploited children  thorn  and purdue university    the curriculum features lesson plans  interactive activities  and educational videos aimed at equipping kids with the skills to navigate both online and offline risks  by fostering awareness and critical thinking  the program helps young users stay vigilant against online exploitation 

as lawmakers push for stronger child protection laws  meta has been enhancing its safety measures  from making teen accounts more private on instagram to introducing safeguards against sextortion scams  however  education remains a crucial piece of the puzzle  with childhelp s curriculum available at no cost  families and educators now have a powerful resource to help young people recognize online threats and protect themselves 

image credit  illustration by nick barclay   the verge

title: new orleans inspired wings
texto:
new orleans inspired wings popeyes uk unveils the new saucin  lineup  catering to patrons who enjoy saucy over dry wings  spotlighting three flavors  buffalo  bold bbq  and garlic parm  these sauces will arrive at the popeyes franchise as new dipping and coating options for its iconic fried chicken  the launch highlights items like the shatter crunchin  hot wings with popeyes  iconic shatter crunch coating and the new boneless piece 

 creating new flavor offerings is our specialty  which is why we ve also introduced the americana style garlic parm sauce for the first time ever   perfect for those looking to add a punch of bold  new orleans flavor to their shatter crunchin  chicken  

interested parties can find the new saucin  boneless and hot wings range on the popeyes uk app 

image credit  popeyes uk  hypebeast  popeyesuk

title: teen protecting social features
texto:
teen protecting social features instagram has introduced a new safety feature called  teen accounts   which is designed to enhance the protection of teen users in india  as part of this update  the platform will implement additional safeguards within its teen accounts  ensuring a more secure online experience for younger users 

one of the key changes is that users under the age of 16 will now require parental or guardian approval before making certain adjustments to their account settings  this step aims to provide an extra layer of oversight  helping parents stay informed and involved in their child s digital habits  more features include daily usage limits and id verification 

additionally  for teens aged 16 and above  instagram allows parents to enable account supervision  with these updates  instagram reinforces its commitment to creating a safer  more responsible digital environment for young users 

image credit  instagram

title: dessert like seltzers
texto:
dessert like seltzers although it can be difficult to avoid sugar  dairy  or gluten in sweet treats  polar seltzer dessert cart is a limited edition lineup of refreshments that makes it easy to avoid these ingredients and more  the beverage brand beloved for its naturally calorie free  no sugar  no sweetener  no sodium  and no caffeine seltzers dropped this decadently flavored range after  toying with the idea of a sensory  effervescent dessert experience  

in the lineup  the sparkling drinks are ready to sip in refreshingly different varieties like lemon meringue  apple crisp  strawberry rhubarb pie  and cinnamon bun  these small batch seltzer polar seltzer products go above and beyond the usual fruity flavors crafted with citrus  berries  and spices  offering a more indulgent way to sip and savor without compromise
