title: singer songwriter salad creations
texto:
singer songwriter salad creations true food kitchen has launched the  sza cza salad   a new dish created in collaboration with grammy award winning artist sza  this innovative take on the classic kale caesar salad will be featured on the 2025 menu at all 46 true food kitchen locations  the salad is designed to be seed oil free  reflecting the restaurant s commitment to offering nutritious  flavorful meals that cater to health conscious diners 

the partnership emerged after sza expressed interest in bringing back the salad during a seasonal menu update  moreover   proceeds from the sza cza salad will benefit süprmarkt  a los angeles based nonprofit focused on food equity and community support  

the salad includes ingredients such as  organic kale  cherry tomatoes  avocado  scallions  rosemary garlic croutons  shaved parmesan  and caesar dressing  prepared without seed oils  maintaining true food kitchen s focus on healthy and wholesome dining  

image credit  true food kitchen

title: multi benefit hydration serums
texto:
multi benefit hydration serums incorporating a hyaluronic serum into a skincare routine helps with everything from moisture retention and plumping to reducing the appearance of fine lines  and the mutha hydration serum goes above and beyond basic benefits 

this lightweight  oil free formula contains four molecular weights of hyaluronic acid  and it delivers more than hydration thanks to additional ingredients like two types of grape stem cells  black tea ferments  and probiotic ferments  the mutha hydration serum doesn t just contain soothing ingredients that are suitable for those with sensitive skin  it s also scientifically shown to be a gentle  anti inflammatory active with benefits for all skin types 

this supercharged serum makes a potent addition to skincare routines day and night when a boost of skin barrier support is desired  all while enhancing plumpness  softness  and radiance

title: textural modern outdoor furniture
texto:
textural modern outdoor furniture british tom dixon introduces the new groove collection of outdoor furniture which is now launching after over a decade of research and development has been conducted  the elegant range of furniture fuses elements of functionality  durability  and a timeless look  it is great for lounging under the sun or just laying back in the evenings and staring at the stars 

the groove capsule offers users a stylish base to build a captivating outdoor space for any occasion  the first parts of the journey started all the way back in 2012 when tom dixon worked with the german industrial machine manufacturing company trumpf at most  this explored design and engineering  laying down the foundation of the range s most innovative approach to form and materials 

image credit  tim dixon

title: soft colored kitchen appliances
texto:
soft colored kitchen appliances kitchenaid has introduced  butter  as its 2025 color of the year  a soft yellow shade with a creamy satin finish  this selection aims to evoke warmth and familiarity  reflecting the deep connection between color and the experience of home cooked meals 

according to chad ries  global brand marketing director at kitchenaid small appliances  buttery yellow is  widely associated with comfort and homemade meals  which made it a natural choice for the kitchenaid stand mixer  a long standing kitchen essential   as such  the butter color embodies the nostalgic feeling of cooking with loved ones 

furthermore  butter marks the seventh installment in the  kitchenaid color of the year program   a  series that highlights emerging global color trends   since launching its first stand mixer colors in 1955  kitchenaid has continuously emphasized the role of color in inspiring creativity and enhancing the overall kitchen experience 

image credit  kitchenaid

title: research backed swooped work chairs
texto:
research backed swooped work chairs haworth  a global furniture imprint has garnered research to collect about 5 5 billion data points in the space of ergonomic analysis to create the breck chair  the simple furniture has a minimal silhouette with a swooped back curve with comfort provided by the plush cushioned chair  the breck is playful yet intuitive with a range of colorway options to choose from 

it is made with patented technology through geo stretch  a structural component that has a flexible stretch seat back  the international design studio manager at haworth  nicolai czumaj bront notes to design milk   simplification was a big part of this chair and that was an interesting challenge because task chairs are inherently complex  breck components have been thoughtfully combined with performance that is easy to understand  

image credit  haworth

title: streamlining operational tools
texto:
streamlining operational tools yum  brands is redefining the future of restaurant technology with the launch of byte by yum   a cutting edge ai powered software suite designed to streamline operations and elevate customer and employee experiences  this innovative choice consolidates the company s digital solutions under a single  comprehensive tech ecosystem  replacing legacy platforms like poseidon and superapp with a more intuitive  unified system that benefits both consumers and the overall business model 

byte is built to be the digital backbone of modern restaurant operations  offering a seamless  data driven approach to managing key business functions  from online and mobile ordering to point of sale systems  kitchen and delivery optimization  and menu  inventory  and labor management  byte provides end to end automation and insights  new team member tools also enhance workforce efficiency and engagement  ensuring smoother day to day operations 

image credit  yum brands

title: k beauty brand expansions
texto:
k beauty brand expansions the europe born k beauty brand yepoda  is making waves with its upcoming launch into sephora locations across europe this march  known for its clean  natural  and vegan skincare formulas developed in south korea  yepoda is expanding its presence after a successful u s  online debut in 12   2024 and a series of immersive pop up events in europe 

founded in 2020 by veronika strotmann and sander joonyoung van bladel  yepoda bridges the gap between innovative korean beauty and western accessibility  the brand s bestsellers  like the  calm balm cleanser    bubble double foam cleanser   and  dewy day tinted cushion   offer effective and affordable options  building on a stellar 2024  where sales soared by 130   yepoda is doubling down on consumer engagement through retail pop ups and product development influenced by its active social media community 

whether you re exploring k beauty for the first time or are already a fan  yepoda s sephora debut promises to bring a touch of korean skincare brilliance to shelves near you 

image credit  yepoda

title: iconic movie themed cookies
texto:
iconic movie themed cookies keebler has teamed up with warner bros discovery global consumer products to bring the enchantment of the wizarding world to your snack shelf with limited edition  harry potter butterbeer fudge stripes cookies   inspired by the beloved harry potter beverage  these limited edition cookies offer a delightful blend of butterbeer flavored cookie and creamy butterbeer flavored fudge  recreating the iconic mix of cream soda and butterscotch 

adding to the magic  the cookies are adorned with designs and imprints inspired by the harry potter films  making them a visual and flavorful delight for fans of all ages  kim thomas  brand manager for keebler fudge stripes  shared the brand s excitement about this collaboration  emphasizing the cookies  role in creating joyful  magical moments for families  these butterbeer cookies are available nationwide at u s  retailers 

image credit  keebler

title: advanced probiotic serums
texto:
advanced probiotic serums harsh skincare systems used to clear acne can strip the skin of its natural oils  leading to irritation  dryness  and an imbalance that may worsen the condition over time  and phyla s acne phage serum is part of a system that suggests  you don t have to destroy your skin to destroy acne  

the brand s breakthrough serum for acne addresses the root cause of acne a bacteria called c acnes with phages technology  which harnesses the power of a naturally occurring probiotic to eliminate acne causing bacteria  effective for targeting hormonal  cystic  nodular  and teen acne  as well as blackheads and whiteheads  this technology leaves beneficial bacteria intact and supports the microbiome all the while 

this serum with patented acne fighting technology pairs well with the brand s cleanser and moisturizer which also respects the skin s balance

title: water activated facial cleansers
texto:
water activated facial cleansers norwex cleansing facial powder is a cleansing foam that taps into the power of biobased surfactants  nordic antioxidants  and prebiotics and uses a water activated formula to deliver gentle exfoliation and freshness 

unlike some traditional facial cleansers that rely on harsh surfactants and disrupt the skin s natural barrier in the process  this one leaves skin feeling clean and comfortable after washing  this simple  water saving solution for removing everything from stubborn makeup and spf products to dirt  oil  sweat  and environmental pollutants is fueled by ingredients like kaolin clay  upcycled rice bran wax  natural exfoliants  and skin caring organic cloudberry  lingonberry  and sea buckthorn oils  norwex s cleansing facial powder comes in 100  refillable pcr packaging 

the cleansing facial powder recently received ewg verification along with two other best selling norwex products  the renewing eye cream and the hydrating moisturizer

title: ai powered energy management
texto:
ai powered energy management at the international conference on digital transformation and sustainable development  schneider electric took center stage  offering a glimpse into its latest innovations designed to revolutionize energy management  with a sharp focus on sustainability and digital integration  the company introduced a suite of cutting edge solutions tailored to the evolving needs of the ukrainian market 

the lineup includes the ecostruxure energy hub  an advanced platform for real time energy monitoring  and the ai powered grid manager  which leverages artificial intelligence to enhance grid stability and efficiency  for urban development  the green building suite integrates smart automation to reduce carbon footprints  while the smart charging station system supports the growing ev infrastructure  promoting clean mobility 

 we are proud that our solutions presented in the global arena will be available to ukrainian customers in the near future  this will enable the introduction of advanced technologies for energy management and automation  contributing to the sustainable development of the country and improving energy efficiency   said mikhail bubnov 

image credit  schneider electric

title: lab grown pet food
texto:
lab grown pet food dog owners in the uk can now treat their furry friends to an innovative snack with  chick bites   the first ever dog treats made from lab grown chicken  this groundbreaking product  created by meatly in collaboration with british vegan dog food company the pack  offers a sustainable and ethical alternative to traditional meat based pet foods 

crafted using cultivated chicken meat grown from a single egg cell  chick bites deliver all the nutrients dogs need  including essential amino acids  fatty acids  minerals  and vitamins  combining lab grown chicken with plant based ingredients  these treats are as nutritious as they are eco friendly  aiming to reduce the environmental impact of pet food 

currently available in a limited release at a pets at home store in brentford  england  chick bites are a milestone in sustainable pet care  as meatly scales production  it plans to expand availability over the next three to five years  paving the way for a kinder  greener future for pets and the planet  learn more at meatly s official website 

image credit  the pack

title: advanced 3d printers
texto:
advanced 3d printers elegoo has introduced the  centauri carbon   a high performance corexy 3d printer designed for speed  precision  and reliability  with a print volume of 256   256   256 mm  it offers professional quality printing in a user friendly design 

its fully enclosed structure and rounded corners make it safer  especially for homes with children and pets  the assembly free setup allows for quick use  while a built in air filter helps reduce harmful emissions  dual glass panels and a side mounted filament holder improve access and visibility 

built with a strong die cast frame and reinforced aluminum pillars  it stays stable for accurate prints  hardened nozzles handle carbon fiber and tough materials  running on  elegoo os  the printer includes wi fi control  real time monitoring  led lighting  and a touchscreen while advanced print adjustments ensure smooth and high quality results  

image credit  elegoo

title: ai photography robots
texto:
ai photography robots high quality photos are crucial for businesses to make a strong impression and attract customers  but for small businesses with limited resources  capturing professional looking images can be a significant challenge and gency pb offers a solution 

gency pb  a ces 2025 innovation awards honoree in robotics  is an ai powered photo robot that automates more than 90  of the commercial photography process  with the aid of this ai photography robot  small businesses can skirt high labor costs and repetitive tasks since this gency pb can capture hundreds of professional quality photos fast 

the self driving bot analyzes subjects precisely  adjusts settings with a robotic arm  and gency pb can even handle photo editing to support seamless content creation

title: renovated classic home designs
texto:
renovated classic home designs a special collaboration is born in the form of the wedge wood  project between best practice architecture and ainslie davis  the two have taken on a renovation project of a home first built in the 70s  it is revived to cater to the needs of modern living  the family owned contracting studio creates a close and sentimental connection to the property 

the house is originally created by the late uncle of ainslie davis team  the project is affectionately named and embraces a calm balance of transformation and preservation all at once  the redesign starts from the heart of the home  which is the kitchen  it was previously outdated and closed so the space opens up to form a close connection to the dining area  

image credit  best practice architecture  ainslie davis

title: ergonomic pet snack bowls
texto:
ergonomic pet snack bowls the team at trot pets has presented the new snack bowl to join its elevated complete set  the brand offers a range of pet bowls in 12 modern color options  it comes with a water bowl  a no mess silicone mat  a puzzle slow feeder  two no leak bowl lids  and a special elevated stand  these bowls vary in three size options  so there is one that is suitable for all pets 

additionally  there are three elevation heights to accommodate pets in an ergonomically friendly manner  the lids are great for when pets are on the go or if there are any dietary restrictions that need to be followed  the puzzle feeder slows down those who are fast eaters and better digest the amounts of food 

image credit  trot pets

title: playful cubic fragrances
texto:
playful cubic fragrances joining fan favorite billie eilish fragrances like the original self titled scent and an iteration that amps up cherry notes is a new launch  your turn  with a woody  fresh essence and an iconic bottle design 

while eilish  eilish no  2  and the limited edition eilish no  3 are packaged in the shape of a bust resembling billie herself  the your turn eau de parfum is a departure from this with a bottle that resembles a pair of die stacked atop one another 

scent wise  your turn gets its modern  sensual qualities from opening notes of bergamot peel  cardamom pod  and fresh ginger that lead into soft peach skin  night blooming jasmine  and coconut water  these uplifting and refreshing notes are grounded by a rich base of australian sandalwood  musks  and sustainably sourced  upcycled sylvamber

title: ai powered airport restaurants
texto:
ai powered airport restaurants barcelona airport  bcn  is working with areas to create the self restaurant  a new airport food destination that is fully automated for convenience  self features an assortment of airport food and drinks that can be purchased through a touchscreen system and prepared by an advanced robotic arm that can cook six orders at once 

the robot was trained to use machine vision  enhancing the decision making capabilities of the system  it is energy efficient and uses fsc certified paper packaging  the store also uses human employees who work alongside the robot  optimizing speed and quality of service  and adopts robust engineering from ijrrobótica and aev 

self offers everything from coffee and soft drinks to pasta and desserts  the store is located in terminal 1  next to gate b24 at bcn 

image credit  areas

title: valentine s themed comedy shows
texto:
valentine s themed comedy shows factory theatre is making this valentine s season unforgettable with two comedy shows guaranteed to leave audiences in stitches  whether you re looking for a hilarious date night or a fun evening with friends   chorelord  and  hookup  promise entertainment with a twist of romance

for those in the mood for romantic comedy  hookup runs from february 6 to 15 at 8 pm  this unscripted show pairs audience members for a fully improvised journey through dating  heartbreak  and love    all without leaving their seats  featuring some of the city s top comedic talent  hookup guarantees an evening filled with charm and laughter 

tickets for both shows are available now  visit factorytheatre ca to reserve your spot

title: celebrative multi layered champagnes
texto:
celebrative multi layered champagnes  collection impériale création no  1  stands as the pinnacle of moët   chandon s winemaking mastery  representing a fusion of youthful freshness and the depth gained with age  marking the brand s 28th anniversary  this exceptional champagne is crafted from a blend of seven remarkable vintages  each one carefully aged in distinct environments to highlight its unique qualities 

the champagne showcases  a radiant yellow hue while its bouquet is complex  revealing layers that begin with notes of licorice root  mocha  and toast  followed by hints of madeleine  fresh hazelnut  and vanilla   as it evolves  dried fig and mirabelle plum offer further depth  on the palate   a creamy effervescence balances fresh and subtle bitter notes  culminating in a finish marked by refined touches of smoke and licorice  

overall  collection impériale création no  1 is an embodiment of elegance and craftsmanship  ideal for celebrations and special occasions

title: japanese creative innovation hubs
texto:
japanese creative innovation hubs karimoku furniture is one of the leading wooden furniture manufacturers in japan with an impressive history of 80 years of craftsmanship    it has just launched karimoku research  this is a progressive initiative that functions as a hub to explore new ways of living  to do this  it surveys others  archiving  and understanding how people live  to do this  karimoku research understands through collaborations with global creatives and imagines the role of design in day to day life 

by opening the new research center in tokyo  the brand fuses its woodworking roots with a fresh approach to initiate more dialogue and form meaningful designs that would be of use in the future  the first survey was survey 00  wood  it showcased the firm s commitment to progressing the role of wood in modern design and sustainability along with the collaborative efforts of christian jade

title: electric ink color changing guitars
texto:
electric ink color changing guitars e ink works in collaboration with guitar manufacturer cream guitars to create the new voltage davinci  this is the first ever color changing electric guitar in the world  the two merge elements of digital technology with fine craftsmanship to form the progressive instrument  it allows musicians to transform their instruments in real time  at the root of the voltage davinci is the e ink prism 3 epaper technology 

this is a low power and durable display system that can showcase up to seven different colors and patterns  musicians can shift the look to match their set  mood  and other aesthetics that play a role in the show  this does not need any paint whatsoever  the ceo of cream guitars  luiz ortiz noted   we wanted to break every rule  we ve reimagined every part of an electric guitar to enhance the playing experience  by collaborating with e ink  we re giving artists a new level of creativity beyond anything currently on the market

title: past era honoring furniture capsules
texto:
past era honoring furniture capsules ikea is rounding out the last of its nytillverkad time capsule with the sixth drop of fresh new iterations of beloved designs from its archives  the latest launch brings attention to statement seats  playful textiles  sculptural vases  and custom shelving units  all of these are pulled from the brand s archives between the 60s and the 80s  the design language is defined by bold colors  soft curved lines  and versatile design 

this capsule celebrates its heritage and also brings attention to how vintage pieces can still feel just as strong in today s spaces  at the root of the capsule are four chairs  the mofalla chair  the mila chair from 1967 is now the dyvlinge  the puck armchair is now the bright red sotenäs  and the cox chair

title: upcoming nostalgic animated movies
texto:
upcoming nostalgic animated movies netflix has recently announced that it will be presenting the upcoming plankton  the movie  the new spinoff from spongebob squarepants will be available to stream on march 7th next month  the tiny sheldon j  plankton stars as the protagonist as he faces a new problem

title: nostalgic revived crayon colors
texto:
nostalgic revived crayon colors crayola dives into its past by bringing back eight of its retired colors    this is the first time the company has done this in all of its 122 years in existence  this decision is a response to fan requests throughout the years  some of its most beloved colors are returning  this includes  dandelion  blizzard blue  magic mint  mulberry  orange red  violet blue  lemon yellow  and raw umber  

the chief marketing officer at crayola  victoria lozano notes   color has such a personal connection for kids of all ages  it plays a pivotal role in inspiring creativity  which is an integral catalyst for educational  emotional and cognitive growth  at crayola  we celebrate the enduring value of childhood creativity to help kids reach their full potential  and we look forward to seeing the limited edition colors inspire even more creative moments for our fans

title: unique bourbon maturation processes
texto:
unique bourbon maturation processes whistlepig s snout to tail bourbon  aged for ten years  marks a bold entry into the bourbon scene by the vermont based whiskey maker  this release represents the culmination of a decade of experimentation with aging techniques  the snout to tail maturation process involved barrels being flipped 180 degrees to enhance the infusion of flavors from two toasted barrel heads   vermont oak and smoked maple wood  this distinct approach challenges traditional bourbon production  making it particularly appealing to consumers who appreciate experimental finishes and premium aging processes 

bottled at 88 proof  the bourbon offers a complex flavor profile that includes honey  brown sugar  and toasted cashew notes  followed by roasted almonds and baked cornbread  and finishes with a cedar and crusty bite 

the introduction of this whiskey is complemented by whistlepig s expansion into kentucky with the opening of the piggybank  which will provide an immersive experience for whiskey lovers 

image credit  whistlepig

title: honey inspired hair gels
texto:
honey inspired hair gels the bee girls honey dip honey butter gel from the doux offers a unique solution for individuals seeking a versatile styling product with nourishing benefits  this gel provides a medium hold with high shine and as such  it is ideal for defining curls while avoiding the heaviness often associated with other products 

infused with cationic honey  marshmallow root  and jojoba oil  the bee girls honey dip honey butter gel helps lock in moisture  promote bounce  and protect hair from heat damage  the gel is also free from parabens and cruelty  ensuring that the thoughtful composition appeals to those with ethical or sensitive preferences 

the doux maintains that the bee girls honey dip honey butter gel s lightweight yet effective design works best for individuals with dry  curly  or textured hair  as it ensures hydration without the greasy residue 

image credit  the doux

title: portable gym care beauty kits
texto:
portable gym care beauty kits the après gym care kit offers a curated selection of beauty and wellness products designed for individuals leading active lifestyles  the kit includes skin cooling facial towelettes  collagen eye masks  sculpting workout bands  a silk scrunchie set  and convenient travel accessories like a tote and mesh bag  it is marketed as an all in one solution for post workout recovery and self care 

consumers interested in combining their fitness routine with skincare and relaxation will find the après gym care kit  the packaging  which is sure to capture attention  is designed with both elegance and functionality in mind  each product is housed in a sleek and modern aesthetic  communicating a a clean  sophisticated vibe  with a focus on understated beauty  the tote and mesh bag add to the cohesive look 

image credit  après beauty

title: ethereal peachy fragrances
texto:
ethereal peachy fragrances guerlain s l art   la matière pêche mirage fragrance offers a unique interpretation of the peach by combining artistic inspiration with avant garde perfumery 

developed by delphine jelk  the fragrance incorporates synthetic elements that highlight the peach s essence while blending it with complex notes like saffron  blackcurrant  and osmanthus flower  the composition balances these vibrant fruity elements with warmer  sensual undertones of leather  sandalwood  and amber  this creates an enveloping and intimate scent  the use of synthetic molecules to enhance the peach note offers a modern twist on a classic fruit inspired fragrance 

guerlain s l art   la matière pêche mirage fragrance s design draws from charles petillon s balloon sculptures  which evoke a sense of lightness and intrigue  guerlain s commitment to craftsmanship and artistry in perfumery  combined with the allure of its limited edition appeal  will likely attract those who appreciate sophisticated and multifaceted fragrances 

image credit  guerlain

title: empowering woman inspired campaigns
texto:
empowering woman inspired campaigns stuart weitzman s  how lovely to be a woman  ad campaign features christy turlington and other notable women  the initiative celebrates modern womanhood and highlights personal stories of empowerment and confidence 

turlington stands out in the how lovely to be a woman campaign because she is not only a supermodel but also a maternal health advocate and founder of every mother counts  a nonprofit focused on improving maternal health worldwide  alongside turlington  other global brand ambassadors such as aly raisman  issa rae  lucy liu  and ming xi  all share their stories of standing strong and embracing their identities 

consumers may be drawn to this campaign for its focus on women s empowerment and social impact  additionally  stuart weitzman will donate  50 000 to every mother counts 

image credit  stuart weitzman

title: ultra advanced camping mattresses
texto:
ultra advanced camping mattresses the hest foamy advanced camping mattress is designed to deliver exceptional comfort and support  the product is marketed as rivaling the quality and feel of a home mattress while offering portability and durability for outdoor adventures 

featuring two layers of memory foam  the advanced camping mattress provides body alignment and pressure point relief  with features like a welcome mat  phone pocket  waterproof lower construction  a washable cover  and an integrated compression strap  the hest foamy combines functionality with ease of use as well  additionally  the product boasts durable materials  and temperature resilient memory foam to optimize adaptability and comfort 

the product comes in three sizes  ensuring versatility for different sleeping preferences  it comes in a light grey shade 

image credit  hest

title: celebrity studded perfume campaigns
texto:
celebrity studded perfume campaigns christian dior homme eau de parfum continues to evolve its signature scent with an updated version featuring robert pattinson as its iconic face  this iteration is reimagined by master perfumer francis kurkdjian and highlights a powerful iris note  which serves as the fragrance s core  the iris is presented in dual forms  it balances ts delicate petals with the earthy  grounded strength of its roots  this juxtaposition of soft and intense qualities reflects the perfume s blend of masculinity and sensuality  the fragrance also incorporates amber and woody elements that further deepen its sophisticated and bold profile 

dior s continued partnership with robert pattinson  who is celebrated for his connection with modern  enigmatic masculinity  adds an element of intrigue and contemporary relevance to the new homme eau de parfum release 

image credit  christian dior

title: ai powered at home boxing training
texto:
ai powered at home boxing training london based startup pendulum boxing offers a cutting edge fitness experience that brings professional boxing training directly into the home  the company combines ai technology with traditional boxing techniques to provide users with personalized coaching  biometric training plans  and real time progress feedback  the home suite includes boxing equipment and strength training tools  such as color coded weights  the integration with wearables enhances the user experience and provides a comprehensive view of progress in both boxing and strength training 

consumers would be attracted to pendulum boxing for its unique blend of advanced technology and elite level training  the ai powered real time feedback ensures that users receive professional guidance and continue to achieve form and technique as they progress  the customizable  biometrics based training plans are appealing to those looking for a personalized fitness journey 

image credit  pendulum boxing

title: ai powered nutrition tracking tools
texto:
ai powered nutrition tracking tools health technology startup bevel has launched a new ai powered nutrition tracking feature that integrates with leading blood glucose monitors like dexcom and libre  this feature aims to provide users with personalized  real time insights into how their food choices affect their health  particularly in relation to blood glucose levels  by using a vast database of over five million verified food items  bevel ensures that its nutrition data is accurate and reliable  in doing so  it avoids inconsistencies common in other platforms that rely on language models 

consumers would be drawn to bevel s new ai powered nutrition tracking feature for its personalized approach to health tracking  by offering tailored nutrition scores and connecting eating habits to other health metrics  users gain valuable insights that help them make better decisions about their diet  the integration with blood glucose data provides a more precise picture of how food choices directly affect the body  which could appeal to those looking to improve their health  manage conditions like diabetes  or optimize their performance 

image credit  bevel

title: valentine s day inspired olive lines
texto:
valentine s day inspired olive lines supermarket italy offers a unique and flavorful way to celebrate valentine s day with its curated selection of sanniti olives  known for its high quality imported gourmet products  the company provides a range of olive varieties that cater to different tastes   from mild and buttery castelvetrano olives to rich and fruity taggiasca olives  in addition to individual products like pitted and stuffed olives  supermarket italy offers an olive sampler and other items such as green olive spreads 

the olives are sourced from regions known for their rich culinary traditions  supermarket italy allows customers to explore international tastes and this may make its curated selection a great option for food lovers or anyone looking for a unique and sophisticated gift 

image credit  supermarket italy

title: branded health initiatives
texto:
branded health initiatives hims   hers has introduced two new initiatives aimed at enhancing customer engagement and personalizing the healthcare experience    the health collective and the community member council  these programs empower customers by giving them a more active role in shaping their healthcare journey 

the health collective is a community driven ambassador program that allows participants to share their stories  connect with others  and be among the first to learn about new products  meanwhile  the community member council is a select group of 15 members who provide direct feedback to influence the development of hims   hers  offerings  this feedback loop aims to improve the platform s services and ensure it meets customer needs more effectively 

the health collective and the community member council highlight the company s commitment to creating a more customer centric healthcare model 

image credit  hims   hers

title: convenient banana bread flavored snacks
texto:
convenient banana bread flavored snacks cooper street has expanded its lineup of wholesome snacks with the introduction of banana bread granola bake  a new product inspired by the flavors of homemade banana bread  combining real bananas with a blend of ancient grains  the snack offers a chewy texture and natural sweetness without artificial additives or preservatives  this launch aligns with the brand s focus on delivering nutritious and satisfying options made from high quality ingredients 

by incorporating nutrient rich ingredients such as quinoa  chia seeds  and flax  cooper street aims to provide a snack that supports heart health  digestion  and blood sugar management  its commitment to using real fruit and locally sourced ingredients further reinforces its reputation for crafting better for you treats 

beyond its focus on quality  the company is also dedicated to charitable efforts as it partners with organizations like make a wish and hooah inc  to support various community initiatives 

image credit  cooper street

title: paper bottle margarita mixes
texto:
paper bottle margarita mixes new creation soda works has introduced an innovative approach to cocktail mixers with the launch of the world s first paper bottle margarita mix line  available in fresh squeezed lime and strawberry habanero flavors  the product will debut in georgia fresh market stores in march before expanding nationwide  this move reflects the company s commitment to sustainability  as the fully recyclable paper bottle weighs significantly less than glass and reduces carbon emissions by 84  compared to traditional packaging 

the transition to the paper bottle margarita mix aesthetic aligns with new creation s broader focus on environmentally responsible production  founder paul kooistra notes that the decision to adopt this packaging for the newly rebranded salty goat margarita mix was driven by a desire to offer a more sustainable alternative while maintaining high ingredient quality  the mix itself continues to be made from premium components such as fresh lime juice  raw agave nectar  and ripe strawberries 

image credit  new creation soda works

title: award winning music inspired tequilas
texto:
award winning music inspired tequilas música tequila has earned a prestigious double gold medal at wswa access live 2025  a major event in the beverage alcohol industry  the recognition highlights the exceptional quality of its reposado  which scored an impressive 98 5  the brand s añejo and blanco varieties were also acknowledged 

founded in 2024 by chris and geri andrews  música tequila is rooted in both tequila craftsmanship and a passion for music  the spirit is produced in jalisco  mexico  using 100  blue agave from volcanic soil  the tequila is made without additives and emphasizes natural flavors and traditional methods  the expertise of maestro tequilero hugo yerenas dominguez  son of a legendary tequila maker  ensures a refined production process that upholds authenticity and heritage 

beyond its focus on high quality spirits  música tequila integrates music into its brand identity by supporting local musicians in florida and michigan while partnering with save the music  a nonprofit dedicated to music education 

image credit  música tequila

title: multi year energy drink partnerships
texto:
multi year energy drink partnerships the professional fighters league has announced a multi year partnership with valr energy  making the emerging energy drink brand its official partner in the u s  as part of this collaboration  valr will receive prominent branding opportunities  including the naming rights to the league s vip cage side club and the rebranding of its athlete bracket  additionally  select professional fighters league fighters will partner with valr to share their journeys through social media  a move that further integrates the brand into the world of mixed martial arts  valr will also play a key role in the 2025 pfl world tournament bracket reveal show 

known for its nitrogen infused energy drinks  valr offers a formulation designed to enhance mental clarity and physical endurance  the beverage features goof for you ingredients like natural caffeine  essential amino acids  and important antioxidants 

image credit  valr energy

title: peach flavored hard teas
texto:
peach flavored hard teas kyla hard kombucha has introduced  kyla peach bellini craft hard tea   marking its debut in the hard tea market  this new beverage offers a refreshing and balanced flavor profile  combining the natural sweetness of peaches with a hint of citrus zest  it is crafted to suit those seeking a mindful drinking experience  making it ideal for a variety of outdoor activities 

in addition to its uniquely refreshing taste  kyla peach bellini craft hard tea is  brewed with organic black tea and boasts a 5 5  alcohol by volume the beverage is also gluten free  100  vegan  and contains zero sugar   moreover  its slightly sparkling taste and dry finish further enhance its appeal  making it a versatile choice for outdoor enthusiasts whether enjoying winter sports or relaxing after a spring hike 

currently  the product is  available in 12 ounce cans  sold in six packs at select retailers such as whole foods  natural grocers  total wine  and safeway colorado  

image credit  kyla hard kombucha

title: stigma addressing diabetes shorts
texto:
stigma addressing diabetes shorts abbott s new short film  titled  above the bias   addresses the stigma surrounding diabetes and how misconceptions can negatively impact those living with the condition  a global survey accompanies the film  it reveals that over 2 600 individuals with diabetes face judgment and misinformation  often leading to social and medical consequences  findings indicate that 40  have skipped or missed medical appointments due to stigma  while nearly a quarter have refrained from sharing their diagnosis out of embarrassment  the study also highlights that food related comments  such as questioning whether someone should be eating a particular item  trigger stress responses comparable to high pressure situations 

abbott s above the bias emphasizes the importance of shifting public perception and fostering a more supportive environment  it builds upon ongoing advocacy efforts to promote factual awareness about diabetes while demonstrating how encouragement can positively impact disease management 

image credit  abbott s

title: big game hospitality experiences
texto:
big game hospitality experiences marriott bonvoy and courtyard by marriott created a unique super bowl experience by organizing a city wide challenge in new orleans  where participants had to identify the real jason kelce among 25 lookalikes  the winners  a duo from texas  earned an overnight stay in the exclusive courtyard super bowl sleepover suite inside caesars superdome  along with tickets to super bowl lix  this marks the ninth year of the sleepover suite tradition  an initiative designed to bring fans closer to the game in an immersive way 

the collaboration between marriott bonvoy and the nfl  with jason kelce as the brand s first  fanbassador   highlights an ongoing effort to create exclusive fan experiences  throughout the regular season  marriott bonvoy members accessed special football related events  and this latest activation extended the engagement leading up to the championship  additionally  kelce lookalikes will remain present throughout super bowl week  offering fans chances to win branded merchandise and other prizes 

image credit  marriott bonvoy and courtyard by marriott

title: advanced accessible beauty solutions
texto:
advanced accessible beauty solutions neutrogena has announced tate mcrae as its newest global brand ambassador and this move aligns with the launch of the brand s  beauty to a science  campaign  which emphasizes the fusion of advanced skincare technology with accessible beauty solutions 

the  beauty to a science  campaign spotlights the hydro boost collection and the water gel moisturizer in particular  in addition to mcrae  the accessible beauty solutions initiative features dermatologist dr  muneeb shah  whose presence reinforces the brand s credibility by addressing the connection between stress and skin health 

the  beauty to a science  campaign will span multiple platforms  integrating digital  social media  and in store marketing to maximize its reach  by combining the expertise of a trusted skincare brand with the relatability of a rising celebrity  neutrogena positions itself as both a scientifically driven and consumer friendly option 

image credit  neutrogena

title: premium audio enhanced earphones
texto:
premium audio enhanced earphones tumi has announced a long term collaboration with premium audio brand master   dynamic and the first product from this partnership is the mw09 active noise canceling true wireless earphones  which incorporate tumi s signature 19 degree design elements  this move marks the intersection of high end travel accessories and cutting edge sound technology 

engineered for durability and high performance  the earphones offer features such as an advanced six microphone system with wind noise reduction and an ip54 water resistance rating  available in black and silver  the mw09 active noise canceling true wireless earphones are designed to complement tumi s 19 degree aluminum collection 

this collaboration between tumi and master   dynamic is positioned as a fusion of craftsmanship and innovation  the  450 price tag reflects the premium nature of both brands  catering to frequent travelers and audiophiles seeking sophisticated  high performance sound equipment 

image credit  tumi

title: breakfast chain fundraising initiatives
texto:
breakfast chain fundraising initiatives sunset grill s pancake tuesday continues the brand s long standing partnership with the canadian cancer society  on march 4  2025  patrons at all sunset grill locations in ontario  alberta  and new brunswick can enjoy buttermilk pancakes for  2  with all proceeds going toward cancer research and support programs  over the years  the initiative has raised more than  227 000  and this year s campaign aims to generate an additional  50 000 to further assist those affected by cancer 

sunset grill s pancake tuesday underscores the breakfast chain s commitment to community engagement  bulk pre orders are available for schools and organizations   a move that ensures widespread participation 

given statistics that show that nearly half of canadians will face a cancer diagnosis in their lifetime  the fundraiser aligns with a cause that is sure to resonates broadly with breakfast lovers 

image credit  sunset grill

title: canadian made product campaigns
texto:
canadian made product campaigns unifor  canada s largest private sector union  has called on major grocery retailers   like empire  loblaw  and metro   to prioritize canadian made products in response to potential trade tariffs from the us  in a letter addressed to the ceos of these companies  unifor national president lana payne emphasized the importance of supporting domestic industries to safeguard canadian jobs  the union has proposed clear labeling and promotional efforts to help consumers easily identify locally produced goods  as well as a commitment from retailers to source from canadian suppliers whenever possible 

the request aligns with unifor s broader initiative to strengthen domestic manufacturing and secure employment across the supply chain  by encouraging consumers to choose canadian made products  the union seeks to mitigate the potential economic fallout of trade restrictions 

image credit  unifor

title: powerfully formulated sheet masks
texto:
powerfully formulated sheet masks mediheal has launched three new transformative sheet masks designed to tackle specific skincare needs  the  hyper collagen gel mask  uses advanced technology to firm and hydrate the skin  as the mask changes from pink to clear  the collagen rich formula absorbs into the skin  helping to tighten pores and improve texture in just 30 minutes 

the  hyper hyaluronate gel mask   on the other hand  is  packed with 10 types of hyaluronic acid and brightening ingredients to deeply hydrate and improve skin elasticity and texture   like the collagen gel mask  it also changes from pink to clear  offering the benefits of a firming treatment 

finally  the  spicule pore tightening system mask  combines a serum and anti wrinkle mask with special ingredients like micro collagen this mask helps tighten pores and smooth skin  it comes in two concentrations  1 000 ppm and 3 000 ppm  to address different pore concerns 

image credit  mediheal

title: thailand inspired chocolate bars
texto:
thailand inspired chocolate bars compartés introduces its latest creation  a thailand inspired chocolate bar  as part of its ongoing collaboration with hbo s white lotus  this decadent chocolate bar  inspired by the highly anticipated third season of the hit show set in thailand  combines the creamy richness of white chocolate with the tropical sweetness of mango and the comforting flavor of sticky rice 

perfectly capturing the essence of thailand s iconic dessert  this limited edition bar offers a sensory journey to southeast asia with every bite  ideal for white lotus fans  chocoholics  or anyone seeking a luxurious treat  the thailand mango sticky rice bar is also a thoughtful valentine s day gift or a unique movie night indulgence 

available now  this gourmet chocolate bar blends artistry and flavor  reflecting compartés  commitment to crafting exquisite chocolates that celebrate global cultures  whether you re enjoying the series premiere or gifting to a loved one  this edible homage is a must try for the season 

image credit  compartes

title: wildflower topped extension renovations
texto:
wildflower topped extension renovations british architecture firm studio merlin updates the hoj house  which is a victorian home in london s stoke newington  it is topped with a wildflower extension inspired by scandinavian aesthetics  the hoj house is dubbed after the danish word for high  taking over a terrace defined by its four story tall dwellings with narrow gardens at the back 

it has a broad and low lying extension made from neutral concrete blocks to contrast the london stock brick of the original home in a honey like hue  the founder  josh piddock shared with dezeen   our clients wanted a flexible space that would allow a seamless flow of activity from outside to inside  particularly during the summer for family gatherings  the material palette was deliberately neutral in order to draw attention to the natural elements and provide a balanced and warm minimalist aesthetic  

image credit  richard chivers

title: various textural homeware boutiques
texto:
various textural homeware boutiques interior design firm studio shoo has just completed a store design for estil io in yerevan  armenia  it blends sculptural elements with bright detailing and chrome furniture  overall  it has a calm aesthetic    the space sells homeware  art objects  and coffee table books in a way that is meant to bring comfort and an inviting aura  creating a space for visitors to relax in 

the store has tables of different heights  colors  and shapes to give flexibility when showcasing products  the founder of studio shoo  shushana khachatrian shared with dezeen   our key objective was to design a background for the displayed items that would not contradict  but rather emphasise  the products  distinctiveness  tones of warm white were chosen as the project s primary hues  and the emphasis was turned to the diversity and blend of various material textures  

image credit  katie kutuzova

title: miami as a future city of innovation
texto:
miami as a future city of innovation miami is quickly making a name for itself as a future city of innovation  blending sustainability  technology  and creativity in exciting new ways  trend hunter s future festival miami  ff miami  is set to capture this energy in a one of a kind microcosmic space  offering a glimpse into how cities of tomorrow can function 

at the heart of the event is the climate   innovation hub  a space that s been thoughtfully repurposed to minimize environmental impact  from relocating and planting trees to using low voltage lighting and collaborating with local eco artists  every detail is designed to enhance both sustainability and creativity  it s a space that doesn t just host innovation it embodies it 

but it s more than just a venue  ff miami will bring together policymakers  entrepreneurs  and changemakers to explore real world solutions that could reshape urban living  by treating events as living ecosystems  this festival will showcase ideas that don t just stay within its walls but can be applied to everyday city life  in a city already leading the way  ff miami is set to push the boundaries even further 

join us at future festival 2025  connect with top innovators from brands like starbucks  netflix  and google  miami  feb 25 26   nyc  06   3 4   or toronto world summit  sept 23 25   register now 

image credit  shutterstock

title: lip balm range expansions
texto:
lip balm range expansions guerlain has introduced new shades to its  kisskiss bee glow pearly lip balm   expanding the beloved honey infused  color adapting range  these limited edition shades are designed to enhance the lips  natural tone  offering a radiant  pearlescent finish that evolves uniquely on each wearer 

infused with organic corsican honey  the balm hydrates and nourishes the lips  while its key ingredients    including propolis extract    provide anti inflammatory and antioxidant properties  this luxurious formula ensures smooth  soft lips throughout the day  with a creamy texture that creates a luminous  glowing effect 

presented in elegant golden packaging  the kisskiss bee glow pearly lip balms offer indulgent skincare benefits and deliver a customizable pop of color  these new shades add sophistication to guerlain s existing lineup  ideal for everyday wear  this product is a must have for those seeking a balance between hydration and subtle glamour 

image credit  guerlain

title: transformed colorful holiday homes
texto:
transformed colorful holiday homes a retro gdr bungalow near berlin has been transformed into a holiday home by its owners jan winkelmann and julia carloff winkelmann  the color palette hits the spotlight as the home is crafted with a palette that nods to california modernism  it has a mono pitch roof and sloped facade walls  built from a double walled brick masonry 

jan winkelmann spoke to dezeen about the project  noting  to understand the original architecture and unlock the building s full potential  we decided to completely gut the bungalow  starting with the floor plan redesign  we first relocated the cellar access   previously a kitchen hatch   to the exterior  next  we sealed the old kitchen window and installed a new one for the bathroom  

image credit  anne deppe

title: portable clamshell phone keyboards
texto:
portable clamshell phone keyboards product designer justin mitchell dreamed up the amber kb 1 keyboard  which is a conceptual portable clamshell device that transformed smartphones into a small laptop  the device is meant to be compatible with iphone models and the galaxy s series by samsung 

justin mitchell spoke to dezeen about the project noting   the amber keyboard  or kb 1 as we are calling it  was inspired by a need to write anywhere inspiration strikes  the top clamshell is large enough to support most if not all large form factor phones and we will supply faceplates for the most common device sizes in the box   it has chunky mechanical keys and allows users to place their device into the slot to type witha bluetooth connection

title: stealthy all black durable footwear
texto:
stealthy all black durable footwear asics introduces a look at the new gel yeti tokyo hi gtx footwear model with an all black colorway palette  the model is set to launch online at asics officially on february 20th  the stealthy palette for the reimagined silhouette is doused in the intense hue as the gel yeti boot has a suedette upper 

it is all coated in gore tex materials which allow the shoe to have a waterproof sensibility without compromising its luxurious elements  it is finished with matte black hardware whilst the white stitching offers a contrasting look to elevate the structural elements  this is paired with a quick lacing system as the shoes  the gel yeti tokyo hi gtx rests on top of a rugged outsole unit to move around tough terrains with ease 

image credit  asics

title: the fundamentals of innovation and hip hop
texto:
the fundamentals of innovation and hip hop innovation and hip hop may seem like distinct worlds  but as trend hunter s chief growth officer  jonathan brown  highlighted in his keynote speech  they share a fundamental principle reinvention  both thrive on blending ideas  breaking conventions  and anticipating what s next  just as hip hop reshaped culture by merging jazz  funk  rock  and r b  marketing succeeds by reimagining messaging  drawing from diverse influences  and crafting fresh narratives that stay ahead of the curve 

hip hop didn t invent music  it reinvented it  by sampling and remixing existing sounds  it created a global movement that continues to shape culture  marketing operates in much the same way  taking inspiration from the past while introducing new perspectives  whether through nostalgia driven campaigns  brand reinventions  or cultural storytelling  the industry s most impactful strategies emerge from this fusion of familiarity and innovation 

jonathan also emphasized how both hip hop and marketing exist in  wicked learning environments   where ambiguity and unpredictability demand adaptability  success in both spaces requires embracing risk  anticipating trends  and pushing creative boundaries  by adopting hip hop s mindset of reinvention and cultural awareness  marketers can craft campaigns that don t just sell products but build movements  making a lasting impact in an ever evolving world 

want to learn more about innovation and marketing  join us at future festival 2025  connect with top innovators from brands like starbucks  netflix  and google  miami  feb 25 26   nyc  06   3 4   or toronto world summit  sept 23 25   register now 

image credit  shutterstock

title: fashionable bowling inspired sneakers
texto:
fashionable bowling inspired sneakers the adidas x brain dead x dsm collaboration takes the classic bowling shoe to the next level  merging vintage inspired design with contemporary streetwear appeal  this latest iteration  a refined take on adidas and brain dead s bowling style sneaker  now includes the pioneering retailer dover street market  adding an extra layer of exclusivity 

offered in an understated black leather upper with white stitching and gold branding  this shoe blends heritage aesthetics with modern minimalism  though its silhouette is rooted in a 1970s archival adidas design  the sneaker feels incredibly current  aligning with the growing trend of hybrid footwear    where sneaker functionality meets classic craftsmanship 

with sneaker loafer mashups and adidas  past collaborations with clot and peaceminusone dominating fashion conversations  this bowling inspired design stands out as a pioneer in the trend  whether worn casually or dressed up  this sleek  versatile shoe proves that bowling shoes are no longer just for the lanes  expect the adidas x brain dead x dsm bowling shoe to drop later this year 

image credit   fullress

title: lightweight sleek collaborative eyewear
texto:
lightweight sleek collaborative eyewear cubitts and soar work in collaboration to present a new collection of running eyewear  cubitts is a modern spectacle designer and soar is a performance running imprint    together  they merge their expertise  as a result  cirrus was born and it is a progressive pair of running eyewear made for elevated performance  dubbed the  world s lightest running glasses   cirris has an ultralightweight titanium skeleton 

these are carefully made to be refined over 18 months from the initial 22 gram prototype  what results is a durable and featherlight frame which have been engineered for both comfort and stability  it weighs only 10 grams and is inspired by constantin brâncu i s bird in space  it adapts to movement and has crosshatched nose pads for a secure fit 

image credit  cubitts  soar

title: character themed t shirt collections
texto:
character themed t shirt collections uniqlo s latest sesame street ut collection brings beloved characters like elmo  cookie monster  and big bird to life on high quality apparel  this collaboration offers a range of t shirts and loungewear  featuring unique designs that capture the charm of the iconic children s show 

the collection includes vintage style t shirts that feature classic artwork showcasing colorful sesame street characters  blending nostalgia with contemporary fashion  soft fabrics and relaxed fits ensure comfort  making them perfect for everyday wear  available in various sizes  the sesame street ut collection ensures that fans of all ages can enjoy these delightful pieces  whether you re looking to relive childhood memories or introduce the magic of sesame street to a new generation  this collection offers something special for everyone 

explore the full range at uniqlo com 

image credit  uniqlo

title: peptide moisturizing solutions
texto:
peptide moisturizing solutions the skincare brand has unveiled its pro collagen peptide plumping moisturizer  marking a significant advancement in peptide powered hydration  the lightweight gel cream formula features a proprietary 3x pro collagen peptide complex  incorporating hexapeptide 5 for improved skin firmness  oligopeptide 1 for enhanced elasticity  and tridecapeptide 1 for wrinkle reduction  clinical studies demonstrate the moisturizer s ability to deliver 24 hour hydration  with 90  of users reporting immediate plumping effects 

paula s choice has strategically launched this innovation alongside its first ever brand ambassador  olympic medalist ilona maher  the most followed rugby player on social media  the collection also includes the pro collagen peptide plumping lip treatment  designed to complement the moisturizer in a comprehensive skincare routine  the foundation friendly formula integrates seamlessly into both morning and evening regimens  with the brand recommending application after cleansing and serums  followed by spf 30  for daytime use 

image credit  paula s choice

title: sustainable cashmere collections
texto:
sustainable cashmere collections reformation has expanded its clara cashmere cardigan collection with four new distinctive designs  the latest additions include the husky multi argyle  lemon icing cable  slate blue cable  and an elevated bow embroidery variant  each piece in the collection maintains the brand s commitment to sustainable materials  utilizing 95  recycled cashmere in its construction while ensuring 100  recyclability through its refrecycling program 

the expanded collection builds upon the success of the original clara cardigan  which has garnered attention from notable figures including olivia rodrigo and emilia clarke  priced at  288 cad  with the bow embroidery version at  348 cad  these pieces represent reformation s ongoing evolution in sustainable luxury knitwear  the design variations range from classic cable knit patterns to contemporary argyle interpretations  offering versatile styling options for the modern wardrobe 

consumers can shop the new pieces online and in store 

image credit  reformation

title: effervescent cannabis tablets
texto:
effervescent cannabis tablets the cv sciences thc fizz tablets have been launched as part of the aura collection as a natural health product that will enable consumers to craft a premium cannabis refreshment from the comfort of home in an on demand way 

the product features 2 5mg of fast acting thc in each tablet and works by having one or two placed into a glass of water or seltzer  the tablets will go to work providing an effervescent refreshment experience  while the hemp in the formulation will offer a way to combat stress and encourage relaxation 

ceo joseph dowling spoke on the cv sciences thc fizz tablets saying   we are delighted to expand our aura collection with the addition of these fast acting and innovative fizz tablets  we are continually developing new and innovative ways to improve the well being of consumers  this new form factor offers an alcohol free alternative to minimize stress  inspire calmness  and unlock a deeper sense of relaxation  

image credit  cv sciences  inc

title: protein enhanced beverage solutions
texto:
