title: customizable seven in one docking hubs
texto:
customizable seven in one docking hubs the memdock g2 docking station is a versatile  multifunctional peripheral created with efficiency in mind to provide users with a range of functions that work well for gaming  productivity and more 

the peripheral is equipped with seven keys along with a knob that can be personalized to your choice of functions to accelerate gameplay or productivity  the unit also features a plug and play functionality that includes 100w powerdelivery for charging  4k streaming at 60hz and more 

the memdock g2 docking station is compatible for use with a wide range of equipment including gaming systems  pcs and more  the peripheral is highly user friendly with the ability to be plugged in and ready to use in moments  while the mobile functionality means it can be used out of the house to support productivity from anywhere

title: hot honey themed menus
texto:
hot honey themed menus kfc is launching a new hot honey menu  appealing to recent trends and interest in the  swicy  category  featuring menu items like hot honey drizzled tenders  bone in hot honey chicken  secret recipe fries  and more  this launch is perfect for consumers who love a bit of kick in their food  there is also a fan favorite s box that features four bone in hot honey chicken pieces  12 piece kfc nuggets  secret recipe fries  four biscuits  and four sauces 

consumers can also order mike s hot honey as a dipping sauce and use it to complement traditional kfc menu items 

 like so many americans  i grew up on  kfc s  iconic fried chicken buckets and it was one of my very first drizzles when i first created mike s hot honey   founder mike kurtz said in a statement   the sweet heat pairs perfectly with their original recipe chicken and i am so happy everyone will have an opportunity to enjoy this delicious combination  

image credit  kfc

title: outdoor inspired beer spots
texto:
outdoor inspired beer spots nascar cup series driver  ross chastain  stars in busch light s new advertisements  which will air during this year s superbowl 

the first spot  titled  circles   features  chastain alongside the busch guy  as two hikers become disoriented on a trail  repeatedly circling during their hike the busch guy offers helpful advice on how to avoid getting lost  with chastain providing additional insights   as the official beer sponsor of nascar  busch light humorously references its experience with circular tracks while also emphasizing the importance of proper navigation in outdoor settings 

the second ad   time   sees the busch guy teaching viewers how to tell time in the wilderness using a busch light can  signaling when it s time for happy hour  both ads are part of  the busch guide  series  which offers lighthearted outdoor survival tips from the busch guy  the new spots will first appear in 11 select markets before airing nationally during the 2025 nascar cup series season  starting with the daytona 500 

image credit  busch light

title: fragrant rollerball toys
texto:
fragrant rollerball toys mga entertainment is expanding a popular collection with new yummiland num noms body scents toys so that kids can enjoy blind unboxing experiences and create sweet diy scents 

in all  there are 10 yummiland num noms body scents to collect with signature scents like birthday cake  passion fruit  and vanilla raspberry  kids will enjoy exploring the world of fragrance in a safe way with fun characters like sugarcloud and berryswirl rollerballs that they can add liquid to  and keychains to take their sweetly crafted scents to go 

gen alpha s love of skincare and beauty has sparked an obsession with collecting real products designed for adult skin  prompting toy brands to step in and reintroduce opportunities for play through beauty inspired toys

title: dynamic immersive exhibitions
texto:
dynamic immersive exhibitions during this year s textile trade fair at heimtextil  patricia urquiola and moroso joined forces to create the among us design installation  it transforms hall 12 0 and the space creates a perfect background to experiment with textile concepts  sustainability  and more  it is an open concept that nods to both of its contributing efforts 

urquiola explains   the title  among us  refers to the concept of being together and reflects the intent of the installation to celebrate hybrid new relations  the installation creates a playful landscape populated by hybrid creatures of our fantasy   the seating is by moroso and patricia tapped a few talents to create the textile landscape  with handing textiles from cc tapis and lounge islands that are made by kettal using kvadrat fabric materials

title: powerful pet dental powders
texto:
powerful pet dental powders fera pets has officially launched dental support  a new product designed to help achieve fresh pet breath without requiring excessive maintenance  made with a combination of postbiotics  oral health enzymes  and botanicals  this robust powder helps address common dental issues while promoting healthy teeth for your pet  notably  this product appeals to pet owners because it requires no brushing  just a simple sprinkle on your pet s food will help promote overall mouth health 

 pet dental care shouldn t feel like a battle  ideally  we should be brushing our pets  teeth daily  but we know that s not always realistic   said dr  michelle dulake  veterinarian and co founder of fera pets   that s why we created dental support as a simple  stress free solution  this powdered formula works from the inside out  leveraging a clinically studied postbiotic to naturally balance the oral microbiome  supporting healthier gums and teeth       

image credit  fera pets

title: cinnamon espresso martinis
texto:
cinnamon espresso martinis alongside its signature espresso martini in a can  blossom launched a cinnamon espresso martini that takes its recipe with cold pressed espresso  chocolate  vanilla  cane sugar  spices  and premium  small batch vodka to the next level  this vanilla spiced version of the brand s coffee cocktail uses a lighter peruvian roast for warming  festive sips that are ready to crack open at home or take on the go 

the espresso martini  a beloved 80s coffee cocktail  is making a comeback as bars and brands reimagine the classic with unique flavors and modern twists  although this minimal ingredient cocktail is simple enough to make from scratch  drinkers are now spoiled for choice when it comes to bartender quality cocktails in cans  options like this one deliver the velvety  smooth experience consumers expect with the convenience they crave

title: spicy pizza finishing sauces
texto:
spicy pizza finishing sauces the pieology spicy ranch sauce has been announced by the brand as its featured sauce for february as a new take on a classic for customers to try out this winter  the sauce features the signature recipe of ranch dressing infused with calabrian chilis to give it a touch of spiciness in every bite  the sauce is being launched as an after bake drizzle or a dipping sauce to work well for customer preferences 

the pieology spicy ranch sauce is being offered for a limited time only and can also be ordered as a dressing for your choice of pizza  calzone  cheese bread or even salad  the sauce comes in response to increasing consumer demand for spicy flavor experiences that aren t too intense

title: calcium enhanced soy milks
texto:
calcium enhanced soy milks the rude health chilled soya drink has been unveiled by the brand as a new fortified plant based milk product perfect for consumers to try out as part of their morning routine  the soy milk is expected to be right at home within the existing range that includes oat  almond and coconut varieties  and is made with just four ingredients  spring water  soy beans  calcium carbonate and sea salt  the drink is thus right in calcium and versatile enough to be used in a wide range of recipes or meals  while also having a no added sugar recipe with a gluten free profile to boot 

head of marketing sam maguire spoke on the rude health chilled soya drink saying   we have had an increasing number of requests from people to rude health to make a soya drink with calcium  so we decided to look into developing this drink to sit alongside our other calcium fortified drinks  there are a large number of people who choose soya but currently there are no options that are  clean deck  products fortified with calcium  so we set out to fill that gap

title: in store dating experiences
texto:
in store dating experiences ikea and breeze have announced a new partnership in the uk that will provide consumers with a chance to get romantic with a special someone this valentine s day  the partnership will see nine couples in london  manchester and edinburgh matched through the breeze dating app getting the chance to have their first date at their local ikea store  daters will enjoy a romantic meatball dinner in bed that s based on the ikea six sleep essentials to ensure a comfortable experience for both parties 

commercial activity leader tania douglas spoke on the ikea and breeze partnership saying   at ikea  we believe everyone deserves a good night s sleep   so we re excited to team up with breeze to help those looking for love to find someone they can sleep soundly with  we ve used our six sleep essentials to help lucky singles find their sleep soulmate

title: full size wireless keyboards
texto:
full size wireless keyboards the keychron q6 max is a full size wireless mechanical keyboard designed for both mac and windows users  it features a 100  full size layout with support for 2 4 ghz wireless  bluetooth 5 1  and type c wired connectivity  the keyboard is crafted from 6063 aluminum  which undergoes cnc machining  polishing  sandblasting  and 24 additional manufacturing stages to create a solid and durable metal body  the q6 max also includes reinforced multi layer acoustic foam and a double gasket design to provide a satisfying typing experience with superior sound quality 

customization is a key feature of the q6 max  allowing users to choose from various keycaps  switches  and accessories  it supports hot swappable switches  enabling users to personalize their typing experience without soldering  the keyboard also offers customizable rgb backlighting with 22 types of rgb settings  allowing users to fine tune the hue  saturation  brightness  and effect speed  with its ergonomic design  powerful arm cortex m4 chip  and rapid 1000 hz polling rate  the keychron q6 max delivers both performance and comfort for gaming and productivity tasks 

image credit  keychron

title: nutritious socially supportive smoothies
texto:
nutritious socially supportive smoothies the erewhon deeper wellness smoothie has been created with kacey musgraves as a socially supportive refreshment perfect for consumers to try out as a way to fuel up and support a good cause  the smoothie starts off with almond milk before being paired with lion s mane powder  vanilla  spinach  sea moss  collagen  protein and spirulina  which combine to give it a wide range of vitamins and minerals  the drink also features sun chlorella powder that works with the aforementioned ingredients to have an earth inspired appearance as a nod to mother earth 

the erewhon deeper wellness smoothie is priced at  21  available now at all 10 locations and will see proceeds donated to altadena girls to support teens displaced by the la wildfires 

image credit  erewhon  hypebeast  erewhon

title: olfacory experience metaverses
texto:
olfacory experience metaverses all sorts of brands are launching interactive games on roblox to reach gen z and gen alpha  and givaudan is the first fragrance house to enter the popular metaverse platform with an experience called guardians of memories  with it  givaudan opened its digital factory project accelerator to the public for the first time 

guardians of memories pays tribute to the sense of smell and provides an immersive experience that invites exploration  learning  and sensory challenges  players are tasked with collecting ing redients  extracting their essences and formulating balanced olfactory compositions with pleasing top  middle  and base notes 

roblox  which welcomes 90 million users daily  provides the perfect place to reach players ages eight to 16  and familiarize them with the world of fragrance  the magic of beautifully interwoven notes  and the possibilities of self expression using personal scents

title: celebrative brand films
texto:
celebrative brand films clarks celebrates 200 years with  from somerset to the world   a documentary style film directed by set free richardson to commemorate the brand s anniversary  the film explores the brand s evolution from its origins in somerset to its cultural significance across various global communities 

featuring  perspectives from figures such as liam gallagher  ghostface killah  and martine rose  the film examines the impact of clarks  wallabee and desert boot silhouettes in music  fashion  and street culture   it highlights the brand s presence in regions including harajuku and jamaica  as well as its influence on hip hop and contemporary design 

additionally  the film reflects on clarks   longstanding commitment to craftsmanship  rooted in values of integrity  simplicity  equality  and community   the brand continues to integrate these principles into its approach to footwear design while adapting to the evolving landscape of style and culture 

image credit  clarks

title: social video beauty brands
texto:
social video beauty brands time inc  has launched a new video beauty brand for millennials in partnership with l oreal paris and maybelline new york  the pretty will offer beauty content to time inc  s 50 million consumer wide audience  with brands like hellogiggles  people  instyle  real simple  essence  peoplestyle  and people en español  the brand hopes to establish itself as a top platform for younger consumers 

 this partnership provides a multi brand platform for l oréal brands to reach audiences who are passionate about beauty through snackable  compelling content   said nadine mchugh  svp omni media  strategic investments and creative solutions  l oréal usa 

the pretty will launch in the summer of 2025  offering 10 weekly videos filmed in los angeles and new york  it will also launch through time inc  s other beauty channels 

image credit  time inc

title: easy to use efoil boards
texto:
easy to use efoil boards the lift5 from lift foils is an advanced efoil  electric hydrofoil  designed for enhanced performance and user experience  featuring a streamlined carbon fiber body with a double concave bottom for smooth touchdowns and sharper chine rails for crisp transitions  the lift5 is engineered for simplicity and efficiency  the lift connect system  lcs  allows for tool free assembly  enabling users to easily attach the wings  mast  and propulsion components with a simple click  additionally  the lift5 boasts a double walled battery with an inline cooling system  making it the quietest efoil available 

designed primarily for gliding across relatively flat water surfaces  the lift5 offers a quiet and smooth ride  its wireless connectivity  one touch startup  and redesigned accessories  such as ergonomic board bags and a battery backpack  enhance the overall user experience  the lift5 represents a significant advancement in efoil technology  combining innovative engineering with surf inspired design to deliver unparalleled performance and reliability 

image credit  lift foils

title: chickpea protein toppers
texto:
chickpea protein toppers salads can be transformed from simple to seemingly chef crafted with the addition of a flavorful  texture packed topper like the chickpea protein toppers served up by all day 

all day s chickpea protein crunch products are available in varieties like cracked pepper parmesan  garlic parsley  and spicy jalapeño  bringing the perfect balance of crispness and indulgence to every bite  beyond flavor  these plant based  soy free  gluten free toppers are packed with a serving of plant powered protein complete with all nine essential amino acids  beyond salads  these toppers are ready to sprinkle over everything from popcorn to macaroni and cheese 

like all starday foods brands  all day was made possible with machine learning and a proprietary platform to hunt unmet consumer needs on the market  rapidly iterate on development  and launch products in a remarkably short time frame less than six months  in fact

title: farmer focused campaign ads
texto:
farmer focused campaign ads the lay s super bowl ad is taking a heartfelt turn this year  shifting the spotlight from its new  all dressed  flavor to the family farmers who grow its potatoes  in the 60 second spot titled  the little farmer   directed by taika waititi  the pepsico brand celebrates the dedication of american farmers in a touching and visually rich story 

the ad follows a young girl who tends to a single potato  caring for it as it grows    symbolizing the patience and effort of real farmers behind lay s chips  set to a nostalgic cover of  all i want is you  by caroline says  the commercial culminates with a tribute to the 50 family owned farms supplying lay s potatoes  reinforcing the brand s commitment to its roots 

while lay s originally planned to debut its all dressed chips during the super bowl  that ad will now air during snl50  the anniversary special on february 16  for the big game  lay s is choosing authentic storytelling    honoring the hardworking families who make its chips possible 

image credit  lay s

title: high speed pc memory kits
texto:
high speed pc memory kits the g skill cl32 96gb memory kit is a high performance ddr5 module designed for intel based systems  it features a speed of 6800mhz with a cas latency of 32  cl32   offering a significant improvement in both capacity and speed compared to previous models  the kit is available in various configurations  including 2x16gb  2x24gb  2x32gb  and 2x48gb  providing flexibility for users with different system requirements  the memory kit has been validated on intel z790 and z890 platforms  ensuring compatibility and stability for overclocking enthusiasts 

in addition to its impressive specifications  the g skill cl32 96gb memory kit supports intel s xmp 3 0 overclocking profile  allowing for easy memory overclocking via the motherboard bios  the kit is available in different aesthetics  including trident z5 royal  trident z5 rgb  and ripjaws m5 rgb  catering to various user preferences  with its high capacity and performance  the g skill cl32 96gb memory kit is an ideal choice for pc enthusiasts and professionals seeking to maximize their system s capabilities 

image credit  g  skill

title: low sugar hazelnut cocoa spreads
texto:
low sugar hazelnut cocoa spreads gooey is a low sugar hazelnut cocoa spread that was made to meet the demand for a healthier  more sustainable version of a delicious childhood favorite  this vegan friendly chocolatey spread  free from palm oil  and gluten dairy  is all natural and made with just a handful of simple  delicious ingredients  followed by a rich base of hazelnut butter  gooey s ingredient list includes organic agave syrup  liquid allulose  cocoa powder  and a few other additions to create its crave worthy  spoonable flavor and texture  plus salt 

like every starday foods product  gooey was created to satisfy an unmet consumer need  the nyc based company uses a proprietary artificial intelligence platform to find gaps in the market and rapidly launches products to fill those voids in less than half a year

title: small business support initiatives
texto:
small business support initiatives mastercard launches its latest mastercard x pier five small business fund initiative  supporting women owned canadian enterprises with  10 000 grants and mentorship opportunities  the program highlights ten recipients spanning various industries  from sustainable food ventures to indigenous marketplaces  selected businesses include bruized  a toronto based company transforming surplus food into plant based snacks  and lesley hampton  a luxury fashion brand blending indigenous artistry with contemporary design 

the initiative extends beyond financial support  featuring an exclusive networking event in toronto that connects grant recipients with industry mentors and mastercard partners  the diverse cohort includes innovative ventures like imaginable solutions  developing assistive technology for individuals with hand disabilities  and shawish market  an indigenous marketplace platform eliminating vendor fees  this program reflects a growing focus on empowering local  women led businesses across canada while promoting sustainability and social impact in entrepreneurship 

image credit  shutterstock

title: body positive brand campaigns
texto:
body positive brand campaigns dove s super bowl ad is delivering a powerful message about the impact of body criticism on young female athletes  with nearly half of girls dropping out of sports by age 14 due to low body confidence  the brand is tackling a widespread issue head on in its 30 second big game spot 

set to a moving cover of bruce springsteen s  born to run  by h e r   the ad follows a young girl running freely    until she reaches adolescence  where body shaming starts to hold her back  with the stark message that 1 in 2 girls quit sports after being told they don t have the right body type  dove urges parents  coaches  and communities to rethink how they talk to young athletes 

as part of its body confident sport program  dove is offering tools to help girls build resilience and stay in sports  with endorsements from venus williams and billie jean king  this campaign is a movement to keep girls confident on and off the field 

image credit  dove

title: gen z marketed alcoholic beverages
texto:
gen z marketed alcoholic beverages united breweries  ub  has officially launched kingfisher flavours  aiming to attract young  gen z consumers who desire new options in the alcoholic beverage market  this product aligns with gen z s desire for sweeter  unique tastes that reimagine or recontextualize traditional flavors seen on the market  the kingfisher flavours currently have lemon masala and mango berry twist variants  the company also has plans to roll out a marketing scheme to specifically target gen z consumers 

 flavours are a global trend  with around 12  of the beer category s growth coming from flavoured variants   says vikram bahl  chief marketing officer at united breweries   we re seeing this shift in india too  especially among gen z consumers who enjoy experimenting with new products  particularly in the alco bev category  

image credit  united breweries

title: humorous ai forward spots
texto:
humorous ai forward spots godaddy unveiled its super bowl lix advertisement   act like you know   highlighting the capabilities of  godaddy airo   an ai powered platform designed to assist small business owners in quickly establishing an online presence  the ad  featuring walton goggins in his super bowl debut  humorously demonstrates how godaddy airo helps entrepreneurs create a professional image even if they lack prior experience 

the commercial opens with goggins reflecting on his ability to convincingly take on roles outside his expertise  such as detective  astronaut  and race car driver  the focus shifts to his business venture   walton goggins goggle glasses   a company that  creates stylish goggle glasses hybrids for all types of adventures  with the help of godaddy airo  goggins develops his website  logo  and social media content  

the ad emphasizes godaddy s mission to empower entrepreneurs with ai driven solutions  making it easier for them  to confidently launch and grow their businesses  

image credit  godaddy

title: inclusive denim campaigns
texto:
inclusive denim campaigns torrid unveils its spring 2025  jeans for life  denim campaign  showcasing a comprehensive collection designed specifically for curvy fashion enthusiasts  the campaign emphasizes the brand s expertise in creating denim that combines precise fit engineering with trend forward designs  the collection features updated silhouettes including relaxed fits  artful distressing  and seasonal light washes  all crafted with torrid s signature attention to comfort and durability 

accompanying the launch  torrid introduces its  bottoms up  promotion  an omnichannel initiative offering tiered savings through a buy more  save more structure  this strategic pricing approach allows customers to build their dream denim wardrobe while maximizing value  the campaign reinforces torrid s position as a denim authority in the plus size fashion space  delivering pieces that promise both longevity and style versatility for every wardrobe need 

the entire torrid jeans for life collection is available to purchase online and in store 

image credit  torrid

title: zero sugar soda challenges
texto:
zero sugar soda challenges pepsi is reintroducing the  pepsi challenge   now featuring  pepsi zero sugar   after a nationwide taste test showed that pepsi zero sugar is preferred for its flavor and refreshment compared to  coca cola zero   this marks the brand s effort to promote pepsi zero sugar as the leading zero sugar cola 

the original pepsi challenge  was launched 50 years ago  becoming a significant part of the cola wars  the campaign invited consumers to participate in blind taste tests  comparing pepsi to coca cola  and revealed a preference for pepsi   this campaign not only influenced the beverage industry but also shifted marketing strategies  emphasizing consumer choice and taste 

as part of the current initiative  pepsi will host a nationwide tour  offering over a million people the opportunity to taste pepsi zero sugar  the tour will begin in new orleans during super bowl lix weekend  engaging participants in the competitive atmosphere of the event 

image credit  pepsi

title: gut friendly seasoned rice blends
texto:
gut friendly seasoned rice blends some types of rice can be difficult to digest  resulting in bloating and digestive discomfort  but cozumi sets itself apart as a brand specializing in gut friendly seasoned rice blends  these flavorful rice blends tested to meet low fodmap certification standards also meet the needs of other consumers with specialty dietary needs or preferences  such as gluten free  plant based  and allium free 

these gut friendly seasoned rice blends made without potential triggers like garlic and onion are available in varieties like smoky spicy tomato chile with paprika  turmeric curry with ginger and coconut  and umami lemongrass bamboo 

cozumi is one of the brands brought to market by starday foods  a company that uses a proprietary ai platform to identify  and then satisfy unmet consumer needs in less than six months

title: demolition derby game sequels
texto:
demolition derby game sequels wreckfest 2  developed by bugbear entertainment and published by thq nordic  is the highly anticipated sequel to the popular full contact racing game  wreckfest  set to launch in early access on march 20  2025  the game promises to deliver even more intense crashes  deeper component damage  and absolute vehicular mayhem  the developers have overhauled the physics engine to enhance realism and provide players with a more immersive experience  the game features a variety of gameplay modes  including racing  derby  and multiplayer  with a completely revamped career mode that adapts to individual playstyles 

in wreckfest 2  players can expect to race in old  rusty  and patched together vehicles  each with its own unique story  the game emphasizes customization  allowing players to build and modify their cars to create the ultimate wrecking machine  with new tracks  vehicles  and special challenges being added throughout early access  wreckfest 2 aims to offer a dynamic and ever evolving gameplay experience  the game also supports mods  enabling the community to contribute to the game s content and extend its longevity 

image credit  bugbear

title: nutritious free from crackers
texto:
nutritious free from crackers habeya is a creator of school safe  better for you snacks made without the top nine allergens  soon  the brand will be ready to introduce products like organic sweet potato crackers and a snack mix with pretzels fueled by similarly wholesome  plant powered ingredients 

these vegan friendly  soy free  nut free  sesame free  gluten free snacks by habeya provide the crispness all ages love  plus the nutritious benefits that parents and caregivers love to provide  and the ingredient exclusions that so many require to align with special dietary needs 

habeya is an innovation out of starday foods  a company that uses an artificial intelligence platform to locate unmet consumer needs on the market and rapidly satisfy demand  according to stayday foods   our proprietary platform of tools enables us to launch new brands and products to market in less than six months

title: unconventional pizza pairings
texto:
unconventional pizza pairings pizza and wine are a match made in heaven with the yellow tail x domino s collaboration  here to challenge the status quo  this partnership proves that a bold red blend is just as worthy of a pizza night as your go to beer  this limited edition yellow tail   domino s red blend is crafted to perfectly complement a classic domino s cheese pizza and an array of favorite toppings  making your casual night in feel a little more elevated 

but this partnership isn t just about great taste    it s about innovation  select bottles feature  twist tap order   technology  an industry first bottle cap that lets you order pizza straight from your smartphone with a simple tap  no app searching  no extra steps    just twist off the cap  tap your phone  and get pizza delivered instantly 

 with this collab  we re making pizza night even more fun and effortless   says dan kleinman  chief brand officer at yellow tail  domino s chief marketing officer  kate trumbull  adds   we love pushing the boundaries of convenience  and this is a game changer  

image credit  ad age

title: eye friendly monitor technologies
texto:
eye friendly monitor technologies for those who spend long hours in front of a screen  the  hannspree hybri monitor  offers a revolutionary solution that reduces eye strain without sacrificing color or functionality  this innovative display combines transmissive lcd technology with reflective e paper principles  creating a transflective screen that adapts to different lighting conditions    offering a paper like experience without the traditional downsides of e ink 

unlike standard lcd or oled screens  which require harsh backlighting  the hybri monitor reflects ambient light  mimicking the way ink appears on paper  this significantly reduces blue light exposure  helping to prevent eye fatigue and disrupted sleep cycles  a low power 50 nit led backlight can be activated in dim environments  providing just enough illumination without overloading your vision 

designed for bright workspaces  the hannspree hybri monitor is a game changer for professionals  students  and creatives who need comfortable  extended screen time 

image credit  yanko design

title: sweetly tart sodas
texto:
sweetly tart sodas dr pepper has recently introduced its newest permanent flavor   dr pepper blackberry   which is available in regular and  zero sugar  versions  this addition combines the signature bold taste of dr pepper with the sweet and tart flavor of blackberry  creating a unique offering for consumers 

in addition to its innovation   dr pepper blackberry joins the brand s established portfolio  which includes popular flavors like dr pepper strawberries   cream and dr pepper cherry   this expansion highlights dr pepper s ongoing commitment to diversifying its product range 

moreover  the new flavor will be available in 12 oz  12 packs across retailers across the united states  furthermore   for a limited time  both regular and zero sugar versions will be offered in 20 oz  bottles   with dr pepper blackberry zero sugar available exclusively in this format for the next two months 

image credit  dr  pepper

title: concentrated waterless cleansers
texto:
concentrated waterless cleansers the water wise pea size power face cleanser is a game changing skincare innovation from colep consumer products that delivers a high performance formula with minimal waste  the concentrated zero water formula boasts 94  natural origin ingredients and is packaged in an aluminum tube for reduced environmental impact  thanks to its form  only a minimal amount of product needs to be dispensed at a time  and virtually every drop can be squeezed out with the aid of a tube squeezer roller key 

although water is commonly the first ingredient in skincare products  this one does away with it and lets customers activate the cleansing formula with water at the time of use 

colep consumer products  water wise pea size power face cleanser is a finalist for the it award at makeup in los angeles 2025

title: local inspired charming salons
texto:
local inspired charming salons the team at kyiv based architecture firm hvyla design are the minds behind the design of ukrainian beauty brand gxbar  it has gotten a new location in the vibrant city of barcelona  where there is a celebration of mediterranean charm throughout the space 

the interiors celebrate barcelona without a doubt as there is a blend of warm tones paired with subtle sandy touches and bold blue details  the same notion simultaneously nods to the brand s distinct language as well  the team drew inspiration from locals to form a space that feels modern yet rooted in the surroundings  the interior layout is thoughtful  and sections are divided into various zones of the services that gxbar offers to customers 

image credit  hvylya design

title: revived crayon collections
texto:
revived crayon collections for the first time in its 122 year company history  crayola is bringing back a collection of eight fan favorite retired crayon colors including dandelion  retired in 2017  blizzard blue  retired in 2003  and orange red  violet blue  lemon yellow  and raw umber  retired in 1990  the nostalgic limited edition retired colors 8 count crayon pack brings back these beloved colors and more from decades past 

crayola will also partner with key licensees who will offer custom programs and products inspired by the limited edition colors  such as lee  caboodles  s well  and other lifestyle  fashion  and beauty brands 

alongside this limited edition retired crayon pack  crayola will introduce limited edition collection colored pencil and limited edition collection marker packs  bringing the beloved colors to different formats

title: athlete centric cosmetics partnerships
texto:
athlete centric cosmetics partnerships revlon canada has announced its partnership with olympian and professional hockey player sarah nurse  who will be the brand s first canadian ambassador  nurse joins other global revlon ambassadors  including madelyn cline and ashley graham  and will represent the  colorstay  collection throughout 2025 

as part of this collaboration  nurse will be  featured across multiple marketing channels  such as in store displays  social media  digital platforms  and events  

sarah nurse commented on the partnership  noting that revlon s colorstay range is a key part of her daily routine  stating   whether i m preparing for game day or going about my everyday life  i rely on the colorstay products   i m looking forward to inspiring canadian women to feel confident in their pursuits  

krista cunningham  general manager of revlon canada  emphasized the alignment between nurse s impact as a canadian athlete and revlon s brand values of empowerment and independence 

image credit  revlon

title: stylish fashion campaigns
texto:
stylish fashion campaigns marc jacobs unveils its spring 2025  marcworld   campaign  spearheaded by jermaine daley as campaign stylist  is designed to present an immersive brand experience that  integrates fashion  luxury  and design  by emphasizing fashion as a lifestyle rather than just an aesthetic choice  the campaign creates a dynamic space where style and innovation intersect  

featuring rolf schrader  anok yai  and georgia palmer  the campaign highlights key pieces from the spring 2025 collection  at the forefront is  the dual   a handbag  crafted from smooth italian leather that balances style and functionality   designed with versatility in mind  it features a j marc turn lock closure and an interlocking j marc handle detail with subtle engraving  moreover  the bag can be worn as a shoulder bag or carried with its leather top handle  making it adaptable for various occasions 

beyond showcasing new designs  marcworld focuses on self expression and individuality as the season progresses  the campaign will unfold in multiple phases  further expanding on the brand s evolving vision 

image credit  matt   kat

title: quirky pizza chain ads

texto:

title: health conscious hydration drinks
texto:
health conscious hydration drinks bodyarmor is expanding its reach in canada with the launch of bodyarmor zero sugar  a new hydration drink designed for active lifestyles  building on its growing popularity in the canadian market  this drink offers zero sugar and zero carbs  making it a great choice for health conscious consumers  bodyarmor zero sugar is packed with over 800mg of potassium rich electrolytes  along with vitamins c  e  and b to help support your active day  with natural flavors and no artificial colors  it delivers a clean  refreshing taste in two delicious options  fruit punch and lemon lime

title: plumping retinol eye creams
texto:
plumping retinol eye creams introducing the new eight saints smooth sailing retinol eye cream  launching march 1st for  46  this eye cream is specially designed for the delicate skin around your eyes  its powerful formula combines clinically proven retinol which boosts collagen production to strengthen thinning skin with hyaluronic acid that deeply hydrates and plumps tired eyes  green tea is also included to soothe irritation and neutralize free radicals that can cause premature aging 

in addition to retinol  the cream features vitamin b5  known for its calming and hydrating benefits  this lightweight  fast absorbing formula helps reduce fine lines  wrinkles  redness  and uneven skin tone  making it a great choice whether used alone or alongside another eight saints eye cream 

for best results  massage a small amount onto dry skin around the eyes daily  or start with twice a week if you have sensitive skin

title: mindful functional browsers
texto:
mindful functional browsers opera air is a browser designed to support personal well being by integrating mindfulness tools directly into the browsing experience  in addition to its core functions  the browser offers features like  breathing exercises  meditation  binaural beats  and positive affirmations  

likewise  the minimalist scandinavian design with a frosted glass interface creates a calming atmosphere  additionally  opera air s  take a break  feature provides mindfulness exercises  such as breathing techniques and body scans  ranging from 3 to 15 minutes  users can set reminders for regular breaks 

the  boosts  feature uses binaural beats to influence brainwave activity  promoting relaxation  focus  or a meditative state  options like  creativity boost  and  deep relaxation  allow for customized experiences with adjustable volume  nature sounds  and background music  boosts can be set for various lengths of time 

overall  opera air blends mindfulness seamlessly into daily browsing  helping users maintain focus and calm while working or browsing

title: family caregivers support apps
texto:
family caregivers support apps amintro family is a free online community for anyone caring for an aging parent  friend  or family member  it connects you with others who share similar experiences  so you don t have to face caregiving challenges alone  when you join  you gain access to a supportive forum where members exchange practical advice  share tips  and discuss the ups and downs of caring for loved ones 

the platform also offers a rich library of resources to help you care for your family member while taking care of yourself  you can explore expert advice on caregiving  learn about best practices  and avoid burnout  additionally  amintro family features a marketplace with special offers from trusted partners  plus events to meet and connect with other caregivers 

 family caregivers provide essential support in countless ways   explains rick lauber  author of caregiver s guide for canadians and the successful caregiver s guide as well as a former co caregiver   these responsibilities take a toll   physically  mentally  emotionally  and financially  instead of dismissing these challenges  family caregivers must learn to navigate them  amintro family offers guidance on what to expect from others  practical strategies for managing caregiving duties  access to valuable resources  stress management techniques  and  most importantly  reassurance that they are not alone  

image credit  amintro family

title: dermatological hair systems
texto:
dermatological hair systems cerave has expanded its skincare expertise into the haircare category with its new gentle hydrating shampoo and conditioner system  the dermatologist developed duo features the brand s signature ceramide enriched formula  combined with hyaluronic acid to maintain the scalp s moisture barrier while cleansing  this scientific approach to haircare represents a growing convergence between skincare and haircare formulations  with products that focus on scalp health as the foundation for healthy hair 

the sulfate free  fragrance free system caters to all hair types  including color treated hair and various curl patterns  positioning itself as a universal solution for consumers seeking gentle yet effective haircare  at  12 99 cad per product  the line maintains cerave s accessible price point while delivering dermatological benefits  the allergy tested formulas exclude common irritants such as phthalates  dyes  parabens  and mit  methylisothiazolinone   reflecting the brand s commitment to creating products suitable for sensitive skin and scalp conditions 

image credit  cerve

title: japanese tamari sets
texto:
japanese tamari sets san j  a japanese soy sauce producer with a history dating back to 1804  has introduced its  tamarimaniac  line  further expanding on its legacy of traditional fermentation methods passed down over eight generations 

the first set  the  premium crafted tamari set   features  double brewed tamari  saishikomi   this variety is made by fermenting soybeans in brewed tamari  rather than brine  which results in a rich  intense flavor with twice the umami of regular soy sauce   notably  this double brewing method is rare  with only 1  of soy sauce produced using this process 

additionally  the set includes  seaweed tamari   a blend of  kombu  shiitake mushrooms  and rice koji  which is fermented to create a flavor profile similar to traditional dashi  

in addition to these offerings  san j provides a  diy tamari dashi kit   allowing users to craft their own dashi with customizable ingredients 

image credit  san j

texto:

title: coffee kindess initiatives
texto:
