for intense hydration  the  cashmere whipped oil butter  offers 72 hours of rich moisture with a barrier strengthening formula  perfect for dry climates  nighttime treatments  or extra tlc  if you prefer lightweight hydration with a glow  the  cashmere body oil  delivers a velvet finish and 24 hour weightless moisture  locking in hydration and enhancing the vanilla cashmere fragrance  to complete the ritual  the  cashmere lip butter  combines skincare inspired peptides and the cashmere cmooth  complex  giving lips a soft  plump  and protected finish    all while indulging in a creamy vanilla flavor 

available now on amazon and target  with a february 7 launch on eos  official site  these new additions are making skincare luxurious 

image credit  eos

title: music producer condiments
texto:
music producer condiments the heinz mustard x mustard has been unveiled as a new collaborative condiment created by the prepackaged goods company and the grammy award winning producer  the condiment was showcased during the grammy awards ceremony and features the recognizable profile of the heinz mustard bottle  but with a bejeweled profile that s suitable for mustard himself  the collaboration also sees mustard donning the chief mustard officer moniker  and is expected to be an integral part of the brand s upcoming events and more 

mustard spoke on the heinz mustard x mustard collaboration saying   this collab coming to life is a big deal and something that has been decades in the making for me  everyone knows me for my beats and sound  but what they don t know is that cooking and grilling is a huge part of my life  i m on the grill every chance i get  i ve been using heinz since i was a kid  so partnering with them is something i ve always wanted to do  

image credit  heinz  hypebeast  mustardxmustard

title: rotating lens short throw projectors
texto:
rotating lens short throw projectors the fujifilm zuh6000 ultra short throw projector is engineered with versatility in the spotlight to provide installers with the perfect unit for a wide range of personal and professional setups  the projector is capable of throwing images up to 100 inches in size from a very short distance and is equipped with a rotating lens that will enable installation in a wider range of locations  this will enable the projected image to be shifted without having to reposition the entire unit to make it a versatile addition to any space 

the fujifilm zuh6000 ultra short throw projector is rated to pump out up to 6 000 lumens of brightness and is slated to launch in 06   in black and white finish options with pricing yet to be announced 

image credit  fujifilm

title: valentine s ready spring capsules
texto:
valentine s ready spring capsules as valentine s day approaches  uniqlo has stocked the perfect spring essentials to keep you and your loved ones stylish and cozy  the brand offers trending pieces like the merino cardigan in pink  which works as great transitional piece  easily shifting from winter to spring with a festive touch  for sweater lovers  the unisex milano ribbed sweater in off white and red is perfect for him or her  while the cashmere sweaters in red  women s  and natural  men s  add a luxe pop of color 

the standout accessory of the season is the round mini shoulder bag in pink and off white  available in 12 colors  uniqlo s basics like the ultra warm t shirt  fleece turtleneck  and crew neck t shirt are essential for layering and styling  while their coats  including the seamless down short coat and hybrid down coat  are perfect for keeping warm and stylish on chilly date nights 

image credit  uniqlo

title: comfort forward high heels
texto:
comfort forward high heels the vida collection by antonia saint ny is redefining what it means to wear high heels  designed for those who refuse to sacrifice comfort for style  this revolutionary lineup brings luxury craftsmanship from spain  innovative comfort technology  and a timeless aesthetic    without the painful trade offs 

created by antonia saint dunbar  co founder of thinx period underwear  the fab five lineup blends sneaker like softness with the sophistication of a 90mm  3 5 inch  stiletto heel  featuring a patented slim softsurround  system  these heels provide full foot cushioning  arch support  and sculpted heel cups    so you can strut  not suffer 

with five distinct silhouettes     classic    sweetheart    half d orsay    d orsay lasso   and  t strap     each style is available in sizes 5 11  plus custom options for half sizes  4  12  13  and varied widths  whether you prefer black nappa  mocha suede  or embossed textures  there s a vida heel to complement your wardrobe 

image credit  antonia saint ny

title: valentine s day cereal lines
texto:
valentine s day cereal lines general mills is bringing back the beloved heart shaped cheerios just in time for valentine s day  offering a special edition in flavors like honey nut and chocolate  each box features heart shaped cereal pieces  and this year  the boxes are personalized with names like  brother  and  abuela   making it a perfect gift for your loved ones 

alongside heart shaped cheerios  general mills is launching several new products for the season  cinnamon toast crunch strawberry and new loaded cereals in s mores and chocolate strawberry for a treat filled start to your day 

for cozy moments or parties  consumers can try out the betty crocker soft baked cookie mixes in birthday cake batter and chocolate caramel or pillsbury red velvet cookie dough with oreo  plus  shareable snacks like seasonal gushers tropical fruit snacks  fruit by the foot minis  and chex mix muddy buddies are perfect for spreading love with friends and family 

image credit  general mills

title: iconic extra spicy hot sauces
texto:
iconic extra spicy hot sauces the cholula extra hot hot sauce is being launched by the mexican hot sauce brand as its latest creation that builds on the success of its original recipe  the product features the same ingredients as the original cholula hot sauce  but is blended with spiciness in mind as a response to increasing calls from consumers for spicier flavors  the hot sauce relies on the original family recipe as the base with arbol and piquin peppers alongside vibrant spices to achieve the perfect balance 

the cholula extra hot hot sauce is headed to retailers this spring to provide shoppers with a great option to try out with their choice of cuisine  the hot sauce comes in five ounce bottles and features a suggested price point of  3 99

title: connected ceramic charcoal grills
texto:
connected ceramic charcoal grills the big joe konnected joe is a connected outdoor cooking solution engineered with the essential needs of today s avid chef in mind to help them craft a range of recipes with ease  the charcoal grill is characterized by its ceramic construction that can reach temperatures up to 700 degree fahrenheit and weighs in at 60 pounds less than one of the brand s other models  the unit will provide up to 450 square inches of cooking space to maximize versatility for chefs 

the big joe konnected joe boasts built in wifi that will enable chefs to monitor performance from anywhere in the home for a more hands off approach  the kontrol board on the front of the unit provides access to a range of data including temperature  graphs  alerts and more 

image credit  kamada joe

title: first responder bbq meals
texto:
first responder bbq meals dickey s first responders relief combo has been created by the barbecue brand as a new offering that will help to support first responders in the face of the california wildfires  the meal puts the hot honey bbq chicken sandwich in the spotlight in your choice of either smoked or crispy finish alongside a side of barbecue beans and the brand s signature big yellow cup  the meal will be on offer through february 2025 with a portion from every one sold donated to relief efforts for those affected by the wildfires 

ceo laura rea dickey spoke on the dickey s first responders relief combo saying   at dickey s  we stand with our first responders in times of crisis  these brave men and women put their lives on the line to protect our communities  and we are honored to support them through this initiative both in our restaurants and through the dickey foundation

title: exclusive japanese restaurant vodkas
texto:
exclusive japanese restaurant vodkas sexy fish vodka has bene created in collaboration between the restaurant and hawkridge distillers in the uk as an exclusive spirit that pays homage to the japanese restaurant 

the spirit is double distilled to ensure quality before being triple filtered for impressive purity and comes finished with a touch of honey for a well rounded taste profile  the spirit is bottled with a 42  abv and reported to have rich umami notes alongside light  subtle flavors  the spirit is available now at the restaurant s three locations in london  manchester and miami 

director of beverage at caprice holdings xavier landais spoke on the sexy fish vodka saying   at sexy fish  we focus on delivering the best 360 degree experience across dining and drinking  so creating our own vodka was a natural step  distilled in england from the finest local grain  sexy fish vodka offers bold  smooth flavour and a luminous label that makes it a striking centrepiece for any celebration   a nod to our sexy fish spirit

title: skylight topped english pool houses
texto:
skylight topped english pool houses british design firm klas hyllén architecture has completed the malvern pool house    it has been added to an existing home in warwickshire  the design is defined by its cathedral like style with timber ceilings to shelter the pool home  it is formed of two volumes    one side has a swimming pool and the other has spaces to change  a wine cellar  and a space for meditation  they are connected and added to the existing home by glazed links 

the founder of the studio  klas hyllén told dezeen  we wanted it to feel almost monastic  and inspiration came from quite austere spaces such as the sankt petri church in klippan  sweden by lewerentz or the bishop edward king chapel by niall mclaughlin  it s about all the senses  acoustics  temperature  tactility and the smell of water on brick  which gives off this very pleasant mineral scent  the most significant moment is probably floating on your back while taking in the exquisite timber  it s backstroke only here as you stargaze into the cosmos for a spot of night swimming  

image credit  hyde films

title: italian informed loft extensions
texto:
italian informed loft extensions london based design firm oeb architects has completed the structure of the lewisham loggias  which is a bright loft extension that is inspired by italian palazzos and art works  the design project adds an additional floor to the home in south london and it is for a couple isabel and jaime who are accommodating their growing family 

eland and baird stated the design by asking their clients to create a mood board comprised of art  objects  details  and more  eland noted to dezeen   one of the most exciting parts of our job is to see how these references can combine with the more functional aspects of a brief  isabel and jamie responded really well to this task  preparing a rich collection of references including memories of holidays  times with family  art they liked and little details on the house they enjoyed  

image credit  taran wilkhu

title: comfortable foam seating series
texto:
comfortable foam seating series a number of sustainability focused designers including lilian van daal and richard hutten have contributed to the rethink softly project originally by rianne koens  it is dedicated to forming seating that does not use polyurethane foam  the project kicked off to inspire the industry to reduce the use of the material 

rianne koens explains   the clients of deberenn are mostly projects  projects do not need fluffy  bulky soft seating  there we can go very minimalistic  a product giving you enough comfort for 50 minutes is doing a perfect job  many companies are trying now to replicate or to work with alternative foams in the same traditional way we re creating our soft seating now  but if you re going to be much higher in price  you can t compete and it s not a solution  

image credit  richard hutten  rianne koens  lilian van daal

title: game day boneless wings
texto:
game day boneless wings the jack in the box crispy boneless wings are headed to participating locations to provide customers with a deliciously textural chicken option for enjoyment for a limited time only  the menu item comes in three options to choose from including classic crispy  smoke show and honey garlic  which are each crafted with premium chicken an extra crispy breading before being cooked to perfection  the boneless wings each come served with a buttermilk ranch dipping sauce that offers additional flavor and texture in every bite 

the jack in the box crispy boneless wings come in six  12 and 18 piece orders as well as in six and 12 piece combo meals  which are all perfect for picking up for super bowl festivities

title: mid century home renovation projects
texto:
mid century home renovation projects the founders of new york based design firm bond have renovated a mid century house dubbed the fire island home as it is nestled in fire island pines  after the two visited and enjoyed the island over the course of years  husbands noam dvir and daniel rauchwerger purchased the cottage  the two approached the renovation by modernizing the home to represent their own aesthetics whilst honoring the original build 

the team at bond shared   the island retreat is bond s personal reinterpretation of the experimental homes that were built there in the 1950s and 60s led by visionary architects like harry bates  marcel bretos  earl combs  and the prolific horace gifford  calling it a machine for voyeurism  everything is on display   said the team  which aimed to  execute the fine line of both sexual playfulness and desire  

image credit  chris mottalini

title: plant based salad boosters
texto:
plant based salad boosters salad toppers can make healthy eating more delicious with added flavor and texture that transforms simple dishes into satisfying  crave worthy meals  and bean vivo s salad protein booster simultaneously delivers a serving of plant based protein and fiber 

the hint of lemon salad protein booster is made with wholesome ingredients like red and white quinoa  and edamame  plus lemon juice  extra virgin olive oil  and sea salt to pack flavor into not just salads but also bowls and wraps  bean vivo says   our favorite way to enjoy is with kale  red onion  cucumber  and radishes and a dijon mustard vinaigrette  

bean vivo s hint of lemon flavor is the newest salad protein booster and it joins customer favorite varieties like garlic   herb and seasoned

title: sleek tonal layered footwear
texto:
sleek tonal layered footwear new balance introduces a new tonal variation of the 990v6 sneaker model with the salmon colorway to join its roster this season  the iconic model is doused in hues of salmon and accents of white to add some tonal contrast  the official launch date for the colorway is february 14th 

it is finished in a light orange color throughout the entire upper which is constructed from mesh and suede materials  this adds a touch of breathability at the base and then soft durability overlaying on top  the new balance n logo marks the side with touches of purple continuing at the tongue  the insoles  and the heel  it all rests on top of the encp midsole made with white  black  and gray 

image credit  new balance

title: stealthy collaborative bowling shoes
texto:
stealthy collaborative bowling shoes dover street market participates in a three way collaboration alongside brain dead and adidas originals on a pair of bowling shoes  the silhouette is doused in a stealthy core black colorway palette which is launching for spring 2025  the newest edition revives the 70s model with a modern twist 

the new core black hue is made with premium leather materials in a black hue with soft white to add some tonal contrast and continues with the exposed stitching  the branding arrives in the form of the three stripes motif that can be seen on the panel  more co branding details are on the ankle in a gold hue  with insoles  and monochromatic heel accents applied by embossing 

image credit  adidas

title: extra crispy snacking nuggets
texto:
extra crispy snacking nuggets krispy krunchy chicken chicken nuggets are the latest creation from the brand crafted with taste  texture and snacking occasions in mind to provide consumers with the perfect option to pick up  the menu item consists of white meat chicken breast pieces marinated in a signature seasoning blend before being covered in a special breading and fried to a golden brown  the nuggets can be purchased as part of a six piece meal or a 10 piece order priced at  4 99 and  6 99  respectively 

krispy krunchy chicken chicken nuggets are crafted with on the go snacking occasions in mind and are thus great for enjoying out of the house  the extra crispy texture speaks to increasing demands for more textural experiences amongst consumers  while the cajun spices offer additional interest 

image credit  krispy krunchy chicken

title: roasted rice powders
texto:
roasted rice powders given the global cacao shortage especially in west africa  which supplies 60  of the world s cocoa inventive alternatives like organic roasted brown rice powder are popping up  this brown rice café product  made from 100  organic brown rice  is a caffeine free  gluten free plant based superfood that promises  strong  full bodied roasted aroma like coffee and a rich taste like chocolate   as such  it s ready to be scooped into smoothies and shakes for both sensorial and health benefits  and brown rice café calls its organic roasted brown rice powder  the next matcha  

with the growing need for cocoa alternatives  brands are innovating with ingredients that mimic chocolate s rich color  deep flavor  and enticing aroma  ensuring consumers don t feel like they re missing out on the indulgence they love

title: immunity boosting cooking pastes
texto:
immunity boosting cooking pastes the biona organic ginger turmeric paste is a new cooking product slated to be launched from the brand in the uk that will provide chefs with a way to elevate the flavor and function of their favorite recipes 

the product features a ready to use formulation that s crafted with ginger and turmeric in the mix  and thus perfect for crafting recipes like indian or malaysian curries  the ingredients will aid in digestion  while also contributing towards the reduction of inflammation and the improvement of blood sugar levels  the cooking paste is slated to arrive in the market this march 

brand manager at windmill organics carmen ferguson spoke on the biona organic ginger turmeric paste saying   with recent data from nielsen once again confirming the positive growth trajectory for organic food sales  which are now outperforming non organic  we re excited to bring another sought after and healthy organic option to market  scratch cooking continues to grow in popularity  and particularly south east asian inspired scratch cooking  so we expect this new launch to be well received by consumers

title: purple yam chocolates
texto:
purple yam chocolates as climate challenges and supply concerns impact cacao  brands like galleon chocolate are exploring creative alternatives like purple ube chocolate 

galleon chocolate s ube royale touted as the original purple ube chocolate takes inspiration from ube halaya  a traditional filipino dessert made of ube yam  cream  and sugar  taste wise  galleon chocolate describes ube yam as  a cross between vanilla and pistachio with slight undertones of coconut  

in galleon chocolate s ube chocolate gift set  customers will find the brand s ube royale alongside inventive flavors like ube coconut cream  ube cheesecake  and ube macadamia nuts  another addition  ube goat milk  remixes the original ube royale recipe by trading whole milk for goat milk and promising a flavor experience that will transport tasters to the islands of the philippines

title: symbolic knot inspired footwear
texto:
symbolic knot inspired footwear nike introduces a new lifestyle silhouette model in the form of the dunk low silhouette with the friendship knot iteration to join its roster  the colorway palette is comprised of hues of sail  picante red  flax  and pale ivory throughout the structure  it is inspired by traditional friendship knots and the new version is made up of a unique insole unit that is stamped with instruction graphics on how to tie the symbolic knot 

this contributes to the overarching notion of unity with intricate craftsmanship defining the model followed by a web stitched swoosh logo to create a handwoven effect enhancing its artisanal visual  the model is complete with custom trimmed laces and bespoke embroidered accents at the back 

image credit  nike

title: waterproof color changing bandages
texto:
waterproof color changing bandages drysee bandages are showing off a new function that will provide an indication if a breech has occurred to eliminate the need for guesswork when it comes to changing wound coverings  the bandages feature the liquid alert technology that will change color when water permeates from light blue to a a darker blue color to let the person know that it needs to be swapped out  the waterproof bandages are designed to seal out water and germs  while still providing breathable wound coverage that will stay in place when bathing 

ceo brad greer commented on the new drysee bandages saying   infections are a historical and ongoing plague on the health care system  drysee is a game changer for post procedure care  there is no more ambiguity on the part of the patient  it is visibly obvious when a bandage needs to be changed  this visual cue should help patients be more proactive with their wound care  and help reduce the number of infections

title: history honoring minimal timepieces
texto:
history honoring minimal timepieces seiko introduces a new addition to its collection of presage craftsmanship watches with the newest version of the spb495j1  it is made with an enamel dial that is accented with roman numerals  the watch honors the japanese watch imprint s rich history of precise timekeeping whilst also celebrating its iconic railroad watches 

the spb495j1 is inspired by one of the earliest creations by seiko  the timekeeper pocket watch from 1895  the historical reference elevates the brand s ongoing commitment to delivering accurate and fine craftsmanship  it is made with a refreshed dial interpreted from the original timekeeping with a white enamel dial detailed with a rail track design around the perimeter  this is complete with roman numerals and the handset is finished in a metallic blue 

image credit  seiko

title: crispy squid snacks
texto:
crispy squid snacks people love calamari  but it s usually reserved for sit down dining experiences  limiting how often it s enjoyed but arawoom s crispy squid snack changes that by making it snackable  the sweet and salty fried snack is as beloved by children as it is by adults in korea  and the crispy  flavorful bites deliver anytime indulgence on demand  although this savory  nutritious snack is ready to be enjoyed on its own straight out of the bag  some like to enhance it with their favorite sauces  such as hot sauce or rich and creamy mayonnaise  and adults often enjoy it as an accompaniment to beer 

showcased at the 2025 winter fancy food show in las vegas  this squid snack represents the next wave of cultural food poised to make a splash in north america

title: electric portable stealthy toothbrushes
texto:
electric portable stealthy toothbrushes the new electric toothbrush design by upplang is defined by its premium look and build  it looks like a piece of art with its aluminum alloy construction backed by eco friendly materials  the toothbrush is also sleek in structure with its compact elliptical design that fits easily into a backpack 

upplang realized that a traveling toothbrush of high quality was a gap in the market  there are either weak vibrations  construction  or no care is put into merging oral hygiene with being on the road  this design has a metallic look at the encasing which holds the brush inside along with a prop stand to keep it on the bathroom counter when users are on their trips or mounted to the wall with the suction 

image credit  upplang

title: larch slatted pump houses
texto:
larch slatted pump houses british design firm hugh broughton architects has completed the kew pumping station  it is a timber structure that is formed by interlocking larch slats to form a screen around a pump house in kew gardens  the structure has an oval shape resting over an underground tank that stores 280 000 liters of water  it is a part of a new irrigation technique taking place at the royal botanical gardens 

the project architect of the design  steve mccloy shared with dezeen   the design had to be functionally efficient  economically designed and  as a piece of small architecture  had to achieve a level of sensitivity and design quality worthy of its famously beautiful surroundings   he adds   the side elevation of the enclosure  which is made up of an array of interlocking self similar timber modules  recalls the palm fronds that are gloriously displayed in kew s most iconic glasshouse  

image credit  dirk lindner

title: realistic sketch reflective furniture
texto:
realistic sketch reflective furniture jinil park imagines the drawing series of furniture  which is a visually deceptive and beautiful capsule of furniture  each piece looks like it has been literally drawn on a piece of paper but it is truly a tangible and three dimensional product  park s design notion centers on the distortion of lines which he believes captures the designer s emotions  artistic expression  and state of mind 

park drew lines freely and discovered the liberating line on paper  creating strokes that led to the development of the objects  his furniture is not just functional    it is a statement piece that becomes the focal point of any room  the sketch like look allows the look to blend into any space  especially for children to foster their creativity 

image credit  jinil park

title: hybrid dating apps
texto:
hybrid dating apps a new generation of singles  frustrated with algorithms stacked against them and the addictive nature of dating apps  is turning to fresh  different experiences provided by alternatives like when we first the first dating app created by a professional matchmaker  based on a hybrid model that combines elements of online dating with traditional offline matchmaking  when we first officially launches on valentine s day 2025 

when we first sets users up for success with data driven online tools to help them identify their most engaging profile photos and helps them feel safe when connecting to verified profiles  the app also introduces the human button  a feature that lets them connect with real life matchmakers for personalized tips and advice  as well as curated date guarantees

title: functional smoothie cubes
texto:
functional smoothie cubes bumpin  blends teamed up with lifestyle influencer caitlin covington to create caitlin s clean green smoothie  a convenient  superfood packed recipe in the form of cubes ready to blend with one s choice of milk 

all organic mango  banana  celery  lemon  spinach  and ginger root form the base of the smoothie  which also gets a kick and additional benefits from turmeric and black pepper  these easy to use smoothie cubes are packaged with a qr code to familiarize new customers with the process of making their instantly blended beverage 

smoothie blends can be haphazard when random ingredients are tossed into a blender  often resulting in unbalanced flavors and nutrition  bumpin  blends simplifies smoothie creation with its convenient  frozen cubes  and takes a science led approach to recipe creation  caitlin s clean green smoothie specifically supports inflammation and detoxification

title: hourglass shaped phone concepts
texto:
hourglass shaped phone concepts eduardo gouffran and andrea fanelli work together to create the meti phone concept  reducing the distractions that often come with smartphones and bringing attention to the basics  one of the most common advice for productivity or staying focus is to simply allocate 20 to 25 minutes of time uninterrupted to do deep work 

it sounds simple  but it is a challenge to train our brains to balance tasks from one to another  the meti is the combination of the words  mind  and  time  which is a design notion that works as a digital timer between user and their phones  the hourglass shape is done on purpose as time management is the main function of the meti  it uses a dot matrix grid to show lights trickling down like sand 

image credit  eduardo gouffran  andrea fanelli

title: sardine shaped dark chocolates
texto:
sardine shaped dark chocolates fishwife  the brand bringing tinned fish to a new generation of consumers  teamed up with bixby chocolate for valentine s day to create sardine shaped dark chocolates 

the dark chocolate sardines made in partnership with bixby chocolate were exclusive to fishwife s valentine s day gift pack  consumers who were able to snap up the limited time pack before it sold out will be able to treat themselves to three tinned fish cans  one smoked rainbow trout  one smoked salmon with sweet   spicy zhong  and one albacore tuna in spicy olive oil  plus and a chocolate treat packaged in the same style for dessert 

thanks to this box which also contains a how to eat fishwife sticker sheet a romantic dinner in february need not be overcomplicated

title: geometric structural dynamic homes
texto:
geometric structural dynamic homes house design ideas presents a look at the new pentagone house  which is a tiny house concept that pushes boundaries with its structure  the geometric silhouette creates a more interesting visual and forms a unique way of living 

the dodecahedron has a total of 12 flat surfaces which is closer to a low poly sphere instead of a regular box  each of the surfaces is complete in a pentagonal shape which earns it its namesake  despite its small space  measuring only 915 square feet  and its irregular structure  the design can fit two bedrooms  a powder room  a kitchen  one bathroom  and a living room  additionally  it is fit into two floors with its smart arrangement 

image credit  house design ideas

title: sleek public seating concepts
texto:
sleek public seating concepts hanneke louren is a furniture designer based in california and originally born in south africa    they present the leftover bench structure  the silhouette is made with inspiration drawn from public seating notions  in south africa  public seating in communal spaces is met with creativity  turning milk crates  mismatched chairs  and more into impromptu seating 

the thoughtful approach is the inspiration behind the leftover bench as it is made with south african themes and backed by california craftsmanship  the leftover bench s shape is drawn from a playful blend of structures  this includes a bench  a chair  and a stool    all of these are blended together to create a communal seat using salvaged old growth redwood 

image credit  hanneke louren

title: contemporary privacy screen collections
texto:
contemporary privacy screen collections kfi studios works in collaboration with union design to present the calm system  it is a range of stylish privacy partition screens that take design into consideration  it is comprised of fa luted pattern which has been carefully pressed using recycled plastic felt  it forms a versatile and modular shape that transforms work environments without sacrificing its aesthetics 

the screens are made from recycled plastic felt and are detailed with the aforementioned fluted design  the calm comes as freestanding panels so that it is modular and personalized as needed  the system allows users to connect multiple panels together with the six steel brackets in a range of configurations  this includes   l shaped  zigzag  and even star shaped  

image credit  kfi studios

title: sleek aesthetic air conditioners
texto:
sleek aesthetic air conditioners chinese company xiaomi introduces a look at its latest air conditioning system defined by its sleek design    dubbed the mijia air conditioner natural wind pro with top air vent  it is meant to be mounted at the top of a wall and does not require being near a window 

how it functions by pulling air into the system through the vent at the bottom and pushing cool air along the ceiling  the idea essentially understands that hot air rises and cooling a space would mean that it should start at the top  this same process will simultaneously ensure that cold air is not blasting directly at the subject in the room to cause any discomfort 

image credit  xiaomi

title: frozen tomato sandwich recipes
texto:
frozen tomato sandwich recipes the  tomato ice toast  trend on tiktok has gained popularity among gen z users as a refreshing alternative to traditional avocado toast  this trend involves freezing whole tomatoes and then grating them over a slice of toast  often accompanied by burrata cheese  olive oil  and balsamic vinegar  the result is a cold  crunchy  and savory treat that some describe as a  savoury granita  

while some tiktokers praise the dish for its unique texture and refreshing qualities  others find it unappetizing and question its appeal  the popularity of this trend has led to many consumers and influencers alike creating their variations of the recipe  for example  in taddy s test kitchen episode 5  the hosts experimented with this trend  using farmer s market bread and a combination of in season tomatoes  salt  pepper  oil  whole garlic cloves  and basil to create a flavorful topping 

the trend s viral nature highlights the ever evolving landscape of social media food trends  where unconventional combinations can quickly gain traction and divide opinions  whether it s a fad or a lasting culinary innovation  the tomato ice toast trend underscores the influence of social media on food culture and the willingness of younger generations to explore new flavors and textures  taddy s test kitchen episode 5 showcased how this trend can be adapted with various ingredients  offering a unique twist on a classic dish 

image credit  shutterstock

title: soda inspired chocolates
texto:
soda inspired chocolates fizzy beverages were top of mind when raaka chocolate created the exclusive cherry chocolate cola and raspberry lime rickey chocolates for its first nibs two bar subscription  while one creatively inspired bar treats chocolate lovers to an experience of 62  cacao with the familiar flavors of a rich  dark carbonated soft drink  the other gleans from a mixture of fresh lime juice and soda water sometimes savored with optional add ins like alcohol or sugar 

for february  raaka chocolate s first nibs three bar subscription pairs these two innovative monthly micro batch bars with a romantic rose cardamom flavor  another decadent treat that showcases the unique qualities of unroasted dark chocolate which is naturally fruity and traceable  high quality  organic  transparently traded single origin cacao

title: bamboo parasol community canopies
texto:
bamboo parasol community canopies local design firm the purple ink studio has taken on a unique design challenge by approaching academic buildings and it has covered the tapmi center in india with a canopy  this structure is comprised of parasols which are clad in bamboo    it forms a shelter over the business school s social hub  this extension is on a part of campus which is set against plenty of lush forest valleys 

it is comprised of two white buildings which section into wings  the principal of the purple ink studio  nishita bhatia shares   the campus already hosts several academic buildings  but these often follow a conventional  closed design  they are rigid blocks that  while functional  fail to engage with their surroundings or the students in a meaningful way  our approach was to break away from this norm  

image credit  suryan  dang

title: indulgent snacking friendly puddings
texto:
indulgent snacking friendly puddings the ambrosia deluxe rice pudding range has been expanded by the brand in the uk to provide consumers with a variety of new options that are perfect for snacking occasions  the new pudding flavors include caramlised biscuit and apple   cinnamon  which are both crafted with fresh cream alongside premium ingredients for a rich  thick consistency  the puddings are non hfss to make them permissible treats for consumers to try out this winter 

the new additions to the ambrosia deluxe rice pudding range are expected to be a hit amongst existing fans with a penchant for high quality ambient desserts  the products will also help to build brand awareness amongst consumers seeking out a simple way to enjoy a quick treat

title: dog food topper campaigns
texto:
dog food topper campaigns brutus bone broth  recognized as the leading dog meal topper in the united states  has launched the  skip the sauce challenge  in collaboration with professional football player raheem mostert  running from february 3 to 9  this campaign encourages football fans to experience snacking without sauces  condiments  dips  or flavor enhancers during the peak of the sports season 

in the challenge  participants are  invited to enjoy common snacks  such as wings without ranch or chips without dip  in a way that mirrors how many dogs eat their meals   by refraining from added flavors  the campaign prompts consumers to reflect on why dogs are often expected to eat plain kibble without the enhancement of flavorful meal toppers like bone broth  ultimately  this initiative encourages pet owners to reconsider the importance of providing their pets with more enjoyable  flavor packed meal options 

image credit  brutus bone broth

title: fruit peel lip oils
texto:
fruit peel lip oils lip oils are all the rage  and byroe s banana brulee lip oil promises to take beauty consumers  obsession to the next level by pairing a decadent  dessert like inspiration with a sensorial  plumping formula featuring an upcycled ingredient for a luxe and sustainable twist 

the plant powered lip oil was created to glaze lips with caramel color inspired by banana brulee  all while delivering deep hydration  a shimmery finish  and a warming sensation that results in a fuller looking pout  vitamin rich upcycled banana peel is the star ingredient in the juicy formula and it joins a blend of low molecular weight hyaluronic acid in oil  plus a brulee complex touted as a  torched blend of maple syrup  caramel  cacao  and black sugar that smooths texture  provides essential moisture  and a natural brown tint

title: lifestyle catering molded footwear
texto:
lifestyle catering molded footwear adidas introduces a monochromatic and dynamic update of the harden vol  9 sneaker model with the launch of the molded leather update  the model is set to launch later this year in 07   2025 and it features a simple palette of black and white throughout the silhouette  the athlete works with adidas to move closer to a lifestyle wearing approach 

the signature shoe adds to the six colorways that have already been confirmed and is launching to markets in april  the summer variation is a lifestyle version of the performance model  the upper is coated with leather materials and the three stripes logo is stripped back from the heel and the usual cut outs in an oblong shape are filled 

image credit  adidas

title: historically influenced stool designs
texto:
historically influenced stool designs the loki stool is a simple yet elevated silhouette designed by dutch based designer nick beens  it is rooted in the simplicity of dutch hanseatic craftsmanship and traditions  this is nestled in a rich network of trade and culture which have been expanded from some german towns to nearly 200 settlements in history 

these medieval roots are captured and transformed into the construction and process of the stools  the modern element is retained as it is cleverly integrated into the details of the structure  the loki stool is open in most of its parts  showcasing its joinery and building proudly  notably  the loki stools are easily stackable so storage is made simple  making it highly functional 

image credit  nick beens

title: y2k aesthetic inspired apparel
texto:
y2k aesthetic inspired apparel gloomy bear x sophie powers is the latest fashion collaboration bringing y2k subculture back to life  partnering with harajuku streetwear brand acdc rag  singer and designer sophie powers fuses hyperpop energy with rebellious japanese aesthetics to create a collection that celebrates individuality  bold expression  and counterculture 

the collection debuts february 5  with part 1 embracing the neon soaked visuals of sophie s debut ep   glitch  lvl  1   think vibrant pastels  edgy silhouettes  and punk meets kawaii inspirations  part 2  dropping february 17  shifts into darker  moodier tones  mirroring gloomy bear s dual personality    cute yet dangerous 

this collection isn t just about clothing    it s about community  sophie  gloomy bear  and acdc rag have long championed unapologetic self expression  making this collaboration a perfect fusion of music  fashion  and creativity  fans can see sophie debut the collection live at the gloomy bear tokyo rave on february 8 

image credit  anya gta

title: green tinted sunscreens
texto:
green tinted sunscreens eltamd uv skin recovery is a 100  mineral sunscreen that pairs patented barrier repair technology with the power of color correction to deliver extra care to consumers with sensitive skin or post procedure skin  this lightweight  green tinted formula neutralizes redness and delivers extra soothing with hero ingredients like centella asiatica and ceramides 

lia arvanitidou  phd  the executive vice president of r d in skin health at colgate palmolive eltamd s parent company revealed to allure that the  uv skin recovery spf 50 sunscreen is one of the  top five products of my career  

this sunscreen product with an unusual tint joins other unconventionally colored options on the market like lion pose s ghost buster 100  mineral spf 42 with an orange based formula and unkissed by d you  a capsule sunscreen with a blue color

title: doll inspired bright timepieces
texto:
doll inspired bright timepieces barbie and casio come together as the brand works in collaboration with mattel to bring forces a bright pink iteration to its roster to celebrate barbie  the limited edition watch is set to launch this month    the gma s110be is the model that elevates the toughness into a more playful look 

the captivating watch is doused in barbie s pink hue and followed by intricate branding to truly make it special  the case back is detailed with engraving with the signature barbie silohead whereas the band has the iconic silhouette with the barbie logo seen on the band loop  additionally  there is also a heart motif on the speed indicator dial which forms a playful touch and balances it all out with a charming accent 

image credit  casio g shock  mattel

title: wellness fragrance candles
texto:
wellness fragrance candles as fans of hbo s the white lotus wait for the hit show s third season to begin  they re indulging their senses with collaborative foods and beverages  and the hbo original the white lotus x nest new york candle 

the limited edition cucumber   white sage decorative three wick candle inspires de stressing and refreshing  much like the thai retreat where the episodes will play out  this candle with a wellness inspired fragrance was crafted to inspire a sense of calm renewal and burn evenly so that rooms are infused with a beautiful  premium scent  alongside notes of cucumber and white sage  the hbo original the white lotus x nest new york candle incorporates hints of lavender 

although the candle promises to last  with up to 100 hours of burn time  its collectible glass vessel can be repurposed once finished

title: decadent wintry beverages
texto:
decadent wintry beverages as part of its winter menu expansion  starbucks introduces the  blackberry sage refreshers   blending sweet and herbaceous flavors into its refreshers lineup  designed to offer a refreshing yet balanced option for colder months  these beverages incorporate green coffee extract along with the bold combination of blackberry and sage  resulting in a distinctive flavor and vibrant hue 

the lineup includes several variations  first  the  blackberry sage refresher  features  sweet blackberry flavors enhanced by subtle notes of sage  shaken with ice and green coffee extract  and finished with dried blackberry inclusions and a light dusting of sage   for those seeking a brighter taste  the  blackberry sage lemonade refresher  introduces lemonade for a crisp  tart finish  meanwhile  the  midnight drink  offers a creamy alternative by  blending blackberry and sage flavors with a coconut beverage  

these seasonal beverages will be available in starbucks stores across canada beginning february 4 for a limited time  while supplies last 

image credit  starbucks canada

title: chocolate paired wine kits
texto:
chocolate paired wine kits wine and chocolate are each indulgent on their own  but with thoughtful chocolate and wine pairings  their flavors enhance one another  creating a richer  more complex tasting experience  this is the experience explored in vinebox s february box of the month  which promises to be perfect for those who want to treat themselves or a loved one to a decadent tasting experience to enhance their appreciation of both wine and chocolate 

described as  a love letter to wine lovers   this curated monthly box from vinebox includes five red wines and one white wine in 100ml vials  plus six moonstruck chocolates  to sweeten the experience  tasting notes  chocolate pairing recommendations  and access to sommelier led virtual tasting videos are included with the purchase

title: lobster shaped luxury bags
texto:
lobster shaped luxury bags french fashion house louis vuitton turned heads during paris fashion week when its new lobster bag made an appearance  the accessory is a part of the fashion house s fall winter 2025 collection    specifically  it is a part of the collaborative work with pharrell williams  lv s menswear creative director  and nigo 

the bag is made from vachetta leather and the premium material is integrated with the signature monogram canvas material interpreted with a lobster like silhouette  it even features details such as the pincers  antennae  and legs  this theme extends beyond the bag itself as it is seen in the rest of the collection as well  there are smaller charms shaped like the crustacean and decorate other accessories 

image credit  louis vuitton

title: plumping phyto mucin serums
texto:
plumping phyto mucin serums byoma  creator of barrier boosting skincare solutions  added the phyto mucin glow serum to its soothing  supportive  problem solving skincare product range beloved by gen alpha and gen z 

touted as a  daily super serum   phyto mucin glow serum creates skin so smooth and radiant it appears reflective and according to external clinical tests  byoma s new phyto mucin glow serum brightens skin tone by up to 22  and reduces redness by up to 34   resulting in a clinically proven stronger skin barrier  this plumping formula with a barrier lipid complex also reduces fine lines and water loss  and boosts hydration  the elasticity of skin  and the production of collagen 

byoma s latest product  made with phyto mucin  is a biobased alternative to tiktok viral snail mucin skincare  ensuring no snails are harmed to produce this product

title: spice infused specialty beers
texto:
spice infused specialty beers bud light has partnered with tajín to introduce the bud light chelada tajín chile limón  a new variation of the traditional chelada beer  this innovative beverage combines the refreshing taste of bud light with the distinctive flavors of tajín clásico seasoning  which includes mild chili peppers  lime  and sea salt  the result is a mildly spicy and zesty beer that offers a unique twist on the classic chelada  appealing to consumers who enjoy a bit of heat in their drinks 

the bud light chelada tajín chile limón is available in 25 ounce cans and is designed to provide a flavorful and refreshing experience  the collaboration between bud light and tajín aims to cater to fans of both brands by offering a new and exciting beverage option  this product reflects bud light s commitment to innovation and understanding of consumer preferences  while also bringing the beloved taste of tajín to a wider audience 

image credit  bud light

title: celeb approved spring campaigns
texto:
celeb approved spring campaigns isabel marant unveils its spring 2025 campaign with an unexpected yet electrifying pairing  ateez s seonghwa and supermodel icon kate moss  the campaign bridges past and future  showcasing marant s signature effortless cool through parisian chic  bohemian influences  and contemporary k pop energy 

for seonghwa  this marks his first ever fashion campaign    a natural evolution after his buzzworthy appearance at isabel marant s paris fashion week show last 09    the k pop star brings a fresh  relaxed confidence to the homme collection  blending structured silhouettes with an edgy  laid back aesthetic  faux leather pants  tailored trousers  and cozy knits define this unpredictable yet effortlessly cool season 

kate moss  a longtime muse of the brand  returns after her 2010 campaign  reinforcing marant s timeless appeal   kate is the embodiment of effortless chic   the designer shares  emphasizing how she and seonghwa redefine modern luxury across generations 

image credit  robin galiegue   isabel marant

title: frothy micellar cleansers
texto:
frothy micellar cleansers as an alternative to cleansing micellar water products  consumers are embracing alternative formats like mousses and jellies  as well as new launches like beekman 1802 s micellar milk froth cleansing gel 

ready to use day and night  this cleansing gel foams to form a rich  latte like froth  this sensorial facial cleanser boasts a two in one formula that condenses double cleansing into a single step  ideal for melting away stubborn makeup and simultaneously supporting the skin barrier  this formula pairs millions of micelles with replenishing  mineral packed golden sea moss and goat milk saponins 

beekman 1802 s micellar milk froth cleansing gel starts a simple  three step skincare routine  followed by the brand s lightweight yet highly concentrated milk drops serum for hydration and nourishment  then the best selling bloom cream daily moisturizer

title: microbiome friendly body mists
texto:
microbiome friendly body mists fragrance products can be unsupportive to skin  especially when formulated with drying ingredients and other disruptive additives  but beekman 1802 s new alcohol free body mist sets itself apart with barrier safe ingredients 

unlike some beautifully scented body mists that can compromise the skin barrier and lead to irritation or dehydration  beekman s nourishing  softening milk shake moisturizing body mist is microbiome friendly  the bi phase formula with hero skincare hydrators like hyaluronic acid  squalane  and goat milk is close in ph to human skin so that  skin instantly recognizes it and drinks it in   when it does drink in the lightweight formula  skin is deeply supported with proteins  prebiotics  amino acids  vitamins  minerals  and more 

featuring the first ever microbiome friendly skincare ingredient certified by mymicrobiome  these body mists are available in three alluring scent experiences honey   orange blossom  lavender  and coconut cream

title: chili lime flavored mayonnaises
texto:
chili lime flavored mayonnaises hellmann s has partnered with tajín to create a new chili lime mayonnaise dressing  which combines the creamy texture of hellmann s mayonnaise with the zesty kick of tajín clásico seasoning  this dressing offers a mild heat balanced with a zesty lime flavor  making it a versatile condiment for dishes such as elote corn  veggie tacos  and more  the product contains no artificial flavors  trans fat  or cholesterol  and is an excellent source of omega 3 ala  aligning with hellmann s commitment to healthier food options 

the chili lime mayonnaise dressing is packaged in bottles made from 100  recycled plastic  reflecting hellmann s dedication to sustainability  this new offering is designed to elevate the flavor of various meals while promoting environmentally responsible packaging  the collaboration between hellmann s and tajín aims to provide consumers with a flavorful and healthier alternative to traditional mayonnaise  enhancing their culinary experiences with a touch of simplicity and sustainability 

image credit  hellmann s

title: drinkable wellness shots
texto:
drinkable wellness shots happy aging  a wellness brand known for its clinically tested ingredients  is broadening its product lineup with the introduction of two new drinkable wellness shots the  glow shot  and the  calm shot  following the success of its  nad  longevity shot   co founded by martha graeff and dr  daniel yadegar  a harvard trained functional medicine specialist  the brand aims to offer accessible wellness solutions tailored to various needs 

together  the glow shot  calm shot  and longevity shot form a comprehensive wellness approach that targets skin health  internal vitality  and emotional balance  all shots are made with  naturally derived ingredients  free from additives  sugars  preservatives  and synthetic fillers  ensuring purity and effectiveness  

the glow shot  priced at  60 for a 10 pack  supports skin hydration and elasticity with  10 000 mg of italian marine collagen and hibiscus extract while the calm shot  also  60 for a 10 pack  promotes stress relief and mental clarity with ashwagandha  l theanine  and magnesium  

image credit  happy aging

title: upcycled fruit serums
texto:
upcycled fruit serums upcircle  the award winning natural skincare brand incorporating upcycle waste ingredients into its products  launched a peptide serum with custard apple   blood orange that s clinically proven to enhance skin elasticity in two weeks of use 

this serum for boosting the production of collagen and improving the elasticity of skin gets numerous benefits from upcycled custard apple extracted from food industry grounds a hero hydrator that also comes packed with antioxidants and antimicrobial properties linked to preventing premature aging and soothing skin irritations as well as upcycled blood orange water 

the plant based skincare product for all skin types  including sensitive ones  gives new life to ingredients that would otherwise go to waste despite being abundant in soothing  skin regenerating  scar healing  and hydrating benefits

title: upcycled overnight skincare
texto:
upcycled overnight skincare the latest launch from harry styles  beauty brand is the pleasing beauty sleep mask and it shares the benefits of unique oil entrapment technology and upcycled australian tea tree oil to support softer  calmer skin by morning 

alongside upcycled tea tree oil  this mask meant to be used as the last skincare step in a nightly routine contains lavender extract from france  as well as antioxidant packed butterfly ginger plant extract  bisabolol  organic ginger extract  an encapsulated peptide  and algae extract  aromatically  the soothing sensorial formula inspires restful sleep with notes of jasmine  peach and lavender 

according to a consumer perception study conducted with 33 male and female participants  97  of subjects reported their skin looked and felt softer  smoother  and renewed after just one week of using the pleasing beauty sleep mask

title: jammy blackcurrant toothpastes
texto:
jammy blackcurrant toothpastes tiktok viral oral care brand hismile added blackcurrant toothpaste to its lineup as a special treat for members who want to continually surprise and delight their taste buds  and keep their routines feeling fresh and rewarding 

touted as a  bold  tangy flavor that s as unforgettable as irresistible   hismile blackcurrant toothpaste unites sweet and tart notes with the bold richness of ripe  jammy flavors that seem to be plucked straight from the vine  although flavor is a huge selling point  the fluoride enhanced formula delivers the smile care consumers can trust 

on instagram  hismile shared its club exclusive blackcurrant toothpaste and teased other unconventional flavors like tiramisu  tutti frutti  cherry limeade  and rainbow pebbles that may soon join the lineup

title: mystery toothpaste boxes
texto:
mystery toothpaste boxes hismile  the oral care brand known for continually surprising and delighting a new generation of consumers with unconventionally flavored toothpastes  introduced a blind box toothpaste experience to keep collections growing and taste buds enticed 

each of the brand s blind boxes contains one of eight exclusive  unreleased toothpastes  and potentially the ultra rare mystery toothpaste  although the top secret flavor remains unknown  other flavors that customers could receive in a box include purple mango  custard  vanilla cola  strawberry matcha  or guava 

these flavored toothpastes share the benefits of a fluoride enhanced formula for everyday smile care  and the blind box makes the experience of unboxing daily oral care as exciting as collecting coveted plush toys  trading cards  or other limited edition items packaged in the same style

title: collagen infused activewear leggings
texto:
collagen infused activewear leggings the collagen leggings from buff bunny are designed for both strength training and yoga  featuring a high rise waist and glute contouring back waistband to enhance the wearer s silhouette  made from a blend of collagen infused umorfil  nylon  and spandex  these leggings offer light to medium compression  promoting skin moisture and providing comfort during workouts  the top seam elastic at the back ensures a secure fit  while the absence of a front rise seam adds to the overall comfort 

available in various sizes ranging from xxs to xxxl  the collagen leggings come in multiple colors  including onyx black and mocha berry  priced at  90 cad  these leggings are designed to support and flatter the body during physical activities  making them a versatile addition to any fitness wardrobe  the use of collagen infused fabric aims to provide additional benefits for skin health  making these leggings a popular choice for fitness enthusiasts 

image credit  buff bunny

title: highly functional stools
texto:
highly functional stools the  loki stool  by dutch designer nick beens merges medieval craftsmanship with modern minimalism  offering a timeless yet contemporary seating solution  inspired by the hanseatic traditions of trade and craftsmanship from the 12th to 15th centuries  this solid ash stool celebrates raw materials and expert joinery 

at 15 7 inches  40 cm  high  the loki stool strikes the perfect balance between a traditional chair and a low stool  its stackable design makes it highly functional    ideal as a quick seat  side table  or communal meeting piece  the stool s defining feature is the central bar with a plus like detail  positioned just above the trapezoidal legs  a subtle yet striking nod to its historical inspiration 

beens  known for his thoughtful  sustainable approach to product design  ensures that every element of the loki stool reflects quality craftsmanship and functionality  whether in a home  office  or creative space  this versatile and durable piece is built to stand the test of time 

image credit  josha krijnen and simone smelt

title: focus forward timers
texto:
focus forward timers the  meti  device reimagines time management with an hourglass inspired design  helping users break free from doomscrolling while staying productive  unlike phone timers that often lead to distractions  meti is a physical  intuitive alternative that encourages focused sessions without interruptions 

m e t i isn t just another device  it s a response to the noise of modern life  designed for undivided attention  it strips away distractions    no notifications  no multitasking    just a single purpose tool to help users stay present 

the device features a dot matrix grid of lights  mimicking sand trickling in an hourglass  a scroll wheel sets the timer  turning habitual scrolling into a productive action  its smartphone integration allows pairing via a shaking motion  letting users track focus sessions without unlocking their screens 

the name m e t i  a fusion of  mind  and  time   symbolizes mental clarity and purposeful moments  by blending analog simplicity with digital connectivity  meti transforms productivity into an enriching experience 

image credit  æhd   lab

title: americanized australian burger chains
texto:
americanized australian burger chains hello harry  hh  has arrived in north adelaide  replacing the old chuck wagon building with a fresh take on american style burgers  founded a decade ago by two hat chef tony kelly  hh draws inspiration from his u s  travels  blending fast food flavors with fine dining techniques  the menu features signature burgers on custom made buns crafted exclusively for hh by a private baker 

  kelly  came up with the concept of making american food using fine dining techniques and approach   explained restaurant manager ravi singh 

for those with a sweet tooth   harry s famous dessert bombs  offer a unique twist flash fried burger buns rolled in cinnamon  filled with ice cream  and topped with strawberry  nutella  or salted caramel  with its dedication to quality ingredients and bold flavors  hello harry is set to become a must visit for adelaide food lovers 

image credit  hello harry

title: low alcohol ipa s
texto:
low alcohol ipa s  rebel ipa  is the latest addition to tiny rebel s craft beer portfolio  offering a crisp  smooth drinking experience with citrus undertones  this gluten free  vegan friendly session ipa sits at 4 3  abv  making it the perfect option for those who want a lower alcohol brew without sacrificing bold flavor 

crafted at tiny rebel s brewery in rogerstone  wales  rebel ipa launched on january 31  strategically closing out dry january with a celebratory twist  the brand partnered with select fuller s pubs in london and birmingham to offer free pints  tapping into research showing that while a quarter of brits attempt dry january  63  don t make it to the end 

 rebel ipa is the antidote for those ready to rebel together and celebrate with a pint   says tiny rebel co founder brad cummings  with cans hitting supermarket shelves nationwide in march  this latest release solidifies tiny rebel s commitment to delivering big flavor perfect for any occasion 

image credit  tiny rebel

title: performance driven air purifies
texto:
performance driven air purifies the newly upgraded mila air 3 incorporates a new motor from nidec and a custom engineered fan  this new iteration retains the sleek  modern design the brand is known for while offering improved functionality 

the nidec motor ensures long lasting reliability  making the mila air 3 capable of enduring 4 7 billion revolutions at maximum speed  this is equivalent to running a car for over six miles  the addition of a quieter  more efficient fan further elevates the user experience as it guarantees better airflow with less noise 

along with these technical advancements  the mila air 3 offers the same level of powerful air purification that mila fans have come to expect  the silhouette  however  is more compact and can be seamlessly integrated into any modern interior setting  despite being smaller in size  the mila air 3 can efficiently handle larger spaces and offers impressive filtration capabilities  including hepa filters and a robust odor and voc removal system 

image credit  mila air

title: french aviator inspired urban collections
texto:
french aviator inspired urban collections for fall winter 2025  côte ciel draws inspiration from the life and work of antoine de saint exupéry  a french aviator and philosopher  the collection is named stratus  and it continues the brand s exploration of texture and form 

the silhouettes incorporate aviation elements while maintaining a balance of fluidity and structure  signature pieces like the orne and hyco s retain their bomber jacket inspired details  while new additions  such as the minho weekender duffle and the yalu backpack  emphasize innovation in both texture and form  notably  the uva crossbody offers adaptable versatility 

côte ciel utilized innovative and performance driven fabrics in its antoine de saint exupéry inspired capsule  the carbon  onyx  and cargo green nylons offer both elegance and durability while also delivering water resistance  this collection is sure to appeal to consumers who appreciate sleek  functional designs with a nod to aviation and exploration 

image credit  côte ciel

title: portable water filtration systems
texto:
portable water filtration systems sawyer has teamed up with cnoc outdoors to create a powerful and portable water filtration system that is ideal for outdoor activities such as hiking  camping  and emergency preparedness  the sawyer squeeze water filtration system is now paired with the cnoc vecto two litre bladder to ensure a highly efficient solution for clean drinking water in the field  this system utilizes sawyer s 0 1 micron absolute hollow fiber membrane filter  which effectively removes harmful bacteria  protozoa  and microplastics  the bladder itself is bpa free and durable 

the sawyer x cnoc outdoors portable water filtration system boasts a long lasting design  which includes a cleaning coupling and plunger for easy maintenance  the product guarantees up to 100 000 gallons of filtered water  making it a sustainable choice for long term use 

image credit  sawyer x cnoc outdoors

title: milk protein haircare collections
texto:
milk protein haircare collections milk_shake  is enriching its highly successful incredible haircare line with two new products   the incredible serum and incredible oil  both of these are designed to complement the original incredible milk leave in treatment  a product that has earned a reputation for its ability to soften hair  enhance shine  and prevent split ends 

the new incredible haircare line products offer targeted solutions to further elevate haircare routines  the incredible serum   which is formulated with milk proteins  hyaluronic acid  and caffeine   focuses on scalp health and follicle fortification  while the incredible oil  which is enriched with argan oil and sunflower seed oil  provides deep hydration and shine 

with an emphasis on milk proteins  fruit extracts  and precious oils  the incredible serum and incredible oil cater to a broad audience by offering lightweight  non greasy solutions suitable for various hair types 

image credit  milk_shake

title: balanced diet focused partnerships
texto:
balanced diet focused partnerships siggi s yogurt has announced a partnership with fitness instructor and wellness expert emma lovewell  who will serve as the brand s first chief live well offiskyr  this collaboration aims to promote a balanced approach to health through practical wellness tips and advice  these resources will be available for free throughout the year on a newly launched wellness hub 

with a philosophy centered on simplicity and balance  emma lovewell will provide resources such as recipes  health hacks  and mindfulness tips to help individuals build achievable  sustainable wellness routines without feeling overwhelmed  siggi s  known for its high protein yogurt made with simple ingredients  is positioning itself as an advocate for accessible health and wellness by partnering with emma lovewell 

image credit  siggi s yogurt

title: romance driven lingerie collections
texto:
romance driven lingerie collections boohoo s latest lingerie collection   which is aptly titled  let s talk about love    offers a blend of romance  sophistication  and sultry charm  launched just in time for valentine s day  the line combines delicate lace bodysuits  sheer baby doll dresses  and bold prints such as cheetah  the silhouettes expertly balance playful femininity with seductive appeal  designed to evoke confidence  the collection emphasizes self expression and empowerment through lingerie that makes a statement 

boohoo s let s talk about love capsule is inclusive in sizing and aims to cater to a diverse range of body types  according to the brand  its offerings are also made available at an affordable price point to ensure that modern luxury lingerie doesn t break the bank 

image credit  boohoo

title: small pet dietary resources
texto:
small pet dietary resources the ontario hamster club website provides a comprehensive guide on safe and unsafe foods for hamsters  the guide emphasizes the importance of understanding hamsters  unique nutritional needs  which differ from those of dogs and cats  it categorizes foods into safe fruits  vegetables  proteins  and miscellaneous items  while also highlighting foods that are controversial or dangerous  the website advises owners to use the size of a hamster s ear as a portion guide when feeding fresh foods 

additionally  the guide includes a food safety chart and peer reviewed scientific documents to support the classification of certain foods as safe or unsafe  it also cautions against using certain types of bedding and treats that can pose health risks to hamsters  the ontario hamster club encourages owners to provide a varied diet that includes high quality mixes and lab blocks  ensuring that hamsters have access to fresh fruits and vegetables regularly 

image credit  shutterstock

title: informative pet dietary resources
texto:
informative pet dietary resources can i give my dog  is a comprehensive resource designed to help dog owners determine the safety of various foods and medications for their pets  the website provides practical advice on a wide range of topics  including what human foods are safe for dogs to consume and which ones should be avoided  it aims to offer reliable information to ensure that dog owners can make informed decisions about their pets  diets and health care 

the website hosts a vast amount of information on different foods and medications for dogs  it collaborates with veterinarians  such as dr  laura seabolt  who contribute their expertise to help dog owners provide the best care for their pets  the site emphasizes the importance of consulting with a veterinarian before introducing new foods or medications to a dog s diet  as individual dogs may have specific health needs and sensitivities 

image credit  can i give my dog

title: low volume ski boot designs
texto:
low volume ski boot designs the k2 cortex collection introduces a new line of low volume ski boots designed to cater to freeride athletes and those seeking a more performance oriented fit  featuring the zonal boa  fit system  these boots stand out for their use of two boa dials   one on the lower foot and one on the cuff  this dual dial configuration ensures precise  customized fitting with micro adjustable precision  as such  the boot designs ensure a snug fit with reduced pressure points  this is enhanced by a low volume fit  which is ideal for individuals with narrower feet 

the k2 cortex collection includes additional technologies aimed at improving both comfort and performance  the fast fit instep allows for easy entry and exit even in harsh  cold conditions  while the bolted rear cuff ensures superior support and can be customized for different flex preferences  for added traction  the gripwalk soles provide superior grip  and the boots come with replaceable soles for better versatility 

image credit  k2

title: expressively functional furniture designs
texto:
expressively functional furniture designs friends   founders  a danish swedish design company established in 2013  continues to explore contemporary aesthetics with a focus on individuality and innovation  the brand s latest collection expands on its commitment to functional yet expressive design  featuring a range of sofas  lounge chairs  and tables that blend nordic simplicity with timeless elegance 

friends   founders  femme collection  for example  introduces sofas and chairs that embrace modularity and adaptability  this makes them suitable for both residential and commercial interiors  with clean lines and a refined aesthetic  these pieces emphasize comfort without compromising on sophistication  the collection also includes the evoke table  a contemporary take on traditional scandinavian woodworking  additionally  friends   founders has released a new edition of the novel chair  now available in astrid fabric with premium aniline leather from sørensen leather 

image credit  friends   founders

title: handcrafted rustic pillow covers
texto:

title: after sun cooling mists
texto:

as a brand known for suncare innovation  australian gold has built a reputation for incorporating nourishing  skin friendly ingredients into its products  the after sun cooling mist extends this dedication by offering post sun care that helps maintain hydrated  refreshed skin  consumers seeking a convenient  dermatologist tested after sun solution may find this mist appealing

title: health focused meal planning programs
texto:
health focused meal planning programs epicure s new good food  real results  program introduces a structured approach to meal planning and supplementation  designed to help individuals achieve their health and wellness goals  the initiative includes a four week meal plan that boasts a collection of portion controlled recipes  grocery lists  and dietary guidance developed with input from registered dietitians 

epicure s good food  real results  aims to support those seeking sustainable weight loss while emphasizing balanced nutrition  a key aspect of the program is its focus on the dietary needs of individuals using glp 1 medications like ozempic  which can suppress appetite and lead to nutritional deficiencies  to address this  epicure has launched two new dietary supplements  the power up whole food multivitamin and power up cal d  these formulations are intended to support energy levels  bone health  and muscle function

title: richly layered fragrances
texto:
richly layered fragrances  dave  by henry rose is a contemporary vanilla fragrance that balances warmth and depth  crafted by perfumer pascal gaurin  dave is a richly layered scent that unfolds with notes of whipped vanilla bean chantilly blended with salted upcycled cocoa shell  and indulgent tonka bean absolute  creating a warm and lingering finish

title: micro spicule beauty technology
texto:

modern golfer footwear designs asics  japan s  golf shoe is a modern  versatile footwear option designed for golfers seeking a combination of style  comfort  and performance  drawing inspiration from the brand s 1981 heritage  these spikeless shoes feature premium materials for durability and a sleek design that transitions easily from the course to social settings

title: symphony orchestras focused equity initiatives
texto:
symphony orchestras focused equity initiatives the black orchestral network has introduced the model standards and procedures for probationary periods in collaboration with the american federation of musicians  this initiative marks a pivotal step toward creating equitable and transparent practices in symphony orchestras  the model standards provide orchestras with a template to implement fair and consistent tenure processes  which have been problematic for a long time 

by addressing the power imbalances that often occur in probationary periods  these standards aim to ensure that musicians are evaluated on merit rather than bias  several prominent orchestras  including the new york philharmonic and cincinnati symphony  have already embraced the black orchestral network s recommendations  the organization s work offers orchestras a tangible resource to advance fairness  making it an essential tool for any organization committed to fostering equity and transparency in its operations

title: sustainable landscape architecture services
texto:

title: childhood literacy promoting initiatives
texto:
childhood literacy promoting initiatives international paper supports childhood literacy by renewing its partnership with champions for literacy  as a signature partner  the company sponsors the fight for literacy games  a national program that utilizes collegiate sports to raise awareness and funds for childhood reading initiatives  these funds support childhood literacy efforts for students in early education  particularly those in underserved communities  through grants for tutoring  summer camps  and reading materials 

the collaboration with champions for literacy highlights international paper s commitment to community engagement and its belief in the importance of literacy as a foundation for future success  jason baker  executive director at champions for literacy  highlights the importance of the initiative   third grade reading level is a powerful predictor of high school graduation and career building  regardless of zip code  if a kid is reading on grade level by the end of third grade  there is an 89  chance they will complete high school and embark on a career  it s hard to find another cause that transcends economics in that manner
